jobs.description:
The Team Lead for the Compliance Monitoring, Assurance & Testing (CMAT) team is responsible for designing and running Binance ADGM's independent, risk-based compliance monitoring and assurance programme. The role assures the Board, Senior Management and the FSRA that the firm's AML/CFT, market conduct, client-asset, and prudential controls are operating effectively and remain compliant with the ADGM Financial Services Regulatory Authority (FSRA) rulebooks and applicable UAE federal requirements.

This is a senior second-line-of-defence leadership role accountable for the disciplined testing of controls, timely escalation of findings, and evidence-based regulatory reporting that stands up to FSRA supervisory scrutiny.

lists.content:
Compliance Monitoring & Testing Programme

  • Own and maintain a risk-based annual Compliance Monitoring & Assurance Plan (CMAP), refreshed on risk assessment outcomes, FSRA thematic reviews, and changes in regulatory posture.

  • Design and execute control testing across AML/CFT, sanctions, market abuse, client-asset safeguarding, complaint handling, outsourcing, and technology/cyber governance.

  • Apply full-cycle assurance methodology: scoping → walkthroughs → sampling → testing → root-cause analysis → findings rating → remediation tracking → closure validation.

  • Deliver thematic deep-dives aligned to FSRA supervisory priorities (e.g., transaction monitoring effectiveness, Travel Rule compliance, EDD for high-risk clients, market abuse surveillance).

    • Regulatory Alignment (FSRA)

  • Ensure monitoring activities map to the FSRA AML/CFT Rulebook, Conduct of Business (COBS), General (GEN), Prudential (PRU), and Virtual Asset framework obligations.

  • Support the Compliance Officer and MLRO in demonstrating effective oversight under FSRA's risk-based supervision model.

  • Maintain evidence trails that satisfy FSRA information requests, on-site inspections, and thematic reviews.

  • Monitor regulatory change (FSRA consultations, ADGM notices, UAE Federal Decree-Law 20/2018 and its Executive Regulations, MoE/EO AML guidance) and reflect updates in the plan.

    • Findings, Reporting & Escalation

  • Produce clear, board-ready assurance reports with quantified findings, severity ratings, and management action plans.

  • Operate a robust issue-management and remediation-tracking framework with escalation protocols for overdue or high-risk items.

  • Present monitoring results to Risk Committees, Compliance Committees, and where required the Board/Audit Committee.

  • Liaise with Internal Audit and external auditors to ensure complementary (non-duplicative) coverage.

    • AML/CFT & Financial Crime Assurance

  • Test the effectiveness of CDD/EDD, KYC onboarding, periodic review, PEP/sanctions screening, transaction monitoring, and SAR/STR escalation processes.

  • Assess suspicious activity identification and reporting effectiveness, including FIU-UAE submission quality.

  • Verify Targeted Financial Sanctions (TFS) and asset-freeze controls.

    • Leadership & Team Management

  • Build, mentor, and lead a high-performing assurance team — setting testing standards, quality review, and coaching.

  • Foster a culture of challenge, professional scepticism, and integrity, consistent with SMCR conduct expectations.

  • Manage resource allocation against the CMAP and ensure delivery within agreed SLAs.

    • Governance & Continuous Improvement

  • Maintain CMAT policies, methodologies, and documentation to an auditable standard.

  • Drive automation and data analytics to strengthen monitoring coverage and efficiency.

  • Embed lessons learned into first- and second-line processes and training.

Essential

  • 7–10+ years in compliance, assurance, internal audit, or regulatory supervision within financial services, fintech, preferably within crypto/VASP environments.

  • 3+ years leading teams or workstreams in a second-line or audit function.

  • Strong working knowledge of ADGM FSRA rulebooks and the UAE AML/CFT landscape; comparable MAS, HKMA, FCA, or DIFC/DFSA experience will be considered.

  • Proven track record designing and executing risk-based compliance monitoring/testing programmes.

  • Depth in AML/CFT, sanctions, and financial-crime control testing.

  • Excellent written and verbal English; strong report-writing and stakeholder-presentation skills.

    • Desirable

  • CAMS, CGSS, CRMA, CIA, ACCA/ACA, ICA, or equivalent certification 

  • Prior experience in a regulated crypto/VASP or high-growth fintech.

  • Data analytics, SQL, or audit-automation tooling skills.

  • Arabic language proficiency (advantageous, not required).

As the TradFi PMO at Binance, you will own end-to-end delivery of the next phase of our Traditional Finance (TradFi) expansion; a strategic, P0 program extending the firm's offering beyond digital assets. You will drive a portfolio of initiatives spanning new TradFi product lines, new markets and regions, and external data and infrastructure partnerships. You will orchestrate product, engineering, risk, legal, compliance, and finance across multiple workstreams and jurisdictions, keeping a single integrated plan, clear accountability, and executive-level visibility from roadmap to launch.

lists.content:
• Own the integrated program plan for the TradFi roadmap, maintaining milestones, critical path, and cross-workstream dependencies across all initiatives in the portfolio.

  • Run the PMO operating cadence: weekly workstream reviews, executive steering committees, and crisp status reporting (RAID logs, scorecards, launch readiness) for senior leadership.

  • Drive market-expansion workstreams across multiple regions — coordinating regulatory and licensing readiness, localization, and launch sequencing with legal, compliance, and regional teams.

  • Own the vendor and partner workstream: sourcing, onboarding, and managing the external market-data and infrastructure partners required for the TradFi stack.

  • Define launch-readiness criteria and go/no-go gates; coordinate phased rollouts and post-launch retrospectives with product and engineering.

  • Identify critical-path risks and blockers early; escalate and drive resolution with workstream owners across product, engineering, risk, legal, and finance.

  • Maintain a competitive-intelligence view of the TradFi landscape to inform roadmap prioritization and sequencing.

  • Standardize PMO tooling and reporting (OKRs, KPIs, dashboards) so program health is visible at a glance across the portfolio.

• Bachelor's degree in Finance, Economics, Business, Engineering, or a related field; MBA, PMP, or CFA preferred.

  • Project management experience at a broker-dealer, exchange, fintech, investment bank, or management consultancy, with a track record of delivering trading, market-data, or brokerage products or large-scale financial-services programs.

  • Solid understanding of TradFi market structure and products across asset classes.

  • Experience coordinating multi-jurisdiction launches and working with regulated workflows (licensing, compliance, and partner agreements).

  • Exceptional executive communication skills — able to synthesize complex, multi-workstream programs into clear steering materials.

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills; comfortable making trade-off calls under ambiguity.

  • Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, high-velocity, crypto-native environment.


    • Preferred Skills:

  • Prior experience at a global brokerage or exchange; direct knowledge of the competitive TradFi landscape is a strong plus.

  • Familiarity with crypto assets, tokenization, and digital-asset trading.

  • Working knowledge of regulatory regimes across key global markets.

Built by the world's largest digital asset exchange by trading volume, Binance VIP and Institutional offers access to digital asset solutions for VIP clients and institutions. We work closely with a wide range of market participants, including individual traders, high-frequency trading (HFT) and proprietary trading firms, hedge funds, asset managers and family offices, market makers and brokers, investment banks, and more. Join us to be part of a team that provides top-tier services to the most influential players in the crypto industry.
 
Our team serves the most sophisticated trading users and participants in the trading and investment industry and we offer you an opportunity to build your portfolio of clients alongside Binance and amongst top colleagues. Work remotely in a global team that covers all parts of the world, where you will get to travel and meet and attract your clients at bespoke events. If you thrive in a fast paced and high pressure environment, we encourage you to apply in!

About the role
We are looking for a motivated and bilingual Intern (Accelerator) to join our VIP team covering the SEA market. This is a hybrid role combining Key Account Coverage (KAC) - providing dedicated client service to existing VIP clients and Sales - driving new VIP onboarding and market acquisition.
This role sits within the Binance Accelerator Program, meaning you'll be doing real, hands-on work from day one. You'll be the on-the-ground presence in SEA, supporting our VIP client base while actively identifying and onboarding new high-value traders.

About the role
We are looking for a motivated and bilingual sales person to join our VIP team covering the SEA market. This is a hybrid role combining Key Account Coverage (KAC) - providing dedicated client service to existing VIP clients and Sales - driving new VIP onboarding and market acquisition.
You'll be the on-the-ground presence in SEA, supporting our VIP client base while actively identifying and onboarding new high-value traders.
There will be a clear target on new business — you will be measured on both client service quality and new VIP onboarding performance.

lists.content:
Key Account Coverage (Client Services)
  • Build and maintain trusted relationships with a portfolio of existing VIP clients in SEA.
  • Act as the primary point of contact for day-to-day client queries, issue resolution, and product support.
  • Analyse user behaviour and trading patterns to identify upsell opportunities and hidden client needs.
  • Coordinate with internal teams (Compliance, Product, Security) to ensure smooth client servicing.
  • Prepare client analysis reports and track the status of key accounts.
    •  
    Sales & Business Development
  • Identify, prospect, and onboard new VIP clients from the SEA market with clear KPIs on new business acquisition.
  • Conduct outreach via LinkedIn, local communities, and existing networks to build a pipeline of potential VIP traders.
  • Support the planning and execution of local VIP events (dinners, meetups, anniversary events).
  • Prepare pitch materials, market updates, and competitive comparisons for client meetings. 
  • Monitor competitor activity and flag relevant market intelligence to the team.
    • Market Coverage
  • Serve as the local eyes and ears on the ground in SEA, providing regular market feedback to the broader APAC team.
  • Support regional initiatives across APAC where needed (e.g., ANZ events, cross-market campaigns)

• Degree in Finance, Economics, Commerce, Statistics, Mathematics, or a quantitative trading-related field (candidates with relevant industry experience in lieu of a degree are also welcome).
  • Fluency in English is required to be able to coordinate with overseas partners and stakeholders. Additional languages would be an advantage.
  • Solid understanding of cryptocurrency, macroeconomics, and financial trading concepts
  • Strong communication, relationship-building, and problem-solving abilities; comfortable working independently in a fast-paced environment.
  • Proficient with data tools/spreadsheets; familiarity with CRM systems is a plus

    • Nice to Have

  • Existing network of crypto/stock traders who are potential VIP clients - particularly valuable if network includes quant trading or mathematical finance communities
  • Personal exposure to trading (stocks, crypto, ETFs, or other financial instruments)
  • Prior experience (or internship) in finance, technical sales, research, or client services
  • Understanding of the local crypto trading community and market dynamics
    •

Wallet Management:

  • Crypto wallet product owner role, offer industry wide leading CEX crypto deposit withdraw safekeep service.
  • Oversee daily operations of exchange wallets, including deposits, withdrawals.
  • Monitor blockchain transactions to ensure timely processing and resolve delays or failures
  • Maintain operational uptime of exchange wallets
  • Coordinate and complete network upgrades, token events and testing with no issues

    • Risk Mitigation & Compliance:

    • Business Growth

• 5+ years in crypto wallet operations, blockchain infrastructure, or a related role
  • 8+ years of experience in Product/Operations Management
  • Familiarity with various blockchain technologies notwithstanding EVM, Polkadot, Cosmos, etc. 
  • Familiarity with on-chain analysis tools, DeFi protocols, and new projects
  • Familiarity with wallet infrastructure such as nodes, signing services and wallet custody models (Hardware wallet, MPC, HSM, KSM, Embedded Custody) 
  • Excellent problem-solving and communication skills
  • Ability to stay calm in pressure situations and make clear decisions with thorough impact analysis
  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, 24/7 crypto environment, passionate and self starter
  • Tradfi experience in Issuer Services & Custody is a plus

Role Overview

Responsible for end-to-end quality assurance across Web and App (mobile) surfaces — combining automated and exploratory testing to ensure product stability, compatibility, and interaction experience from the user's perspective. The core requirement is cross-platform testing capability (Web + App), with the ability to design and maintain an automated testing system and to think deeply about troubleshooting and user-experience-oriented quality.

In one sentence: This role is the quality gatekeeper for Web/App products — someone who can write automation scripts, test interaction experiences, investigate data issues, and use engineering methods to replace manual testing with systematic automated quality coverage. Not a manual tester — a QA engineer with real coding ability.

lists.content:
• Design and maintain comprehensive Web/App test cases and test plans covering functionality, compatibility, and interaction
  • Develop and maintain UI/API automated tests using Java, Python, or JavaScript to ensure high coverage and reliability
  • Combine automation and manual exploratory testing to validate user scenarios and discover potential experience issues
  • Perform root cause analysis on test failures and production issues, and drive fixes to closure
  • Identify blind spots in test coverage and continuously improve automation effectiveness
  • Participate in testing for new features — define expected behaviors, system impact, and risk points from a user-experience perspective
  • Conduct App compatibility testing across devices, OS versions, and screen sizes, as well as Web cross-browser and cross-resolution testing
  • Participate in performance testing (page load time, App cold start / warm start, etc.) and ensure stability under high-concurrency and weak-network scenarios

• Strong coding ability in at least one of Java, Python, or JavaScript (live coding assessment required)
  • Extensive Web/App automation testing experience with tools such as Selenium, Appium, Playwright, etc.
  • Solid understanding of Web/App testing methodologies and automation framework design
  • Proficiency in SQL for data validation and issue troubleshooting
  • Proven root cause analysis ability to solve complex quality problems
  • Familiarity with Web front-end technologies (HTML/CSS/JS) and mobile platform fundamentals (Android/iOS architecture and characteristics)
  • Experience building testing tools, platforms, or quality infrastructure

Background:

  • 1–5 years of QA or test development experience, including at least 1 year of Web or App automation testing
  • Strong coding skills — able to write code from scratch, not just scripts
  • Proficient in SQL for independent data validation and troubleshooting
  • Hands-on mobile or Web testing experience
    • Core Competencies:
  • Automation capability: Can design and develop automation frameworks, not just use existing tools
  • Root cause analysis: Can trace test failures or production issues back to their root cause
  • SQL & data validation: Can write complex SQL to verify data consistency and troubleshoot data-related bugs
  • Cross-platform understanding: Understands Web/App architecture, including front-end/back-end interaction, network requests, cache mechanisms, and WebView
  • UX sensitivity: Can identify experience issues from the user's perspective, not just whether functionality works
  • Test tooling: Experience building test platforms, tools, or quality infrastructure
  • Collaboration drive: Can push developers to fix issues rather than passively waiting

    • Soft Skills:

  • Rigorous and detail-oriented
  • "Destructive thinking" mindset — adept at finding system weaknesses
  • Strong communication — bridges developers and product managers
  • Quality ownership mentality — treats quality as personal responsibility

• Payment, transaction, or financial system QA experience
  • AI tooling usage experience
  • Crypto / Web3 industry background

jobs.title: Senior Brand Designer
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Us

Circle is building the world’s leading AI-powered, all-in-one platform for digital businesses. We make it possible for creators, coaches, educators, and businesses to bring together their audience with engaging discussions, live streams, events, chat, courses, and payments — all in one place, all under their own brand.

We’re proud to be a fully remote company of around 270 (and growing!) team members from 30+ countries around the world. We seek exceptional individuals around the world, set them up to do the best work of their lives, and in turn, create a meaningful impact in their own lives. We don't track hours, but we do manage for high expectations very closely. We collaborate across time zones, are highly async, and like to document a lot.

Twice a year, we bring the whole company together in beautiful places around the world for our company offsites. So far, we’ve hosted offsites in Turkey, Portugal, Mexico, Thailand, Colombia, Italy, Ireland, and more, with still more to come!

Check out our Careers page for more about working at Circle.

About the role

As a Senior Brand Designer at Circle, you'll play a key role in shaping one of our most valuable assets—our brand.

This role sits within our Design Studio team—the creative engine behind all of Circle's marketing design—and focuses on evolving how Circle looks, feels, and communicates across every customer touchpoint. From product launches and campaigns to events, advertising, social, motion, and visual identity systems, you'll help create a brand that's instantly recognizable and impossible to ignore.

We're looking for someone with exceptional visual craft, outstanding creative taste, and experience building brands for modern software, AI, or technology companies. You understand how to communicate complex products through clear, compelling visual storytelling, creating work that's both strategically effective and visually memorable.

You'll think beyond individual assets, building scalable visual systems while constantly pushing the brand forward. Working closely with Marketing, Product Marketing, Motion, Content, and Leadership, you'll help define how Circle shows up to the world.

We're building a brand that stands alongside the very best in technology—not just one that's functional, but one that's instantly recognizable, culturally relevant, and sets the standard for modern software companies.

What you'll be doing

  • Help define and evolve Circle's visual identity across every customer-facing touchpoint.

  • Lead the creative direction for major product launches, campaigns, announcements, and strategic initiatives.

  • Design scalable brand systems that work across web, social, paid advertising, events, presentations, email, video, and product marketing.

  • Develop compelling visual narratives for new product launches, translating complex software and AI capabilities into simple, engaging brand experiences.

  • Create campaign identities, illustrations, iconography, graphics, presentations, and launch assets that elevate the Circle brand.

  • Develop storyboards and creative concepts for launch videos, motion pieces, and product announcements, collaborating closely with motion designers throughout production.

  • Partner with Product Marketing, Content, Motion, and Leadership to define the visual direction for major company moments.

  • Build reusable brand systems, templates, and creative frameworks that improve consistency and speed across the company.

  • Continuously evolve Circle's design language by researching emerging trends across branding, AI, motion, and digital design.

  • Present creative concepts confidently, communicate design rationale, and iterate based on feedback.

  • Maintain exceptional attention to detail, ensuring every asset reflects the quality expected from the Circle brand.

  • Research emerging AI-powered creative tools and identify opportunities to improve our design workflows.

What you'll need to be successful

  • Strong alignment with our values (find them on our Careers page if you haven't already).

  • You are proficient in English (spoken, written, and reading) at a CEFR Level C2 / ILR Level 5.

  • 5+ years of experience as a Brand Designer, Visual Designer within software, AI, or technology companies.

  • A portfolio demonstrating exceptional brand design across campaigns, product launches, visual identities, and digital experiences.

  • Experience building and evolving brands for modern software companies, with a strong understanding of how to communicate complex products through simple, engaging design.

  • Strong understanding of SaaS, AI, and technology design trends, with an eye for where modern brands are heading—not just where they are today.

  • Experience developing creative concepts and storyboards for product launches, brand films, motion graphics, or campaign videos.

  • Experience collaborating closely with motion designers and understanding how static design translates into animation and storytelling.

  • Exceptional typography, composition, colour, layout, and visual storytelling skills.

  • Advanced proficiency in Figma and Adobe Creative Suite.

  • Strong understanding of scalable design systems and visual identity frameworks.

  • Excellent communication skills—you can confidently present ideas, explain creative decisions, and collaborate asynchronously across teams.

  • Highly organised, proactive, and comfortable managing multiple creative projects simultaneously.

  • Curiosity around AI-powered creative workflows and excitement to experiment with emerging technologies.

  • You obsess over craft and sweat every detail, while always thinking about the bigger picture—how every asset contributes to building a memorable, category-defining brand.

 

Compensation & benefits

Circle offers U.S.-benchmarked compensation globally, equity in the company with ongoing refresh grants, and 35 days of paid time off each year.

We’re a remote-only team that comes together twice a year for company retreats in incredible destinations around the world. Alongside incredible flexibility and autonomy, we offer a benefits package that supports health, wellbeing, and professional growth. Learn more in our Candidate Hub.

 

Learn more

  • Candidate Safety & Interview Process Notice

  • Diversity, Equity & Inclusion

  • How We Use Candidate Data

  • Equal Employment Opportunity

  • Visit our Candidate Hub to learn more about working at Circle, our benefits, and our hiring process.

jobs.title: Social Media Lead
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Us

Circle is building the world’s leading AI-powered, all-in-one platform for digital businesses. We make it possible for creators, coaches, educators, and businesses to bring together their audience with engaging discussions, live streams, events, chat, courses, and payments — all in one place, all under their own brand.

We’re proud to be a fully remote company of around 270 (and growing!) team members from 30+ countries around the world. We seek exceptional individuals around the world, set them up to do the best work of their lives, and in turn, create a meaningful impact in their own lives. We don't track hours, but we do manage for high expectations very closely. We collaborate across time zones, are highly async, and like to document a lot.

Twice a year, we bring the whole company together in beautiful places around the world for our company offsites. So far, we’ve hosted offsites in Turkey, Portugal, Mexico, Thailand, Colombia, Italy, Ireland, and more, with still more to come!

Check out our Careers page for more about working at Circle.

About the Role

We’re hiring a Social Media Lead to help build Circle’s social and media function from the ground up. Circle has one of the most interesting brands in the creator economy, but our social accounts don’t yet reflect the strength of the brand or reach the audience they should. This role is a chance to help change that — turning strong ideas, customer stories, partner moments, and long-form content into social content people actually want to watch and share. You’ll help build the engine: creating the content, supporting the strategy, and helping establish the rhythm and systems that make strong output repeatable. Reporting to our VP of Partnerships and Creator Growth, you’ll work closely with our founders and leadership team, as well as teammates across Community, Events, Product Marketing, Partnerships, and our Design Studio, to help Circle show up on social with more clarity, consistency, and ambition.

This is a remote role, which requires travel up to 25% of the time.

What you'll be doing

  • Execute Circle’s social content strategy across channels, helping translate direction into strong, platform-native output.

  • Produce and publish social-first content with a strong emphasis on short-form video.

  • Edit video independently, including cutting clips, shaping hooks, writing captions, and packaging content for distribution.

  • Build and maintain the content operating rhythm, including calendar management, capture workflows, and coordination across teams.

  • Partner with leadership and other stakeholders to identify content opportunities tied to partnerships, events, community, and customer stories.

  • Collaborate on longer-form content development so shoots are designed with short-form distribution in mind from the start.

  • Attend Circle’s events and key moments to capture content and support Circle’s presence on social (this role will require travel up to 25% of the time).

  • Track leading indicators like non-follower reach, watch-through, saves, shares, and cadence consistency, and use them to improve execution over time.

  • Bring practical recommendations on formats, workflows, and content opportunities based on what’s working.

What you'll need to be successful

  • Experience creating content for a tech, SaaS, creator economy, or community-led brand, with a clear understanding of how those audiences engage with social content.

  • Video editing and production skills, including the ability to work independently in Adobe Premiere or a comparable professional editing tool to create polished short-form content quickly.

  • Deep fluency across platforms like Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, and LinkedIn, with a solid grasp of what each platform is rewarding and how non-follower reach compounds over time.

  • A clear point of view on what earns attention on social, with the ability to identify what’s working, what isn’t, and why.

  • Awareness of the social and creator economy landscape, including fluency in how brands in our space are showing up today and what separates the ones that break through.

  • Comfort being on camera when needed and capturing content independently in a fully remote environment.

  • Operational instincts and the ability to build repeatable systems for planning, capture, and cross-functional coordination.

  • Good judgment in cross-functional environments, with a clear understanding of how to support a long-term social strategy centered on non-follower reach and the ability to recognize when requests may conflict with those goals.

  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills in English (CEFR C2 or equivalent), as most collaboration at Circle happens asynchronously.

 

Compensation & benefits

Circle offers U.S.-benchmarked compensation globally, equity in the company, 35 days of paid time off each year, and more.

We’re a remote-only team that comes together twice a year for company retreats in incredible destinations around the world. Alongside incredible flexibility and autonomy, we offer a benefits package that supports health, wellbeing, and professional growth. Learn more in our Candidate Hub.

 

Learn more

  • Candidate Safety & Interview Process Notice

  • Diversity, Equity & Inclusion

  • How We Use Candidate Data

  • Equal Employment Opportunity

  • Visit our Candidate Hub to learn more about working at Circle, our benefits, and our hiring process.

jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Us

Circle is building the world’s leading AI-powered, all-in-one platform for digital businesses. We make it possible for creators, coaches, educators, and businesses to bring together their audience with engaging discussions, live streams, events, chat, courses, and payments — all in one place, all under their own brand.

We’re proud to be a fully remote company of around 270 (and growing!) team members from 30+ countries around the world. We seek exceptional individuals around the world, set them up to do the best work of their lives, and in turn, create a meaningful impact in their own lives. We don't track hours, but we do manage for high expectations very closely. We collaborate across time zones, are highly async, and like to document a lot.

Twice a year, we bring the whole company together in beautiful places around the world for our company offsites. So far, we’ve hosted offsites in Turkey, Portugal, Mexico, Thailand, Colombia, Italy, Ireland, and more, with still more to come!

Check out our Careers page for more about working at Circle.

About the role

You’ll own design for one of Circle’s most important product areas. That means you define the problem, shape the direction, and ship the experience—not wait for a brief. The specific area will be determined based on your strengths and company priorities.

You’ll report into the product design organization and work as the most senior design IC on your product area, partnering directly with product managers, engineers, and design leadership. You’ll also work alongside other Leads across Circle’s product surface. As the team grows, you’ll be expected to raise the bar for the designers around you.

AI is not a section on this job description—it’s how we work. Circle’s design team builds with AI tools daily: exploring product directions, prototyping with code-generation tools, stress-testing ideas faster than traditional workflows allow. We’re looking for someone who already works this way and wants to push it further.

What you'll be doing

  • Own a product area end-to-end: identify opportunities, frame the problem, set design direction, and ship—operating as a peer to Product and Engineering, not a downstream executor

  • Design complex, multi-step product flows that serve multiple user types—balancing creator needs against member experience, and making sophisticated behavior feel simple

  • Prototype and test at speed—using AI-assisted tools, code-generation workflows, and whatever gets you to a testable concept fastest

  • Influence product strategy beyond your own surface: contribute to roadmap conversations, flag opportunities other teams miss, and connect dots across the product

  • Drive the craft standard on your area—interaction design, visual quality, and the small details that separate polished product from “good enough”

  • Collaborate closely with engineers and design engineers to turn concepts into working, shippable experiences—not hand off specs and hope

  • Raise the bar for the broader design team through feedback, shared frameworks, and the quality of your own output

What you'll need to be successful

  • Strong alignment with our values, find our values on our career page if you haven’t read up on them yet

  • You are proficient in English (spoken, written, and reading) at a CEFR Level C2 / ILR Level 5.

  • 5–7+ years of product design experience. Your portfolio should show systems-level thinking: shipped 0→1 work, complex multi-user flows, and evidence that you shaped the product direction—not just the interface

  • Experience operating as the most senior designer on a product area—setting direction, making tradeoffs, and owning outcomes without constant guidance

  • Strong prototyping skills—you build clickable, realistic prototypes yourself. Bonus if you’re already using AI-assisted prototyping tools like Cursor, Claude Code, v0, or Lovable

  • Proficiency in Figma for high-fidelity design and collaboration

  • Exceptional written and verbal communication—able to clearly explain complex ideas, influence decisions, and align teams asynchronously. You write well because that’s how decisions get made in a distributed team

  • Comfortable designing in ambiguity and building conviction through iteration, not waiting for perfect requirements

  • An active, evolving AI workflow—you already use AI tools in your design process and can speak concretely about how. This isn’t a checkbox; it’s a real part of how we evaluate fit

Compensation & benefits

We are hiring at a Lead level for this role; however, we may consider offering this position at the Senior level depending on a candidate’s experience level alignment with the role. In either case, the offer would fall within the published compensation range.

Circle offers U.S.-benchmarked compensation globally, equity in the company with ongoing refresh grants, and 35 days of paid time off each year.

We’re a remote-only team that comes together twice a year for company retreats in incredible destinations around the world. Alongside incredible flexibility and autonomy, we offer a benefits package that supports health, wellbeing, and professional growth. Learn more in our Candidate Hub.

 

Learn more

  • Candidate Safety & Interview Process Notice

  • Diversity, Equity & Inclusion

  • How We Use Candidate Data

  • Equal Employment Opportunity

  • Visit our Candidate Hub to learn more about working at Circle, our benefits, and our hiring process.

jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Us

Circle is building the world’s leading AI-powered, all-in-one platform for digital businesses. We make it possible for creators, coaches, educators, and businesses to bring together their audience with engaging discussions, live streams, events, chat, courses, and payments — all in one place, all under their own brand.

We’re proud to be a fully remote company of around 270 (and growing!) team members from 30+ countries around the world. We seek exceptional individuals around the world, set them up to do the best work of their lives, and in turn, create a meaningful impact in their own lives. We don't track hours, but we do manage for high expectations very closely. We collaborate across time zones, are highly async, and like to document a lot.

Twice a year, we bring the whole company together in beautiful places around the world for our company offsites. So far, we’ve hosted offsites in Turkey, Portugal, Mexico, Thailand, Colombia, Italy, Ireland, and more, with still more to come!

Check out our Careers page for more about working at Circle.

About Discover

People are looking for more than content. They're looking for growth, connection, and transformation — experiences that change how they see themselves and the world. Circle is where they find that. Not another platform optimizing for clicks and consumption — a place built around becoming something.

Discover is where Circle becomes visible to the world — the surface where creators get found and people find experiences worth their time. It's a two-sided marketplace problem spanning communities, courses, events, and more. And it's one of the most genuinely interesting design challenges on the platform.

About the role

You'll own Discover end-to-end as the lead designer: identifying opportunities, setting design direction, and shipping work that raises the bar for how discovery feels at Circle. You'll work closely with a founder-led product team that has strong vision and high standards — and you'll bring the craft, the systems thinking, and the bottom-up ideas that make that vision real.

You'll be joining a design team where context is shared openly, ownership is real, and talented people are trusted to do their best work.

This role is for designers with deep experience in consumer marketplace products — owning discovery, ranking, and engagement at scale; if your background is primarily in internal tools, CMS platforms, or growth systems, this role will not be a fit — please apply to our Core Product role instead.

The problem you'll be solving

Discovery is one of the hardest design problems. You're serving two audiences with opposing needs simultaneously: creators who need visibility, trust signals, and growth; and consumers who need signal through noise, confidence to commit, and experiences that deliver on their promise.

What makes this genuinely novel is AI as the core interaction model — not a filter or a recommendation widget, but the primary way Discover understands intent and surfaces what's worth someone's time. How does an AI-driven experience build trust in a marketplace? How do you make an AI-driven surface feel like a trusted recommendation from someone who knows you, not a ranked list from a system that doesn't? These are real open questions, and the quality of the answers will show up directly in the product.

What you'll be doing

  • Own Discover's design end-to-end. Identify opportunities, frame problems, set design direction, and ship. You connect dots across the platform — understanding how a community business compound product feeds into what Discover surfaces — and you make that systems understanding visible in every design decision.

  • Design AI-driven discovery experiences. The new world UX is conversational and relational. You'll design the interfaces, curation experiences, and trust signals that make AI-driven discovery feel effortless — building the relationship between the platform, creators, and members in ways that feel human, not algorithmic.

  • Serve both sides of the market. You understand what makes a marketplace work at a systems level — how creator visibility gets earned, how consumer confidence gets built, how one broken experience erodes trust on both sides. That understanding drives your design decisions, not just your surface-level execution.

  • Prototype at speed. You use AI-assisted tools — Cursor, Claude Code, v0, Lovable — because you've already figured out it's how ideas get stress-tested fast. You stay in the problem through to launch, working closely with engineers to close the gap between concept and shipped experience.

  • Mentor and elevate. You raise the craft standard on Discover through the quality of your own work and how you develop designers alongside you. 

What you'll need to be successful

  • Strong alignment with our values, find our values on our career page if you haven’t read up on them yet

  • You are proficient in English (spoken, written, and reading) at a CEFR Level C2 / ILR Level 5.

  • Marketplace or two-sided platform experience — this is a hard requirement. You've designed for both sides of a market. You know what breaks trust and what builds it. Your portfolio shows you shaped outcomes, not just interfaces.

  • 5+ years of product design experience, including shipped 0→1 work, complex multi-user flows, and clear evidence that you drove product direction — not just executed it.

  • Experience as the most senior designer on a product area — setting direction, making tradeoffs, and owning outcomes without constant guidance.

  • Genuine fluency with AI-assisted prototyping. You build realistic prototypes yourself using tools like Cursor, Claude Code, v0, or Lovable. This is how you think, not just how you produce. You can speak concretely about your process.

  • Proficiency in Figma for high-fidelity design and cross-functional collaboration.

  • Proactive communication. You share your thinking before you're asked, surface decisions early, give real opinions, and keep your team informed without being prompted. At Circle, communication is how trust gets built and work gets shipped.

  • Comfort designing in ambiguity. Discover is still taking shape. You build conviction through iteration, not by waiting for perfect requirements.

Compensation & benefits

We are hiring at a Lead level for this role; however, we may consider offering this position at the Senior level depending on a candidate’s experience level alignment with the role. In either case, the offer would fall within the published compensation range.

Circle offers U.S.-benchmarked compensation globally, equity in the company with ongoing refresh grants, and 35 days of paid time off each year.

We’re a remote-only team that comes together twice a year for company retreats in incredible destinations around the world. Alongside incredible flexibility and autonomy, we offer a benefits package that supports health, wellbeing, and professional growth. Learn more in our Candidate Hub.

These are real open questions, and the quality of the answers will show up directly in the product.




WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING

 - Own Discover's design end-to-end. Identify opportunities, frame problems, set design direction, and ship. You connect dots across the platform — understanding how a community business compound product feeds into what Discover surfaces — and you make that systems understanding visible in every design decision.

 - Design AI-driven discovery experiences. The new world UX is conversational and relational. You'll design the interfaces, curation experiences, and trust signals that make AI-driven discovery feel effortless — building the relationship between the platform, creators, and members in ways that feel human, not algorithmic.

 - Serve both sides of the market. You understand what makes a marketplace work at a systems level — how creator visibility gets earned, how consumer confidence gets built, how one broken experience erodes trust on both sides. That understanding drives your design decisions, not just your surface-level execution.

 - Prototype at speed. You use AI-assisted tools — Cursor, Claude Code, v0, Lovable — because you've already figured out it's how ideas get stress-tested fast. You stay in the problem through to launch, working closely with engineers to close the gap between concept and shipped experience.

 - Mentor and elevate. You raise the craft standard on Discover through the quality of your own work and how you develop designers alongside you. 




WHAT YOU'LL NEED TO BE SUCCESSFUL

 - Strong alignment with our values, find our values on our career page https://circle.so/careers if you haven’t read up on them yet

 - You are proficient in English (spoken, written, and reading) at a CEFR Level C2 https://magoosh.com/english-speaking/english-proficiency-levels-a-guide-to-determining-your-level/ / ILR Level 5 https://www.govtilr.org/.

 - Marketplace or two-sided platform experience — this is a hard requirement. You've designed for both sides of a market. You know what breaks trust and what builds it. Your portfolio shows you shaped outcomes, not just interfaces.

 - 5+ years of product design experience, including shipped 0→1 work, complex multi-user flows, and clear evidence that you drove product direction — not just executed it.

 - Experience as the most senior designer on a product area — setting direction, making tradeoffs, and owning outcomes without constant guidance.

 - Genuine fluency with AI-assisted prototyping. You build realistic prototypes yourself using tools like Cursor, Claude Code, v0, or Lovable. This is how you think, not just how you produce. You can speak concretely about your process.

 - Proficiency in Figma for high-fidelity design and cross-functional collaboration.

 - Proactive communication. You share your thinking before you're asked, surface decisions early, give real opinions, and keep your team informed without being prompted. At Circle, communication is how trust gets built and work gets shipped.

 - Comfort designing in ambiguity. Discover is still taking shape. You build conviction through iteration, not by waiting for perfect requirements.




COMPENSATION & BENEFITS

We are hiring at a Lead level for this role; however, we may consider offering this position at the Senior level depending on a candidate’s experience level alignment with the role. In either case, the offer would fall within the published compensation range.

Circle offers U.S.-benchmarked compensation globally, equity in the company with ongoing refresh grants, and 35 days of paid time off each year.

Alongside incredible flexibility and autonomy, we offer a benefits package that supports health, wellbeing, and professional growth. jobs.title: Growth Lead, Discover
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Us

Circle is building the world’s leading AI-powered, all-in-one platform for digital businesses. We make it possible for creators, coaches, educators, and businesses to bring together their audience with engaging discussions, live streams, events, chat, courses, and payments — all in one place, all under their own brand.

We’re proud to be a fully remote company of around 270 (and growing!) team members from 30+ countries around the world. We seek exceptional individuals around the world, set them up to do the best work of their lives, and in turn, create a meaningful impact in their own lives. We don't track hours, but we do manage for high expectations very closely. We collaborate across time zones, are highly async, and like to document a lot.

Twice a year, we bring the whole company together in beautiful places around the world for our company offsites. So far, we’ve hosted offsites in Turkey, Portugal, Mexico, Thailand, Colombia, Italy, Ireland, and more, with still more to come!

Check out our Careers page for more about working at Circle.

About the role

We’re building something game-changing at Circle: a discovery marketplace where millions can find creators, communities, and products to help them achieve their highest personal and professional goals.

You’ll own generating and growing the demand engine for the Discover marketplace. Think of a Pinterest, Reddit or Instagram-style product, reimagined with a mission to help people achieve their goals instead of distracting them with endless doom scrolling. Through Discover, you will be building technology that could help millions of people grow, self-actualize, and live their best lives.

As the Growth Lead for Discover, you’ll report directly to the GM of Discover and work closely with Circle's co-founders to bring this vision to life. Day to day you'll work with the product team for Discover, our paid media team, data team, brand and design studio, lifecycle marketing, partnerships, and more.

This is a fully remote role, open to candidates in any North American time zone.

What you'll be doing

  • Own growth for the Discover marketplace. Drive traffic to Discover, experiment with how consumers find and engage with Discover, and grow its GMV and transaction volume.

  • A/B testing and experimentation. Run experiments to better acquire, engage, and retain traffic. Test what people see when they arrive on Discover, the algorithms behind recommendations, and marketplace structure.

  • Build Circle's end-to-end lifecycle email programs. Build the acquisition funnel for Discover by setting up a recommendations newsletter, creating offers to acquire subscribers, and developing email programs to turn visitors into repeat buyers.

  • Build an SEO program. Grow Discover's organic surfaces and SEO / AEO across product pages and distribution partnerships with the creators already building on Circle.

  • Drive creator success on the marketplace. Help creators listed on Discover succeed by sending them buyers who convert and stay, diagnosing which categories generate traffic but underconvert, and applying those learnings across the marketplace.

  • Build the team's reporting. Track funnel performance by category, cohort retention of Discover-sourced members, and what individual creators earn from the marketplace, and own reporting on performance and recommendations to leadership.

  • Help shape and execute Discover's growth strategy. Partner with the GM of Discover and co-founders to shape growth priorities and collaborate with the product team to evolve the product.

What you'll need to be successful

  • A track record of owning a revenue or GMV number across multiple channels at one time, where you were able to grow the number and deliver real results. Ideally, you can walk us through what moved the number, what worked, and what you got wrong. This matters a lot more to us than your title or how many years you've been doing this.

  • Experience with email and lifecycle marketing, including building a program from scratch. You should have a clear view of what it should be judged on beyond opens and clicks.

  • Experience acquiring email subscribers profitably and growing their value over time. This mechanic is going to be key here: bring someone in for less than they'll eventually spend, then earning more from them by delivering real value to both them and the creator.

  • Comfortable being hands-on as a player-coach. This includes writing the emails, building the pages, talking to the creators, setting up reporting, and reading the results yourself.

  • Deep understanding of marketplaces and/or businesses with strong network effects. Ideally, you’re someone who obsesses about marketplace network effects, and shows strong judgment and opinions on growing the demand side of a marketplace.

  • Learn fast, experiment aggressively, and thrive in a highly dynamic environment. You’ll need to be comfortable running a lot of experiments and letting the results settle the argument, including the ones that don't work (which will be many of them in the beginning).

  • Comfortable in a fast-paced environment with ambiguity. You’ll need to learn and pick up new technologies when projects require it.

  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills in English (CEFR C2 or equivalent), as most collaboration at Circle happens asynchronously.

Compensation & benefits

Circle offers U.S.-benchmarked compensation globally, equity in the company with ongoing refresh grants, and 35 days of paid time off each year.

We’re a remote-only team that comes together twice a year for company retreats in incredible destinations around the world. Alongside incredible flexibility and autonomy, we offer a benefits package that supports health, wellbeing, and professional growth. Learn more in our Candidate Hub.

Learn more

  • Candidate Safety & Interview Process Notice

  • Diversity, Equity & Inclusion

  • How We Use Candidate Data

  • Equal Employment Opportunity

  • Visit our Candidate Hub to learn more about working at Circle, our benefits, and our hiring process.

jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Us

Circle is building the world’s leading AI-powered, all-in-one platform for digital businesses. We make it possible for creators, coaches, educators, and businesses to bring together their audience with engaging discussions, live streams, events, chat, courses, and payments — all in one place, all under their own brand.

We’re proud to be a fully remote company of around 270 (and growing!) team members from 30+ countries around the world. We seek exceptional individuals around the world, set them up to do the best work of their lives, and in turn, create a meaningful impact in their own lives. We don't track hours, but we do manage for high expectations very closely. We collaborate across time zones, are highly async, and like to document a lot.

Twice a year, we bring the whole company together in beautiful places around the world for our company offsites. So far, we’ve hosted offsites in Turkey, Portugal, Mexico, Thailand, Colombia, Italy, Ireland, and more, with still more to come!

Check out our Careers page for more about working at Circle.

About the role

We’re excited to bring on Circle’s first Creative Director.

This is a unique opportunity to shape how Circle shows up in the world, and define the story of a generational company building the future of digital businesses.

We’re looking for an exceptional creative storyteller who can help us develop strong, consistent narratives across everything Circle puts into the world: product launches, campaigns, ads, landing pages, announcements, partnerships, events, and more.

You obsess over the power of a great narrative. You believe every word, visual, and detail matters. You have an exceptionally high creative bar, thrive in highly collaborative environments, and know how to influence people through the quality of the work itself.

As Circle’s first Creative Director, you’ll first and foremost act as a creative extension of the founders. You will turn their ideas, product strategy, and company vision into narratives that are clear, memorable, and unmistakably Circle across all our assets.

On a day-to-day basis, you’ll work closely with Circle’s founders and across our in-house design studio, product marketing, paid media, video, and events teams to elevate our storytelling and creative execution across every major moment.

Your goal is to help make Circle one of the most creatively distinct and definitive companies in the category of digital businesses.

What you'll be doing

  • Shape Circle’s narrative. Work closely with Circle’s founders to synthesize, sharpen, and evolve the story behind our long-term vision, and translate it into clear, compelling narratives that can travel across everything we do.

  • Own the creative direction of our biggest launches and campaigns. Find the angle, develop the brief, shape the story, and obsess over how we make each moment stand out. You’ll partner closely with Product Marketing across launches, announcements, demos, and enablement to ensure everything feels cohesive, intentional, and unmistakably Circle. Doing this well requires developing a deep understanding of our product, customers, and market.

  • Be a deeply embedded creative marketing partner to our design studio. You’ll work especially closely with our Design Studio, which is led by one of Circle’s co-founders and won’t report to you. Success here involves shared taste, mutual trust, healthy creative tension, and the ability to move quickly together. You’ll occasionally lead external agencies as well — and when the moment calls for it, write the high-stakes copy yourself: the headline, manifesto, launch script, or line someone delivers on stage.

  • Raise the bar on our advertising and creative campaigns. Develop the concepts and narratives behind Circle’s ad creative, partnering up our Paid Acquisition team to turn them into high-performing campaigns. They’ll bring the channel and media-buying expertise; while you can make sure the creative is worth paying to distribute.

  • Direct how our stories come to life across video and events. Get hands-on with scripts, structure, pacing, and narrative for launch films, social, ads, virtual summits, and other major moments. You won’t be editing videos or producing events yourself, but you’ll understand the craft well enough to have strong opinions about what works in each medium, and collaborate deeply with the specialists who bring it to life.

  • Influence the narrative behind brand experiences people remember across our webinars, virtual summits, conferences, and live events to align with company brand vision. This includes everything from the theme and programming to the booth, talks, slides, copy, and small details nobody else would think to obsess over.

  • Turn partnerships into stories. Work with our Partnerships team to make more of our collaborations with creators and customers into stories we can distribute across our channels. You can help develop the concept, framing, name, narrative, and creative execution behind our biggest partnerships, and helping our partners tell those stories powerfully themselves.

What we're looking for

  • A body of work you’re genuinely proud of. We care far more about what you’ve made than the titles you’ve held or the number of years you’ve been doing it. You should be able to walk us through your best work piece by piece: the problem, the idea, the choices you made, what you personally contributed, and ultimately, whether it worked.

  • Exceptional creative taste and judgment. You know great work when you see it, can articulate why it’s great, and have the conviction to push work until it gets there. Just as importantly, you know when an idea is trying too hard, when something is off-brand, and when your own fingerprints are making the work worse rather than better.

  • You’re an exceptional storyteller and writer. You can take something complicated and find the simple, compelling story inside it. You care deeply about language and will happily obsess over a headline, a launch narrative, or a single line of copy until it feels inevitable.

  • A strong point of view, and the ability to make it better through collaboration. We don’t want someone who waits for a brief and executes it. We want someone who can tell us what the brief should be, challenge the premise when necessary, elevate ideas coming from the team and our founders, and make a compelling case for a different direction.

  • Real fluency in video as a creative medium. You don’t need to shoot, edit, animate, or produce. But you should deeply understand what makes video work, from the script and opening seconds to structure, pacing, emotion, and payoff. You should also understand why a great launch film, social video, customer story, and paid ad require very different creative choices.

  • Experience making creative that has to perform. You’ve developed ads and campaigns where the work was ultimately accountable to results. You’ve seen the numbers, learned from them, iterated because of them, and know how to partner with paid acquisition teams without allowing performance marketing to turn into boring marketing.

  • An instinct for getting attention without going off script. You understand how to make a brand noticeable, surprising, and culturally relevant without chasing attention for its own sake. Ideally, you can show us a creative risk you fought for that worked, and another you talked the room out of because it wasn’t right for the brand.

  • The ability to lead through influence, not hierarchy. There’s no large creative organization reporting to you. Much of your impact will come from getting exceptional work out of designers, marketers, writers, video producers, agencies, and founders who don’t report to you. You know how to raise the creative bar without becoming a bottleneck.

  • A great eye for design and deep respect for the craft. You don’t need to be a designer, but you should be able to work shoulder-to-shoulder with exceptional ones. Our Design Studio is led by a co-founder and operates with a very high bar; you’ll need the visual taste, vocabulary, and collaborative instincts to be a trusted creative partner to that team.

  • Experience working closely with founders. You’re comfortable working with founders who care deeply about the product, brand, and details. You will need to extract the vision, challenge it when needed, and turn it into something better than either of you would have arrived at independently.

  • An obsession with understanding what how to tell the world about we do and why it matters. The best creative work here will come from understanding Circle at a deep level: our product, customers, competitors, category, and where the market is going. You should genuinely enjoy developing that level of context rather than treating it as somebody else’s job.

  • Exceptional communication skills. Circle is global, remote, and highly asynchronous. You’ll need outstanding written and verbal English (CEFR C2 or equivalent), and the ability to make your thinking clear enough that great work can move forward even when everyone isn’t in the same room.

Compensation & benefits

Circle offers U.S.-benchmarked compensation globally, equity in the company with ongoing refresh grants, and 35 days of paid time off each year.

We’re a remote-only team that comes together twice a year for company retreats in incredible destinations around the world. Alongside incredible flexibility and autonomy, we offer a benefits package that supports health, wellbeing, and professional growth. Learn more in our Candidate Hub.

Learn more

  • Candidate Safety & Interview Process Notice

  • Diversity, Equity & Inclusion

  • How We Use Candidate Data

  • Equal Employment Opportunity

  • Visit our Candidate Hub to learn more about working at Circle, our benefits, and our hiring process.

If you enjoy turning ambitious product ideas into polished, scalable systems, this role is for you.

 

What you'll be doing

  • Build and ship Page Builder features that directly impact how customers design and publish their sites.

  • Work across the stack using React & TypeScript (frontend) and Ruby on Rails (backend).

  • Partner closely with product/design to translate specs into high-quality, user-friendly experiences.

  • Improve the architecture of the builder/editor and publishing pipeline for reliability, extensibility, and performance.

  • Own projects end-to-end—from technical design through implementation, testing, rollout, and iteration.

  • Review PRs thoughtfully and contribute to a culture of quality and continuous improvement.

  • Work async-first and communicate clearly and proactively.

What you'll need to be successful

  • Strong alignment with our values. Find our values on our career page if you haven’t read up on them yet.

  • 5+ years of experience building and scaling SaaS products.

  • Deep experience with Ruby on Rails and strong proficiency with React & TypeScript.

  • A product mindset—you care about the “why,” sweat UX details, and iterate based on customer needs.

  • Experience building complex, stateful UI (editors, builders, or design tools) and/or the systems behind them.

  • Solid architectural judgment and a high bar for quality, balanced with pragmatism.

  • Comfort working with and alongside AI tools in your development workflow.

  • Excellent async communication and collaboration skills.

  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills in English (CEFR C2 or equivalent), as most collaboration at Circle happens asynchronously. 

Bonus points

  • Experience working on site builders, page editors, or CMS platforms.

  • Experience with rich text/content editing, drag-and-drop interactions, component systems, or design tooling.

  • Familiarity with web performance, caching strategies, and scaling high-traffic rendering/publishing systems.

  • Prior experience at an early-stage or growth-stage startup.

  • Contributions to open-source projects or developer communities.

Compensation & benefits

Circle offers U.S.-benchmarked compensation globally, equity in the company with ongoing refresh grants, and 35 days of paid time off each year.

We’re a remote-only team that comes together twice a year for company retreats in incredible destinations around the world. Alongside incredible flexibility and autonomy, we offer a benefits package that supports health, wellbeing, and professional growth. Learn more in our Candidate Hub.

  • Candidate Safety & Interview Process Notice

jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Us

Circle is building the world’s leading AI-powered, all-in-one platform for digital businesses. We make it possible for creators, coaches, educators, and businesses to bring together their audience with engaging discussions, live streams, events, chat, courses, and payments — all in one place, all under their own brand.

We don't track hours, but we do manage for high expectations very closely. We collaborate across time zones, are highly async, and like to document a lot.

Twice a year, we bring the whole company together in beautiful places around the world for our company offsites. So far, we’ve hosted offsites in Turkey, Portugal, Mexico, Thailand, Colombia, Italy, Ireland, and more, with still more to come!

Check out our Careers page for more about working at Circle.

About the role

We’re looking for a Senior Quality Engineer to help shape how quality is built into our product.

Our SQEs work across multiple product teams, partnering with Engineering, Product Leads and Design across different areas of Circle. You’ll get involved throughout the development lifecycle. Exploring ideas, identifying risks, challenging assumptions and helping teams make better decisions about quality.

This is a collaborative, hands-on role for someone who enjoys being close to the product, moving between different problem spaces and making Quality Engineering visible across the organisation.

You’ll combine strong product thinking, exploratory testing, automation and technical investigation to help teams ship with confidence.

 

What you'll be doing


Product Quality

  • Partner with multiple product teams across different areas of Circle.

  • Get involved early in product, design and engineering discussions.

  • Identify meaningful product, technical and customer risks.

  • Bring a quality perspective to user journeys, UI/UX, requirements and technical approaches.

  • Shape pragmatic, risk-based testing approaches based on the change and its potential impact.

Automation & Technical Quality

  • Build and maintain reliable automated coverage across web, APIs and integrations.

  • Make thoughtful decisions about what to automate, where to test it and what provides the strongest signal.

  • Investigate complex failures across the application, APIs, CI pipelines and supporting systems.

  • Work with engineers to improve testability, reliability and developer feedback loops.

  • Use modern engineering and AI-assisted tooling where it improves planning, automation, debugging or investigation.

Quality Strategy & Enablement

  • Identify recurring or systemic quality issues and drive improvements across teams.

  • Use bugs, production issues and quality signals to improve prevention, not just detection.

  • Help teams make informed decisions about risk, coverage and release confidence.

  • Share knowledge and approaches that strengthen quality ownership across Engineering.

What you'll need to be successful

  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills in English (CEFR C2 or equivalent), as most collaboration at Circle happens asynchronously. 
    Strong experience working as a Quality Engineer within modern product engineering teams.

  • Strong web test automation experience with Playwright, TypeScript, or comparable technologies.

  • Good knowledge of API and integration testing.

  • Strong exploratory and risk-based testing skills.

  • Confidence reading application code and debugging complex technical issues.

  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines and automated test execution.

  • Strong product judgement. You care about the experience being built, not just whether it technically works.

  • Comfortable working across multiple teams and product areas, switching context and getting up to speed quickly.

  • Able to operate with a high degree of autonomy and identify where your input will create the most value.

  • Confident asking questions, challenging assumptions and influencing decisions constructively.

  • A collaborative and pragmatic approach to balancing quality, risk and delivery.

Bonus points

  • Experience, interest or strong potential in building quality platforms, test infrastructure, automation frameworks, developer tooling or other reusable quality-enabling systems. We’re particularly interested in SQEs who enjoy solving quality problems in scalable ways.

  • Mobile testing, particularly React Native, iOS or Android.

  • Payments or integration-heavy products.

  • Observability and production monitoring.

  • Performance and load testing.

  • CI/CD and build infrastructure.

  • Developer experience or engineering productivity.

Compensation & benefits

Circle offers U.S.-benchmarked compensation globally, equity in the company with ongoing refresh grants, and 35 days of paid time off each year.

We’re a remote-only team that comes together twice a year for company retreats in incredible destinations around the world. Alongside incredible flexibility and autonomy, we offer a benefits package that supports health, wellbeing, and professional growth. Learn more in our Candidate Hub.

  • Candidate Safety & Interview Process Notice

  • Diversity, Equity & Inclusion

  • How We Use Candidate Data

  • Equal Employment Opportunity

  • Visit our Candidate Hub to learn more about working at Circle, our benefits, and our hiring process.

jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Us

Circle is building the world’s leading AI-powered, all-in-one platform for digital businesses. We make it possible for creators, coaches, educators, and businesses to bring together their audience with engaging discussions, live streams, events, chat, courses, and payments — all in one place, all under their own brand.

We’re proud to be a fully remote company of around 270 (and growing!) team members from 30+ countries around the world. We seek exceptional individuals around the world, set them up to do the best work of their lives, and in turn, create a meaningful impact in their own lives. We don't track hours, but we do manage for high expectations very closely. We collaborate across time zones, are highly async, and like to document a lot.

Twice a year, we bring the whole company together in beautiful places around the world for our company offsites. So far, we’ve hosted offsites in Turkey, Portugal, Mexico, Thailand, Colombia, Italy, Ireland, and more, with still more to come!

Check out our Careers page for more about working at Circle.

About the role

The AI Quality engineering team at Circle owns the foundation for measuring, diagnosing, and improving the quality of Circle's AI-powered features. This team focuses on building the infrastructure to measure, diagnose, and improve production AI systems, rather than ML research or model training.

We're looking for a Lead Engineer to help us build out the evaluation frameworks, observability tooling, and diagnostic infrastructure that tell us whether our AI Agents are working well, where to improve them, and how to make them faster and more cost-efficient.

This is a hands-on player-coach role. You’ll also lead and manage the AI Quality engineering team, with an ambitious and growing roadmap.

If you're excited about making AI systems work reliably, efficiently, and at scale, this is for you.


What you'll be doing

  • Build and own our evaluation infrastructure. Design the CI/CD pipelines, scorers, and datasets that tell us whether Circle's AI agents (planners, tool-callers, and sub-agents) are actually working, from a single tool call to a full multi-turn conversation.

  • Diagnose exactly where quality breaks down. Trace failures across the agent pipeline including plan creation vs. execution, tool selection, tool trajectory in complex areas like workflows, site builder, and analytics. Turn what you find into prototypes that solve the issue or identify priorities for AI core engineering can help.

  • Grow the datasets that make evaluation possible. Stand up annotation workflows and build out AI-generated and simulated conversations so we can cover more of the product faster than manual labeling alone.

  • Run structured experiments across prompts, models, and the agent harness. Evaluate new and open-source models against our production baseline, build the framework we use to decide when to shift models, and chase cost and latency wins through model swaps, caching, and routing by plan complexity.

  • Lead and grow the AI Quality engineering team. Set technical direction and manage day-to-day priorities, all while staying hands-on in the code yourself.

  • Partner closely with AI Core engineering. Work with the engineers building Circle's AI products so they have real confidence that their changes are actually improving quality, not just shipping.

What you'll need to be successful

  • 7+ years of experience building and shipping production software, ideally including LLM-powered agents that take real actions in a product. You've worked on complex, tool-using systems (multiple tools, planning or orchestration, sub-agents) not just simple, single-turn assistants, and you can walk us through something you shipped and how you knew it was actually working.

  • Comfortable in Ruby on Rails / Python or ready to pick them up quickly. Ruby on Rails is our production system and the foundation that Circle’s AI Agents are built on and proficiency in Python is a strong plus, especially for the data and evaluation side of the work.

  • Experience building evaluation or observability infrastructure for ML/AI systems. You've built eval pipelines, scorers, dashboards, or CI/CD for evals before and have experience with evaluation frameworks like Braintrust, LangSmith, or similar.

  • Experience designing datasets, annotation workflows, or labeling pipelines for ML/AI evaluation. You know how to turn raw examples into a dataset you can trust through human annotation, AI-generated data, or simulation.

  • Learn fast, experiment aggressively, and thrive in a highly dynamic environment. You’ll need to be comfortable running a lot of experiments and letting the results settle the argument, including the ones that don't work (which will be many of them in the beginning).

  • Comfortable in a fast-paced environment with ambiguity. You’ll need to learn and pick up new technologies when projects require it.

  • Strong alignment with our company values.

  • You are proficient in English (spoken, written, and reading) at a CEFR Level C2 / ILR Level 5.

 

Compensation & benefits

Circle offers U.S.-benchmarked compensation globally, equity in the company with ongoing refresh grants, and 35 days of paid time off each year.

We’re a remote-only team that comes together twice a year for company retreats in incredible destinations around the world. Alongside incredible flexibility and autonomy, we offer a benefits package that supports health, wellbeing, and professional growth. Learn more in our Candidate Hub.

  • Candidate Safety & Interview Process Notice

  • How We Use Candidate Data

  • Visit our Candidate Hub to learn more about working at Circle, our benefits, and our hiring process.

jobs.title: Sales Lead
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Job Title: Sales Lead (Latin America)
Department: Financial Partnerships & Sales
Reports to: Co-Founder (Sales)
Location: Remote (Based in Latin America)

About Codex

Codex is building the infrastructure for stablecoin-based cross-border payments — moving money faster, cheaper, and more transparently than the legacy financial system. Backed by Circle, Coinbase, Dragonfly, we're a small team solving hard problems at the intersection of crypto and global payments.


The Role
As a Sales Lead at Codex, you'll own the end-to-end commercial relationship with institutional clients and fintech partners in your region — from first outreach through to signed contracts and live trading.

This is a high-ownership, high-accountability role. You'll be managing a live pipeline, attending conferences, and regularly interfacing with Compliance, Legal, and Operations to unblock deals and get clients trading.


Responsibilities

Pipeline Development & Outbound

  • Own your regional pipeline from top of funnel to close — sourcing leads, qualifying prospects, and maintaining accurate deal records

  • Run targeted outbound across various platforms in coordination with the Marketing function, and follow up on inbound leads generated by the website and conferences

  • Identify and attend high-value industry conferences and side events in your region to generate new relationships and accelerate deals in progress

Deal Execution

  • Run discovery calls and commercial negotiations with prospects across your region

  • Identify client use cases, volume profiles, and corridor requirements — and translate these into pricing proposals in coordination with the Trading, Treasury and Account Management team

  • Escalate pricing blockers, compliance queries, and onboarding blockers with clear context so they can be resolved quickly

  • Manage deals involving complex structures with appropriate rigour and cross-functional coordination

Client Onboarding & Activation

  • Own the handoff from signed deal to live trading — coordinating with internal teams on KYB, account setups, and spread configurations

  • Stay close to newly onboarded clients during their ramp-up period, following up on first trades and resolving any friction in their early experience

  • Surface client feedback on product gaps, pricing, SLAs, and rail coverage to the relevant internal teams

Account Management & Reactivation

  • Monitor the health of your client book — tracking volume trends, flagging at-risk accounts, and proactively engaging clients who have gone quiet

  • Lead reactivation efforts for dormant clients in your region, understanding why they churned and what it would take to bring them back

  • Build deep relationships with key accounts, acting as a trusted commercial partner rather than a transactional sales contact

Market Intelligence

  • Stay current on competitor pricing, product capabilities, and market positioning in your region, and share intelligence with the team regularly

  • Identify emerging client segments, use cases, or geographies that represent commercial opportunity for Codex


What This Role Requires

  • Sales experience in fintech, crypto, payments, or financial services — ideally selling to institutional or business clients

  • Strong understanding of cross-border payments, stablecoins, and the FX dynamics of your target region

  • Comfortable discussing pricing, compliance requirements, and product capabilities in the same conversation

  • Highly organised with a disciplined approach to pipeline management and follow-up

  • Able to work across time zones and build relationships with clients who operate in fast-moving, operationally complex environments

  • Fluency in English required; additional languages relevant to your region are a strong advantage
