jobs.title: Business Development Associate
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Consensys

Consensys Incorporated is an independent blockchain infrastructure company, spun out of Consensys Software Inc. — one of the world's leading blockchain technology companies and the primary development organization behind the Ethereum ecosystem.

We build and operate neutral, institutional-grade blockchain infrastructure that connects banks, asset managers, custodians, and financial market infrastructures to digital asset networks, meeting the non-negotiable standards of institutional finance: privacy, scalability, resilience, security, and regulatory readiness.

Headquartered in Miami, Florida, and operating across the US, Europe, and Australia, Consensys Incorporated launched as an independent entity in September 2026 and is building the team to match its ambition.

Why this role exists

We build and operate blockchain infrastructure for financial market infrastructure: settlement, custody and clearing institutions that put real value on the networks we run. We have signed clients with production dates this quarter and a platform standing on its own for the first time. Our pipeline of banks, custodians and market operators is growing faster than we can work it properly.

You are the first hire on the Business Development team. You own the pipeline data and act as the coordination layer between prospects, engineering and leadership. You also make sure that what we promise in a sales conversation matches what we can deliver. When someone asks where a deal stands, what a client actually asked for, or whether a commitment is real, you're the person with the answer.

What you'll own

  • Building pipeline with financial institutions: banks, custodians, broker-dealers, asset managers and market infrastructure providers. You work out who to approach, find the right person in each institution, and get the first meeting.

  • Account research before every conversation. You should know a prospect's settlement stack, where their collateral and liquidity problems are, what they've said publicly about tokenization, and who else they're talking to. Nobody should walk into a meeting cold.

  • Qualifying opportunities against what we actually sell: access, execution, interoperability and network engines, plus forward-deployed engineering engagements, managed hosting, interop settlement and sequencer services. That means working out whether there's a real budget, a real owner, a real timeline and a real problem we solve, and saying so early when there isn't.

  • Supporting live deal cycles, including discovery notes, meeting prep, follow-ups, RFP and RFI responses, security questionnaires and due-diligence packs. Institutional sales cycles are long and documentation-heavy. You keep them moving.

  • Pipeline and CRM discipline. Stages, next steps and close dates should reflect reality, and the forecast should hold up when someone questions it.

  • Market and competitive intelligence. Enterprise post-trade vendors don't publish their pricing, so what we know about it comes from conversations. You collect it, organize it and make it useful for pricing and positioning.

  • Translating between two worlds. Our buyers speak repo, collateral, DvP, cut-off times and operational risk. Our engineers speak sequencers, finality and nodes. You need to be fluent enough in both to bring back an accurate account of what the client asked for.

  • Outbound materials and messaging, working with Marketing and Product on one-pagers, case narratives, event follow-up and sequences that sound like they were written by someone who understands the client's business.

  • Events and ecosystem presence, including industry conferences, working groups and partner channels where institutional decision-makers show up.

  • Capturing client feedback for Product. What prospects ask for, what makes them hesitate and why deals stall should all reach the roadmap in a structured way.

  • Using AI in the work every day for research, account mapping, first drafts and meeting prep, held to the same bar for accuracy as anything else sent to a client.

Two lines sit outside this role and you'll work with both constantly:

  • Solutions and forward-deployed engineering own technical scoping, architecture and delivery commitments. You bring them in at the right moment with the right context, and you never promise a date or capability they haven't agreed to.

  • Legal and Finance own contract terms, pricing approvals and commercial structure. You make sure deals reach them clean and early, not the week before signature.

What we are looking for

  • 2–4 years in B2B tech sales, business development, or a client-facing role at a financial institution, fintech or market infrastructure provider.

  • Working knowledge of how institutional finance operates: trade lifecycle, clearing and settlement, custody, collateral. You don't need to be a post-trade expert, but you need to follow the conversation and ask good questions.

  • Real curiosity about onchain infrastructure and tokenized assets, and the ability to explain why it matters to a treasury or operations buyer without resorting to hype.

  • Strong written communication. Your emails, notes and summaries are clear, short and accurate.

  • Organized and persistent. Deals here take quarters, not weeks. You keep threads alive without being a nuisance.

  • Commercially sharp. You can tell interest from intent, and you'd rather disqualify a deal early than carry it on hope.

  • Comfortable in a company that is young and still building. The playbook is being written now, and you'll help write it.

  • Direct. This team has a low tolerance for polish over substance. Say the hard thing early, and say it kindly.

  • Coachable and collaborative. You want feedback, you act on it, and you make the people around you more effective.

Useful, not required

  • Experience selling into, or working at, a bank, custodian, CSD, exchange or clearing house.

  • Familiarity with Ethereum, EVM networks or permissioned blockchain deployments.

  • Exposure to repo, FX, stablecoins or tokenized treasuries/RWAs.

  • Experience with enterprise procurement: RFPs, vendor due diligence, InfoSec reviews.

What this role is not

  • Not a volume-dialing SDR seat. We'd rather have ten well-researched conversations than a thousand generic touches.

  • Not someone who overpromises to book a meeting. Our buyers remember.

  • Not someone who waits to be told what to do next, or who doesn't ask why an account matters.

  • Not someone who needs to be the loudest voice in the room. Listen first, then bring the insight.

  • Not a solutions-engineering role. You need to be credible technically, but you aren't expected to architect deployments.

Working at Consensys

We are a fully remote, globally distributed company. We hire the best people wherever they are, work asynchronously, and judge each other on impact rather than hours or location. We offer competitive compensation, meaningful equity, and the chance to work on genuinely open source software at the frontier of web3.

Consensys is an equal opportunities employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to building an inclusive environment for all employees.

jobs.title: Senior Content Marketer
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Are you our new Senior Content Marketer?

Dapper is looking for a Senior Content Marketer with a pioneering spirit. You’ll play a key role in helping our clients drive online growth, from strategy to execution. We work with a diverse range of B2B businesses across the globe: from promising start-ups to fast-growing scale-ups, and beyond.

At Dapper, we believe B2B marketing needs a revolution. Our mission is to make B2B marketing less boring, more creative, and more impactful.

This job is for you if you:

  • Have 6 years of relevant experience, ideally in a B2B context, fast scaling, or agency environment (or you are open to adapt fast to a new environment)

  • You bring strategic content marketing skills, meaning you know how to create ICPs, content messaging frameworks, host the workshops needed and bring that together in a realistic strategy with roadmap that you keep tracking for continuous improvement. However, you still enjoy jumping into the details, whether challenging content creation, writing long and short form copy, reviewing ad copies or sparring with your clients on content strategy and value-proposition

  • Do the deep research needed to make sure you get to the bottom of the needs and wishes of the client, which you can translate into concrete content ideas that stand out (scripts and concepts for video and visuals, infographics, thought leadership posts, blogs, copy for landing pages, ads, etc.)

  • You can connect your writing skills to design execution (visual thinker) to make sure the copy and design are complementing each other (no worries, our creative team does the design work)

  • Share knowledge proactively. Something you're particularly proud of? Take your team along in your thought process. Together we learn and grow

  • Guide juniors/mediors with clear and practical feedback and guidance so that they learn and grow into becoming the best content marketers

  • You bring a growth mindset, open to feedback, focused on learning, and always looking for ways to improve and support others in doing the same.

  • Take full ownership of your projects, challenging the brief, aligning with clients, and pushing for better outcomes through collaboration with the team

  • Are confident owning and leading client relationships, from onboarding and strategy to reviews and roadmap planning

What we value in everyone at Dapper

Dapper works as a close-knit team with different perspectives, but the same energy to push boundaries and raise the bar. Regardless of your role, there are a few qualities we look for in every team member:

  • You communicate clearly and proactively in Dutch and English.

  • You are flexible and stay focused when things change, you adapt without losing momentum, and you find smart ways to move forward.

  • You want to grow and make an impact, you take ownership, welcome feedback, and push yourself (and others) to raise the bar.

  • You bring positive energy and curiosity, you enjoy solving problems, testing ideas, and collaborating with people who care about what they do.

A list of reasons why you might enjoy working with us:

At Dapper, we not only help our clients to grow but also ensure that we are always committed to advancing ourselves. We get the job done and celebrate afterwards.

  • Consult fast-growing B2B companies

  • Receive training from the leading B2B Marketing experts

  • 30 vacation days per year

  • Participation in our retirement plan (plus a 5% monthly contribution on top of your salary at Nationale Nederlanden)

  • 8% holiday allowance

  • 10 additional unpaid leave days

  • Complimentary breakfast and lunch

  • Travel costs covered

  • Complimentary Macbook

  • Complimentary annual Dapper work vacation with the team

  • Office next to Rotterdam Central Station

  • Gym and wellness facility membership

  • Team activities throughout the year

  • You’re welcomed into a positive work environment where freedom, teamwork, and respect are key

Who are we?

Dapper is a fast-growing B2B marketing agency, headquartered in Rotterdam with a second office in Lisbon. Since 2019, we’ve been redefining what’s possible in B2B marketing.

Thanks to our vision and ambition, within six years Dapper has grown to become B2B Agency of the Year (2025) according to the European Agency Awards. It’s our ambition to become the #1 B2B Marketing Agency worldwide in the next ten years.

We’re home to 65 passionate marketers with a wide range of expertise: performance specialists, content marketers, designers, and more. We represent over 21 nationalities, which helps us serve B2B businesses worldwide.

We prioritize growth, both on a company and personal level. Join Dapper if you want to fast-track your development and work at the forefront of B2B Marketing.

We work by our values:

  1. We Peak Perform: We are always on top of our game, and are passionate about what we do.

  2. We Pioneer: We are innovators at heart. We come first while others follow and drive change.

  3. We don't work, we Play: We enjoy the adventure that we're on together.

Ready? Set? Go!

Are you ready to take the next step with us? Leave your info here, and who knows… See you soon!

  • Can independently lead a project, client discussions and workshop presentation.

jobs.title: Digital Marketing Intern
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Are you our new Digital Marketing Intern?

Do you want to develop an online B2B marketer mindset? Do you want to explore the world of digital marketing? Then this might be the position you are looking for.

You will make a difference

As a Digital Marketing intern, you are a hands-on part of the team helping clients realize digital growth. For who might you do this? Think big and wide, we work with a range of businesses, including promising start-ups, midsized companies, and beyond - such as Logitech or TOPdesk.

As a Digital Marketing Intern, you get to learn about the journey from start to finish - whether you are writing copy for a LinkedIn campaign or launching a Google Ads campaign. In collaboration with your manager, you will determine whether you join the performance or content marketing team. At the end of the internship, you’ll be ready for your first full-time job in marketing!

No, we won’t let you do this alone. You will be joining a team of motivated marketers who are keen to go the extra mile to become the best B2B marketing agency in Europe. If you, like us, dare to dream big, Dapper is the place for you.

Reasons why this job is for you

  • You are currently registered as a student and will be for the duration of the internship.

  • You have strong written and verbal communication skills in Dutch and English!

  • Your are based in the Netherlands

  • You are available full-time for 5 - 6 months

  • You feel comfortable giving advice to companies

  • You have a great set of social skills

  • You have a strong drive and a proactive mindset

  • You know how to have fun

A list of reasons why you might enjoy working with us:

Together, we will help our clients grow and ensure that we are always committed to advancing ourselves. Once we've done that, it's time to celebrate together!

Are you our new Sales Manager?

Dapper is looking for a Sales Manager. Someone ambitious enough to help us build the #1 B2B marketing agency worldwide.

  • Speak Dutch and are fluent in English.

  • Build initial strategies and proposals for potential clients to sell collaborations.

  • Take ownership of projects while still collaborating effectively with your team and clients

  • Hands-on experience in performance marketing, content marketing, demand generation or revenue operations is a plus.

  • You bring positive energy and curiosity, you enjoy solving problems, testing ideas, and collaborating with people who care about what they do.

  • Consult fast-growing B2B companies

  • Complimentary breakfast and lunch

  • Travel costs covered

  • Complimentary Macbook

  • Complimentary annual Dapper work vacation with the team

  • Office next to Rotterdam Central station

  • Gym and wellness facility membership

  • Team activities throughout the year

We’re home to 65 passionate marketers with a wide range of expertise: performance specialists, content marketers, designers, and more. We represent over 21 nationalities, which helps us serve B2B businesses worldwide.

We prioritize growth, both on a company and personal level. Join Dapper if you want to fast-track your development and work at the forefront of B2B Marketing.

 

We work by our values:

2. We Pioneer: We are innovators at heart. We come first while others follow and drive change.

3. We don't work, we Play: We enjoy the adventure that we're on together.

 

Ready? Set? Go!

Are you ready to take the next step with us? Leave your info here. And who knows… See you soon!

jobs.title: VP Engineering
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Why Delphi? 

Delphi is building the network of digital minds.

For the first time, anyone can create an interactive version of themselves: a living profile that talks, teaches, and answers questions in your voice, with your perspective and judgment, around the clock. The internet gave us static profiles and endless feeds. We're building something alive. People won't just read about you, they'll experience how you think.

This is the consumer shift we're betting on. Today it's thousands of the world's most brilliant minds. Next it's everyone: every thought leader, expert, and professional with a digital mind that scales their wisdom to anyone, anywhere. A new social layer where knowledge is abundant, personalized, and discoverable.

We are trusted and loved by thousands of the world’s most brilliant minds. We have tripled revenue, users, and Delphi interactions in the past 6 months - all organically through word of mouth. We plan to accelerate even further from here.

Delphi’s investors include Sequoia Capital, Founders Fund, Abstract Ventures, Michael Ovitz, Gokul Rajaram, Olivia Wilde, and dozens of founders from Lyft, Zoom, Doordash, and many more. Our team includes founders with successful exits and builders from Apple, Spotify, Substack and more.

Learn more about Delphi and this position by calling the CEO’s digital mind here

The Role

As VP of Engineering, you will own and scale Delphi’s engineering organization as we move into our next phase of exponential growth. You’ll set the technical vision, build high-performance teams, and partner closely with product, design, and leadership to to support the next phase of Delphi.

This is a role for someone who wants to help shape the future of human connection, scale wisdom for billions, and build something that will outlast us all.

What You’ll Do

  • Define and execute on the technical vision and architecture for systems serving millions of digital minds.

  • Build and lead the engineering organization to a standard of excellence - establish technical precision practices and foster ownership-driven culture where engineers proactively solve problems.

  • Drive engineering execution - consistently ship high-quality systems quickly, balancing speed and durability.

  • Partner cross-functionally with product, design, and leadership to align strategy and deliver ambitious roadmaps.

  • Raise the bar: mentor leaders, establish a world class engineering culture, and ensure Delphi remains a magnet for top talent.

What You Bring

  • 7+ years of engineering experience, with 2+ years leading teams of 10+ engineers in a hyper-growth, high-expectation environment.

  • A proven track record of building teams and shipping large-scale, high-impact systems.

  • Executive communication skills: can translate between technical and non-technical audiences.

  • First-principles thinker, comfortable navigating ambiguity and inventing new playbooks.

  • Ability to build an ownership-driven engineering culture where teams consistently exceed expectations, beat deadlines, and take complete responsibility for their domains.

Why You'll Love It Here

We work on hard problems. Our team is full of former founders, and entrepreneurial individuals who are taking on immense initiatives.

We push each other. Work from our beautiful Jackson Square office in San Francisco, surrounded by peers pushing to do their best work.

Benefits

  • Unlimited Learning Stipend: Whether it’s books, courses, or conferences, we want to support your growth and development. The more you learn and improve your craft the more effective we will be together.

  • Health, Dental, Vision: Comprehensive coverage to keep to take care of your health.

  • 401k covered by Human Interest.

  • Housing Stipend.

  • Relocation support to SF (as needed)

If you’re looking for just a job, Delphi isn’t the right fit. But if you want to shape the future of human connection, scale wisdom for billions, and build something that will outlast us all - you’ll feel at home here.

Own Product Initiatives: drive digital mind studio creator tools, text/voice/video interaction experiences, and consumer discovery platforms from concept to launch.

Architect Full Stack Systems: design scalable Next.js/Python/AWS solutions with durable data models and efficient database structures that support rapid growth and millions of interactions.

Cross-Domain Excellence: seamlessly navigate frontend React development, backend architecture, database optimization, and cloud infrastructure deployment.

What You Bring

  • Proven ability to build products end-to-end with a track record of taking massive initiatives from concept to launch.

  • Deep proficiency in TypeScript/Next.js and Python with hands-on experience in our core technology stack.

  • Strong understanding of SQL, database design, cloud infrastructure, and containerization for scalable systems.

  • Proven experience with systems architecture and API design (crisp, predictable, versioned), queues, caching, background tasks, resilience, and self-healing patterns.

  • Can-do attitude with intense curiosity about technology and the ability to adapt quickly in our fast-moving environment.

Learn more about Delphi and this position by calling the CEO’s digital mind here

Who You Are

  • Code-first builder with exceptional design taste - You're a front-end engineer who happens to have a great eye for design. You can debate the merits of Server Components vs Client Components as easily as you can critique visual hierarchy.

  • Master of the modern web stack - React, Next.js, TypeScript, and Tailwind aren't just tools you use—they're tools you've mastered. You know the performance implications of your choices and write code that's both beautiful and fast.

  • Obsessive about craft and details - You notice when animations feel off by 50ms, when a loading state causes layout shift, or when a color doesn't meet WCAG standards. You fix these things without being asked.

  • Full-stack front-end engineer - Comfortable working across the entire front-end stack, from API integration and state management to responsive layouts and micro-interactions. Bonus if you can jump into Python backends when needed.

  • Owner, not executor - You prototype quickly, gather feedback, iterate fast, and ship confidently. You take features from zero to production and own the outcomes.

  • Product-minded engineer - You push back on designs that don't serve users, suggest improvements to the product direction, and think deeply about user flows. You build with empathy and intention.

  • Comfortable in ambiguity - You thrive when the problem space is undefined. You're energized by questions like "how should people discover Delphi's?" rather than paralyzed by them.

What You'll Do

  • Build the core interfaces of Delphi Studio - Own and ship the primary user-facing features: creation flows, customization tools, and interaction patterns. You'll write the React components, build the APIs integrations, and polish every detail.

  • Create a discovery platform for digital minds - Design and implement the browsing experience, search functionality, filtering systems, and recommendation interfaces. Make exploring thousands of AI personas feel effortless and delightful.

  • Architect scalable front-end systems - Build reusable component libraries, establish patterns for state management, optimize bundle sizes, and ensure the app performs beautifully at scale.

  • Translate AI complexity into simple UX - Work directly with product and backend engineers to understand AI capabilities, then build interfaces that expose the power while hiding the complexity.

  • Set the standard for quality - Your code will be the example others follow. Write clean TypeScript, build accessible components, implement smooth animations, and establish the bar for what "production-ready" means.

  • Collaborate across disciplines - Partner closely with designers to refine mockups and improve interactions. Work with backend engineers to define API contracts. Sync with product to shape roadmap priorities.

Why You'll Love It Here

We work on hard problems. Our team is full of former founders, and entrepreneurial individuals who are taking on immense initiatives.

We push each other. Work from our beautiful Jackson Square office in San Francisco, surrounded by peers pushing to do their best work.

Benefits

  • Unlimited Learning Stipend: Whether it’s books, courses, or conferences, we want to support your growth and development. The more you learn and improve your craft the more effective we will be together.

  • Health, Dental, Vision: Comprehensive coverage to keep to take care of your health.

  • Housing Stipend.

jobs.title: Customer Success Manager
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Double

Bookkeepers today are stuck working in excel spreadsheets and homegrown project management solutions to support their clients. Double is on a mission to change that.

With our all-in-one tool, bookkeepers can manage their work, communicate with clients, catch hard-to-find errors, and deliver reports to help their small business customers make smarter strategic decisions.

Founded in 2021, Double has raised $12M in funding, backed by leading tech investors like Y Combinator and founders at top startups like Lattice, Front, Superhuman, Plaid, and more. Double currently helps thousands of bookkeepers and accountants manage the books for startups and small businesses across the US.

We're bringing on dozens of new customers each month. You will be the main point of contact for larger firms and will be responsible for helping them onboard and succeed in our product.

What You'll Do

Onboarding Prospective Customers

  • Conduct onboarding calls with prospective customers, train them to use the product, complete technical implementation steps, and help them realize value quickly

  • Coordinate with Account Executives to identify any red flags that would hinder the prospect from subscribing to Double 

  • Maintain a high conversion rate from Free Trial to subscribed customer (80-85%)

Expansion of Existing Accounts

  • Proactively reach out to accounts in your pipeline to ensure they're continuing to reach their goals and respond to inbound support inquiries in a timely manner

  • Identify barriers to success or any roadblocks that would hinder accounts from fully adopting the full feature suite Double offers

  • Facilitate continued check-ins, team training calls, and Q&A sessions via Zoom 

  • Create and maintain customer education materials: record video feature overviews and write user guides for content-driven email sequences

  • Drive expansion revenue of existing accounts in your pipeline (increase MRR)

Internal Team Processes

  • Keep your finger on the pulse of trending feature requests and areas within the product that could be improved, then document and share customer feedback with the rest of the team to inform our product roadmap

  • Document best practices, creating templates for customer engagement at key milestones for various user personas

  • Help the team iterate to find the most efficient internal processes that reduce friction and best help our customers succeed

  • Take on additional projects that inspire you and help move the needle for our team

Who You Are

  • 2-3 years of experience in a customer-facing role at an early-stage SaaS startup

  • Ability to articulate complex concepts in a simple, straightforward manner, both in written and verbal communication

  • Keen attention to detail, thoughtfulness, and a customer-centric mindset

  • Knack and passion for process improvement, documentation, and increasing operational efficiencies

  • Familiarity with modern SaaS technologies such as Slack, Notion, Hubspot and/or Salesforce

  • Accounting/finance experience is preferred; interest in learning the space is required

Benefits

  • Competitive pay and equity

  • Unlimited PTO

  • Health, dental, and vision insurance

Double provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, genetics, sexual orientation, gender identity, or gender expression. We are committed to a diverse and inclusive workforce and welcome people from all backgrounds, experiences, perspectives, and abilities.

jobs.title: Head of People, Prism Media LLC
Senior Software Engineer - Middle and Back Office
Data Scientist (Forward Deployed)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Fundamental

Fundamental is an AI research lab pioneering the future of enterprise decision-making. Our flagship model, NEXUS is the world's most powerful Large Tabular Model (LTM) - purpose-built for the structured records that contain trillions of dollars in business value. With $275m in funding from leading investors and trusted by Fortune 100 companies, Fundamental is giving businesses the Power to Predict.

At Fundamental, you'll work on unprecedented technical challenges in foundation model development and build technology that transforms how the world's largest companies make decisions. This is your opportunity to be part of a category-defining company from the ground-up. Join the team defining the future of enterprise AI.


About the role

Fundamental is seeking a Forward deployed Data Scientist to facilitate the adoption of NEXUS and collaborate with customers to address complex technical challenges.

The Data Scientist is an integral part of our FDE team, which is dedicated to driving the successful deployment of Fundamental products and proving value over legacy baselines or net new use cases. They work hand-in-hand with customers from the Proof of Value stage to post-implementation, ensuring our solutions run securely in the client's production heartbeat.

In this role, you’ll manage customer relations involving multiple stakeholders (IT, C-suite, and data science teams) and function as a key bridge, translating field insights into our product roadmap.

Key responsibilities

  • You’ll individually help deploy into production use cases with considerable business impact, moving from "science experiments" to definitive ROI

  • You’ll work on rigorous head-to-head benchmarking against client baselines (XGBoost, LightGBM), executing the work of data engineering, feature engineering, and validation

  • You’ll work in collaboration with our research and product teams to translate operational pain points and data anomalies into essential inputs for the Fundamental roadmap

  • You’ll be involved in technical strategy to identify the right business problems, prevent data leakage, and handle the "last mile" integration (VPC, on-prem, air-gapped)

  • Your collaboration with the Sales and Solution Architect teams will help align diverse stakeholders and explain predictions to business users

Must have

  • You hold a PhD / master in CS / Math / Stats or you have equivalent deep statistical literacy

  • You have 2+ years as a technical individual contributor (data scientist or software engineer)

  • You have experience with containerization (Docker), orchestration, and writing performant APIs (FastAPI/Flask)

  • You master the end-to-end pipeline, from framing, pre-processing, ml algorithm and validation strategies

  • You have a deep understanding of data handling (PySpark, Pandas) and memory optimization

As part of the Research team, you will contribute to ideation, designing, implementing, and evaluating breakthrough Machine Learning models that will be deployed in the real world. jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Fundamental

Fundamental is an AI research lab pioneering the future of enterprise decision-making. Our flagship model, NEXUS is the world's most powerful Large Tabular Model (LTM) - purpose-built for the structured records that contain trillions of dollars in business value. This is your opportunity to be part of a category-defining company from the ground-up. Join the team defining the future of enterprise AI.


About the role

Fundamental is seeking a Forward Deployed Full-Stack Engineer to build the critical integration layers and interfaces that allow our customers to adopt NEXUS.

The Forward Deployed Engineer is an integral part of our FDE team, dedicated to driving the successful deployment of Fundamental products. While our ML engineers focus on the model performance, you will focus on usability, integration, and system reliability. You will work hand-in-hand with customers from the Proof of Value stage to post-implementation, ensuring our solutions are not just accurate, but accessible, secure, and seamlessly embedded in the client's production workflow. In this role, you’ll manage technical relationships with multiple stakeholders (IT security, application owners, and business users) and function as a key bridge, translating field requirements into features for our platform roadmap.


Key responsibilities

  • You’ll individually architect and build production-grade applications that wrap our core models, turning projects into intuitive, high-value user experiences

  • You’ll lead the last mile engineering efforts, handling API integration, data visualization, and authentication/security requirements (SSO, RBAC) within complex enterprise environments (VPC, on-prem, air-gapped)

  • You’ll design and implement performant backend services to ingest customer data and serve model predictions at scale, ensuring low latency and high availability

  • You’ll work in collaboration with our research and product teams to translate operational friction - such as data ingestion difficulties or UI gaps - into essential inputs for the Fundamental roadmap

  • Your collaboration with the Sales and Solution Architect teams will help align diverse stakeholders, building dashboards and tools that allow business users to inspect, trust, and act on predictions

Must have

  • You hold a BS/MS in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field

  • You have 5+ years as a Full-Stack Engineer, with a track record of shipping production code in complex environments

  • You have deep proficiency in modern frontend frameworks (React, TypeScript, Next.js) and data visualization libraries (D3.js, Recharts, or similar)

  • You have strong experience with backend development (Python/FastAPI, Go, or Node.js) and database design (PostgreSQL, Redis)

  • You have experience with containerization (Docker), orchestration (Kubernetes), and CI/CD pipelines

  • You are comfortable navigating enterprise security constraints and have experience integrating with identity providers (LDAP, SAML, OIDC)

  • You hold strong communication skills with an ability to translate architectural nuances into clear business value for non-technical stakeholders

Nice to have

  • Experience building tools for Data Science or ML workflows (e.g., labeling interfaces, model monitoring dashboards)

  • Experience with cloud-native architectures (AWS, GCP, Azure) and Infrastructure as Code (Terraform)

  • Experience as a Forward Deployed Engineer, Solutions Engineer, or Technical Consultant in a B2B software company

  • Familiarity with data processing frameworks (Pandas, PySpark) to better collaborate with our ML counterparts

Benefits

  • Competitive compensation with salary and equity

  • Comprehensive health coverage for you and your dependents, including medical, dental, vision, and 401K

  • Paid parental leave for all new parents, inclusive of adoptive and surrogate journeys

  • Relocation support for employees moving to join the team in one of our office locations

  • A mission-driven, low-ego culture that values diversity of thought, ownership, and bias toward action

jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Fundamental

Fundamental is an AI research lab pioneering the future of enterprise decision-making. Our flagship model, NEXUS is the world's most powerful Large Tabular Model (LTM) - purpose-built for the structured records that contain trillions of dollars in business value. With $275m in funding from leading investors and trusted by Fortune 100 companies, Fundamental is giving businesses the Power to Predict.

At Fundamental, you'll work on unprecedented technical challenges in foundation model development and build technology that transforms how the world's largest companies make decisions. This is your opportunity to be part of a category-defining company from the ground-up. Join the team defining the future of enterprise AI.

About the role

The Solutions Architect role sits at the intersection of our customers, engineering, enterprise deployment, and product, working directly with some of the world’s most data-rich organizations to bring predictive applications into production using our tabular foundation model. In this role, you will guide customers from early discovery and evaluation through deployment and scale. You’ll work with senior business and technical leaders to identify high-value use cases, design robust architectures, and ensure deployments deliver measurable business impact.

This is a hands-on role combining solution design, data science & machine learning, and production engineering, ideal for someone who enjoys owning a customer's technical success end-to-end and building real systems that perform in complex enterprise environments.

Key responsibilities

  • Lead technical discovery to pinpoint high-feasibility, high-impact use cases where NEXUS demonstrates clear ROI

  • Partner with Sales to drive the technical win by scoping and building "Art of the Possible" demos, running competitive benchmarks, and prototyping solutions on customer data

  • Own the technical strategy for customers, maintaining deep relationships with senior stakeholders and defining the long-term strategy for adoption and expansion

  • Lead the end-to-end delivery project, coordinating Forward Deployed Engineers and customer teams to resolve technical blockers and drive alignment across IT, Governance, and Business stakeholders

  • Design robust solution architectures and integration patterns that ensure production-grade performance in complex enterprise environments (On-prem, VPC, Legacy systems)

  • Translate patterns from the field into high-signal engineering tickets for Product and Research to inform the roadmap and model evolution

  • Codify winning deployment strategies into reusable assets and reference architectures to accelerate the entire Solutions Architect team.

  • Travel 50% of the time

Must have

  • 5+ years of experience in technical consulting or customer-facing technical roles (e.g. Solutions Architect, Data Scientist, Sales Engineer, ML engineer)

  • Proven ability to lead complex technical implementations, spanning traditional machine learning and/or modern Generative AI systems, with an understanding of cloud and on-prem architectures

  • Strong experience working with enterprise customers, including navigating multi-stakeholder environments and deployment cycles

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills to convey complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences

  • Hands-on technical proficiency with a focus on data manipulation (Python, Pandas, SQL) to execute rapid prototyping and analyze customer datasets independently.

  • A collaborative mindset - excited to work cross-functionally, manage trade-offs and balance competing priorities across teams

  • Demonstrated ability to own problems end-to-end, learn quickly, and fill in knowledge gaps as needed to deliver outcomes

  • Humble, team-oriented attitude with a bias toward action and doing what’s necessary to help the broader team win

Benefits

  • Competitive compensation with salary and equity

  • Comprehensive health coverage for you and your dependents, including medical, dental, vision, and 401K

  • Paid parental leave for all new parents, inclusive of adoptive and surrogate journeys

  • Relocation support for employees moving to join the team in one of our office locations

  • A mission-driven, low-ego culture that values diversity of thought, ownership, and bias toward action

jobs.title: Full-Stack Engineer
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Fundamental

Fundamental is an AI research lab pioneering the future of enterprise decision-making. Our flagship model, NEXUS is the world's most powerful Large Tabular Model (LTM) - purpose-built for the structured records that contain trillions of dollars in business value. With $275m in funding from leading investors and trusted by Fortune 100 companies, Fundamental is giving businesses the Power to Predict.

At Fundamental, you'll work on unprecedented technical challenges in foundation model development and build technology that transforms how the world's largest companies make decisions. This is your opportunity to be part of a category-defining company from the ground-up. Join the team defining the future of enterprise AI.

Key responsibilities

As a Full-Stack Engineer at Fundamental, you will be responsible for developing both the front-end and back-end systems that allow users to seamlessly interact with our models. You will work on everything from the user interface to building scalable systems that power data upload and integration pipelines.

Your responsibilities will include:

  • Building robust backend services and APIs for model inference, including efficient batching systems and optimization for large datasets

  • Implementing state management and session persistence mechanisms to maintain model context and deliver consistent user experiences

  • Designing and developing responsive, user-friendly frontends for model interaction, monitoring, and configuration using modern frameworks (React, Vue, or Angular)

  • Designing event-driven architectures with pub/sub messaging patterns to enable asynchronous processing and system scalability

  • Developing database connectivity layers and integration points with third-party data sources (e.g., Snowflake, Databricks)

  • Creating comprehensive error handling, retry mechanisms, and monitoring solutions to ensure system reliability

  • Collaborating with MLOps and DevOps teams to optimize the overall architecture and deployment pipeline

Must have

  • 5+ years of experience in Full-Stack engineering roles

  • Strong Python development experience, particularly with FastAPI and the ASGI ecosystem for high-performance API development

  • Experience building full-stack applications with modern frontend frameworks (React, Vue, Angular) and backend systems

  • Proficiency designing event-driven architectures using pub/sub messaging patterns and integrating distributed task queues (e.g., Celery) for asynchronous processing

  • Understanding of model serving patterns (REST, gRPC, async batching) and experience handling large-scale inference workflows in production

  • Knowledge of database systems (SQL/NoSQL) and integration with cloud data platforms (Snowflake, Databricks)

  • Experience with state management, session persistence, and efficient data flow patterns in distributed applications

  • Proven ability to deliver high-quality, maintainable frontend code and collaborate with design/product stakeholders

Benefits

  • Competitive compensation with salary and equity

  • Paid parental leave for all new parents, inclusive of adoptive and surrogate journeys

  • Own and manage a segment of strategic technology partnerships (cloud providers including marketplaces, data platforms, system integrator, and infrastructure software vendors)

  • Serve as the primary point of contact for partner organizations, engaging with partner managers, sales representatives, solutions architects, and engineering teams

  • Identify, evaluate, and prioritize new partnership opportunities based on strategic fit, market demand, and revenue potential

  • Navigate complex partner ecosystems and internal decision dynamics to secure buy-in, resources, and co-investment from partner organizations

  • Collaborate with product and engineering to shape the integration roadmap based on partner and market feedback

  • Build and maintain partner business plans with clear milestones, success metrics, and pipeline targets

  • Represent Fundamental at partner events, industry conferences, and executive briefings

Must have

  • 8+ years of experience in technical partnerships (of which 3+ within AI), partner management, business development, or solutions architecture within enterprise software, AI/ML, data platforms, and/or cloud infrastructure

  • Strong understanding of cloud and data infrastructure ecosystems (e.g., AWS, GCP, Azure, Databricks, Snowflake, etc) and how enterprise software is distributed via marketplaces and partner channels

jobs.title: Model Serving Engineer
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Fundamental

Fundamental is an AI research lab pioneering the future of enterprise decision-making. Our flagship model, NEXUS is the world's most powerful Large Tabular Model (LTM) - purpose-built for the structured records that contain trillions of dollars in business value. With $275m in funding from leading investors and trusted by Fortune 100 companies, Fundamental is giving businesses the Power to Predict..

At Fundamental, you'll work on unprecedented technical challenges in foundation model development and build technology that transforms how the world's largest companies make decisions. This is your opportunity to be part of a category-defining company from the ground-up. Join the team defining the future of enterprise AI.

About the role

Our Serving team is responsible for turning NEXUS, our Large Tabular Model, into a reliable and scalable production system. We own the infrastructure and execution stack that serves the model across multiple deployment environments, each with different requirements around scale, isolation, performance, and trust.

The team sits at the intersection of research and production engineering. We work closely with researchers to bring new model architectures into production, while building the systems needed to operate them efficiently and predictably under real-world workloads. Tabular foundation models introduce serving challenges that differ meaningfully from traditional LLM inference, including irregular computational behavior and complex resource tradeoffs across CPU, GPU, memory, and networking.

As a Model Serving Engineer, you’ll work across the full inference stack - from Python runtime performance and concurrency behavior to distributed orchestration, GPU serving infrastructure, and deployment architecture. You’ll identify bottlenecks, improve throughput and latency, and help define how new generations of the model are translated from research artifacts into production-grade systems.

This is a deeply technical, Python-heavy role for engineers who enjoy distributed systems, performance optimization, and low-level infrastructure challenges close to modern ML systems.


Key responsibilities

  • Optimize Python inference code for performance under real concurrency constraints, including GIL contention, multi-threading, multiprocessing, async execution, and long-running production workloads

  • Work closely with research to understand model internals and support the continuous evolution of the architecture, especially around complex and non-obvious computational behavior under production load

  • Collaborate with research and infrastructure teams to reason about hardware utilization and serving tradeoffs across GPU, CPU, memory, networking, batching, and concurrency

  • Define and evolve the architecture behind our distributed inference and asynchronous execution stack, including orchestration, worker coordination, and end-to-end concurrency patterns

  • Own the Triton serving layer for NEXUS, including how models are packaged, configured, and executed as part of our production inference pipeline

  • Build observability and performance tooling across the serving stack, and use production metrics to drive tuning decisions around latency, throughput, and resource efficiency

  • Solve cross-cutting serving challenges that emerge from deploying the same model across environments with very different scale, isolation, and reliability constraints

  • Evaluate and integrate new inference runtimes, serving strategies, and infrastructure approaches as the model ecosystem evolves

Must have

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience)

  • 5+ years of experience in model serving, ML infrastructure, or a closely related backend engineering role

  • Deep expertise in Python concurrency, including GIL behavior, multi-threading, thread safety, multiprocessing

  • Experience building asynchronous and message-driven systems

  • High-performance, large-scale distributed systems

  • Ability to read and reason about ML model implementations at a computational level, including compute behavior, batching, memory usage, and inference characteristics

  • Experience profiling and optimizing performance across CPU, memory, I/O, and ideally GPU workloads, and translating findings into architectural improvements

Nice to have

  • Understanding of GPU architecture, performance characteristics, and resource utilization in high-performance compute workloads

  • Experience working with tabular and structured-data ML systems

  • Understanding of neural networks and modern deep learning architectures

  • Experience with Kubernetes and cloud infrastructure

  • Familiarity with DevOps and production infrastructure tooling, including containers, Helm, observability, and CI/CD systems

Benefits

  • Competitive compensation with salary and equity

  • Comprehensive health coverage for you and your dependents

  • Paid parental leave for all new parents, inclusive of adoptive and surrogate journeys

  • Relocation support for employees moving to join the team in one of our office locations

  • A mission-driven, low-ego culture that values diversity of thought, ownership, and bias toward action

Tabular foundation models introduce serving challenges that differ meaningfully from traditional LLM inference, including irregular computational behavior and complex resource tradeoffs across CPU, GPU, memory, and networking.



As a Model Serving Engineer, you’ll work across the full inference stack - from Python runtime performance and concurrency behavior to distributed orchestration, GPU serving infrastructure, and deployment architecture. You’ll identify bottlenecks, improve throughput and latency, and help define how new generations of the model are translated from research artifacts into production-grade systems.



This is a deeply technical, Python-heavy role for engineers who enjoy distributed systems, performance optimization, and low-level infrastructure challenges close to modern ML systems.



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

 - Optimize Python inference code for performance under real concurrency constraints, including GIL contention, multi-threading, multiprocessing, async execution, and long-running production workloads

 - Work closely with research to understand model internals and support the continuous evolution of the architecture, especially around complex and non-obvious computational behavior under production load

 - Collaborate with research and infrastructure teams to reason about hardware utilization and serving tradeoffs across GPU, CPU, memory, networking, batching, and concurrency

 - Define and evolve the architecture behind our distributed inference and asynchronous execution stack, including orchestration, worker coordination, and end-to-end concurrency patterns

 - Own the Triton serving layer for NEXUS, including how models are packaged, configured, and executed as part of our production inference pipeline

 - Build observability and performance tooling across the serving stack, and use production metrics to drive tuning decisions around latency, throughput, and resource efficiency

 - Solve cross-cutting serving challenges that emerge from deploying the same model across environments with very different scale, isolation, and reliability constraints

 - Evaluate and integrate new inference runtimes, serving strategies, and infrastructure approaches as the model ecosystem evolves
   
   


MUST HAVE

 - Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience)

 - 5+ years of experience in model serving, ML infrastructure, or a closely related backend engineering role

 - Deep expertise in Python concurrency, including GIL behavior, multi-threading, thread safety, multiprocessing

 - Experience building asynchronous and message-driven systems

 - High-performance, large-scale distributed systems

 - Ability to read and reason about ML model implementations at a computational level, including compute behavior, batching, memory usage, and inference characteristics

 - Experience profiling and optimizing performance across CPU, memory, I/O, and ideally GPU workloads, and translating findings into architectural improvements
   
   


NICE TO HAVE

 - Understanding of GPU architecture, performance characteristics, and resource utilization in high-performance compute workloads

 - Experience working with tabular and structured-data ML systems

 - Understanding of neural networks and modern deep learning architectures

 - Experience with Kubernetes and cloud infrastructure

 - Familiarity with DevOps and production infrastructure tooling, including containers, Helm, observability, and CI/CD systems
   
   


BENEFITS

 - Competitive compensation with salary and equity

 - Comprehensive health coverage for you and your dependents

 - Paid parental leave for all new parents, inclusive of adoptive and surrogate journeys

 - Relocation support for employees moving to join the team in one of our office locations

 - A mission-driven, low-ego culture that values diversity of thought, ownership, and bias toward action

About Fundamental

Fundamental is an AI research lab pioneering the future of enterprise decision-making. Our flagship model, NEXUS is the world's most powerful Large Tabular Model (LTM) - purpose-built for the structured records that contain trillions of dollars in business value. With $275m in funding from leading investors and trusted by Fortune 100 companies, Fundamental is giving businesses the Power to Predict.

At Fundamental, you'll work on unprecedented technical challenges in foundation model development and build technology that transforms how the world's largest companies make decisions. This is your opportunity to be part of a category-defining company from the ground-up. Join the team defining the future of enterprise AI.

About the role

You will join the Research team as our first software engineer, owning the core codebase behind our model development. The codebase needs to be fast to iterate on, robust through experiments and large training runs, and ready to carry models all the way to production. Working alongside research scientists, you'll find what slows them down and build the infrastructure that fixes it, laying the technical foundations that let Fundamental operate at the frontier of large-scale tabular modeling.

Key responsibilities

  • Amplify and Accelerate: You will be proactive in providing solutions which enable our researchers to be more efficient and effective, including agentic workflows.

  • Steward: You will steward the long-term development and maintenance of our codebase. Ensuring it is production-ready, while preserving the flexibility needed for empirically driven research. You will set the bar for code quality by leading pull request reviews and acting as the gatekeeper for external contributions.

  • Champion Best Practices: Establish and implement software engineering best practices in the machine learning domain, serving as a mentor and guide to research scientists on the team.

  • Elevate Code Maturity & Quality: Lead the transition of our core research codebase from an early-stage experimental state to a highly scalable, maintainable and robust engineering standard. You will proactively manage technical debt, ensure experiment reproducibility, and drive overall code quality.

  • Maintain Documentation: Develop and maintain clear, comprehensive documentation for our research infrastructure and systems.

  • Collaborate Cross-Functionally: Ensure precise interactions of the research codebase with other code at Fundamental to translate research breakthroughs into tangible, real-world impact.

  • Guard the research–engineering contract: Build and own the testing layer that runs alongside model development: CI, contract tests, and verification that catch when research changes break the interfaces engineering depends on. Bugs should surface in PRs, not in production.

Must have

  • 5+ years of software engineering experience, with meaningful time on ML or data-intensive backends, training pipelines, distributed inference, feature infrastructure, or similar.

  • Strong software architecture skills including modular design, clean interfaces, and design patterns for maintainable research codebases.

  • Excellent communication skills with a proven ability to discuss complex technical ideas clearly and collaborate effectively across interdisciplinary teams.

  • Expert-level proficiency in Python and deep familiarity with PyTorch.

  • Hands-on experience with the modern ML research tech stack and cloud infrastructure (e.g., cloud providers (AWS, GCP), Weights & Biases, Datadog, Kubernetes, ArgoCD, GitHub Actions).

  • Demonstrated track record of developing and utilizing solutions for robustness and quality assurance within software and/or ML systems.

  • Mission-driven mindset, motivated by the prospect of real-world impact and a relentless focus on excellence in software development.

Nice to have

  • Familiarity with MLOps best practices, CI/CD for machine learning, and infrastructure-as-code (e.g., Terraform).

  • Experience working in an early-stage, fast-paced startup environment.

  • A background or strong interest in tabular data, data engineering, or enterprise data architecture.

  • Experience with other programming languages (Rust, C++, Go)

  • Contributions to open-source machine learning libraries, frameworks, or tools.

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering or a STEM field

Benefits

  • Competitive compensation with salary and equity

  • Comprehensive health coverage for you and your dependents

  • Paid parental leave for all new parents, inclusive of adoptive and surrogate journeys

  • Relocation support for employees moving to join the team in one of our office locations

  • A mission-driven, low-ego culture that values diversity of thought, ownership, and bias toward action

About Fundamental

Fundamental is an AI research lab pioneering the future of enterprise decision-making. Our flagship model, NEXUS is the world's most powerful Large Tabular Model (LTM) - purpose-built for the structured records that contain trillions of dollars in business value. With $275m in funding from leading investors and trusted by Fortune 100 companies, Fundamental is giving businesses the Power to Predict.

This is your opportunity to be part of a category-defining company from the ground-up. Join the team defining the future of enterprise AI.

About the role

The Solutions Architect role sits at the intersection of our customers, engineering, enterprise deployment, and product, working directly with some of the world’s most data-rich organizations to bring predictive applications into production using our tabular foundation model. In this role, you will guide customers from early discovery and evaluation through deployment and scale. You’ll work with senior business and technical leaders to identify high-value use cases, design robust architectures, and ensure deployments deliver measurable business impact.

This is a hands-on role combining solution design, data science & machine learning, and production engineering, ideal for someone who enjoys owning a customer's technical success end-to-end and building real systems that perform in complex enterprise environments.

Key responsibilities

  • Lead technical discovery to pinpoint high-feasibility, high-impact use cases where NEXUS demonstrates clear ROI

  • Partner with Sales to drive the technical win by scoping and building "Art of the Possible" demos, running competitive benchmarks, and prototyping solutions on customer data

  • Own the technical strategy for customers, maintaining deep relationships with senior stakeholders and defining the long-term strategy for adoption and expansion

  • Lead the end-to-end delivery project, coordinating Forward Deployed Engineers and customer teams to resolve technical blockers and drive alignment across IT, Governance, and Business stakeholders

  • Design robust solution architectures and integration patterns that ensure production-grade performance in complex enterprise environments (On-prem, VPC, Legacy systems)

  • Translate patterns from the field into high-signal engineering tickets for Product and Research to inform the roadmap and model evolution

  • Codify winning deployment strategies into reusable assets and reference architectures to accelerate the entire Solutions Architect team.

  • Travel 50% of the time

Must have

  • 5+ years of experience in technical consulting or customer-facing technical roles (e.g. Solutions Architect, Data Scientist, Sales Engineer, ML engineer)

  • Proven ability to lead complex technical implementations, spanning traditional machine learning and/or modern Generative AI systems, with an understanding of cloud and on-prem architectures

  • Strong experience working with enterprise customers, including navigating multi-stakeholder environments and deployment cycles

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills to convey complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences

  • Hands-on technical proficiency with a focus on data manipulation (Python, Pandas, SQL) to execute rapid prototyping and analyze customer datasets independently.

  • A collaborative mindset - excited to work cross-functionally, manage trade-offs and balance competing priorities across teams

  • Demonstrated ability to own problems end-to-end, learn quickly, and fill in knowledge gaps as needed to deliver outcomes

  • Humble, team-oriented attitude with a bias toward action and doing what’s necessary to help the broader team win

Benefits

  • Competitive compensation with salary and equity

  • Comprehensive health coverage for you and your dependents

  • Paid parental leave for all new parents, inclusive of adoptive and surrogate journeys

  • Relocation support for employees moving to join the team in one of our office locations

  • A mission-driven, low-ego culture that values diversity of thought, ownership, and bias toward action

jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Fundamental

Fundamental is an AI research lab pioneering the future of enterprise decision-making. Our flagship model, NEXUS is the world's most powerful Large Tabular Model (LTM) - purpose-built for the structured records that contain trillions of dollars in business value. With $275m in funding from leading investors and trusted by Fortune 100 companies, Fundamental is giving businesses the Power to Predict.

At Fundamental, you'll work on unprecedented technical challenges in foundation model development and build technology that transforms how the world's largest companies make decisions. This is your opportunity to be part of a category-defining company from the ground-up. Join the team defining the future of enterprise AI.

About the role

In this role, you'll research, develop, and productize data science capabilities that enhance and expand our product performance on real enterprise use cases - working across a wide range of prediction tasks, data types, and business domains. You'll go deep on hard data science problems, collaborate closely with R&D on product capabilities, and ship production-grade work that has a direct impact on Production use cases.

Key responsibilities

  • Research and develop data science methods that improve NEXUS predictive performance across diverse enterprise datasets, industries, and prediction task types

  • Design and implement robust, production-quality Python components with a strong focus on correctness, generality, and reusability

  • Deeply understand the characteristics of real-world enterprise data and develop strategies that help NEXUS handle them reliably

  • Run rigorous experiments to measure the impact of new approaches, design meaningful benchmarks, and use results to guide prioritization

  • Work across a wide variety of structured data problems - including but not limited to classification, regression, ranking, and forecasting

  • Collaborate closely with the Engineering and Research teams to develop a deep understanding of NEXUS model behavior and use that knowledge to inform your work

  • Work with Applied AI Engineers to validate approaches on real customer datasets and translate findings into product capabilities

  • Contribute to technical documentation and internal best practices, helping the broader team apply new capabilities correctly and confidently

Must have

  • 5+ years of experience in data science or machine learning roles

  • Strong Python skills, including fluency with pandas, numpy, and scikit-learn

  • Deep hands-on experience with traditional ML models: XGBoost, LightGBM, CatBoost, and similar gradient boosting frameworks

  • Solid understanding of what makes real-world tabular data challenging: class imbalance, high cardinality, distribution shift, missing values, and more

  • Strong experimental mindset - comfortable designing benchmarks and drawing rigorous conclusions from noisy results

  • Ability to work autonomously and drive work from idea to shipped output

Nice to have

  • Familiarity with tabular foundation models (TabPFN, CARTE, or similar)

  • Competitive data science experience (Kaggle, DrivenData, or similar) - especially top finishes on tabular competitions

  • Background in a domain where structured prediction matters: finance, supply chain, healthcare, retail, or industrial

  • Experience contributing to or designing internal ML libraries or shared tooling

  • Familiarity with DuckDB, Polars, or modern in-process analytics engines

  • Comfort reading ML research papers and translating findings into practical implementations

Benefits

  • Paid parental leave for all new parents, inclusive of adoptive and surrogate journeys

  • Relocation support for employees moving to join the team in one of our office locations

  • A mission-driven, low-ego culture that values diversity of thought, ownership, and bias toward action

jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Fundamental

Fundamental is an AI research lab pioneering the future of enterprise decision-making. Our flagship model, NEXUS is the world's most powerful Large Tabular Model (LTM) - purpose-built for the structured records that contain trillions of dollars in business value. With $275m in funding from leading investors and trusted by Fortune 100 companies, Fundamental is giving businesses the Power to Predict.

At Fundamental, you'll work on unprecedented technical challenges in foundation model development and build technology that transforms how the world's largest companies make decisions. This is your opportunity to be part of a category-defining company from the ground-up. Join the team defining the future of enterprise AI.


About the role

Fundamental is seeking a Forward Deployed Data Scientist - Oil & Gas, Houston to facilitate the adoption of NEXUS and collaborate with customers to address complex technical challenges with an initial focus on Houston-based Oil & Gas customers.

The Data Scientist is an integral part of our FDE team, which is dedicated to driving the successful deployment of Fundamental products and proving value over legacy baselines or net new use cases. They work hand-in-hand with customers from the Proof of Value stage to post-implementation, ensuring our solutions run securely in the client's production heartbeat.

In this role, you’ll manage customer relations involving multiple stakeholders (IT, C-suite, and data science teams) and function as a key bridge, translating field insights into our product roadmap.

Key responsibilities

  • You'll individually help deploy into production use cases with considerable business impact, moving from "science experiments" to definitive ROI

  • You’ll work on rigorous head-to-head benchmarking against client baselines (XGBoost, LightGBM), executing the work of data engineering, feature engineering, and validation

  • You’ll work in collaboration with our research and product teams to translate operational pain points and data anomalies into essential inputs for the Fundamental roadmap

  • You’ll be involved in technical strategy to identify the right business problems, prevent data leakage, and handle the "last mile" integration (VPC, on-prem, air-gapped)

  • Your collaboration with the Sales and Solution Architect teams will help align diverse stakeholders and explain predictions to business users

Must have

  • You hold a PhD / master in CS / Math / Stats or you have equivalent deep statistical literacy

  • You have 7+ years as a technical individual contributor in Data Science, Machine Learning, Applied Science, or ML Engineering

  • You have strong experience working directly with customers or business stakeholders, ideally in complex enterprise or industrial environments

  • You have experience with containerization (Docker), orchestration, and writing performant APIs (FastAPI/Flask)

  • You master the end-to-end pipeline, from framing, pre-processing, ml algorithm and validation strategies

  • You have a deep understanding of data handling (PySpark, Pandas) and memory optimization

  • You have demonstrated experience optimizing models for a specific business problem

  • You hold strong communication skills with an ability to translate architectural nuances into clear business value

Nice to have

  • Experience with PyTorch and cloud-native ML pipelines (AWS, GCP, Azure)

  • Prior experience or understanding of Oil & Gas, energy, utilities, industrials, logistics, or heavy asset environments

  • Experience as a Forward Deployed Engineer, Staff Engineer, Machine Learning Engineer, or Staff Data Scientist

  • Industry-based subject matter expertise

Benefits

  • Competitive compensation with salary and equity

  • Comprehensive health coverage for you and your dependents, including medical, dental, vision, and 401K

  • Paid parental leave for all new parents, inclusive of adoptive and surrogate journeys

  • Relocation support for employees moving to join the team in one of our office locations

  • A mission-driven, low-ego culture that values diversity of thought, ownership, and bias toward action

jobs.title: AI Deployment Strategist - Houston
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Fundamental

Fundamental is an AI research lab pioneering the future of enterprise decision-making. Our flagship model, NEXUS is the world's most powerful Large Tabular Model (LTM) - purpose-built for the structured records that contain trillions of dollars in business value. With $275m in funding from leading investors and trusted by Fortune 100 companies, Fundamental is giving businesses the Power to Predict.

At Fundamental, you'll work on unprecedented technical challenges in foundation model development and build technology that transforms how the world's largest companies make decisions. This is your opportunity to be part of a category-defining company from the ground-up. Join the team defining the future of enterprise AI.


About the role

The AI Deployment Strategist owns the AI strategy for one of Fundamental's most strategic accounts. You are the single person accountable for how NEXUS grows inside that enterprise: which business problems it solves next, which executives sponsor it, how value is measured and communicated, and how a first deployment becomes a multi-year, multi-business-unit program.

Where a Solutions Architect owns the technical win, you own the commercial and strategic one. You will operate as the customer's trusted advisor on applied AI, sitting with senior business leaders to map where prediction changes decisions in their P&L, building the case for each new use case, and orchestrating Fundamental's Solutions Architects, Forward Deployed Engineers, Research, and leadership team to deliver against that roadmap. Expansion of the account is your primary measure of success.

This role is based in Houston, embedded with an anchor customer in oil and gas, with regular time on site and in our San Francisco office. You need to already speak the language of the industry: how an operator plans capital, runs its assets, trades its production, and makes decisions across upstream, midstream, and corporate functions. The role suits someone who has spent years advising energy companies on strategy and operations, wants to move from recommending to owning outcomes, and is comfortable being the face of an early-stage company inside a Fortune 100 organization.

Key responsibilities

  • Own the account AI strategy: build and maintain a multi-year roadmap of NEXUS use cases across the customer's business units, prioritized by business value, feasibility, and executive appetite

  • Drive expansion: identify, qualify, and shape new opportunities inside the account, from first conversation through business case, budget, and commercial agreement, working hand in hand with Sales and Fundamental's leadership team

  • Build and run the executive relationship map: cultivate sponsors at VP and C-level, run steering committees and quarterly business reviews, and turn deployed use cases into internal champions and reference stories

  • Quantify and communicate value: define the business KPIs for each deployment before it starts, track realized impact against them, and translate model performance into language a CFO acts on

  • Orchestrate delivery: set priorities for the Solutions Architects and Forward Deployed Engineers assigned to the account, remove organizational blockers across IT, data governance, procurement, and business lines, and keep every workstream tied to the strategic roadmap

  • Structure the account like a portfolio: run discovery workshops with functional leaders (production operations, drilling and completions, supply chain, finance and planning, commercial and trading, HSE), map decision points to prediction problems, and sequence bets to compound trust and value

  • Be the voice of the customer inside Fundamental: bring field patterns, competitive intelligence, and unmet needs to Product, Research, and the executive team to shape roadmap and go-to-market

  • Codify the expansion playbook: turn what works in this account into repeatable frameworks, business case templates, and executive narratives that the wider Applied AI team can reuse across strategic accounts

  • Travel as needed between customer sites, Houston, and San Francisco

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Business, Economics, Finance, Engineering, or a related field; MBA or equivalent is a plus

  • 5+ years of experience in the oil and gas industry, either in strategy consulting (MBB or equivalent) serving energy clients, in corporate strategy or operations at an operator or oilfield services company, or in a strategic account role selling enterprise technology into oil and gas

  • Working knowledge of how an oil and gas company runs: upstream and midstream operations, capital allocation and portfolio planning, production and cost forecasting, commodity markets, and the organizational structure of a major or large independent

  • Track record of expanding an engagement or account: turning a single project into a broader program by finding new problems, building the business case, and securing executive sponsorship and budget

  • Executive presence and structured communication: comfortable leading a room of senior leaders, writing a crisp one-page recommendation, and defending a value model line by line

  • Strong commercial and financial acumen: able to build a business case, model ROI, and navigate enterprise procurement and budget cycles

  • Enough technical fluency to be credible with data and ML teams: you understand what a prediction problem is, what data it needs, and how to judge whether a use case is feasible, even if you don't write the code

  • An existing network of senior relationships in Houston's energy ecosystem is a strong plus

  • Ownership mentality: you want to be measured on outcomes for the account, not on deliverables, and you are energized rather than daunted by ambiguity

  • Humble, team-oriented attitude with a bias toward action and doing what is necessary to help the broader team win

Benefits

  • Competitive compensation with salary and equity

  • Comprehensive health coverage for you and your dependents, including medical, dental, vision, and 401K

  • Paid parental leave for all new parents, inclusive of adoptive and surrogate journeys

  • Relocation support for employees moving to join the team in one of our office locations

  • A mission-driven, low-ego culture that values diversity of thought, ownership, and bias toward action
