jobs.description:
We are looking for an AI Product Manager to join our Cross-Border Payments team.
 
This role combines strong technical understanding, FDE (Forward Deployed Engineer) capabilities, APP product experience, and AI product expertise. You will work closely with engineering, operations, risk, and business teams to identify real-world problems and turn AI and technology capabilities into scalable products.

lists.content:
• Own the end-to-end product lifecycle for cross-border payment products, with a strong focus on APP and user-facing experiences.
  • Deeply understand user and business needs, using data and user insights to improve product experience, conversion, engagement, and efficiency.
  • Operate with an FDE mindset by working closely with business and operational teams to identify problems, prototype solutions, and drive them into production.
  • Partner closely with engineering teams and contribute to technical discussions involving APIs, system architecture, data, integrations, and frontend/backend interactions.
  • Identify and develop opportunities to apply AI/LLM capabilities to real business and product scenarios.
  • Design and launch AI-powered features and workflows, including LLM applications, AI Agents, RAG, intelligent customer support, AI-assisted operations, and workflow automation.
  • Own the full AI product lifecycle from problem identification, product definition, solution design, development, launch, and performance evaluation.
  • Use product data, user feedback, and market insights to continuously improve product performance.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with Engineering, Design, Operations, Data, Risk, and other stakeholders to drive product initiatives from concept to production.
  • Support product localization and optimization across different international markets.

• 3+ years of Product Management experience, with strong technical understanding or a technical background. A degree or previous experience in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field is preferred.
  • Proven experience building and operating consumer-facing or APP products, with a strong understanding of user growth, engagement, retention, conversion, and UX.
  • Hands-on experience with AI products or AI-powered projects, with a solid understanding of LLMs, AI Agents, RAG, and related AI technologies.
  • Demonstrated ability to translate AI capabilities into practical product and business applications, rather than simply using AI tools.
  • Strong technical understanding of APIs, databases, system architecture, data flows, and frontend/backend interactions.
  • Ability to work closely with engineers and participate meaningfully in technical solution design. Coding experience is a strong plus.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to use data to identify problems and measure product impact.
  • Experience in payments, fintech, cross-border payments, financial products, or transaction-based businesses is preferred.
  • Strong business judgment and ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, ambiguous environment.
  • Professional working proficiency in English; experience with international or global products is preferred.

lists.content:
• Responsible for AI Agent security review and penetration testing, including defense design and implementation against emerging threats such as AI tool misuse, context poisoning, various forms of data/prompt poisoning, and prompt injection.
  • Responsible for designing and developing AI-based automated security detection tools, enabling automated alert triage, attack attribution, and improved security operations efficiency.
  • Participate in building Agent behavior auditing and anomaly detection systems, identifying abnormal behavior chains during Agent runtime, constructing an AI-driven security operations platform, and exploring, designing, and implementing defense and countermeasure solutions based on real business scenarios.
  • Combine security risks of cloud-native infrastructure (K8S, Docker, cloud services) to assess the attack surface of Agent runtime environments and design defense-in-depth solutions.

1. At least 3+ years of security offense/defense experience (penetration testing/red team practice), with 1+ years of experience in LLM (large model) security offense/defense; extensive hands-on red team experience preferred.
  2. Familiar with network architecture and cloud-native technology stacks, including K8S, Docker container security, and cloud security (IAM, network isolation, cloud-native threat models, etc.), with the ability to assess security risks in complex infrastructure.
  3. Possess practical Agent development capability, able to independently build/modify AI Agents (e.g., based on frameworks such as LangChain), as well as hands-on offensive capability against Agents (practical construction and validation of attack techniques such as tool misuse, prompt injection, context poisoning).
  4. Familiar with security frameworks such as OWASP Top 10 for LLM and MITRE ATT&CK, familiar with common AI attack techniques, adversarial logic, and defense solutions, with a strong passion for AI security.
  5. Proficient in at least one programming language such as Python/Go/C++, with the ability to develop security offense/defense tools or perform deep secondary development on open-source security platforms.

Nice to Have

  1. Familiar with mainstream AI frameworks (PyTorch, TensorFlow, LangChain, etc.), with practical experience in local deployment and optimization of large language models.
  2. Hands-on cloud security (AWS) experience or related certifications.

As an App Developer Senior Manager, you will be the core leader of the company’s app development business, responsible for formulating the app development strategy, technical roadmap, and work plan, aligning with the company’s business development goals and regulatory requirements. You will oversee the entire lifecycle of app development, including demand analysis, technical architecture design, development implementation, testing, launch, iteration, and maintenance, focusing on meeting the functional needs of core business links such as digital currency spot trading, derivative trading, fund recharge and withdrawal, and user asset management. This role requires in-depth understanding of mobile app development technologies, rich team management experience, strong technical research and development capabilities, and familiarity with app security and compliance requirements related to digital assets, to ensure the company’s mobile apps are stable, efficient, secure, and compliant.

Key Responsibilities

1. App Development Strategy & Technical Planning

  • Formulate the company’s app development strategy, technical roadmap, and annual/quarterly development plan, combining the company’s business needs (digital currency trading, payment settlement) and industry technical trends (cross-platform development, app security, user experience optimization).
  • Determine the app technical architecture, development framework, and technology stack (such as iOS: Swift, Android: Kotlin/Java, cross-platform: Flutter/React Native), optimize the technical architecture, and ensure the scalability, maintainability, and security of the app.
  • Research and introduce advanced app development technologies, tools, and methodologies, promote technical innovation and optimization, improve development efficiency and product quality, and enhance the company’s app technical competitiveness.
  • Coordinate with the product team to clarify app functional requirements, convert business needs into technical solutions, and formulate detailed development plans and schedules.

    • 2. Full Lifecycle App Development Management

  • Oversee the entire lifecycle of app development, including demand review, technical design, coding development, unit testing, integration testing, UAT testing, and launch, ensuring that the development work is completed on time, with quality and quantity.
  • Supervise the development of core app functions, including digital currency trading interface, order execution, fund management, user authentication, message push, and security encryption, ensuring that functions meet business requirements and regulatory standards.
  • Manage app iteration and maintenance work, collect user feedback and technical problems, formulate iteration plans, fix online bugs in a timely manner, and continuously optimize app performance and user experience.
  • Coordinate with the test team to formulate test plans and test standards, supervise the test process, ensure that the app meets quality requirements before launch, and reduce online risks.
  • Manage app release and update work, handle release processes in major app stores (App Store, Huawei AppGallery, Xiaomi App Store, etc.), and ensure the smooth launch and update of the app.

    • 3. App Security & Compliance Management

  • Establish and improve the app security management system, formulate app security standards and specifications, and ensure that the app meets data security, user privacy protection, and digital asset security requirements.
  • Oversee app security development, conduct regular security audits and vulnerability scans, identify and fix security risks (such as data leakage, malicious attacks, and tampering), and ensure the security of user assets and transaction data.
  • Ensure that app development and operation comply with global regulatory requirements (FATF, MiCA, local regulations) and app store review rules, handle compliance-related issues, and avoid regulatory risks and app removal risks.
  • Cooperate with the compliance and risk control teams to complete app compliance reviews, regulatory filings, and security assessments, and provide relevant technical materials and explanations.

    • 4. Team Management & Development

  • Build, manage, and develop the app development team, formulate team OKRs, performance assessment standards, and talent training plans, and improve the team’s professional capabilities (app development, technical research, problem solving, etc.).
  • Arrange daily work assignments for the team, supervise work progress, solve technical difficulties in the development process, and create a positive and collaborative technical team atmosphere.
  • Guide team members’ professional growth, organize technical training, technical sharing, and skill assessments, cultivate technical backbones, and build a professional app development talent echelon.
  • Manage team performance, conduct regular performance reviews, motivate team members to achieve work goals, and retain core technical talents.

    • 5. Cross-departmental Collaboration & Technical Support

  • Communicate closely with product, trading, compliance, risk control, operations, and other departments to understand business needs, coordinate app development-related work, and ensure that app development is closely aligned with business development.
  • Cooperate with the backend development team to ensure the smooth docking of app and backend systems, and solve interface docking and data interaction problems.
  • Provide technical support for other departments, answer app-related technical questions, assist in solving app-related problems in business operations, and support the promotion and operation of the app.
  • Communicate with external technical partners (app stores, security service providers, etc.) to handle technical cooperation and coordination matters.

    • 6. Project & Budget Management

  • Manage app development projects, formulate project plans, control project progress, cost, and quality, identify project risks, and put forward targeted risk mitigation measures.
  • Formulate the app development team’s budget plan, control development costs, reasonably allocate resources, and improve resource utilization efficiency.
  • Track and analyze project execution, conduct project summary and review, summarize experience and lessons, and continuously optimize project management processes.

1. Experience: 7+ years of mobile app development and management work experience, including 3+ years of app development team management experience; preferred experience in fintech, digital currency, payment, or internet financial institutions. Deep understanding of app development processes, technical architecture, and digital asset-related business models, with experience in leading the development and launch of large-scale mobile apps.
  2. Professional Expertise:
    1. Proficient in mobile app development technologies, familiar with at least one of the mainstream development frameworks (iOS: Swift; Android: Kotlin/Java; cross-platform: Flutter/React Native), with rich practical development experience.
    2. Familiar with app technical architecture design, performance optimization, security encryption, and interface docking technologies, able to solve complex technical problems in app development.
    3. Familiar with app store review rules and compliance requirements, with experience in app release, update, and maintenance in major app stores.
    4. Familiar with digital currency exchange-related business (spot trading, derivative trading, fund recharge and withdrawal), able to convert business needs into technical solutions.
    5. Proficient in agile development methodologies (Scrum, Kanban), able to manage app development projects efficiently; familiar with project management tools (Jira, Trello, etc.) and code management tools (Git, SVN, etc.).
  3. Leadership & Management: Excellent leadership and team management capabilities, able to build and lead a high-performance app development team; strong work organization, coordination, and decision-making capabilities.
  4. Technical Research & Innovation: Strong technical sensitivity and learning ability, able to track industry technical trends, research and introduce advanced technologies, and promote technical innovation and optimization.
  5. Communication Skills: Excellent oral and written communication skills in both Chinese and English, able to effectively communicate with cross-departmental colleagues, external partners, and team members.
  6. Education: Bachelor’s degree or above in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or related fields; relevant professional certifications (such as PMP, CKAD, CKA) are preferred.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Has app development management experience in compliant digital currency exchanges, familiar with the development needs of digital currency trading apps and related compliance requirements.
  • Has experience in leading cross-platform app development projects (Flutter/React Native), with rich experience in app performance optimization and security reinforcement.
  • Has experience in handling app security incidents and regulatory compliance reviews, and is proficient in solving app-related security and compliance problems.
  • Familiar with blockchain technology and digital asset underlying logic, able to combine technical iteration to optimize app functions and user experience.

lists.content:
• System Architecture & Delivery: Lead the architectural design, end-to-end development, and performance optimization of the core cross-border payment platform. Spearhead technical implementations across the full payment lifecycle, including acquiring, clearing, settlement, and ledger accounting.

  • Capital Security & Risk Mitigation: Architect robust anti-fund-loss frameworks by deeply analyzing transaction risks. Design and deploy automated reconciliation engines, sophisticated exception-handling systems, and continuous fund audits to structurally eliminate financial leaks and capital exposure.

  • Global Channel Integration: Spearhead integrations with international payment rails, banking channels, local payment methods (LPMs), and major credit card networks. Architect configurations to seamlessly handle complex cross-border variables, including localized compliance, dynamic exchange rates (FX), and multi-currency settlement.

  • Performance & Scalability Optimization: Continuously optimize system infrastructure to guarantee high availability, low latency, and operational efficiency. Solve critical distributed system challenges involving massive concurrency, distributed transactions, and strict data consistency.

  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner closely with risk management, corporate finance, compliance, and product teams to drive continuous improvements in payment system stability, security, and financial compliance.

• 5+ years of professional, hands-on Java development experience, with at least 2+ years dedicated to technical architecture and distributed system design.

  • At least 2+ years of specialized experience in building and maintaining payment infrastructure, with deep proficiency in the core logic, architecture, and transaction flows of cross-border payment platforms.

  • Proven track record of serving as the lead developer or architect for the end-to-end lifecycle of a core payment platform (covering acquiring, clearing, or settlement).

  • Strong understanding of capital protection frameworks. Possesses practical experience in diagnosing fund-loss incidents or designing automated mitigation systems (such as high-speed reconciliation engines or fund audits).

  • Prior experience handling integrations with international payment rails, banking APIs, localized payment methods (LPMs), and credit card networks is highly preferred.

  • Excellent communication skills with a strong sense of ownership, accountability, and a proactive approach to technical problem-solving.

jobs.description:
Join the Pioneer Crypto Brand in the Philippines!

Coins is the most established crypto brand in The Philippines and has gained the trust of more than 18 million users. Through the easy-to-use mobile app, users can buy and sell a variety of different cryptocurrencies and access a wide range of financial services.

Coins is fully regulated by the Bangko Sentral ng Pilipinas (BSP) and is the first ever crypto-based company in Asia to hold both Virtual Currency and Electronic Money Issuer licenses from a central bank.

We're looking for a Backend Engineer who wants to grow their career building payment systems used by millions. You'll work with senior engineers and architects in a regional team, and you'll use AI tools every day to build, test, and ship faster.

lists.content:
• Build and ship backend services: Design, develop, test, and maintain Java-based microservices that run our payment platform. Contribute to features across the payment lifecycle, including acquiring, clearing, settlement, and ledger accounting.

  • Protect user funds: Help build and improve reconciliation jobs, exception-handling flows, and monitoring that keep every transaction accurate and every peso accounted for.

  • Integrate with partners: Work on integrations with banks, local payment methods, card networks, and international payment partners. Along the way you'll learn how multi-currency and FX flows work.

  • Use AI in your daily work: Use AI-assisted development tools (e.g., code assistants, AI-driven testing, and debugging) to work more productively. Help explore and prototype AI-powered features and internal tools.

  • Improve reliability and performance: Troubleshoot production issues, write clean and well-tested code, and help make our systems more available, scalable, and efficient.

  • Collaborate across teams and regions: Work closely with product, risk, finance, and compliance, as well as Mandarin-speaking engineering and business teams, to deliver secure and compliant solutions.

• 1–5 years of professional backend development experience. Strong fresh graduates with solid internship or project experience are welcome to apply.

  • Hands-on experience with Java (Spring Boot preferred). Experience in other backend languages is a plus if you're willing to work mainly in Java.

  • Familiarity with microservices architecture, RESTful APIs, and relational databases (e.g., MySQL, PostgreSQL).

  • A strong interest in AI, such as regularly using AI coding tools, experimenting with LLMs or AI APIs, or building AI-powered side projects.

  • Proficiency in Mandarin Chinese (spoken and written) is required. You'll work regularly with Mandarin-speaking teams and stakeholders. Business-level English is also required.

  • A good grasp of computer science fundamentals: data structures, algorithms, and basic distributed systems concepts.

  • Strong problem-solving skills, ownership, and eagerness to learn.

• Exposure to fintech, payments, banking, e-wallets, or crypto.

  • Experience with message queues (e.g., Kafka, RabbitMQ), caching (e.g., Redis), or containerization (Docker, Kubernetes).

  • Understanding of transaction consistency, idempotency, or reconciliation concepts.

  • Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Alibaba Cloud).

As a Backend Senior Manager, you will be the core technical leader of the company’s backend business, responsible for formulating the backend technical strategy, technical roadmap, and system architecture plan, aligning with the company’s business development goals and regulatory requirements. You will oversee the full lifecycle of backend system development, including architecture design, technical selection, development implementation, testing, deployment, iteration, and maintenance, focusing on supporting core business links such as digital currency spot trading, derivative trading, fund recharge and withdrawal, user authentication, and transaction settlement. This role requires in-depth understanding of backend development technologies, rich senior team management experience, strong system architecture design capabilities, and familiarity with backend security and compliance requirements related to digital assets, to ensure the company’s backend systems are stable, efficient, secure, and scalable.

Key Responsibilities

1. Backend Technical Strategy & Architecture Planning

  • Formulate the company’s backend technical strategy, long-term and short-term technical roadmap, and system architecture plan, combining the company’s business development needs (digital currency trading, payment settlement) and industry technical trends (distributed systems, microservices, cloud native, big data, etc.).
  • Lead the design and optimization of the core backend system architecture, determine the technical framework, technology stack (such as Java, Go, Python, Node.js), and system deployment mode (on-premises, cloud, hybrid cloud), ensure the scalability, maintainability, high availability, and security of the system.
  • Research and introduce advanced backend technologies, tools, and methodologies (such as microservice architecture, containerization, CI/CD, monitoring and alerting), promote technical innovation and architecture optimization, improve development efficiency, system performance, and operation and maintenance capabilities.
  • Evaluate and select technical solutions for core business scenarios, provide technical decision support for business development, and ensure that technical solutions are aligned with business goals and regulatory requirements.

    • 2. Backend System Development & Lifecycle Management

  • Oversee the full lifecycle of backend system development, including demand review, technical design, coding development, unit testing, integration testing, UAT testing, deployment, and online operation, ensuring that the development work is completed on time, with quality and quantity.
  • Supervise the development of core backend modules, including trading system, payment settlement system, user management system, asset management system, risk control system, and API gateway, ensuring that system functions meet business requirements and regulatory standards.
  • Manage backend system iteration and maintenance work, monitor system operation status, collect and analyze system performance data, identify and solve system bottlenecks, fix online bugs in a timely manner, and continuously optimize system performance and stability.
  • Coordinate with the DevOps team to build and optimize the CI/CD pipeline, improve the automation level of system deployment, testing, and operation and maintenance, reduce manual operations, and improve system deployment efficiency and stability.

    • 3. Backend Security & Compliance Management

  • Establish and improve the backend system security management system, formulate security standards and specifications, and ensure that the backend system meets data security, user privacy protection, and digital asset security requirements.
  • Lead the security development of backend systems, conduct regular security audits, vulnerability scans, and penetration tests, identify and fix security risks (such as data leakage, malicious attacks, and transaction tampering), and ensure the security of user assets and transaction data.
  • Ensure that backend system development and operation comply with global regulatory requirements (FATF, MiCA, local regulations), cooperate with the compliance and risk control teams to complete system compliance reviews, regulatory filings, and security assessments, and provide relevant technical materials and explanations.
  • Establish a system disaster recovery plan and emergency response mechanism, conduct regular disaster recovery drills, ensure business continuity in case of system failures or emergencies.

    • 4. Team Management & Talent Development

  • Build, manage, and develop the backend development team, formulate team structure, OKRs, performance assessment standards, and talent training plans, and improve the team’s overall professional capabilities (backend development, architecture design, security development, etc.).
  • Arrange daily work assignments for the team, supervise work progress, solve complex technical difficulties in the development process, and create a positive, collaborative, and high-performance technical team atmosphere.
  • Guide team members’ professional growth, cultivate technical backbones and system architects, organize technical training, technical sharing, and skill assessments, and build a professional backend talent echelon.
  • Manage team performance, conduct regular performance reviews, motivate team members to achieve work goals, and retain core technical talents.

    • 5. Cross-departmental Collaboration & Technical Coordination

  • Communicate closely with product, app development, trading, compliance, risk control, operations, and other departments to understand business needs, coordinate backend development-related work, and ensure that backend systems are closely aligned with business development.
  • Coordinate with the app development team to optimize API design and interface docking, ensure the smooth interaction between backend and frontend systems, and improve the overall product experience.
  • Cooperate with the data team to provide data support for business analysis, risk control, and decision-making, and optimize data collection, storage, and analysis processes.
  • Communicate with external technical partners (cloud service providers, security service providers, etc.) to handle technical cooperation and coordination matters, and ensure the smooth operation of backend systems.

    • 6. Project & Resource Management

  • Manage key backend development projects, formulate project plans, control project progress, cost, and quality, identify project risks, and put forward targeted risk mitigation measures.
  • Formulate the backend development team’s budget plan, control development costs, reasonably allocate technical resources, and improve resource utilization efficiency.
  • Track and analyze project execution, conduct project summary and review, summarize experience and lessons, and continuously optimize project management processes.

1. Experience: 10+ years of backend development and management work experience, including 5+ years of senior backend team management experience; preferred experience in fintech, digital currency, payment, or large-scale internet financial institutions. Deep understanding of backend development processes, system architecture design, and digital asset-related business models, with experience in leading the development and operation of large-scale backend systems (supporting high concurrency, high availability).
  2. Professional Expertise:
    1. Proficient in backend development technologies and frameworks, familiar with at least one mainstream programming language (Java, Go, Python, Node.js), with rich practical development experience in distributed systems, microservices, and cloud native technologies.
    2. Excellent system architecture design capabilities, able to design scalable, high-availability, and secure backend architectures for core business scenarios (such as high-concurrency trading systems, large-scale payment settlement systems).
    3. Familiar with backend security technologies (encryption, authentication, authorization, anti-attack), with experience in building and optimizing backend security systems, and familiar with digital asset-related security compliance requirements.
    4. Familiar with DevOps practices (CI/CD, containerization, monitoring and alerting), proficient in using related tools (Docker, Kubernetes, Jenkins, Prometheus, etc.), able to improve the automation level of development and operation and maintenance.
    5. Familiar with digital currency exchange-related business (spot trading, derivative trading, fund recharge and withdrawal, transaction settlement), able to convert business needs into technical solutions and architecture designs.
  3. Leadership & Management: Excellent leadership and senior team management capabilities, able to build and lead a high-performance backend development team; strong strategic thinking, decision-making capabilities, and resource integration capabilities.
  4. Technical Research & Innovation: Strong technical sensitivity and learning ability, able to track industry technical trends, research and introduce advanced technologies, and promote technical innovation and architecture optimization.
  5. Communication Skills: Excellent oral and written communication skills in both Chinese and English, able to effectively communicate with senior management, cross-departmental colleagues, external partners, and team members.
  6. Education: Bachelor’s degree or above in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or related fields; relevant professional certifications (such as PMP, CKA, CKAD, AWS Certified Solutions Architect) are preferred.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Has backend senior management experience in compliant digital currency exchanges, familiar with the backend development needs and compliance requirements of digital currency trading systems.
  • Has experience in leading the transformation of backend systems (such as monolithic architecture to microservice architecture, traditional deployment to cloud native deployment), with rich experience in system performance optimization and high concurrency processing.
  • Has experience in handling large-scale backend system failures and security incidents, and is proficient in formulating emergency response plans and disaster recovery solutions.
  • Familiar with blockchain technology and digital asset underlying logic, able to combine technical iteration to optimize backend system functions and security.

lists.content:
As a BI Senior Manager, you will be the core leader of the company’s business intelligence team, responsible for formulating and implementing the company’s BI strategy and roadmap. You will lead the team to build and optimize the BI system, integrate data from digital currency trading, payment services, user behavior, risk control, and compliance, and provide accurate, timely, and actionable data insights for the company’s senior management, business departments, and compliance teams. This role requires deep understanding of the crypto and payment industry, strong data analysis capabilities, and excellent team management skills to align BI work with the company’s business development, risk control, and compliance goals.

Key Responsibilities

1. BI Strategy & System Construction

  • Formulate the company’s long-term and short-term BI strategy, roadmap, and implementation plan, combining the company’s business development goals, risk control requirements, and compliance needs.
  • Lead the construction, optimization, and iteration of the BI system, including data modeling, data integration, data visualization, and report development, to ensure the system’s stability, efficiency, and scalability.
  • Establish and improve BI work standards, data quality management systems, and report release mechanisms to ensure the accuracy, timeliness, and compliance of data and reports.
  • Track the latest BI technologies and industry trends, introduce advanced BI tools and methods, and promote the digital transformation of the company’s business decision-making.

    • 2. Team Management & Development

  • Build, manage, and develop the BI team, formulate team OKRs, performance assessment standards, and talent training plans to improve the team’s professional capabilities (data analysis, visualization, modeling, etc.).
  • Arrange daily work assignments for the team, supervise work progress, solve work difficulties, and create a positive and collaborative team atmosphere.
  • Guide team members’ professional growth, organize technical training and skill exchanges, and cultivate a professional BI talent echelon.
  • Manage team performance, conduct regular performance reviews, and motivate team members to achieve work goals.

    • 3. Data Analysis & Insight Provision

  • Lead the team to conduct in-depth data analysis on core business areas, including digital currency trading volume, user activity, payment transaction data, risk control indicators, and compliance data.
  • Provide data-driven insights and decision support for senior management, including business growth analysis, user portrait analysis, risk early warning, and compliance monitoring.
  • Develop and optimize core BI reports and dashboards (such as trading data dashboard, user data dashboard, risk control dashboard, compliance dashboard) to meet the needs of different departments.
  • Track key business indicators (KPIs), analyze deviations, and put forward targeted improvement suggestions to support business optimization and risk control.

    • 4. Cross-departmental Collaboration & Demand Management

  • Communicate closely with business departments (trading, payment, operation, marketing), risk control, compliance, and technical departments to understand their data and BI needs.
  • Coordinate internal resources to promote the implementation of BI projects, ensure that BI products meet business and compliance requirements, and improve work efficiency.
  • Feedback data problems and optimization suggestions to the data warehouse and R&D teams, promote data quality improvement and system optimization.
  • Cooperate with the compliance team to ensure that BI data and reports comply with global regulatory requirements (FATF, MiCA, local regulations) and support regulatory audits and inspections.

    • 5. Risk Control & Compliance Support

  • Lead the team to build data models for risk control and compliance, including abnormal transaction monitoring, user risk rating, and compliance indicator analysis.
  • Provide real-time data support for the risk control team to help identify and mitigate risks (such as money laundering, fraud, market manipulation).
  • Assist the compliance team in completing data statistics, report submission, and regulatory compliance work related to BI.

1. Experience: 8+ years of BI-related work experience, including 3+ years of senior BI team management experience; preferred experience in fintech, digital currency, payment, or blockchain industries. Deep understanding of digital currency trading, payment business, and related data logic.
  2. Professional Expertise:
    1. Proficient in BI tools (such as Tableau, Power BI, Looker), data modeling, data visualization, and data analysis methods.
    2. Familiar with data warehouse construction, ETL processes, and data quality management; able to independently lead the construction and optimization of BI systems.
    3. Understanding of global regulatory requirements (FATF, MiCA, etc.) related to digital assets and payment, and experience in providing BI support for compliance and risk control.
    4. Proficient in SQL, familiar with Python/R is preferred; able to conduct complex data analysis and model building.
  3. Leadership & Management: Excellent leadership and team management capabilities, able to build and lead a high-performance BI team; strong cross-departmental coordination and resource integration capabilities.
  4. Analytical & Problem-Solving: Strong data sensitivity and analytical thinking, able to identify business problems from data and provide actionable solutions.
  5. Communication Skills: Excellent oral and written communication skills in both Chinese and English, able to effectively communicate with senior management, business departments, and technical teams.
  6. Education: Bachelor’s degree or above in Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Data Science, Finance, or related fields; relevant professional certifications (such as CBIP, Data Analyst Professional) are preferred.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Has experience in building BI systems for compliant digital currency exchanges or payment institutions.
  • Familiar with on-chain data analysis, digital asset trading data logic, and payment transaction data processing.
  • Has experience in leading BI projects related to risk control and compliance, and understands the data needs of regulatory audits.
  • Familiar with cloud computing and big data technologies (such as Hadoop, Spark) and has experience in applying them to BI systems.

• Responsible for the overall planning, construction, and continuous optimization of AWS cloud environment security architecture, covering account systems, IAM, VPC, compute, storage, container, and data security.
  • Responsible for the design, configuration, and operation of WAF and DDoS protection systems, including AWS WAF, AWS Shield, CloudFront, Route 53, and third-party security products.
  • Design and implement network isolation strategies, including multi-account, multi-VPC, production and non-production environment isolation, subnet segmentation, east-west access control, egress control, and zero-trust access.
  • Responsible for the configuration and auditing of Security Group, NACL, Transit Gateway, PrivateLink, VPN, Direct Connect, and other network security components.
  • Proficient in using AI technologies and tools to carry out cloud security operations, achieving cloud resource risk identification, security monitoring, anomalous behavior analysis, intelligent alert triage, and incident response automation, improving the efficiency of security threat detection and handling.
  • Build cloud security monitoring and response capabilities, discovering and handling security risks based on CloudTrail, GuardDuty, Security Hub, Config, VPC Flow Logs, and other tools.
  • Drive the implementation of cloud resource configuration baselines, vulnerability management, key management, log auditing, data encryption, and disaster recovery strategies.
  • Participate in cloud security incident response, attack tracing, risk assessment, and remediation tracking.
  • Drive infrastructure as code and security automation, integrating security checks into Terraform, CloudFormation, CI/CD, and other processes.
  • Collaborate with R&D, operations, network, and AI teams to provide security architecture review and launch support for business systems.

• Bachelor's degree or above, majors in computer science, cybersecurity, software engineering, or related fields preferred.
  • 5+ years of experience in cloud security, network security, or cloud platform operations.
  • Familiar with AWS security architecture and core services, including IAM, Organizations, Control Tower, VPC, EC2, EKS, S3, KMS, CloudFront, WAF, Shield, CloudTrail, GuardDuty, Security Hub, and Config.
  • Familiar with TCP/IP, DNS, HTTP/HTTPS, TLS, VPN, routing, load balancing, firewalls, and common network attack and defense principles.
  • Able to independently design network isolation and access control solutions across multiple accounts, regions, and environments.
  • Familiar with WAF rule design, bot protection, API protection, rate limiting strategies, and DDoS emergency response.
  • Familiar with Kubernetes, container, and cloud-native security, with experience in EKS network policies, image security, RBAC, and runtime security.
  • Possess scripting or automation skills, familiar with at least one of Python, Go, or Shell.
  • Familiar with infrastructure as code tools such as Terraform and CloudFormation.
  • Possess good security risk analysis, troubleshooting, documentation, and cross-team communication skills.

    • Preferred Qualifications

    • Hold certifications such as AWS Certified Security – Specialty, AWS Solutions Architect, CISSP, CCSP, CISA, etc.
    • Experience with large-scale AWS multi-account governance, Landing Zone, or cross-region cloud architecture construction.
    • Experience with generative AI, LLM, MLOps, GPU/Kubernetes cluster security operations.
    • Familiar with zero trust, SASE, micro-segmentation, service mesh, and cloud-native network security products.
    • Familiar with security platforms such as SIEM, SOAR, CSPM, CNAPP, CWPP.
    • Have practical experience in security incident response, offense-defense exercises, or red-blue team confrontation.

Join the Pioneer Crypto Brand in the Philippines!

Coins is the most established crypto brand in The Philippines and has gained the trust of more than 18 million users. Through the easy-to-use mobile app, users can buy and sell a variety of different cryptocurrencies and access a wide range of financial services.

Coins is fully regulated by the Bangko Sentral ng Pilipinas (BSP) and is the first ever crypto-based company in Asia to hold both Virtual Currency and Electronic Money Issuer licenses from a central bank.

Who we are

We are one of the earliest and largest crypto platforms in Southeast Asia offering exchange and wallet services to our users. Our product lineup also includes electronic payment service and e-wallet. Through our wallet, users can send money to anyone, pay for bills, shop online at over 100,000 merchants, receive money transfers from 200+ countries even without a bank account, and of course view and purchase cryptocurrencies.

Coins Champions (Volunteer)

The Coins Champion Program is an opportunity for the most passionate Coins.ph users to grow and build for the Coins.ph community. Champions have the opportunity to connect with fellow crypto enthusiasts and co-build the crypto community in the Philippines as a whole. This is a volunteer community program.

lists.content:
• Advocates for Coins.ph who actively support and believe in the vision of growing crypto adoption.
  • Passionate community builders who are excited to help create meaningful, lasting relationships within our ecosystem.
  • Crypto enthusiasts eager to share knowledge, participate in discussions, and foster growth in the Coins.ph community.

• Inspire and lead community initiatives by creating events, campaigns, and content that spark excitement and engagement across the Coins.ph ecosystem.
  • Mentor and uplift new members, guiding them through their crypto journey and connecting them with resources that empower them to thrive.
  • Cultivate a culture of inclusivity and ensure that online spaces remain welcoming, supportive, and aligned with our shared values.
  • Be the voice of the community, providing key insights, feedback, and ideas to the Coins.ph team to shape future features and improvements.
  • Act as a self-starter by taking the initiative to build and expand local and nationwide communities, bringing fresh energy to the crypto movement.

• Be a Trailblazer for Crypto Adoption: As a Champion, you’ll be at the forefront of Coins.ph's mission to expand the reach of crypto in the Philippines, helping to grow communities and drive innovation across the country.
  • Direct Collaboration with the Coins Team: Champions are empowered to provide real-time feedback to the Coins.ph team, influencing the direction of product development and community initiatives.
  • VIP Community & Leadership Opportunities: Join an exclusive group of like-minded leaders in private Telegram and Discord channels. Here, you'll connect with other Champions and the Community Manager to strategize, organize Champs' Quests and other community-exclusive initiatives that elevate engagement within the Coins ecosystem.
  • Crypto Networking & Learning Events: Champions often attend major crypto events together, fostering relationships and learning alongside other industry leaders in the CryptoPH space. This exposure expands your network and prepares you for leadership roles in the broader crypto ecosystem.

Exclusive & Tangible Rewards
 
By becoming a Student Ambassador, you will strengthen your professional influence within the industry. We offer tangible benefits for your hard work:
 
Performance-Based Commissions: Earn direct cash or crypto rewards for every active student user (50 pesos per KYC L2 user)  and campus merchant (500 to 2500 pesos per KYB user) you successfully refer. Top performers may unlock higher tiers of rewards/commissions. 
 
Career Fast-Track: Top performers secure priority interviews for Coins.ph’s internships and full-time positions post-graduation. 
Exclusive Brand Swag: Receive official Coins.ph ambassador kits, including limited-edition apparel, backpacks, and tech accessories. 
Professional Training & Certification: Access exclusive fintech workshops led by industry experts and receive an official certificate to boost your resume. 
Exclusive Networking Opportunities: Access to exclusive HQ events and get to know the internal team members and industry professionals. Also get free pass to notable industry conference/events 
 
Early Access to Innovation Programs:
 
Ambassadors are granted early access to pilot initiatives such as the BTC Builder Program, a four year college commitment focused on disciplined Bitcoin holding, financial literacy, and long term thinking.
 
Why Join the Coins Student Ambassador Program?
 
By joining the Coins Student Ambassador Program, you will drive real financial inclusion in your campus while earning tangible, performance-based commissions in cash or crypto. Beyond receiving exclusive brand swag and professional fintech certifications, you'll gain hands-on marketing experience that builds a standout resume. Top-performing ambassadors will also secure priority interviews for future internships and full-time roles, fast-tracking your career in the digital finance space.
 
Apply to the Coins Student Ambassador Program and be part of shaping the next chapter of digital finance in the Philippines.

Coins is fully regulated by the Bangko Sentral ng Pilipinas (BSP) and is the first ever crypto-based company in Asia to hold both Virtual Currency and Electronic Money Issuer licenses from a central bank.

We are seeking a meticulous and proactive Compliance Analyst to join our growing Legal & Compliance team in Brazil. This role will serve as the tip of the spear in our global expansion, ensuring that the right operational infrastructure is established across all current and future markets.
 
Because onboarding is essential to maintaining our competitive edge, making this process efficient across diverse markets, and across multiple tiers of partners, is crucial. Excellence in this area will be a key differentiator for us as we continue to scale.
 
The ideal candidate is a fast learner, able to quickly absorb the company’s procedures; highly organized, capable of managing multiple onboarding simultaneously while keeping all required documentation updated and easy to access; and skilled at translating complex regulations into clear Processes and Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs). This person will play a pivotal role in strengthening Coins.xyz’s operational efficiency by helping structure the right partner ecosystem, enabling the exchange to deliver best-in-class service.

lists.content:
• External Onboardings: Run the partners integration process, in order to maintain the required infrastructure to deliver our services consistently, at a competitive price and with the desired breadth of scope.
  • Internal Onboarding & Due Diligence (KYC/KYB): Execute end-to-end onboarding processes for retail users and corporate clients (Institutional/B2B). Perform detailed verification of documentation, corporate structures, and Ultimate Beneficial Owners (UBOs).
  • Background Checks & Screening: Conduct in-depth background checks and screening against global sanctions lists (OFAC, UN, EU), PEPs (Politically Exposed Persons), and adverse media, utilizing specialized compliance tools.
  • Enhanced Due Diligence (EDD): Lead investigations for high-risk customers or complex corporate structures, preparing risk assessment reports for senior management approval.
  • Policy & SOP Development: Assist in the creation, review, and maintenance of AML/CFT (Anti-Money Laundering / Combating the Financing of Terrorism) policies, KYC/KYB Manuals, and Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), ensuring alignment with Brazilian legislation (e.g., Lei 9.613/98, Circular BCB 3.978) and global standards.
  • Audit & Monitoring: Support internal and external audits by preparing documentation, sampling, and process evidences. Monitor the effectiveness of onboarding controls and recommend improvements to the Compliance Officer.
  • Regulatory Alignment: Stay updated on local and international regulatory changes (BACEN, CVM, COAF) to ensure the continuous adaptation of our verification processes.

• Education: Bachelor’s degree in Law, Accounting, Economics, Business Administration, or related fields.
  • Experience: 2+ years of experience in Compliance, AML/CFT, or Risk Management, specifically within Financial Institutions, Payment Institutions (IPs), Fintechs, or Crypto/VASPs.
  • Technical Skills:
  • Deep knowledge of KYC (Know Your Customer) and KYB (Know Your Business) flows.
  • Experience with background check tools and watchlists (e.g., World-Check, LexisNexis, Neoway, upLexis, etc.).
  • Ability to draft clear, technical policies and SOPs.
  • Languages: Advanced English / Native or Fluent Portuguese.
  • Soft Skills: Analytical mindset, organized worker , extreme attention to detail, and high ethical standards.
    •  
  • Nice-to-haves (Differentials)

We are looking for an experienced Risk Strategy Leader to lead the design and execution of our end-to-end risk control framework across both fiat and crypto ecosystems.
This role owns fraud prevention, AML strategy, and fund flow risk management, covering the full lifecycle from fiat on/off ramps to on-chain transactions. The ideal candidate can trace and assess end-to-end fund flows, identify suspicious patterns, and drive clear risk decisions and account actions.

jobs.description:
We are looking for an experienced Risk Strategy Leader to lead the design and execution of our end-to-end risk control framework across both fiat and crypto ecosystems.

This role owns fraud prevention, AML strategy, and fund flow risk management, covering the full lifecycle from fiat on/off ramps to on-chain transactions. The ideal candidate can trace and assess end-to-end fund flows, identify suspicious patterns, and drive clear risk decisions and account actions.

This role is not a regulatory-facing MLRO/compliance role, but will work closely with the Philippines (PH) Risk & AML team to ensure strong local execution.

lists.content:
1. End-to-End Risk Strategy (Fraud + AML + Fund Flows)

  • Own and drive the overall fraud prevention and AML strategy across fiat and crypto
  • Design strategies across the full lifecycle: onboarding, login, fiat deposits/withdrawals, trading, and crypto transfers
  • Identify and mitigate risks such as payment fraud, account takeover, mule activity, scams, and money laundering
  • Build unified strategies that connect user behavior, transaction activity, and fund flows (fiat + on-chain)
  • Balance risk control with user experience and operational efficiency

    • 2. Fiat Risk & Payment Flow Control (New - Core Requirement)

    • Design and optimize risk strategies for fiat on-ramp and off-ramp flows (bank transfers, e-wallets, payment rails)
    • Monitor and assess incoming and outgoing fiat transactions for fraud and AML risks
    • Define review, approval, and escalation mechanisms for high-risk transactions
    • Work closely with payment partners and internal teams to manage risk exposure

      • 3. Fund Flow Analysis & Risk Decisioning (Key Differentiator)

      • Analyze and trace end-to-end fund flows across fiat and crypto
      • Identify suspicious patterns such as layering, structuring, mule networks, and fraud-linked flows
      • Make or guide decisions on account-level actions (e.g., allow, block, restrict, freeze, escalate)
      • Build frameworks for consistent and explainable risk decision-making

        • 4. On-chain Risk & Tooling (Elliptic Focus)

        • Leverage and optimize Elliptic to strengthen on-chain monitoring and AML capabilities
        • Translate blockchain intelligence into actionable risk strategies (e.g., scam flows, high-risk wallets)
        • Integrate Elliptic signals into internal systems for automated decision-making
        • Evaluate other tools (e.g., Chainalysis, TRM) where needed

          • 5. Risk System & Platform Development

          • Lead the design of scalable risk infrastructure, including rule engines, decision engines, and case management systems
          • Build unified systems that support fraud, AML, and fund flow monitoring
          • Drive real-time decisioning and reduce reliance on manual processes

            • 6. Data-driven Optimization

            • Identify emerging fraud and AML typologies using data analysis
            • Define and track key metrics (fraud loss, detection rate, false positives, operational efficiency)
            • Implement testing frameworks (A/B testing, rule tuning, segmentation)

              • 7. Team Leadership & Cross-regional Collaboration

              • Build and lead teams across risk strategy, fraud operations, and AML operations
              • Work closely with PH Risk & AML team for execution and local alignment
              • Partner with Product, Engineering, Compliance, and Operations globally

Experience

  • 8+ years in fraud risk, AML, payments risk, or risk strategy, with 3+ years in leadership
  • Strong experience in payments, crypto exchanges, or fintech platforms
  • Proven experience managing fiat transaction risk and/or payment fraud

    • Core Competencies

    • Deep expertise in anti-fraud (ATO, payment fraud, scams) and AML
    • Strong understanding of fiat transaction flows, payment systems, and risk controls
    • Ability to trace fund flows across fiat and crypto and identify suspicious patterns
    • Experience making or guiding account-level risk decisions (block/freeze/restrict)
    • Experience designing scalable risk strategies and rule systems

      • Tools & Data

      • Hands-on experience with Elliptic (or similar tools like Chainalysis / TRM)
      • Ability to translate tool outputs into risk decision logic
      • Strong data skills (SQL required, Python preferred)

        • Leadership & Collaboration

        • Strong leadership and execution capability across functions
        • Experience working with regional or distributed teams
        • Fluent in English

          • Nice to Have

          • Experience with both fiat payments risk and crypto risk
          • Experience analyzing complex fund flows (multi-hop, cross-channel)
          • Familiarity with Southeast Asia / Philippines market
          • CAMS or similar certifications

• A full-stack risk leader across fraud, AML, and payments
  • Someone who can trace money end-to-end (fiat → crypto → fiat)
  • A decision-maker who can translate analysis into clear account actions
  • A builder who can turn strategies into scalable systems
  • A partner who can work effectively with PH teams

Coins is the most established crypto brand in The Philippines and has gained the trust of more than 18 million users. Through the easy-to-use mobile app, users can buy and sell a variety of different cryptocurrencies and access a wide range of financial services.

Coins is fully regulated by the Bangko Sentral ng Pilipinas (BSP) and is the first ever crypto-based company in Asia to hold both Virtual Currency and Electronic Money Issuer licenses from a central bank.

Join the leading Crypto Brand in the Philippines!

Who we are

We are one of the earliest and largest crypto platforms in Southeast Asia offering exchange and wallet services to our users. Our product lineup also includes electronic payment service and e-wallet. Through our wallet, users can send money to anyone, pay for bills, shop online at over 100,000 merchants, receive money transfers from 200+ countries even without a bank account, and of course view and purchase cryptocurrencies.

lists.content:
• Work closely with Operations and Quant Team to configure and test the exchange application end-to-end, which includes drafting, executing, reviewing, and owning the test scenarios, test cases and checklist(s)/process flow(s).
  • Monitor exchange prices and spreads to ensure it is align with global market prices
  • Treasury management for quant wallet 
  • Prepare and present weekly OKR reports
  • Managed and onboard partners onto exchange
  • Leverage trading metrics to identify inefficiencies and opportunities to increase profitability and performance
  • Maintain exchange liquidity and troubleshoot any live-trading issues

• A bachelor's degree in Business, Finance, or a related field is preferred.
  • Extensive experience in Crypto operations and process optimization.
  • More than 2 years of experience in exchange operations.
  • Preferably, more than 1 year of experience in spot or Conversion trading in financial services and/or user operations.
  • Good knowledge in operations, including BAU, back admin system management, basic trading knowledge, and market promotion.
  • Experience collaborating with cross-functional teams.
  • Experience in risk management and automation tools.
  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to prioritise tasks and manage multiple projects simultaneously.

We are looking for an experienced Financial Risk Officer to join our Risk Management team, with a focus on market and liquidity risk. In this role, you will independently identify, measure, monitor, and report on market and liquidity risk exposures across Coins.ph's treasury and digital asset activities to protect the company's balance sheet and its customers' funds. You will develop and maintain risk frameworks and controls, ensure compliance with BSP and other applicable regulatory requirements, and deliver clear, decision-useful insights to Senior Management and the Risk Committee. This is a hands-on role suited to someone who can operate independently in a fast-paced, technology-driven financial institution and who is comfortable bridging traditional banking risk discipline with the realities of a crypto-enabled platform.
jobs.description:
Join the Pioneer Crypto Brand in the Philippines!

Coins is the most established crypto brand in The Philippines and has gained the trust of more than 18 million users. Through the easy-to-use mobile app, users can buy and sell a variety of different cryptocurrencies and access a wide range of financial services.

Coins is fully regulated by the Bangko Sentral ng Pilipinas (BSP) and is the first ever crypto-based company in Asia to hold both Virtual Currency and Electronic Money Issuer licenses from a central bank.

We are looking for an experienced Financial Risk Officer to join our Risk Management team, with a focus on market and liquidity risk. In this role, you will independently identify, measure, monitor, and report on market and liquidity risk exposures across Coins.ph's treasury and digital asset activities to protect the company's balance sheet and its customers' funds. You will develop and maintain risk frameworks and controls, ensure compliance with BSP and other applicable regulatory requirements, and deliver clear, decision-useful insights to Senior Management and the Risk Committee. This is a hands-on role suited to someone who can operate independently in a fast-paced, technology-driven financial institution and who is comfortable bridging traditional banking risk discipline with the realities of a crypto-enabled platform.

lists.content:
Risk Identification & Measurement

  • Identify, assess, and maintain risk profiles across market, liquidity, and digital asset/crypto exposures, both on- and off-balance sheet.
  • Monitor market risk on trading and treasury positions, including foreign exchange and digital asset price volatility, using metrics such as VaR, stressed VaR, and sensitivity analysis.
  • Perform market risk back-testing, stress testing, and exception analysis, escalating limit breaches and model issues in accordance with governance requirements.
  • Measure and monitor liquidity risk across on- and off-balance sheet exposures, including cash flow projections, funding concentration analysis, and liquidity coverage across fiat and digital asset holdings.
  • Conduct interest rate stress testing and scenario analysis, evaluating behavioral assumptions and structural balance sheet risk.

    • Risk Management Strategy & Controls

  • Develop, implement, and continuously refine market and liquidity risk management strategies, policies, and frameworks to mitigate identified financial risks.
  • Design and maintain relevant internal controls and operational risk controls related to treasury and digital asset operations.
  • Assess market and liquidity risk exposures against Board-approved risk appetite limits and regulatory thresholds, escalating material breaches, model issues, and emerging concerns in line with governance protocols.
  • Support the design and enhancement of risk methodologies as Coins.ph's product suite and digital asset activities evolve.

    • Data Analysis & Reporting

  • Analyze financial data, market trends, and treasury/digital asset portfolio performance to identify potential risks and opportunities, using financial modeling to evaluate market and liquidity risk scenarios.
  • Prepare risk reports and dashboards for Senior Management and the Risk Committee, and support the ongoing enhancement of market and liquidity risk policies, frameworks, and procedures.
  • Track key risk indicators (KRIs) and support regulatory reporting obligations to the BSP and other relevant authorities.

    • Compliance & Governance

  • Ensure risk practices comply with BSP regulations and circulars, AMLC requirements, and other applicable Philippine and international regulatory standards for EMIs and VASPs.
  • Partner with Compliance, Finance, Audit, and Legal teams to ensure integrated, consistent risk management practices across the organization.
  • Stay current on regulatory developments affecting digital assets, e-money, and payments in the Philippines and the broader Southeast Asian market.

    • Crisis & Incident Management

  • Develop and help execute contingency plans for managing financial emergencies, market dislocations, and other unforeseen risk events, including crypto market volatility scenarios.
  • Support the Head of Risk on ad hoc risk investigations, special projects, and other related initiatives as needed.

Education

  • Bachelor's degree in Finance, Economics, Accounting, Mathematics, or a related field.

    • Experience

  • At least 3–5 years of experience in market risk, liquidity risk, treasury risk, or a related financial risk management function, within banking, fintech, or a related financial services environment.
  • Exposure to or strong interest in digital assets/cryptocurrency markets is a plus.

    • Knowledge

  • Solid understanding of market and liquidity risk methodologies, stress testing, and risk appetite frameworks.
  • Familiarity with BSP regulations and industry standards applicable to EMIs, VASPs, and payment institutions.
  • Working knowledge of fixed income, foreign exchange, and digital asset products, as well as balance sheet risk management.

    • Skills

  • Strong analytical and financial modeling skills, with high attention to detail.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to present complex risk concepts clearly to non-technical audiences.
  • High degree of professionalism, sound judgment, and ethical standards.
  • Comfortable operating with autonomy in a fast-moving, technology-driven environment.

lists.content:
• FX Market Trading
    Conduct foreign exchange trading activities based on market conditions, trading strategies, and the Company's risk management requirements.
  • Position Management
    Actively manage trading positions, monitor exposure and market risk, and adjust positions in a timely manner based on market movements and trading strategies.
  • Risk & Trading Discipline
    Strictly follow established trading strategies, risk management policies, position limits, stop-loss requirements, and trading procedures. Maintain strong trading discipline and avoid emotional or unauthorized trading decisions.
  • Market Monitoring & Analysis
    Closely monitor global foreign exchange markets, including currency movements, macroeconomic developments, central bank policies, interest rates, economic data, geopolitical events, and other factors that may impact FX markets.
  • Trading Strategy Optimization
    Continuously review trading performance, market conditions, and risk exposure, and proactively update trading approaches and strategies to adapt to changing market environments.
  • Trading Performance & Reporting
    Maintain accurate trading records and regularly review trading performance, risk exposure, and key trading decisions. Provide timely market updates and trading insights to management when required.

• Bachelor's degree or above in Finance, Economics, Mathematics, Statistics, or a related field preferred.
  • 1+ years of hands-on foreign exchange trading experience, preferably with experience in institutional or professional trading environments.
  • Solid understanding of the FX market, currency pairs, market dynamics, and macroeconomic drivers.
  • Demonstrated experience in position management, exposure management, and trading risk control.
  • Strong trading discipline with the ability to strictly execute established trading strategies and risk management rules.
  • Strong market awareness and ability to respond quickly to changes in market conditions.
  • Able to continuously follow global financial markets and update trading strategies and market views.
  • Strong analytical, numerical, and decision-making skills.
  • Experience with trading platforms, market data terminals, or relevant FX trading systems is preferred.
  • High level of integrity, responsibility, and risk awareness.

lists.content:
Key Responsibilities

1. Frontend Technical Strategy & Architecture Planning

  • Formulate the company’s frontend technical strategy, long-term and short-term technical roadmap, and system architecture plan, combining the company’s business development needs (digital currency trading, payment settlement) and industry technical trends (front-end engineering, cross-platform development, componentization, performance optimization, AI integration in front-end, etc.)[2].
  • Lead the design and optimization of the core frontend system architecture, determine the technical framework, technology stack (such as Vue3, React, TypeScript, Flutter, React Native), and development specifications, ensure the scalability, maintainability, reusability, and security of the frontend system.
  • Research and introduce advanced frontend technologies, tools, and methodologies (such as component library construction, module federation, CI/CD, performance monitoring, PWA), promote technical innovation and architecture optimization, improve development efficiency, system performance, and user experience.
  • Evaluate and select technical solutions for core business scenarios (such as high-concurrency trading interfaces, real-time data display, multi-terminal adaptation), provide technical decision support for business development, and ensure that technical solutions are aligned with business goals and regulatory requirements.

    • 2. Frontend System Development & Lifecycle Management

  • Oversee the full lifecycle of frontend system development (web, app, H5), including demand review, technical design, coding development, unit testing, integration testing, UAT testing, deployment, and online operation, ensuring that the development work is completed on time, with quality and quantity.
  • Supervise the development of core frontend modules, including trading interface, order operation, fund management, user center, real-time market display, risk control prompt, and message notification, ensuring that system functions meet business requirements and regulatory standards, and the user experience is optimized.
  • Manage frontend system iteration and maintenance work, monitor system operation status, collect and analyze user feedback and system performance data, identify and solve system bottlenecks (such as page loading speed, interaction fluency), fix online bugs in a timely manner, and continuously optimize system performance and user experience.
  • Coordinate with the DevOps team to build and optimize the CI/CD pipeline, improve the automation level of frontend deployment, testing, and operation and maintenance, reduce manual operations, and improve system deployment efficiency and stability.

    • 3. Frontend Security & Compliance Management

  • Establish and improve the frontend system security management system, formulate security standards and specifications, and ensure that the frontend system meets data security, user privacy protection, and digital asset security requirements (such as data encryption, anti-XSS, anti-CSRF, sensitive information desensitization).
  • Lead the security development of frontend systems, conduct regular security audits, vulnerability scans, and penetration tests, identify and fix security risks (such as data leakage, malicious tampering, interface abuse), and ensure the security of user assets and transaction data.
  • Ensure that frontend system development and operation comply with global regulatory requirements (FATF, MiCA, local regulations) and app store review rules, cooperate with the compliance and risk control teams to complete system compliance reviews, regulatory filings, and security assessments, and provide relevant technical materials and explanations.
  • Ensure that the frontend interface complies with regulatory requirements (such as risk prompts, information disclosure), and coordinate with the compliance team to optimize the display of compliant content.

    • 4. Team Management & Talent Development

  • Build, manage, and develop the frontend development team, formulate team structure, OKRs, performance assessment standards, and talent training plans, and improve the team’s overall professional capabilities (frontend development, architecture design, UI/UX integration, security development, etc.).
  • Arrange daily work assignments for the team, supervise work progress, solve complex technical difficulties in the development process (such as cross-terminal adaptation, high-concurrency interface optimization), and create a positive, collaborative, and high-performance technical team atmosphere.
  • Guide team members’ professional growth, cultivate technical backbones and frontend architects, organize technical training, technical sharing, and skill assessments, and build a professional frontend talent echelon.
  • Manage team performance, conduct regular performance reviews, motivate team members to achieve work goals, and retain core technical talents.

    • 5. Cross-departmental Collaboration & Technical Coordination

  • Communicate closely with product, backend, UI/UX, compliance, risk control, operations, and other departments to understand business needs and user demands, coordinate frontend development-related work, and ensure that frontend systems are closely aligned with business development and user experience goals.
  • Coordinate with the backend development team to optimize API design and interface docking, ensure the smooth interaction between frontend and backend systems, and improve the overall product experience.
  • Cooperate with the UI/UX team to integrate design schemes into frontend development, ensure the consistency and beauty of the interface, and optimize the interactive experience of the product.
  • Communicate with external technical partners (app stores, third-party component providers, security service providers, etc.) to handle technical cooperation and coordination matters, and ensure the smooth operation of frontend systems.

    • 6. Project & Resource Management

  • Manage key frontend development projects, formulate project plans, control project progress, cost, and quality, identify project risks (such as technical difficulties, demand changes), and put forward targeted risk mitigation measures.
  • Formulate the frontend development team’s budget plan, control development costs, reasonably allocate technical resources, and improve resource utilization efficiency.
  • Track and analyze project execution, conduct project summary and review, summarize experience and lessons, and continuously optimize project management processes.

1. Experience: 10+ years of frontend development and management work experience, including 5+ years of senior frontend team management experience; preferred experience in fintech, digital currency, payment, or large-scale internet financial institutions. Deep understanding of frontend development processes, system architecture design, and digital asset-related business models, with experience in leading the development and operation of large-scale frontend systems (supporting high concurrency, multi-terminal adaptation)[2].
  2. Professional Expertise:
    1. Proficient in frontend development technologies and frameworks, familiar with at least one mainstream frontend technology stack (Vue3/React + TypeScript), with rich practical development experience in cross-platform development (Flutter/React Native) and web development.
    2. Excellent frontend architecture design capabilities, able to design scalable, maintainable, and user-friendly frontend architectures for core business scenarios (such as high-concurrency trading systems, real-time data display systems).
    3. Familiar with frontend security technologies (XSS, CSRF, data encryption, sensitive information desensitization), with experience in building and optimizing frontend security systems, and familiar with digital asset-related security compliance requirements.
    4. Familiar with frontend performance optimization technologies (page loading speed, rendering performance, resource compression), and have practical experience in optimizing large-scale frontend systems to improve user experience.
    5. Familiar with DevOps practices (CI/CD, containerization, monitoring and alerting), proficient in using related tools (Webpack, Vite, Docker, Jenkins, Prometheus, etc.), able to improve the automation level of development and operation and maintenance.
    6. Familiar with digital currency exchange-related business (spot trading, derivative trading, fund recharge and withdrawal, transaction settlement), able to convert business needs and user demands into frontend technical solutions and architecture designs.
  3. Leadership & Management: Excellent leadership and senior team management capabilities, able to build and lead a high-performance frontend development team; strong strategic thinking, decision-making capabilities, and resource integration capabilities.
  4. Technical Research & Innovation: Strong technical sensitivity and learning ability, able to track industry technical trends (such as frontend engineering, AI integration, cross-platform development), research and introduce advanced technologies, and promote technical innovation and architecture optimization.
  5. Communication Skills: Excellent oral and written communication skills in both Chinese and English, able to effectively communicate with senior management, cross-departmental colleagues, external partners, and team members.
  6. Education: Bachelor’s degree or above in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or related fields; relevant professional certifications (such as PMP, Frontend Engineer Certification) are preferred.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Has frontend senior management experience in compliant digital currency exchanges, familiar with the frontend development needs and compliance requirements of digital currency trading systems.
  • Has experience in leading the transformation of frontend systems (such as monolithic architecture to componentized architecture, traditional development to cross-platform development), with rich experience in frontend performance optimization and multi-terminal adaptation.
  • Has experience in handling large-scale frontend system failures and security incidents, and is proficient in formulating emergency response plans and solutions.
  • Familiar with blockchain technology and digital asset underlying logic, able to combine technical iteration to optimize frontend system functions, user experience, and security.
  • Has experience in integrating AI into frontend products, such as intelligent trading prompts, user behavior analysis, to optimize product experience and user stickiness.
