jobs.description: We are seeking a Digital Marketing Leader to own and drive the digital marketing strategy for Coins.ph and Coins.xyz ’s payments and crypto businesses. This role will lead end-to-end digital growth initiatives, with a strong focus on paid advertising campaigns and performance marketing. The ideal candidate will be both a strategic thinker and a hands-on executor, capable of managing budgets, teams, and cross-functional campaigns to deliver measurable growth.

lists.content:
• Strategy & Leadership
  • Develop and execute an integrated digital marketing strategy across paid, owned, and earned channels to drive user acquisition, engagement, and retention.
  • Manage digital marketing budgets, ensuring optimal allocation for maximum ROI.
  • Paid Ads Management
  • Own performance marketing and paid ad campaigns across Google, Facebook, TikTok, programmatic, and other major ad platforms.
  • Design and implement bidding strategies, targeting plans, and creative testing to maximize ROAS.
  • Identify and test emerging ad platforms and formats to uncover new growth opportunities.
  • Monitor paid campaign performance daily, optimizing based on data insights and market trends.
  • Campaign Execution
  • Plan and execute large-scale acquisition campaigns for payments, crypto, and B2B products.
  • Oversee SEO/SEM initiatives to drive organic growth alongside paid ads.
  • Partner with creative teams to deliver compelling ad creatives and conversion-focused messaging.
  • Data & Optimization
  • Track and analyze campaign performance, conducting A/B tests to optimize results.
  • Collaborate with Data & Analytics to generate actionable insights and refine targeting strategies.
  • Monitor KPIs including CAC, ROAS, LTV, CTR, and conversion rates.
  • Team & Collaboration
  • Lead and mentor the digital marketing team, fostering a data-driven, high-performance culture.
  • Collaborate with Product, Sales, BD, and Regional Marketing teams to align campaigns with product launches, promotions, and market expansion.
  • Ensure all paid ads comply with relevant advertising regulations and brand guidelines.

• Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business, Communications, or related field (MBA is a plus).
  • 7+ years of experience in digital marketing, with at least 3 years in a leadership role.
  • Proven track record in managing high-budget, multi-channel paid ad campaigns in fintech, payments, or crypto.
  • Strong analytical skills and experience with marketing analytics tools (e.g., Google Analytics, Mixpanel, Appsflyer).
  • Expertise in paid ad platforms, bidding strategies, and attribution models.
  • Excellent leadership, communication, and cross-functional collaboration skills.
  • Creative problem solver with a growth mindset and ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment.

• Paid ad-driven new user acquisition volume and cost efficiency.
  • ROAS and campaign ROI.
  • Conversion rate improvements across paid channels.
  • New user growth in reach, impressions, and market share through paid advertising.

jobs.descriptionPlain:
About the Role
We are seeking a visionary and strategic Head of Product Solution Design to lead our end-to-end product design function. This role will oversee our talented team of UX/UI designers, researchers, and product design strategists. You will be responsible for crafting delightful, intuitive, and seamless user journeys that align with our business goals and deliver exceptional value to our customers.
 
As the design leader, you will play a critical role in shaping the user experience across all touch points—defining the design language, elevating design thinking within the organization, and collaborating closely with product managers, engineers, marketers, and business stakeholders to bring innovative, user-centric solutions to life.
jobs.description:
About the Role
We are seeking a visionary and strategic Head of Product Solution Design to lead our end-to-end product design function. This role will oversee our talented team of UX/UI designers, researchers, and product design strategists. You will be responsible for crafting delightful, intuitive, and seamless user journeys that align with our business goals and deliver exceptional value to our customers.
 
As the design leader, you will play a critical role in shaping the user experience across all touch points—defining the design language, elevating design thinking within the organization, and collaborating closely with product managers, engineers, marketers, and business stakeholders to bring innovative, user-centric solutions to life.

lists.content:
• Leadership & Strategy
  • Define and own the vision, strategy, and roadmap for the Product Solution Design function under Global Product team.
  • Build, lead, and mentor a high-performing team of Product Designers, UX/UI Designers, Design Researchers, and UX Writers.
  • Advocate for design excellence and user-centric thinking across all levels of the organization including Coins Payment, Crypto Trading and other products.
  • Partner with Product, Engineering, Marketing, and Business teams to ensure holistic and cohesive product experiences.
  • Design Execution & Innovation
  • Oversee the end-to-end design process, from discovery and ideation to wireframes, prototypes, and final UI.
  • Implement design systems, frameworks, and tools that drive consistency and efficiency at scale.
  • Champion design thinking and research-led innovation, integrating user feedback and data into all design decisions.
  • Ensure designs are accessible, inclusive, and optimized for all platforms (mobile, web, etc.).
  • User Experience & Journey Ownership
  • Own the entire user journey and experience lifecycle, identifying pain points and opportunities for continuous improvement.
  • Develop metrics and KPIs to measure user satisfaction, usability, and design impact.
  • Drive initiatives to improve user onboarding, engagement, conversion, and retention through superior design.
  • Collaboration & Communication
  • Act as the voice of the user in strategic discussions and decision-making forums.
  • Effectively communicate design vision, strategies, and updates to stakeholders at all levels.
  • Foster a culture of collaboration, experimentation, and continuous learning within the design team and beyond.

• 5+ years of experience in product design, UX/UI, or user experience strategy, with at least 4 years in a leadership or head-of-role.
  • Proven experience designing for digital products at scale (fintech, crypto, super apps, payments, or e-commerce experience preferred).
  • Strong portfolio demonstrating deep expertise in design strategy, user journeys, and end-to-end product design.
  • Mastery of design and prototyping tools such as Figma.
  • Deep understanding of human-centered design, accessibility principles, and responsive design.
  • Experience working with cross-functional teams in agile/scrum environments.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to interpret complex data and translate into design insights.
  • Excellent communication and storytelling skills; able to influence executive stakeholders.
    •  
    Preferred Qualifications
  • Background in behavioral science, design psychology, or UX research is a plus.
  • Prior experience in fintech, payments, digital wallets, or blockchain/crypto industries.
  • Familiarity with front-end technologies (HTML/CSS, JavaScript) is an advantage.

jobs.description:
Position Overview

We are seeking an experienced and highly influential Group Lead of HRBP to partner closely with the executive leadership team and business leaders across the organization. This role will be responsible for driving organizational effectiveness, workforce productivity, leadership capability, performance management, talent development, and cultural transformation.

The ideal candidate combines strong strategic thinking with hands-on execution capability and has a proven track record of helping high-growth organizations scale effectively through people, structure, and performance.

lists.content:
Organizational Design & Effectiveness

  • Lead company-wide organizational diagnostics and assessments to identify structural, capability, and efficiency gaps.
  • Design and implement organizational restructuring, workforce planning, and operating model improvements aligned with business strategy.
  • Partner with executives to optimize organizational layers, spans of control, accountability frameworks, and decision-making processes.
  • Drive initiatives to improve organizational agility, cross-functional collaboration, and execution effectiveness.

    • Performance Management & Business Execution

    • Establish and continuously improve the company-wide performance management framework.
    • Partner with leadership teams to translate strategic objectives into measurable organizational, departmental, and individual performance goals.
    • Drive OKR/KPI design, alignment, monitoring, and execution across the organization.
    • Ensure accountability mechanisms are in place to improve business outcomes and organizational performance.
    • Utilize data and analytics to assess performance trends and recommend interventions.

      • Talent Strategy & Leadership Development

      • Serve as a strategic advisor to senior leaders on organizational and people-related decisions.
      • Partner with business leaders to assess organizational capability and identify critical talent gaps.
      • Lead talent review, succession planning, and leadership pipeline development programs.
      • Support leaders in upgrading key talent, building high-performing teams, and strengthening management capability.
      • Develop strategies to attract, retain, and develop top talent in highly competitive markets.

        • Workforce Productivity & People Effectiveness

        • Drive company-wide initiatives focused on improving workforce productivity and organizational efficiency.
        • Develop frameworks and metrics to measure people effectiveness and return on talent investments.
        • Identify opportunities to improve resource allocation, team effectiveness, and overall organizational output.
        • Champion a high-performance culture that rewards impact, accountability, and continuous improvement.

          • Employee Experience & Culture

          • Lead initiatives that strengthen company culture, employee engagement, and organizational health.
          • Build programs that reinforce company values, leadership expectations, and desired behaviors.
          • Partner with leaders to foster an inclusive, collaborative, and high-performance working environment.
          • Act as a change management leader during periods of rapid growth and transformation.

            • Strategic HR Partnership

            • Partner directly with the CEO, executive leadership team, and business unit leaders on strategic workforce matters.
            • Provide insights and recommendations on organizational risks, talent implications, and business transformation initiatives.
            • Drive alignment between people strategy and business objectives across all functions and geographies.
            • Lead and develop a high-performing HRBP team capable of supporting the organization's future growth.

Required Experience

  • 12+ years of progressive HR experience, including substantial HRBP leadership experience in fast-growing and performance-driven organizations.
  • Must have prior experience in electronic payments, fintech, digital banking, crypto, financial services technology, or other regulated digital finance sectors.
  • Proven experience partnering with CEOs, founders, executive teams, and business unit leaders on organizational design, performance management, talent strategy, and business execution.
  • Demonstrated track record in organizational diagnostics, restructuring, workforce productivity improvement, leadership upgrade, and culture transformation.
  • Strong understanding of KPI/OKR design, performance review mechanisms, talent review, succession planning, and leadership development.
  • Experience supporting multi-country, regional, or group-level organizations is strongly preferred.
  • Excellent English communication skills are required, including the ability to communicate effectively with global stakeholders, prepare executive-level materials, and influence senior leaders in English.

    • Key Competencies

    • Strategic Thinking
    • Organizational Design & Development
    • Executive Influencing
    • Performance Management
    • Talent Assessment & Succession Planning
    • Change Management
    • Workforce Analytics
    • Leadership Coaching
    • Stakeholder Management
    • Data-Driven Decision Making
    • Strong Communication & Presentation Skills

As the Head of Trade Manager, you will be the core leader of the company’s trading business, responsible for formulating the overall trading strategy and business roadmap, aligning with the company’s development goals. You will oversee all trading operations, including spot trading, derivatives trading (if applicable), liquidity management, and trading system optimization, while strictly controlling trading risks and ensuring compliance with global regulatory requirements. This role requires in-depth understanding of digital asset markets, rich trading management experience, excellent leadership, and strong risk control capabilities to drive the growth of trading volume, improve trading efficiency, and enhance the company’s core competitiveness in the digital currency trading market.

Key Responsibilities

1. Trading Strategy & Business Planning

  • Formulate the company’s long-term and short-term trading strategies, including market positioning, product layout (spot, derivatives, etc.), liquidity strategy, and pricing strategy, aligning with the company’s business development goals and market trends.
  • Develop detailed trading business plans and OKRs, decompose goals to the team and individuals, supervise the implementation progress, and ensure the achievement of key indicators such as trading volume, liquidity, and transaction efficiency.
  • Monitor global digital asset market trends, policy changes, and competitor dynamics, adjust trading strategies in a timely manner, and seize market opportunities to promote business growth.
  • Lead the research and development of new trading products and services, promote product iteration and innovation, and meet the diverse needs of users.

    • 2. Trading Operations Management

  • Oversee the company’s daily trading operations, including order matching, transaction execution, trade settlement, and post-trade reconciliation, ensuring the smooth, efficient, and accurate operation of the trading system.
  • Manage the company’s trading liquidity, cooperate with liquidity providers, optimize liquidity allocation, and ensure the depth and stability of the trading market to improve user trading experience.
  • Establish and improve trading operation processes and standards, standardize the work of the trading team, and improve work efficiency and quality.
  • Coordinate with the technical team to optimize the trading system, improve transaction speed, stability, and security, and support the expansion of trading business.

    • 3. Trading Risk Management

  • Establish and improve the trading risk management system, identify, assess, and control various trading risks, including market risk, liquidity risk, operational risk, and counterparty risk.
  • Formulate trading risk control indicators and thresholds, monitor risk indicators in real time, issue risk warnings in a timely manner, and take effective measures to mitigate risks when abnormalities occur.
  • Lead the trading risk team to conduct regular risk assessments and reviews, summarize risk management experience, and continuously optimize the risk control system.
  • Ensure that all trading activities comply with the company’s risk control policies and global regulatory requirements, and avoid regulatory and operational risks.

    • 4. Team Management & Development

  • Build, manage, and develop the entire trading team, formulate team structure, job responsibilities, and performance assessment standards, and improve the team’s overall professional quality and combat effectiveness.
  • Arrange daily work assignments for the team, supervise work progress, solve work difficulties, and create a positive, collaborative, and high-performance team atmosphere.
  • Guide team members’ professional growth, organize market research, trading skill training, and risk control training, and cultivate a professional trading talent echelon.
  • Manage team performance, conduct regular performance reviews, motivate team members to achieve work goals, and retain core talents.

    • 5. Compliance & Regulatory Coordination

  • Ensure that all trading business activities comply with global regulatory frameworks (FATF, MiCA, local regulations) and industry standards, and cooperate with the compliance team to complete regulatory reporting, audits, and inspections.
  • Participate in the formulation and improvement of the company’s trading compliance system, promote the implementation of compliance requirements in all trading links, and avoid compliance risks.
  • Respond to regulatory inquiries and requirements related to trading business, provide relevant materials and explanations, and maintain good communication with regulatory authorities.

    • 6. Cross-departmental Collaboration

  • Communicate closely with compliance, risk control, technical, product, and operation departments to coordinate resources, promote the integration of trading business with other business links, and ensure the smooth development of the company’s overall business.
  • Cooperate with the marketing and operation teams to formulate trading promotion plans, carry out user acquisition and activation activities, and drive the growth of trading volume and user scale.
  • Feedback user needs and trading market information to the product and technical teams, promote product and system optimization, and improve user trading experience.

1. Experience: 10+ years of digital asset trading or financial trading related work experience, including 5+ years of senior trading team management experience; preferred experience in compliant digital currency exchanges or fintech companies. Deep understanding of digital asset trading markets (spot, derivatives), liquidity management, and trading system operations.
  2. Professional Expertise:
    1. Proficient in digital asset trading strategies, market analysis methods, and liquidity management skills, with a proven track record of driving trading volume growth and improving trading efficiency.
    2. Familiar with digital currency trading systems, order matching mechanisms, and trade settlement processes; able to independently solve complex trading operation and technical problems.
    3. Strong risk control awareness and capabilities, familiar with trading risk management methods and tools, and have experience in establishing and optimizing trading risk control systems.
    4. Familiar with global regulatory requirements (FATF, MiCA, etc.) related to digital asset trading, and have rich experience in trading compliance management.
    5. Proficient in using trading analysis tools and data analysis methods to conduct market analysis and trading performance evaluation.
  3. Leadership & Management: Excellent leadership and team management capabilities, able to build and lead a high-performance trading team; strong strategic thinking, decision-making capabilities, and resource integration capabilities.
  4. Analytical & Problem-Solving: Strong market sensitivity and analytical thinking, able to quickly respond to market changes, identify market opportunities and risks, and provide effective solutions.
  5. Communication Skills: Excellent oral and written communication skills in both Chinese and English, able to effectively communicate with senior management, regulatory authorities, team members, and cross-departmental colleagues.
  6. Education: Bachelor’s degree or above in Finance, Economics, Statistics, Computer Science, or related fields; relevant professional certifications (such as CFA, FRM, Series 7) are preferred.

About Coins.ph
Coins.ph is a leading licensed fiat and crypto wallet services provider in Southeast Asia. We are expanding globally and seeking the right regulatory partner to help us obtain financial and payment licenses in key markets including the EU, Latin America, Africa, South Asia, and Hong Kong.

Role Overview
We are hiring an experienced and highly motivated Lawyer (Global Licensing & Regulatory Affairs) to lead our efforts in securing licenses for payments, remittance, e-money, and virtual asset services across multiple jurisdictions. This role requires strong expertise in financial regulations, hands-on experience with licensing processes, and the ability to coordinate with regulators, external counsel, and internal stakeholders.
jobs.description:
About Coins.ph
Coins.ph is a leading licensed fiat and crypto wallet services provider in Southeast Asia. We are expanding globally and seeking the right regulatory partner to help us obtain financial and payment licenses in key markets including the EU, Latin America, Africa, South Asia, and Hong Kong.

Role Overview
We are hiring an experienced and highly motivated Lawyer (Global Licensing & Regulatory Affairs) to lead our efforts in securing licenses for payments, remittance, e-money, and virtual asset services across multiple jurisdictions. This role requires strong expertise in financial regulations, hands-on experience with licensing processes, and the ability to coordinate with regulators, external counsel, and internal stakeholders.

lists.content:
• Global Licensing Strategy: Develop and execute licensing roadmap across EU, Latin America, Africa, South Asia, and Hong Kong for payments, e-money, remittances, and VASP/crypto-related services.
  • Regulatory Applications: Prepare, review, and submit license applications; manage communications with regulators and government agencies.
  • Stakeholder Management: Engage and coordinate with external legal counsel, consultants, and regulatory authorities in multiple jurisdictions.
  • Compliance Alignment: Work closely with Compliance, Risk, and Operations teams to ensure regulatory frameworks are embedded into product and operational design.
  • Market Research & Monitoring: Track regulatory developments globally, identify opportunities/risks, and advise management on market entry requirements.
  • Policy & Documentation: Draft and maintain internal policies, licensing documentation, and regulatory reports.
  • Regulatory Advocacy: Represent Coins.ph in regulatory discussions, industry associations, and working groups to support favorable licensing outcomes.

• Bachelor of Laws (LL.B.) above.
  • 5+ years of post-qualification legal experience, with at least 3+ years in financial services, fintech, payments, or crypto.
  • Strong track record in securing financial/payment licenses in one or more of the following regions: EU, LatAm, Africa, South Asia, or Hong Kong.
  • Deep understanding of payment services regulations, AML/CFT, e-money licensing, and crypto/virtual asset regulatory frameworks.
  • Strong negotiation and stakeholder management skills with regulators and external counsel.
  • Excellent communication and legal drafting skills in English; additional languages (Chinese) a plus.
  • Ability to work across time zones and manage multiple licensing projects simultaneously.

Join the Pioneer Crypto Brand in the Philippines!

Coins is the most established crypto brand in The Philippines and has gained the trust of more than 18 million users. Through the easy-to-use mobile app, users can buy and sell a variety of different cryptocurrencies and access a wide range of financial services.

Coins is fully regulated by the Bangko Sentral ng Pilipinas (BSP) and is the first ever crypto-based company in Asia to hold both Virtual Currency and Electronic Money Issuer licenses from a central bank.

Key Responsibilities:
Product Strategy & Design Vision
Define and own the design vision and product strategy for our payment products, balancing business goals, user needs, and compliance requirements.
Build and prioritize a roadmap of design and product improvements, using structured frameworks (e.g., RICE, ICE) to weigh impact against effort.
Establish UX/UI design best practices and design-quality standards across the org.
Lead, mentor, and grow a team of product designers and UX researchers.
Product Management for Design
Act as a de facto product manager for your area: translate research and data into structured feature proposals, PRDs, or specs that engineering and stakeholders can act on.
Proactively identify, pitch, and champion new features and improvements based on your own use of the app, competitive analysis, and user feedback. This role is expected to originate ideas, not just execute assigned tasks.
Define success metrics and KPIs for design and product initiatives (e.g., activation, feature adoption, NPS, task completion, retention) and report on outcomes.
Run experiments (A/B tests, usability benchmarks) to validate design and product decisions, using analytics tools (e.g., Amplitude, Mixpanel, GA).
Own the backlog and prioritization conversations jointly with product management and engineering leads.
User-Centered Design Execution
Drive end-to-end product design from discovery, journey mapping, and prototyping to detailed UI specifications.
Conduct and apply user research, usability testing, and data-driven insights to improve product flows and reduce friction.
Create and maintain design systems and patterns for consistency across channels (app, web).
Cross-Functional Collaboration
Partner with product managers and engineers to define product requirements and technical feasibility.
Work closely with risk, compliance, and legal teams to ensure designs adhere to regulatory standards (e.g., BSP, AML, KYC).
Collaborate with marketing and CX to ensure brand-consistent experiences.
Innovation & Market Trends
Stay ahead of payment UX trends in PH, SEA, and globally (e.g., tap-to-pay, open finance, e-wallet interoperability).
Explore opportunities to integrate emerging technologies such as QR Ph, NFC, merchant payment solutions, and blockchain into the payment journey.
Regularly use the Coins app as a customer would, and bring a running list of observations and improvement ideas to the team.

lists.content:
• Provide clear and actionable counsel to the business on a broad range of legal and regulatory issues involving corporate governance, corporate housekeeping, and licensing across all entities in the group.
  • Maintain and keep current the corporate records of every entity in the group, including articles of incorporation and by-laws, stock and transfer books, board and stockholder minutes and resolutions, secretary's certificates, and general information sheets.
  • Prepare and file corporate and regulatory submissions with the SEC, BSP, BIR, LGUs, and other agencies, including annual reportorial requirements, amendments to constitutive documents, increases in authorized capital stock, changes in directors and officers, and beneficial ownership filings.
  • Drive licensing efforts end to end across the group's regulated entities, covering new applications, variations, renewals, and notifications before the BSP, SEC, and other domestic and foreign regulators, including preparation of application dossiers and responses to regulator queries.
  • Manage the corporate approvals and documentation for group transactions, including intra-group restructuring, incorporation and dissolution of entities, share transfers, capital injections, and cross-border structuring.
  • Track and calendar the corporate and licensing deadlines of all group entities and escalate risks of non-compliance early.
  • Provide practical advice on legal issues and risks in a risk-tolerant, but compliance-oriented environment, including the impact on the company's long-term strategy for business.
  • Serve as part of a multi-jurisdiction international legal team, coordinating with external counsel and corporate secretarial providers in other jurisdictions.
  • Draft, review, and negotiate a range of commercial contracts, such as but not limited to vendor contracts and investment agreements.
  • Attend case conferences and hearings with courts and government agencies.
  • Other responsibilities not listed here but reasonably assumed to be a function of the role, including other business lines and matters as may be assigned by the Chief Legal Officer.

• Minimum 1 to 5 years of post-qualification experience in general corporate law, corporate secretarial practice, and regulatory compliance in the Philippines.
  • Familiarity with, and a working knowledge of, key government organizations such as the BSP, SEC, BIR, AMLC, and LGUs will be essential. Prior experience with BSP licensing is a strong advantage.
  • Meticulous attention to detail, with proven ability to manage documents and deadlines across multiple corporate entities at once.
  • Excellent judgment, analytical rigor, clear communication, and business pragmatism.
  • A good team player, agile, and can adapt to a fast-paced, high-intensity environment.
  • Motivated self-starter with a passion for payments and cryptocurrency and requires minimal supervision.
  • Fluency in English with outstanding writing and communication skills.

• Provide clear and actionable counsel to the business on the group's financing, lending, and securitization activities, including the online lending platform (OLP) business.
  • Draft, review, and negotiate financing and credit documentation, including facility and loan agreements, promissory notes, security and collateral documents, guarantees, intercreditor and subordination agreements, and receivables purchase and assignment agreements.
  • Advise on and document securitization and structured finance transactions, including asset transfers, true sale and bankruptcy remoteness analysis, servicing arrangements, and investor documentation.
  • Advise on the regulatory perimeter for lending and financing, including SEC lending and financing company registration and OLP registration, the Truth in Lending Act, the Financial Products and Services Consumer Protection Act, interest rate and fee ceilings, permissible collection practices, credit information reporting, and data privacy in credit scoring and underwriting.
  • Support product, credit, and risk teams on OLP design, covering customer journeys, disclosures, terms and conditions, consent flows, marketing claims, and arrangements with funding partners, collection agencies, credit bureaus, and scoring vendors.
  • Handle regulatory engagements, examinations, and inquiries relating to the lending and financing business, and prepare responses to regulator correspondence.
  • Provide innovative legal solutions for complex projects involving new technologies to support commercial objectives, including the analysis and advice on new regulatory guidance in the fintech industry.
  • Provide practical advice on legal issues and risks in a risk-tolerant, but compliance-oriented environment, including the impact on the company's long-term strategy for business.
  • Serve as part of a multi-jurisdiction international legal team.
  • Attend case conferences and hearings with courts and government agencies.
  • Other responsibilities not listed here but reasonably assumed to be a function of the role, including other business lines and matters as may be assigned by the Chief Legal Officer.

• Minimum 4 to 7 years of post-qualification experience, with substantive exposure to banking and finance, lending, consumer credit, or structured finance and securitization practice in the Philippines.
  • Working knowledge of the SEC lending and financing company and OLP frameworks, BSP regulations, and the consumer protection and data privacy requirements applicable to credit.
  • Demonstrated ability to draft and negotiate finance documentation independently.

lists.content:
Singapore Regulatory Compliance

  • Serve as the designated Compliance Officer for the Singapore entity and act as the primary point of contact for local regulatory compliance matters.
  • Ensure ongoing compliance with applicable Singapore regulations, including MAS requirements related to payment services, AML/CFT, technology risk, and regulatory reporting.
  • Maintain and enhance compliance policies, procedures, and controls for the Singapore business.
  • Support licensing obligations, regulatory submissions, audits, inspections, and examinations.
  • Monitor regulatory developments in Singapore and assess impact on business operations.
  • Coordinate with external counsel, auditors, and regulators where necessary.

    • Global AML & Financial Crime Compliance

    • Support the development and implementation of group-wide AML/CFT and sanctions compliance programs across multiple jurisdictions.
    • Enhance customer due diligence (CDD), enhanced due diligence (EDD), transaction monitoring, sanctions screening, and suspicious activity reporting frameworks.
    • Conduct AML risk assessments for products, jurisdictions, customers, and business initiatives.
    • Partner with Operations and Product teams to implement scalable compliance controls and monitoring solutions.
    • Review and advise on high-risk customers, escalations, and suspicious activities.
    • Assist in managing global AML investigations and reporting obligations where applicable.
    • Develop and deliver compliance training programs across the organization.

      • Governance & Risk Management

      • Prepare compliance reporting materials for senior management, boards, and regulators.
      • Support internal audits and independent compliance reviews.
      • Maintain compliance documentation, registers, and governance records.
      • Help establish compliance metrics, KPIs, and management reporting processes.
      • Promote a strong culture of compliance and ethical conduct across the organization.

• Bachelor’s degree in Law, Finance, Accounting, Business, or related field.
  • Minimum 3–5 years of compliance, AML, or financial crime experience in fintech, payments, banking, or cryptocurrency industries.
  • Strong understanding of Singapore AML/CFT regulations and MAS expectations.
  • Experience working with payment institutions, digital asset businesses, or cross-border financial services is highly preferred.
  • Familiarity with global AML standards and regulatory frameworks (FATF, sanctions regimes, travel rule, etc.).
  • Experience managing compliance operations across multiple jurisdictions is a strong advantage.
  • CAMS, ICA, or equivalent compliance certification preferred.
  • Strong analytical, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
  • Ability to operate independently in a fast-moving and evolving regulatory environment.

    • Preferred Experience

    • Experience supporting Major Payment Institution (MPI) or crypto-related licensing frameworks.
    • Experience interacting directly with MAS or other financial regulators.
    • Familiarity with blockchain analytics and crypto transaction monitoring tools.
    • Experience building compliance processes in high-growth environments.

Join the Pioneer Crypto Brand in the Philippines!

Coins is the most established crypto brand in The Philippines and has gained the trust of more than 18 million users. Through the easy-to-use mobile app, users can buy and sell a variety of different cryptocurrencies and access a wide range of financial services.

Coins is fully regulated by the Bangko Sentral ng Pilipinas (BSP) and is the first ever crypto-based company in Asia to hold both Virtual Currency and Electronic Money Issuer licenses from a central bank.

The OTC Trading Director will lead and scale Coins.ph’s OTC trading business, overseeing execution, client coverage, pricing strategy, and risk management across crypto, FX, and stablecoin markets. This role is responsible for driving revenue growth while ensuring robust risk controls, efficient execution, and best-in-class client experience in a fast-moving, 24/7 trading environment.

lists.content:
Trading & Execution

  • Lead execution of OTC transactions including large block trades, liquidations, and bespoke client orders
  • Ensure high-quality execution across crypto, FX, and stablecoin products
  • Optimize execution strategies to minimize slippage and maximize client satisfaction

    • Client Coverage & Sales Trading

    • Manage and grow relationships with institutional and high-value OTC clients
    • Tailor pricing, spreads, liquidity access, and execution structures per client profile
    • Act as senior point of contact for high-touch, strategic OTC relationships

      • P&L & Risk Ownership

      • Own OTC trading PnL, inventory exposure, and hedging performance
      • Design and manage risk limits across asset classes and counterparties
      • Continuously optimize hedging strategies and inventory management across markets

        • Pricing & Liquidity Management

        • Oversee pricing models, spread configuration, and real-time quote generation
        • Manage liquidity routing across 30+ global venues and counterparties
        • Ensure competitive and consistent pricing across market conditions

          • Platform & Infrastructure Development

          • Partner with product and engineering teams to build OTC systems including:
            • Pricing engine
            • Risk engine
            • Order management & client management systems
            • Settlement and reconciliation infrastructure
            • OTC trading frontend tools
            • Drive automation and scalability of OTC workflows

              • Leadership & Strategy

              • Lead and mentor a high-performing OTC trading team
              • Define OTC business strategy, market expansion opportunities, and product roadmap
              • Collaborate closely with compliance, risk, finance, and technology teams to ensure regulatory and operational robustness

• 7–12+ years of experience in OTC trading, FX trading, crypto markets, market making, or sales trading
  • Proven track record executing large and complex OTC transactions
  • Strong understanding of FX, crypto liquidity, pricing mechanics, spreads, and settlement flows
  • Experience managing PnL, inventory risk, and hedging strategies across volatile markets
  • Demonstrated ability to build and maintain institutional client relationships
  • Strong analytical and systems-thinking mindset; comfortable working with trading tools and internal platforms
  • Experience collaborating with engineering teams on trading infrastructure development
  • Strong leadership skills with ability to build and scale trading teams
  • High sense of ownership, urgency, and ability to operate in a 24/7 trading environment

lists.content:
• Lead, coach, and develop the Payment Operations team through regular one-on-ones, performance management, career development planning, and ownership of team and individual OKRs.

  • Own end-to-end oversight of PESONet and InstaPay transaction processing and settlement, including reconciliation coordination, exception management, and end-of-day balancing, ensuring transactions are settled accurately and within rail cut-off windows, and that discrepancies, returns, and rejects are resolved within SLA.

  • Serve as the primary escalation point for complex or high-severity settlement issues, coordinating resolution with internal teams (Product, Engineering, Compliance, Finance) and external banking, e-wallet, and payment rail partners including SLA discussions for recurring or systemic issues.

  • Define, track, and report team and department KPIs (accuracy, turnaround time, exception aging, incident volume) to senior management, driving process improvement initiatives to increase efficiency and reduce risk.

  • Lead operational readiness for new payment features, partners, or rail/process changes, coordinating UAT, updating SOPs and documentation, and training the team ahead of go-live.

  • Ensure the team's adherence to internal controls, BSP regulatory requirements, AML/CTF obligations, and standard operating procedures governing fiat money movement and customer transactions.

  • Manage team staffing, scheduling, and workload distribution to maintain adequate operational coverage, including during peak volume periods, incidents, or extended hours as needed.

  • Perform ad hoc tasks and lead or contribute to larger-scale projects under the broader Coins.ph Payments Operations roadmap.

• 5+ years of experience in payments operations, settlement, banking operations, or fintech transaction workflows, including at least 2 years managing or leading a team within a fiat settlement, treasury operations, or payments operations function with hands-on experience coaching, developing, and performance-managing team members.

  • Hands-on, working experience processing and reconciling PESONet and InstaPay transactions is required, including a solid understanding of rail mechanics, cut-off schedules, and return/reject handling (not merely familiarity or exposure).

  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Finance, Operations, or a related field.

  • Working knowledge of BSP regulations and operating rules relevant to PESONet, InstaPay, and other electronic fund transfer rails.

  • Proven track record of owning operational KPIs, leading incident escalations, and driving measurable process improvements.

  • Strong stakeholder management skills, with experience partnering across Product, Engineering, Compliance, Finance, and external banking/e-wallet partners.

  • Strong analytical, documentation, and reporting skills; proficient with Google Suite, Excel, operational dashboards/BI tools, and AI-assisted productivity platforms (e.g., Claude) to drive operational efficiency.

  • Excellent communication skills in both English and Filipino.

  • Reliable, organized, and able to lead a team effectively in a fast-paced environment with shifting priorities.

Join the Pioneer Crypto Brand in the Philippines!

Join the leading Crypto Brand in the Philippines!

We are one of the oldest and largest crypto platforms in Southeast Asia offering exchange and wallet services to our users. Our product lineup also includes electronic payment service and e-wallet. Through our wallet, users can send money to anyone, pay for bills, shop online at over 100,000 merchants, receive money transfers from 200+ countries even without a bank account, and of course view and purchase cryptocurrencies.
 
Coins.ph is looking for Payments Product Junior Manager with a strong payments background to join our Payments-Product team. In this role you will help the company's Product team to make decisions based on data and industry best practices.

Coins is the most established crypto brand in The Philippines and has gained the trust of more than 18 million users. Through the easy-to-use mobile app, users can buy and sell a variety of different cryptocurrencies and access a wide range of financial services.

We are looking for a Product Manager – KYC / Compliance / Risk to help build and improve our customer verification, AML, compliance, and risk-control products.
 
You will work closely with Compliance, Risk Operations, Engineering, QA, Data, and external vendors to translate regulatory and operational requirements into scalable product solutions.
 
This role is suitable for someone who understands regulated financial products, is comfortable working with complex workflows and edge cases, and can independently drive projects from requirement analysis through production launch and iteration.

lists.content:
• KYC & Customer Onboarding
  • Own and improve KYC/KYB onboarding and verification flows, including data collection, document verification, OCR, liveness checks, automated decisions, manual review, and result handling.
  • Design and optimize CDD/EDD, risk tiering, verification rules, retry flows, exception handling, and operational review processes.
  • Analyze KYC funnel performance, approval rates, rejection reasons, review time, automation rates, and vendor performance to identify opportunities for improvement.
  • Balance customer conversion, verification accuracy, fraud exposure, regulatory requirements, and operational cost.
  • Compliance & AML Products
  • Work with Compliance and Risk teams to translate AML/CFT, sanctions, transaction monitoring, and regulatory requirements into clear product requirements and system rules.
  • Support the development and optimization of compliance capabilities such as: AML / sanctions screening, transaction monitoring, risk scoring and rule engines, case management and investigation workflows, STR/SAR reporting and regulatory reporting, and audit trails and internal compliance tools.
  • Design decision logic, exception handling, manual review workflows, and escalation mechanisms for different risk scenarios.
  • Risk & Fraud Control
  • Support product solutions for fraud and financial-crime risks such as account takeover, scams, mule accounts, identity fraud, and suspicious transaction behavior.
  • Work with Data and Risk teams to improve risk rules, alerting, monitoring, and automated decision strategies.
  • Use data to evaluate rule effectiveness, false-positive / false-rejection rates, operational workload, and overall risk impact.
  • Product Delivery & Integration
  • Independently conduct requirement analysis, product design, process mapping, and solution design.
  • Write clear PRDs, business rules, user flows, API requirements, acceptance criteria, and edge-case handling.
  • Work closely with Engineering and QA throughout development, testing, UAT, launch, and post-launch monitoring.
  • Integrate and manage external compliance and identity-verification vendors, including KYC providers, sanctions screening services, and blockchain analytics providers.
  • Evaluate vendor solutions based on accuracy, coverage, stability, compliance suitability, user experience, and cost.

• 3+ years of Product Management experience, preferably in fintech, payments, digital banking, crypto, financial services, or other regulated industries.
  • Hands-on experience with at least one of the following areas: KYC / KYB / identity verification, AML / sanctions screening, transaction monitoring, fraud / risk-control systems, or compliance / case-management platforms.
  • Good understanding of KYC and AML concepts, including CDD/EDD, risk-based approaches, screening, manual review, and transaction monitoring.
  • Ability to translate ambiguous compliance or operational requirements into structured product flows, system rules, and executable requirements.
  • Strong analytical mindset and ability to use funnel, approval, rejection, accuracy, and operational data to diagnose product problems.
  • Able to independently drive projects and work effectively with Compliance, Risk, Operations, Engineering, QA, and Data teams.
  • Strong attention to detail, especially around system states, decision rules, exception cases, and auditability.
  • Strong ownership, communication, execution, and problem-solving skills.

• Experience in crypto, digital assets, exchanges, cross-border payments, e-wallets, or remittance products.
  • Familiarity with regulatory environments such as BSP / AMLC or other financial regulators.
  • Experience with KYC vendors such as Sumsub, Jumio, Onfido, Persona, or similar providers.
  • Experience with blockchain analytics or transaction-monitoring tools such as Elliptic, Chainalysis, TRM Labs, or similar platforms.
  • Knowledge of fraud typologies such as scams, mule accounts, phishing, account takeover, and identity fraud.
  • Experience building internal compliance tools, rules engines, workflow systems, or case-management platforms.
  • Background in compliance, risk, operations, data analytics, or financial institutions is a plus.

• Responsible for the automated testing of software projects, designing and executing automated test cases to ensure comprehensive and accurate test coverage.
  • Participate in project requirement analysis and test plan formulation, and propose reasonable test strategies and suggestions.
  • Build and maintain automated test frameworks, continuously optimize test processes, and improve test efficiency and quality.
  • Collaborate closely with development, product, and other teams, communicate issues identified during the testing process in a timely manner, and promote problem resolution.
  • Focus on the testing of payment-related functional modules to ensure the security, stability, and accuracy of payment processes, including but not limited to payment interface calls and payment status synchronization.
  • Responsible for the interaction testing with various payment channels (such as banks, third-party payment platforms, etc.), verify the correctness, compatibility, and reliability of channel integration, and handle issues arising during channel interaction.
  • Write test reports, record test results, analyze test data, and provide a basis for project quality improvement.

• Bachelor’s degree or above in a computer-related major, with more than 3 years of experience in software automated testing.
  • Proficiency in at least one automated testing tool (e.g., Selenium, Appium) and familiarity with the design and implementation of automated test frameworks.
  • Rich experience in testing payment-related projects, and a good understanding of payment business processes, including order generation, payment processing, refund, and reconciliation.
  • Experience in testing interactions with payment channels (banks, third-party payment institutions, etc.), knowledge of channel interface specifications and interaction mechanisms, and the ability to independently conduct channel integration testing.
  • Familiarity with software testing processes and methods, including functional testing, performance testing, and interface testing, with strong ability in problem analysis and localization.
  • Mastery of at least one programming language (e.g., Java, Python) and a certain ability in code writing and debugging.
  • Knowledge of basic database concepts, and proficiency in using SQL statements for data query and operation.
  • Good communication skills, teamwork spirit, and sense of responsibility, and the ability to work under certain pressure.

jobs.description:
We are looking for a Risk Associate to join our Brazil team, focused on Transaction Monitoring. In this role, you will be the local risk point of contact for the BR market, working hands-on with our shared TRMS platform to detect, investigate, and escalate suspicious activity, while ensuring alignment with Brazilian regulatory requirements.

This is a great opportunity for a risk professional with a background in fintech or crypto who wants to operate at the intersection of global risk infrastructure and local regulatory compliance.

lists.content:
• Monitor and review flagged transactions on the shared TRMS platform, applying BR-specific risk context and regulatory knowledge.

  • Investigate alerts generated by automated rules, assess their risk level, and make disposition decisions (escalate, close, or action).

  • Collaborate closely with the PH-based TRMS team to communicate local risk patterns, provide feedback on rule effectiveness, and request tuning adjustments relevant to the Brazilian market.

  • Prepare and file regulatory reports in accordance with COAF (Conselho de Controle de Atividades Financeiras) and other applicable Brazilian AML/CFT frameworks.

  • Identify emerging fraud typologies and transaction patterns specific to the Brazilian market and document findings for the global risk team.

  • Support the development and refinement of local risk policies and procedures, ensuring they align with both global standards and Brazilian regulatory requirements.

  • Act as the first line of escalation for the BR operations team on transaction-related risk queries.

  • Participate in periodic risk reviews, audits, and regulatory exams as needed.

Experience

  • 2–4 years of experience in a risk, compliance, AML, or fraud operations role within fintech, crypto, banking, or payments.

  • Hands-on experience working with transaction monitoring systems or similar risk tooling.

We are seeking a Java Trading Engineer with solid technical skills and a profound understanding of trading systems. The role involves building and optimizing core trading systems that support high concurrency and low latency, covering diverse trading scenarios such as spot trading and futures trading. You will deeply participate in the entire process from business requirement analysis to system implementation, ensuring the stability, security, and efficiency of the trading system.

lists.content:
• Develop and maintain core modules of the trading system based on the Java technology stack, including order reception, matching engine, fund settlement, market data distribution, etc.
  • Optimize system performance, resolve latency issues in high-concurrency scenarios, and ensure that the order processing response time is at the millisecond level.
  • Design distributed trading architectures to ensure high availability of the system under peak traffic (e.g., 10,000-level orders per second).
  • Realize the technical implementation of trading rules, such as spot T+0 trading, futures margin management, position closing/margin call mechanisms, etc.
  • Collaborate with the quantitative trading team to support API interface development and meet high-frequency trading needs.
  • Participate in system monitoring and troubleshooting, formulate disaster recovery plans, and reduce risks in the production environment.

• Bachelor's degree or above in Computer Science/Software Engineering or related majors, with 3-5 years of Java development experience and at least 1 year of trading system development experience.
  • Proficiency in Java fundamentals, in-depth understanding of concurrent programming (thread pools, locking mechanisms), JVM principles and tuning.
  • Familiarity with high-performance frameworks such as Netty and Disruptor; candidates with low-latency system development experience are preferred.
  • Understanding of core logic of trading systems, such as Order Book design and matching algorithms (limit order, market order processing).
  • Mastery of distributed system design principles, and familiarity with the application of middleware such as Kafka, Redis, and MySQL in trading scenarios.
  • Strong problem-analysis ability, capable of locating performance bottlenecks or business anomalies through logs and monitoring data.
  • Work experience in financial exchanges, securities firms, or quantitative trading companies is preferred.

  • Excellent organizational and project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver under tight timelines.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to communicate effectively with process owners, senior management, and risk stakeholders.
  • Strong analytical skills to identify, assess, and anticipate potential risks and vulnerabilities.
  • Solid understanding of accounting systems, financial statements, ratios, and risk measurement tools, including market and liquidity risk indicators.
  • Ability to work independently and collaboratively, providing guidance and support to teams during risk events or control issues.
  • Proven problem-solving skills, with the ability to analyze complex issues, synthesize information, and produce clear, actionable risk reports.
  • Working knowledge of applicable BSP and banking-related regulations, particularly those relevant to non-bank financial institutions.

lists.content:
• Security Operations Center Management
  • Lead security monitoring operations for cryptocurrency exchange infrastructure, trading platforms, and digital wallet systems
  • Oversee real-time analysis of security events, alerts, and anomalies across blockchain networks, trading engines, and customer-facing applications
  • Coordinate incident response activities for security breaches, suspicious trading activities, and potential fraud attempts
  • Manage and optimize SIEM platforms, security orchestration tools, and automated response systems
  • Develop and maintain security playbooks specific to cryptocurrency exchange operations and digital asset protection

  • Insider & Threat Intelligence Analysis
  • Monitor dark web marketplaces, criminal forums, and threat actor communications for indicators targeting cryptocurrency businesses
  • Conduct tactical, operational, and strategic threat assessments specific to digital asset platforms
  • Develop threat intelligence feeds and indicators of compromise (IoCs) relevant to cryptocurrency security
  • Collaborate with external threat intelligence providers and cryptocurrency security communities
  • Design and implement comprehensive insider threat detection programs tailored to cryptocurrency exchange environments
  • Analyze user behavior patterns to identify potential malicious insider activities or account compromises
  • Conduct investigations into suspicious employee activities, unauthorized access attempts, and data exfiltration

  • Incident Response & Forensics
  • Lead incident response efforts for security breaches, fund theft attempts, and system compromises
  • Conduct digital forensics investigations on cryptocurrency-related security incidents
  • Coordinate with law enforcement, regulatory bodies, and external security firms during major incidents
  • Develop and maintain incident response procedures specific to cryptocurrency exchange operations
  • Create post-incident reports and recommendations for security improvements

• Technical Skills
  • Experience: Minimum 5+ years in SOC operations, preferably in financial services or cryptocurrency exchanges
  • Certifications: CISSP, GCIH, GCFA, GNFA, GCTI, CEH, or equivalent security certifications required
  • SIEM Expertise: Advanced proficiency with SIEM platforms (Sumo Logic, Splunk, QRadar, Sentinel, etc.)
  • Threat Intelligence: Experience with threat intelligence platforms (MISP, ThreatConnect, Anomali) and frameworks (MITRE ATT&CK, Diamond Model)
  • Programming/Scripting: Proficiency in Python, PowerShell, or similar languages for automation and analysis
  • Cloud Security: Experience securing cloud infrastructure (AWS, Azure, GCP) and container environments

• Additional certifications: CISSP, CISM, GCTI, GCFA, CEH, or cryptocurrency-specific certifications
  • Experience with insider threat analysis tools and methodologies (Securonix, Exabeam, Splunk UBA, Microsoft Sentinel UEBA)
  • Background in behavioral analytics, user activity monitoring, and privileged access management

lists.content:
• Architecture Review and Reconstruction: Conduct a comprehensive combing and review of the architecture design of the company's existing payment systems (including transaction systems, clearing and settlement systems, risk control systems, accounting systems, channel management systems, cross-border payment systems, etc.). Focus on core modules in cross-border payment scenarios such as currency conversion, cross-border clearing channels, and multi-region compliance adaptation. Identify architectural defects, performance bottlenecks, security risks, and scalability issues, and formulate and implement end-to-end architecture reconstruction plans.
  • Technical Architecture Planning: Based on the business development strategy, especially the expansion needs of cross-border payment business, design the medium and long-term technical architecture plan for the financial payment field. It covers system layering, service splitting, technology selection, middleware governance, cross-border clearing channel adaptation, multi-region compliance architecture design, etc. Ensure the forward-looking and stability of the architecture to support rapid business iteration and scale expansion.
  • Product and Technology Collaboration: Deeply connect with the product team to accurately understand business needs and product plans, convert product needs into reasonable technical implementation plans, promote efficient linkage between technology and products, reduce deviations in demand landing, and improve R&D and product delivery efficiency.
  • R&D Efficiency Improvement: Take the lead in building an efficient R&D system, including but not limited to the formulation of technical specifications, optimization of R&D toolchains, construction of automated testing and deployment processes, and improvement of microservice governance systems. Reduce R&D costs and improve iteration efficiency and delivery quality.
  • Technical Risk Control: Responsible for the design of high availability, high concurrency, data consistency, and security compliance (such as payment license compliance, cross-border payment-related regulations, PCI DSS, relevant specifications of Netlink/UnionPay and overseas payment clearing organizations, etc.) of payment systems (including cross-border payments). Focus on preventing and controlling risks in cross-border payment scenarios such as exchange rate risks, clearing delay risks, and cross-border data transmission risks. Formulate disaster recovery plans and emergency response mechanisms to ensure the stable operation of the system and avoid core technical risks in the financial payment field.

• Education and Major: Bachelor's degree or above in Computer Science and Technology, Software Engineering, Information Security or related majors, with more than 5 years of experience in system architecture design in the financial payment field.
  • Industry Background: Have core work experience in payment companies, Internet finance enterprises, fintech companies or bank payment departments. Deeply understand the entire payment business process (transaction initiation, routing, risk control, clearing, reconciliation, refund, etc.), and have relevant system design or operation and maintenance experience in cross-border payment business. Familiar with cross-border payment clearing channels (such as SWIFT, CIPS, overseas local payment channels, etc.) and multi-region payment compliance requirements.
  • Architectural Capabilities: Have rich experience in distributed system architecture design, proficient in core technologies such as microservices, distributed transactions, high concurrency processing, caching strategies, and message queues; priority will be given to candidates with practical experience in large-scale payment system architecture reconstruction.
  • Technology Stack Requirements: Familiar with mainstream back-end development languages such as Java, proficient in microservice frameworks such as Spring Cloud/Dubbo, familiar with the principles and practices of middleware such as MySQL/Redis/Kafka/RocketMQ; priority will be given to candidates with an understanding of cloud-native technologies (Docker, K8s).
  • Collaboration and Implementation Capabilities: Have excellent cross-team communication and coordination capabilities, able to efficiently link product, R&D, testing and other teams to promote the implementation of architecture plans; have a strong sense of responsibility and execution, and be able to respond to technical challenges in complex business scenarios.
  • Compliance and Security Awareness: Deeply understand relevant laws, regulations and industry standards in the financial payment field (such as PCI DSS, relevant specifications of Netlink/UnionPay, etc.), and have experience in security architecture design and risk prevention and control of payment systems.
  • Preferred Qualifications: Experience in the construction of payment license-related systems; led the design and implementation of cross-border payment system architecture; deeply participated in the docking of large-scale cross-border payment channels (such as SWIFT, CIPS, PayPal, Stripe and overseas local payment channels); familiar with multi-region cross-border payment compliance policies (such as Anti-Money Laundering (AML), Know Your Customer (KYC), etc.).

Coins is the most established crypto brand in The Philippines and has gained the trust of more than 18 million users. Through the easy-to-use mobile app, users can buy and sell a variety of different cryptocurrencies and access a wide range of financial services.

Coins is fully regulated by the Bangko Sentral ng Pilipinas (BSP) and is the first ever crypto-based company in Asia to hold both Virtual Currency and Electronic Money Issuer licenses from a central bank.

The Solutions Engineer will work closely with the sales and product teams to design, present, and demonstrate technical solutions to prospective partners, enterprise clients, and key stakeholders. This role requires a mix of technical expertise, communication skills, and business acumen to bridge the gap between customer needs and Coins.ph’s product capabilities.

lists.content:
• Collaborate with the account manager or sales team to understand client requirements and propose tailored Coins.ph solutions.
  • Conduct product demonstrations, technical presentations, and proof-of-concept (POC) sessions for prospective customers.
  • Translate complex technical concepts into clear business-value propositions.
  • Gather and relay customer feedback to the product team to help shape product enhancements.
  • Prepare technical documentation, integration guides, and solution architecture diagrams for clients.
  • Assist in drafting proposals, responses to RFPs, and solution overviews.
  • Stay up to date with Coins.ph’s product roadmap, industry trends, and competitors.
  • Support the onboarding of new enterprise partners by coordinating with internal teams.

• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or related field (or equivalent experience).
  • 3+ years of experience in a Solutions Engineer, Pre-Sales, or Technical Consultant role, preferably in fintech, payments, or crypto/blockchain.
  • Strong understanding of APIs, system integrations, and enterprise IT environments.
  • Excellent communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills.
  • Ability to quickly understand customer business needs and translate them into technical solutions.
  • Experience working with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Knowledge of cryptocurrency, blockchain technology, and digital payments is a plus.

Role Overview:

The Technical Operations Analyst plays a critical role in ensuring seamless integration between external partners and internal systems. This position serves as the primary point of contact for technical onboarding, troubleshooting, and cross-functional coordination, helping deliver a smooth and efficient partner experience.

lists.content:
Partner Integration & Support

  • Act as the main liaison for partners during the technical integration phase, providing hands-on guidance and support.

  • Troubleshoot and resolve technical issues encountered by partners, ensuring timely and effective solutions.

  • Clearly explain integration requirements, system capabilities, and technical workflows to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

  • Monitor integration progress and proactively address potential blockers to avoid delays.

    • Cross-functional Communication

  • Bridge communication between external partners and internal engineering or development teams to ensure alignment on requirements and timelines.

  • Translate technical concerns into actionable items for developers, and relay updates or solutions back to partners in a clear and concise manner.

  • Provide consistent status updates to stakeholders, ensuring transparency throughout the integration lifecycle.

  • Facilitate meetings, discussions, and documentation to support smooth collaboration across teams.

    • Process Optimization & Continuous Improvement

  • Identify inefficiencies in current integration and operational workflows, and recommend improvements to enhance speed and quality.

  • Develop and maintain documentation, playbooks, and best practices for partner integrations and technical support.

  • Contribute to the standardization of processes to improve scalability and consistency across multiple integrations.

  • Stay informed on industry trends, emerging technologies, and integration best practices to continuously enhance platform capabilities.

    • Additional Responsibilities

  • Support various operational and technical initiatives as needed, including ad hoc analysis, reporting, or project coordination.

  • Assist in testing, validation, and quality assurance efforts related to integrations and system updates.

  • Take on other duties as assigned to support the broader Technical Operations and business objectives.

• Bachelor’s (or higher) degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field.

  • Familiarity with tools such as Jira and Confluence.

  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.

  • Experience with at least one backend programming language (e.g., Java, Python, Node.js).

  • Basic understanding of APIs, system integrations, and RESTful services.

  • Experience with debugging, troubleshooting, and log analysis.

  • Familiarity with SQL and basic database concepts.

  • Experience working with cross-functional teams in a fast-paced environment.

  • Strong problem-solving and analytical skills.

  • Ability to manage multiple tasks and prioritize effectively.

  • Detail-oriented with strong organizational skills.

  • Experience in technical support, operations, or integration roles is a plus.

  • Exposure to Agile/Scrum methodologies is an advantage.

  • Willingness to learn new technologies and adapt to changing requirements.

  • Experience in fintech, SaaS, or similar tech-driven industries is a plus.

lists.content:
As the Technical Support Leader, you will be responsible for leading the technical support team to provide efficient, professional technical support services for users, partners, and internal teams. You will build and optimize the technical support system, manage the support team’s daily work, ensure timely and effective resolution of technical issues, improve user satisfaction, and provide strong technical support for the stable operation of the platform (digital currency trading, payment services, etc.). This role requires balancing service quality, efficiency, and team development to align with the company’s compliance and business development goals.

 

Key Responsibilities

  • Team Management & Development
      • Build, manage, and develop the technical support team, formulate team OKRs, performance assessment standards, and talent training plans to improve the team’s professional capabilities and service level.
      • Arrange daily work assignments for the team, supervise work progress, and handle team performance management, conflict resolution, and staff motivation.
      • Establish a team knowledge sharing mechanism, organize technical training and skill exchanges to enhance the team’s overall technical support capabilities.
      •  
        • Technical Support System Construction & Optimization
            • Establish and improve the technical support process (including problem acceptance, classification, disposal, feedback, and closed-loop management) to ensure standardized and efficient handling of support requests.
            • Optimize the technical support channel (online consultation, phone, email, ticketing system, etc.) to improve the efficiency of problem acceptance and response.
            • Cooperate with the R&D team to optimize the support system, improve the intelligent response capability, and reduce manual intervention.
            •  
              • Technical Issue Handling & Coordination
                  • Lead the team to handle complex technical issues (such as platform system failures, user operation problems, payment channel exceptions, blockchain-related technical issues, etc.), coordinate internal technical resources (R&D, product, etc.) to promote problem resolution.
                  • Track and analyze technical support data (such as problem types, resolution time, user satisfaction), summarize common problems, and put forward suggestions for product and system optimization.

                    •  

                    • User & Partner Support
                        • Ensure the team provides professional, timely technical support for platform users (individuals, institutions) and partners, including problem consultation，operation guidance, etc.
                        • Collect user and partner feedback on technical issues, sort out key demands, and coordinate relevant departments to promote improvement.

                          •  

                          • Compliance & Risk Control

                            • Ensure that technical support work complies with the company’s regulations and relevant industry norms, and strictly protect user data and transaction information security.

                              • Cooperate with the compliance team to provide technical support-related compliance materials and respond to regulatory inquiries.

                                •  

                                • Cross-departmental Collaboration
                                  • Cooperate closely with R&D, product, operation, compliance, and other departments to align technical support work with business development, and promote the optimization of product and system functions based on support feedback.

• Work Experience: 5+ years of technical support or related work experience, including 2+ years of team management experience (preferably in fintech, digital currency, or payment-related industries).
  • Professional Skills:
      • Proficient in computer operation and common technical tools, able to quickly understand and troubleshoot common technical problems (such as system operation, network, blockchain-related basic technical issues).
      • Familiar with technical support processes and tools (ticketing system, remote assistance tools, etc.), with the ability to guide the team to handle complex technical issues.
        • Comprehensive Capabilities:
            • Excellent team management, communication, and coordination skills, able to effectively lead the team to complete work goals.
            • Strong sense of responsibility, good pressure resistance, and the ability to handle emergency technical problems efficiently.
            • Proficient in oral and written English, able to communicate with international users/partners smoothly.
              • Education Background: Bachelor’s degree or above in computer science, information technology, electronic engineering, or related majors; relevant professional certifications (such as ITIL, CompTIA) are preferred.

                •  

                Preferred Qualifications

                • Have experience in technical support management in digital currency, payment, or blockchain-related industries.
                • Familiar with digital currency trading platforms, blockchain technology, or payment system technical support.
                • Have experience in building and optimizing technical support teams and systems.
