Coins is the most established crypto brand in The Philippines and has gained the trust of more than 18 million users. Through the easy-to-use mobile app, users can buy and sell a variety of different cryptocurrencies and access a wide range of financial services.

Coins is fully regulated by the Bangko Sentral ng Pilipinas (BSP) and is the first ever crypto-based company in Asia to hold both Virtual Currency and Electronic Money Issuer licenses from a central bank.

We are looking for a visionary and hands-on Technology Lead to spearhead the development and scaling of our high-performance exchange platform at Coins.
In this role, you will bridge the gap between technical execution and strategic leadership. You will design and implement robust, microservices-based Java applications, mentor a talented team of developers, and collaborate across international borders to support our global expansion. If you thrive in a fast-paced environment, love solving complex architectural challenges, and are passionate about fintech/crypto innovation, we want to hear from you.
jobs.description:
Join the Pioneer Crypto Brand in the Philippines!

Coins is the most established crypto brand in The Philippines and has gained the trust of more than 18 million users. Through the easy-to-use mobile app, users can buy and sell a variety of different cryptocurrencies and access a wide range of financial services.

Coins is fully regulated by the Bangko Sentral ng Pilipinas (BSP) and is the first ever crypto-based company in Asia to hold both Virtual Currency and Electronic Money Issuer licenses from a central bank.

We are looking for a visionary and hands-on Technology Lead to spearhead the development and scaling of our high-performance exchange platform at Coins.

In this role, you will bridge the gap between technical execution and strategic leadership. You will design and implement robust, microservices-based Java applications, mentor a talented team of developers, and collaborate across international borders to support our global expansion. If you thrive in a fast-paced environment, love solving complex architectural challenges, and are passionate about fintech/crypto innovation, we want to hear from you.

lists.content:
• Development & Leadership:
  • Lead the development of the exchange platform, ensuring seamless operations and high performance.
  • Design, implement, and maintain robust Java-based applications and systems.
  • Write high-quality, scalable, and efficient code using Java and relevant technologies.
  • Manage the full software development lifecycle, from requirements gathering to production deployment.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including product managers, designers, and developers, to ensure technical feasibility and adherence to best practices.
  • Develop clean, maintainable, and well-documented code.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve issues across development, staging, and production environments.
  • Lead and mentor junior developers, fostering their technical growth and career development.
  • Conduct regular code reviews to ensure adherence to coding standards and best practices.
  • Continuously stay updated on emerging technologies and apply industry best practices.
    •  
  • Cross-Cultural Relations:
  • Foster and manage relationships across diverse cultures, supporting the global expansion of Coins.
  • Regulatory Compliance:
  • Ensure all operations comply with local regulations and standards, collaborating with compliance teams to integrate KYC and Fiat transaction processes effectively.
    •  
  • Required Tech Skills:
  • Proven experience as a Java Developer with a strong foundation in object-oriented programming principles.
  • Expertise in Spring Boot and Spring Cloud frameworks for building microservices-based applications.
  • Leadership experience, with the ability to mentor and guide a team of developers.
  • Strong knowledge of databases, including MySQL and NoSQL (e.g., Redis).
  • Familiarity with middleware (e.g., Kafka,RabbitMQ)
  • Familiarity with RESTful web services and API design.
  • Experience with version control systems (e.g., Git).
  • Strong problem-solving skills, with keen attention to detail.
  • Ability to manage multiple tasks, prioritize effectively, and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
  • Experience with system performance optimization is a plus.

• Strong Technical Foundation: Proficient in Java and development practices tailored for blockchain-based applications.
  • Strategic Vision & Innovation: Proven ability to conceptualize and execute strategic technology initiatives that align with the startup’s goals and market demands. Demonstrated success in delivering innovative solutions in the fintech or crypto space that drive business growth and scalability.
  • Leadership in Tech Startup Environments: Extensive experience leading, building, and scaling high-performing tech teams in fast-paced startup environments. Strong ability to inspire, motivate, and guide teams toward achieving ambitious technical milestones while nurturing a culture of innovation and continuous learning.
  • Operational Excellence: Expertise in designing robust tech solutions that ensure operational efficiency, security, and scalability. Knowledge of managing distributed systems with a focus on reliability, latency, and privacy, particularly in the context of crypto transactions.
  • Risk Management & Security Expertise: In-depth understanding of security challenges and risks in the crypto industry, with experience implementing best practices for application security and data protection.
  • Adaptability & Problem-Solving: Exceptional analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to anticipate industry trends, adapt to new technologies, and navigate complex regulatory landscapes. A solutions-oriented mindset focused on overcoming challenges and seizing opportunities in the crypto market.
  • Communication: Proficient in spoken English; Mandarin speaking and listening skills are a strong plus.

Coins is the most established crypto brand in The Philippines and has gained the trust of more than 18 million users. Through the easy-to-use mobile app, users can buy and sell a variety of different cryptocurrencies and access a wide range of financial services.

The Thailand Regulatory Affairs & Licensing Manager leads Coins’ regulatory strategy, licensing execution, and compliance alignment in Thailand. The role tracks regulatory developments, manages licensing processes, communicates with regulators, builds internal compliance frameworks, and ensures Coins’ products and operations comply with Thai SEC, BOT, AMLO, and other authorities.

lists.content:
• Monitor and interpret regulations from SEC, BOT, AMLO, and assess their impact on Coins’ products and operations.
  • Advise management and product teams on regulatory feasibility, requirements, and risk implications.
  • Lead end-to-end regulatory licensing processes, including preparing submissions and managing regulator communications.
  • Maintain strong relationships with regulators and handle inquiries, audits, inspections, and periodic reporting.
  • Develop and maintain internal compliance frameworks, policies, SOPs, and AML/CFT requirements for Thailand.
  • Coordinate cross-functionally with Legal, Compliance, Product, Engineering, and Finance to ensure regulatory alignment.
  • Draft regulatory strategy reports, position papers, and consultation responses for policy developments.
  • Identify regulatory risks early and provide clear guidance to internal stakeholders.
  • Represent Coins in regulatory dialogues, consultations, and industry engagements.

• Bachelor’s degree required; advanced degree in Law, Public Policy, Business, or related fields preferred.
  • Minimum 5–8 years of experience in regulatory advisory, licensing, compliance, or legal within financial services, fintech, or consulting.
  • Strong understanding of Thai SEC, BOT, and AMLO regulations covering digital assets, payments, e-money, and AML/CFT.
  • Experience managing licensing applications or preparing regulatory submissions.
  • Excellent analytical, research, and regulatory interpretation skills.
  • Strong written communication skills for drafting filings, policies, and strategic documents.
  • Ability to work independently and manage multiple regulatory projects in a fast-paced environment.
  • High attention to detail and ability to build relationships with regulators and internal stakeholders.

• Experience in crypto, digital assets, CEX operations, or regional fintech.
  • Familiarity with stablecoins, digital asset infrastructure (non-technical level).
  • Previous involvement in regulatory inspections, audits, or formal consultations.
  • Experience developing AML/CFT frameworks, risk management systems, or internal governance programs.
  • Native or fluent Thai language with strong professional English communication.

lists.content:
1. Wallet Architecture Security Construction: Lead and maintain the security architecture of the company’s cold, warm and hot cryptocurrency wallets. Standardize the full lifecycle of private key generation, storage, usage, backup and destruction, and ensure the entire system complies with top-tier industry security standards including FIPS 140-2/3.
2. MPC & Multi-Signature Strategy Management: Manage security policy configuration, permission grading and isolation for MPC (Multi-Party Computation) wallets and multi-sig smart contracts. Conduct regular disaster recovery drills to eliminate single points of failure, permission abuse and internal malicious risks.
3. On-Chain Transaction & Node Security: Conduct security hardening and daily operation and maintenance for full nodes and RPC interfaces of mainstream public chains including BTC, ETH and Tron, defending against node hijacking, Sybil attacks, unauthorized access and other underlying security threats.
4. Smart Contract Interaction Review: Audit the security of business system interactions with external smart contracts such as USDT, USDC and DEXs. Identify and prevent common on-chain vulnerabilities including approval phishing and reentrancy attacks to avoid asset security risks.

1. Bachelor’s degree or above in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, Cryptography, Software Engineering, Blockchain or related majors, with 1-3 years of working experience in Web3 or blockchain security.
2. Familiar with basic cryptography principles, proficient in core logic of public and private key management and encrypted storage, familiar with FIPS 140-2/3 standards and cold/hot wallet architecture.
3. In-depth knowledge of MPC, TSS threshold signature and on-chain multi-signature mechanisms, with hands-on experience in permission control, disaster recovery drills and risk investigation.
4. Familiar with the underlying logic of mainstream public chains (BTC, ETH, TRON), with practical capabilities in public chain node operation, RPC interface security hardening and on-chain attack prevention.
5. Familiar with common smart contract security vulnerabilities, able to independently complete contract interaction security audits, risk assessment and problem rectification.
6. Strong security risk awareness and sense of responsibility, rigorous and meticulous working attitude, with in-depth understanding of digital asset and private key security. Experience in wallet security at large platforms is preferred.

jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Griffin

Hi, we’re Griffin. We’re a fully regulated UK bank that powers the accounts and payments offerings of product-led fintechs and platforms like Uber, Yonder, Prosper, and Sidekick. By doing the heavy lifting behind the scenes, our customers can focus on what they do best - delivering amazing customer experiences.

We’ve grown rapidly since our launch in 2024, and today provide the banking backbone behind products in remittance, payroll, wealth, insurance, proptech, payments, neobanking and more.

We’re moving into card issuing, stablecoin infrastructure, and agentic finance next as we continue to support the next generation of product-led companies.

Learn more about what we do

Our culture

We believe that smart, motivated, conscientious people thrive in high-trust, high-autonomy environments and have done our best to create such an environment at Griffin. People who thrive here don’t require much hand-holding, and go out of their way to figure out how to contribute in the most valuable way possible.

We've been remote-first since we were established in 2017 and we remain so today. Work here is asynchronous and fully flexible - because we want to be a part of your life in a way that helps you to get the most out of both your work and home life.

We understand that our culture and ways of working aren’t for everyone, and we’re very intentional about our hiring process as a result. We won't hire people who don’t seem like a strong fit for our core values, even if they're otherwise extremely qualified.

Our strong culture has helped us to remain a mission-driven company as we have scaled, and gives our people a clear, explicit operating framework and the space to focus on delivering real value for our customers.

Learn more about our culture.

The team

We're building the bank for fintechs and corporates to build on, bringing best-in-class technology, user experience and banking together in the embedded finance space. You'll be the third hire on our Customer Success team, helping shape how we support and grow our customer base from the ground up.

The opportunity

As a Customer Success Manager, you'll own a book of customers and become the person they rely on to get real value from our product. You'll work closely with our implementation and product teams, spot growth opportunities within your accounts, and help define what great customer success looks like at Griffin as we scale.

What success looks like

In your first 6-12 months, you'll have built strong, trusted relationships across your customer book, driven measurable improvements in retention and account growth, and become a go-to voice on what customers need from Griffin. You'll have also helped sharpen how the wider team approaches customer success as we grow.

To do this you'll own

  • Fully owning your customer book and being accountable for their delight, retention and commercial growth through proactive and responsive communication

  • Becoming a true product expert by developing a deep understanding of Griffin's products and systems, so you can support and advocate for your customers

  • Getting hands-on with your customers, understanding the detail of their challenges and going the extra mile to help resolve them

  • Working closely with our implementation teams to ensure a smooth onboarding experience and faster time-to-value

  • Uncovering upsell and cross-sell opportunities within existing accounts to drive revenue growth

  • Improving existing processes and meaningfully harnessing AI to optimise the customer experience

We expect you to shape this role:

This description reflects what we need today. How you achieve these outcomes, where you focus your energy, how this role evolves—that's for you to define as you learn what our customers need and where our technical gaps are.

Your background

To ensure this, we're looking for people who have:

  • 2-3 years' experience in B2B customer success or account management. Financial services or fintech experience is a bonus, not a requirement, provided you can show you pick up new industries and products fast

  • Excellent time management skills, with experience handling competing priorities while consistently delivering results

  • A strong sense of ownership and accountability, with demonstrated success in customer retention and account expansion

  • Strong relationship-building skills, with experience developing trust and rapport across external and internal stakeholders

  • A high degree of comfort adopting new software tools for document drafting, collaboration and communication, since we're hybrid-remote and most of your colleagues won't share an office with you day-to-day

  • A love of writing - we have a major amount of written documentation that you will be contributing to, and we place a high degree of importance on clarity and readability (you can find out more here about how we write)

What can we offer you?

We are an early stage startup and we're working hard to expand our benefits package. We're planning to add to this list in the future.

  • Salary: £50-55,000 (DOE) + discretionary commission

  • Remote-first flexibility: Work from anywhere in the UK

  • Work from abroad: Up to 20 days a year

  • Time off: 25 days' holiday, bank holidays and a winter break (we shut down between Christmas and New Year)

  • Share options: Own a part of what we're building together

  • Pension: Auto-enrolment into our Penfold scheme

  • Insurance: Private medical with Bupa (including family cover) and life insurance with AIG

  • Wellbeing: 1:1 coaching and therapy sessions available through Oliva

  • Family leave: Enhanced parental leave with up to 6 months on full pay after two years' service

  • AI tools: Everyone has a Claude subscription on us and access to other premium tools

  • Your setup: We'll support you in creating a comfortable and effective WFH environment

Our interview process

Learn more about our culture.

The Finance team

Our vision is that our Finance team is a central part of the business, somewhere the Board can rely on to support strategic planning. The team are thought leaders in relation to finance, regulatory, planning and strategic matters.

You'll report directly to Michael, our Treasurer, sitting right at the heart of how we manage economic and regulatory risk and support optimising Griffin's balance within Board risk appetite.

The opportunity

This role is Griffin's essential support to the Treasurer — giving you hands-on ownership of the reporting and analysis that support risk management and decision making, as well as intraday cash management and oversight of regulatory reports. You'll work closely with Michael, stepping in with confidence when he's out, and you'll help shape how we manage liquidity and our HQLA portfolio. It's a rare chance to build deep treasury expertise inside a fast-moving, founder-led bank.

What success looks like

In your first 6 months you'll have built a genuine understanding of Griffin's business model and how treasury supports it. You'll have taken full ownership of our daily and monthly reporting, sense-checking every output before it goes out. By month 12 you'll have picked up our existing processes with confidence, and started enhancing them: improving our reporting and feeding directly into how we manage liquidity and investment strategy. Michael will know he can rely on you, whether he's in the room or not.

To do this you’ll own

  • Daily reporting on liquidity, capital, interest rate risk, funding capacity and asset encumbrance

  • Monthly reporting, including liquidity, interest rate risk, treasury asset interest income, margin, and customer profitability

  • Cash management, including inter-account transfers (our Bank of England Reserve Account included) and payments

  • Liquidity management, monitoring depositor behaviour and refining our outflow assumptions across settlement cycles, including short term forecasting

  • Dealing: pre and post-trade checks, trade confirmation, settlements, and credit analysis

  • Maintaining our treasury mandates

  • Changes to risk management and reporting as a result of strategic projects, such as Direct FPS and access to the Bank of England's Sterling Monetary Framework

We expect you to shape this role:

This description reflects what we need today. How you achieve these outcomes, where you focus your energy, how this role evolves—that's for you to define as you learn what our customers need and where our technical gaps are.

Your background:

To ensure this, we're looking for people who have:

  • 5+ years' experience in a bank treasury function, including measurement and reporting of liquidity and capital from an economic risk and regulatory perspective (e.g., CRR, Basel III, LCR, NSFR, IRRBB, ILAAP, ICAAP)

  • Strong, hands-on Excel skills

  • Dealing experience: evaluating the market, proposing trades, and executing them

  • Sharp attention to detail, with the ability to sense-check your own reporting output

  • A love of writing - we have a major amount of written documentation that you will be contributing to, and we place a high degree of importance on clarity and readability (you can find out more here about how we write )

Ideally, you would also:

  • Have experience in a challenger or growth-stage bank, having built or improved treasury processes and reporting

  • Have a relevant treasury or accounting qualification

  • Bring data skills like Python, SQL, or Power BI, and know how to use APIs and put AI tools to work

  • AI tools: Everyone has a Claude subscription on us and access to other premium tools

  • Your setup: We’ll support you in creating a comfortable and effective WFH environment.

As a bank, we’re committed to maintaining the highest standards of security. This means that the successful candidate will need to complete background screening, and our offer will be conditional upon satisfactory review of these checks. jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Griffin

Hi, we’re Griffin. We’re a fully regulated UK bank that powers the accounts and payments offerings of product-led fintechs and platforms like Uber, Yonder, Prosper, and Sidekick. By doing the heavy lifting behind the scenes, our customers can focus on what they do best - delivering amazing customer experiences.

Learn more about what we do

Our culture

We believe that smart, motivated, conscientious people thrive in high-trust, high-autonomy environments and have done our best to create such an environment at Griffin. People who thrive here don’t require much hand-holding, and go out of their way to figure out how to contribute in the most valuable way possible.

Our strong culture has helped us to remain a mission-driven company as we have scaled, and gives our people a clear, explicit operating framework and the space to focus on delivering real value for our customers.

Learn more about our culture.

The team:

Infrastructure sits within the Craft function. We’re a small team of three - two engineers and an engineering manager - who work closely with our CTO and Founder, Allen Rohner. It’s our job to build the foundations that everything else at Griffin runs on: the systems, the tooling, the automation that helps us run a highly resilient and reliable platform and lets other teams ship fast.

When we start work, we explore multiple solutions before picking one. We write RFCs, build proof-of-concepts, and run experiments to validate approaches. Once we commit to building something, we care about maintainability more than cleverness, observability more than hoping it works, and scalability over premature optimisation. We take the necessary time to ship quality solutions rather than hitting arbitrary deadlines. Once something goes live, we refactor the rough edges rather than polish what's already working.

The opportunity:

Day to day, you'll manage the infrastructure the bank runs on - both in the cloud and on our own hardware in third party data centres. This means running FoundationDB clusters and building tooling for hitless upgrades, managing Kubernetes, writing infrastructure as code in Pulumi and CDK, running the Bazel build farm, and owning the deployment pipeline from CI to production.

Operational resilience is a big part of the job: replica clusters, multi-region failover, and chaos engineering to test how systems handle failures. Security access, CircleCI pipelines, DataDog integration, and cloud spend all fall under infrastructure too.

On our roadmap currently is: building out our self-hosted infrastructure to support a hybrid-cloud setup and remove single-vendor reliance, improving how Kubernetes scales, improving the build farm, and building out our PKI infrastructure. We also have plans for a global HTTP routing layer to allow seamless failover between sites.

Our infrastructure as code is written in TypeScript. Where it makes sense, tooling gets written in Clojure. There's some Rust too.

What success looks like:

Infrastructure problems become production problems fast. Success here means thinking ahead - identifying issues with scale, security, or compliance before they affect services.

You've eliminated an entire class of incidents by fixing the underlying architectural issue. You've proven the database and compute platform can handle 10x current traffic volumes by working with backend teams to stress-test it. You've cut deploy times in half by rethinking how the pipeline works. You've tested multi-region failover under realistic failure scenarios and it worked. You've redesigned service discovery to remove networking issues that used to cause weekly firefights. When new FCA requirements dropped, you were already compliant because you'd built the infrastructure to handle it months earlier.

To do this, you'll own:

  • Infrastructure architecture decisions - how we structure our systems, what approaches we take, what tools we build

  • Production reliability - keeping the database, compute, build farm, and deployment pipelines running and improving them

  • What other teams depend on to ship - CI/CD, security access, monitoring integration, and the infrastructure that lets engineers deploy safely

  • Infrastructure cost and efficiency - managing spend and resource usage across AWS and DataDog

Stack: FoundationDB, Kubernetes, Bazel, Pulumi, CDK, CircleCI, DataDog, Clojure, TypeScript

Your background:

You'll fit in well here if you have:

  • Solid systems experience - you've run container orchestration in production, written infrastructure as code, and understand IP networking well enough to debug it when things go wrong

  • Cloud infrastructure experience - you've built and managed production environments, worked with networking, identity management, and compute at scale

  • Programming fundamentals - you write code to solve problems. TypeScript, Python, Go, or functional languages are all fine. If your experience only extends to Bash scripting and YAML, we probably aren't a good fit for you.

jobs.descriptionPlain:
ABOUT GRIFFIN

Hi, we’re Griffin. We’re a fully regulated UK bank that powers the accounts and payments offerings of product-led fintechs and platforms like Uber, Yonder, Prosper, and Sidekick. By doing the heavy lifting behind the scenes, our customers can focus on what they do best - delivering amazing customer experiences.

We’ve grown rapidly since our launch in 2024, and today provide the banking backbone behind products in remittance, payroll, wealth, insurance, proptech, payments, neobanking and more.

We’re moving into card issuing, stablecoin infrastructure, and agentic finance next as we continue to support the next generation of product-led companies.

Learn more about what we do https://griffin.com




OUR CULTURE

We believe that smart, motivated, conscientious people thrive in high-trust, high-autonomy environments and have done our best to create such an environment at Griffin. People who thrive here don’t require much hand-holding, and go out of their way to figure out how to contribute in the most valuable way possible.

We've been remote-first since we were established in 2017 and we remain so today. Work here is asynchronous and fully flexible - because we want to be a part of your life in a way that helps you to get the most out of both your work and home life.

We understand that our culture and ways of working aren’t for everyone, and we’re very intentional about our hiring process as a result. We won't hire people who don’t seem like a strong fit for our core values, even if they're otherwise extremely qualified.

Our strong culture has helped us to remain a mission-driven company as we have scaled, and gives our people a clear, explicit operating framework and the space to focus on delivering real value for our customers.

Learn more about our culture. https://griffin.com/culture

Infrastructure sits within the Craft function. We’re a small team of three - two engineers and an engineering manager - who work closely with our CTO and Founder, Allen Rohner https://www.linkedin.com/in/allenrohner/. It’s our job to build the foundations that everything else at Griffin runs on: the systems, the tooling, the automation that helps us run a highly resilient and reliable platform and lets other teams ship fast.

When we start work, we explore multiple solutions before picking one. We write RFCs, build proof-of-concepts, and run experiments to validate approaches. Once we commit to building something, we care about maintainability more than cleverness, observability more than hoping it works, and scalability over premature optimisation. We take the necessary time to ship quality solutions rather than hitting arbitrary deadlines. Once something goes live, we refactor the rough edges rather than polish what's already working.




THE OPPORTUNITY:

Day to day, you'll manage the infrastructure the bank runs on - both in the cloud and on our own hardware in third party data centres. This means running FoundationDB clusters and building tooling for hitless upgrades, managing Kubernetes, writing infrastructure as code in Pulumi and CDK, running the Bazel build farm, and owning the deployment pipeline from CI to production.

Operational resilience is a big part of the job: replica clusters, multi-region failover, and chaos engineering to test how systems handle failures. Security access, CircleCI pipelines, DataDog integration, and cloud spend all fall under infrastructure too.

On our roadmap currently is: building out our self-hosted infrastructure to support a hybrid-cloud setup and remove single-vendor reliance, improving how Kubernetes scales, improving the build farm, and building out our PKI infrastructure. We also have plans for a global HTTP routing layer to allow seamless failover between sites.

Our infrastructure as code is written in TypeScript. Where it makes sense, tooling gets written in Clojure. There's some Rust too.

Infrastructure problems become production problems fast. Success here means thinking ahead - identifying issues with scale, security, or compliance before they affect services.

You've eliminated an entire class of incidents by fixing the underlying architectural issue. You've proven the database and compute platform can handle 10x current traffic volumes by working with backend teams to stress-test it. You've cut deploy times in half by rethinking how the pipeline works. You've tested multi-region failover under realistic failure scenarios and it worked. You've redesigned service discovery to remove networking issues that used to cause weekly firefights. When new FCA requirements dropped, you were already compliant because you'd built the infrastructure to handle it months earlier.

 - Production reliability - keeping the database, compute, build farm, and deployment pipelines running and improving them

 - What other teams depend on to ship - CI/CD, security access, monitoring integration, and the infrastructure that lets engineers deploy safely

 - Infrastructure cost and efficiency - managing spend and resource usage across AWS and DataDog
   

Stack: FoundationDB, Kubernetes, Bazel, Pulumi, CDK, CircleCI, DataDog, Clojure, TypeScript

Harmony is an open blockchain with data sharding and fast finality. Social games and community AI can use our onchain tokens for micro-payments, smart contracts for market pricing, and zero-knowledge proofs for data privacy.

Harmony’s mission is to scale trust and create a radically fair economy. Our platform is decentralized, scalable and secure to settle any transactions without trusted parties.

🚀 Building a (Rocket)Ship
We are a Day-1 startup. Blockchains are becoming the foundation of the global economy, yet their adoption is at only 1%. That means that you as a pioneer and developer are shaping the future with 10X impact. Harmony is a community-driven project, a network with hundreds of applications, and a team wearing crazy ambitions on their sleeves. Because the invincible summer awaits!

For engineers, we value your deep understanding of how bytes work. You are a tool maker, a system hacker, and a math nerd all in ONE. Your typical day involves prototyping a top-conference research paper, debugging and profiling in hexdecimal, or writing updates to coordinate asynchronously with tens of engineers in the open. Building a blockchain is like jumping off the cliff while assembling the plane engine on the fly – but, if you can thrive in chaos, why NOT?

For creatives, we approve your obsession with user experience. You are a product designer, a brand manager, and an industry analyst all in ONE. Your typical day involves studying what delights and what hurts through hard metrics, writing long-form narratives on the why's and the do's, or scrumming tasks for a product launch to iterate with millions of users. Building a community is like sharing your blue heart while keeping the culture alive for decades – but, if this is your dream of 50 years, start NOW?

💙 See our project vision on Social A(G)I and Shard 1.

🚀 Building a (Rocket)Ship
We are a Day-1 startup. Blockchains are becoming the foundation of the global economy, yet their adoption is at only 1%. That means that you as a pioneer and developer are shaping the future with 10X impact. Harmony is a community-driven project, a network with hundreds of applications, and a team wearing crazy ambitions on their sleeves. Because the invincible summer awaits!

For engineers, we value your deep understanding of how bytes work. You are a tool maker, a system hacker, and a math nerd all in ONE. Your typical day involves prototyping a top-conference research paper, debugging and profiling in hexdecimal, or writing updates to coordinate asynchronouly with tens of engineers in the open. Building a community is like sharing your blue heart while keeping the culture alive for decades – but, if this is your dream of 50 years, start NOW?

jobs.title: Sales Development Representative
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Harmony

Harmony gives every employee an always-on expert for every service request, inside the tools they already use. Deployed inside Slack and Microsoft Teams, its agents draw on a context graph connecting each employee's identity, devices, applications, and history, resolving requests across IT, HR, finance, procurement, and legal automatically, before a ticket ever opens.

With 100+ prebuilt agents that deploy in days, not months, and a 70% no-touch resolution rate, Harmony removes the manual work from enterprise service without removing the humans who should own the hard problems. Built for IT and HR teams that are done waiting for their service platform to catch up with the rest of the business.

What You'll Do

  • Prospect, qualify, and follow up with a high volume of cold leads and generate sales-ready meetings for the sales team

  • Run thorough discovery and deliver clean handoffs to your assigned AEs

  • Multi-thread accounts across IT and business decision-makers

  • Use Harmony’s sales tech stack (Nooks, Apollo, Sales Navigator, Gong, Salesforce) according to Harmony’s standards

  • Hit quota consistently and thrive in a fast-moving, early-stage environment

  • Bring an entrepreneurial mindset - self-motivated, self-managing, and energized by building from the ground up

  • Build relationships fast over the phone with both business and technical audiences

  • Collaborate across Sales, Marketing, and Product

What You Bring

  • Highly motivated and self-starting, with a genuine drive to be a top performer and grow a sales career

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills

  • Comfortable using AI tools for research, prospecting, and writing

  • Able to work on-site in Manhattan 4 days per week

  • Salesforce and sales engagement tool experience (Nooks, Apollo) a plus

What We Offer

  • Competitive salary and equity

  • Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage

  • 401(k), with company matching

  • Top-tier in-office gear or stipend for home office (for remote employees), and

  • Many more.

Equal Employment Opportunity Harmony is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate the diverse backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences that make our team stronger. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, marital status, pregnancy, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.

jobs.title: Product Manager
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Harmony

Harmony gives every employee an always-on expert for every service request, inside the tools they already use. Deployed inside Slack and Microsoft Teams, its agents draw on a context graph connecting each employee's identity, devices, applications, and history, resolving requests across IT, HR, finance, procurement, and legal automatically, before a ticket ever opens.

With 100+ prebuilt agents that deploy in days, not months, and a 70% no-touch resolution rate, Harmony removes the manual work from enterprise service without removing the humans who should own the hard problems. Built for IT and HR teams that are done waiting for their service platform to catch up with the rest of the business.

In this role, you’ll own the product strategy and roadmap for a core area of the Harmony platform. You’ll work directly with enterprise customers to uncover real problems, partner with Engineering and Design to build elegant solutions, and drive the full product lifecycle from discovery through adoption. This is a high-ownership role at a fast-growing company where your decisions will have a direct and visible impact on customers and the business.

Why This Role Matters

This is a highly visible role in a rapidly growing company where product decisions directly influence our market position and customer success. You’ll have the opportunity to shape category-defining AI experiences, work closely with leadership, and help build the next generation of enterprise software that challenges decades-old approaches to IT Service Management.


What You’ll Do

  • Partner directly with customers to deeply understand their challenges, workflows, and goals, translating insights into innovative products that create business value.

  • Lead end-to-end product development, from discovery and validation through launch, adoption, and continuous optimization.

  • Identifying opportunities to leverage AI agents, automation, and emerging technologies to fundamentally improve how enterprise services are delivered and consumed.

  • Work closely with Engineering, Design, AI, and GTM teams to ensure rapid execution, and successful product launches.

  • Collaborate with Sales, Customer Success, and Solution Engineering teams to support strategic customers, gather market intelligence, and shape product direction.

  • Operate with a high degree of ownership and autonomy, making decisions in a fast-moving environment where your work will have a direct impact on product adoption, and company growth.


What We’re Looking For

Required Qualifications

  • 6+ years of experience as a product manager in at least 2 different B2B software companies.

  • Extremely sharp, self-directed learner with the ability to rapidly master new problem spaces and domains.

  • Customer obsession and strong product discovery skills — you know how to gather feedback, identify unmet needs, and translate insights into clear product requirements and roadmap priorities.

  • Delivery-oriented with the ability to engage thoroughly and in a structured manner with every technical detail of the products you own.

  • Experience working with large enterprise customers (10,000+ employees), particularly with technical teams.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in the ITSM space, working at a company that delivers such a product.

  • Experience defining AI workflows, copilots, automation, or autonomous agents.

  • Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.

  • Strong analytical skills with experience using product metrics, customer data, and business KPIs to guide prioritization and measure success.

  • Background in startups or small companies, with a proven ability to build and launch new products, features, or business lines in ambiguous environments.

Equal Employment Opportunity Harmony is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate the diverse backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences that make our team stronger. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, marital status, pregnancy, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.

Harmony gives every employee an always-on expert for every service request, inside the tools they already use.   • Own the full sales cycle end to end - from prospecting and discovery through demo, negotiation, and close - carrying a quota

  • Run multi-threaded sales cycles with IT, HR, and Operations stakeholders, from individual practitioners up to VP and C-suite buyers

  • Develop deep understanding of prospects’ ITSM workflows and pain points, and translate our AI automation capabilities into clear, quantified business value

  • Build and manage your own pipeline through outbound prospecting, inbound follow-up, and partnerships - you won’t wait for leads to come to you

  • Maintain accurate pipeline hygiene and forecasting in the CRM, and report on activity, conversion, and revenue against targets

  • Act as the voice of the customer internally, share market and competitive feedback that directly influences product roadmap and positioning

  • Help define and refine the sales playbook, messaging, and processes as one of the founding members of the go-to-market team

Required qualifications

  • 5+ years of quota-carrying, closing experience in B2B SaaS sales, with a consistent track record of meeting or exceeding targets

  • Experience owning full-cycle sales - prospecting through close - for technical or platform products sold to business and technical buyers

  • Proven ability to run multi-stakeholder sales cycles and to communicate credibly with both practitioners and executives

  • Strong discovery, presentation, negotiation, and storytelling skills, with the ability to translate technical capabilities into business outcomes

  • High-agency, self-directed operator who thrives in an unstructured, fast-changing early-stage environment and is comfortable building process rather than inheriting it

  • Disciplined with CRM and sales tooling (e.g., Salesforce) and rigorous about pipeline management and forecasting

  • Based in the United States and able to work remotely (preference for east coast), with willingness to travel occasionally to NY HQ, as well as for customer meetings/events

Preferred qualifications

  • Experience selling ITSM, IT operations, observability, security, or workflow/process automation software

  • Working knowledge of AI and automation categories - specific familiarity with AI agents, LLM-based automation, or how AI is applied to IT workflows is a strong plus

  • Prior experience as an early or founding sales hire at a seed to Series B startup, helping establish the go-to-market motion

  • History of top performance - President’s Club, top-decile ranking, or rapid promotion

  • Familiarity selling into IT, DevOps, or IT support organizations and navigating their buying and evaluation processes

  • Experience with modern sales engagement and prospecting tools (e.g., Gong, Nooks)

What We Offer

  • Competitive salary and equity

  • Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage

  • 401(k), with company matching

  • Top-tier in-office gear or stipend for home office (for remote employees), and

  • Many more.

jobs.title: Solutions Engineer
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Harmony

Harmony gives every employee an always-on expert for every service request, inside the tools they already use. Deployed inside Slack and Microsoft Teams, its agents draw on a context graph connecting each employee's identity, devices, applications, and history, resolving requests across IT, HR, finance, procurement, and legal automatically, before a ticket ever opens.

With 100+ prebuilt agents that deploy in days, not months, and a 70% no-touch resolution rate, Harmony removes the manual work from enterprise service without removing the humans who should own the hard problems. Built for IT and HR teams that are done waiting for their service platform to catch up with the rest of the business.

About the Role

We’re looking for a Solutions Engineer to play a critical role in how we win and grow customers. You’ll own the technical implementation and onboarding experience starting during the evaluation period, when the deal is still on the line, and continuing through post-sale deployment. The quality and speed of your work directly influences whether prospects convert and whether customers expand.

You’ll be the person who proves the product delivers real value in a customer’s actual environment - not in a slide deck. That makes you one of the most important people in the sales process. When a prospect is evaluating us alongside competitors, your implementation is often what tips the decision.

This is a deeply technical, individual contributor role. You’ll be hands-on with integrations, configurations, and architecture, while also being someone customers trust and enjoy working with.

What You’ll Do

  • Own the technical implementation end-to-end - configuring, integrating, and deploying the product in customer environments during both evaluation and post-sale phases

  • Be a key driver of deal outcomes: your implementation work during evaluations and POCs is often what converts a prospect into a paying customer

  • Partner closely with Account Executives and the GTM team to shape deal strategy, scope technical requirements, and remove blockers that stand between a prospect and a closed deal

  • Run onboarding for new customers: architect their environment, build out integrations, and accelerate time-to-value so customers see ROI fast

  • Develop repeatable implementation playbooks, scripts, and tooling that make the GTM motion faster and more scalable

  • Diagnose and resolve complex technical challenges during implementation - digging into APIs, infrastructure, and code to keep engagements moving forward

  • Communicate clearly with both technical practitioners and executive stakeholders, framing the product’s value in terms that matter to each audience

  • Feed insights from the field back to Product and Engineering - what customers need, where the product falls short, and what would help close more deals

What We’re Looking For

Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in solutions engineering, software engineering, technical consulting, or a similar hands-on technical role (preferably with GTM exposure)

  • Strong technical depth: you’re comfortable working with APIs, cloud infrastructure, networking, scripting, and debugging complex systems

  • Proficiency in AI-assisted engineering workflows - you use tools like Claude Code, Codex, and similar LLM-based agents as a natural part of how you build, debug, and ship

  • Experience working alongside Sales as part of the deal cycle - you understand what it takes to win a technical evaluation and can operate with a sense of urgency when a deal depends on it

  • Experience running implementations or technical onboarding across multiple customers simultaneously

  • Self-directed problem solver who thrives in ambiguous, fast-moving environments

Preferred Qualifications

  • Domain knowledge in IT operations, IT infrastructure, or IT service management (e.g., ITSM, monitoring, endpoint management, networking)

  • Experience supporting or participating in technical evaluations, POCs, or pilot programs

  • Background in software development - you've built and shipped production code

What We Offer

  • Competitive salary and benefits package

  • Comprehensive health, dental, and vision benefits

  • 401(k) with company match

  • A collaborative, fast-moving team in Downtown Manhattan

Equal Employment Opportunity Harmony is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate the diverse backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences that make our team stronger. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, marital status, pregnancy, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.

  • High-agency, self-directed operator who thrives in an unstructured, fast-changing early-stage environment and is comfortable building process rather than inheriting it

  • Disciplined with CRM and sales tooling (e.g., Salesforce), including modern AI tools/techniques, and rigorous about pipeline management and forecasting

  • Based on the United States East Region, preferably Boston or the Washington metropolitan area (DMV) area. Willingness to travel occasionally to customer meetings, events and conferences is required

Preferred qualifications

  • Experience selling ITSM, IT operations, observability, security, or workflow/process automation software

  • Working knowledge of AI and automation categories - specific familiarity with AI agents, LLM-based automation, or how AI is applied to IT workflows is a strong plus

  • Prior experience as an early or founding sales hire at a seed to Series B startup, helping establish the go-to-market motion

  • History of top performance - President’s Club, top-decile ranking, or rapid promotion

  • Experience with modern sales engagement and prospecting tools (e.g., Gong, Nooks)

  • Many more.

jobs.title: AI-First Marketing Generalist & Agent Manager
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Harmony

Harmony gives every employee an always-on expert for every service request, inside the tools they already use. Deployed inside Slack and Microsoft Teams, its agents draw on a context graph connecting each employee's identity, devices, applications, and history, resolving requests across IT, HR, finance, procurement, and legal automatically, before a ticket ever opens.

With 100+ prebuilt agents that deploy in days, not months, and a 70% no-touch resolution rate, Harmony removes the manual work from enterprise service without removing the humans who should own the hard problems. Built for IT and HR teams that are done waiting for their service platform to catch up with the rest of the business.

AI-First Marketing Generalist & Agent Manager

Company: Harmony Reports to: Gadi BenMark, CMO Team: You, plus a workforce of AI marketing agents (paid media, copy, research, orchestration). Location: New York City. Strong preference for in-office 4 days a week. Level / comp: Flexible, calibrated to the person. We'll scope seniority and compensation to the right builder rather than force-fit a band.

 
 

The one-line version

We sell AI agents. We run our marketing on them too. We need the human who commands that agent workforce, owns the output, and moves fast enough that the CMO can stay on strategy.

 
 

Why this role exists

Harmony is an AI-native company. Our marketing should be the proof.

Today the CMO directs the agents, runs paid, builds the decks, writes the keynotes, and ships the banners. That does not scale. This role takes the operating layer off the CMO's plate: you run paid media across every channel, you produce the brand and content output AI-first, and you make the agents themselves better over time.

This is not a MarTech or Marketing Operations role. That function is owned. This role owns creative, content, and paid growth, executed through AI agents.

 
 

What you'll own

1. Command the paid media agent across all paid channels

  • Direct paid across search, paid social, display, video, and retargeting. Not just search.

  • Own both sides: the creative (ad copy, video and user-generated content (UGC) concepts, landing pages, creative testing) and the analytics (spend, cost per lead, pipeline contribution, weekly reporting, budget reallocation).

  • Turn the weekly paid report into decisions: what to cut, what to scale, which creative to kill, where the next dollar goes.

2. Run AI-first content and brand creative

  • Build the decks: webinar decks, tailored email marketing copy,

  • Write and design for the field: tradeshow banner copy, booth messaging, one-pagers, event handouts.

  • Feed the organic channels: LinkedIn, Twitter, Meta, YouTube, blog, and other owned surfaces, in Harmony's voice ,using text, images, and video.

  • Produce all of it AI-first: draft with the agents, direct the output, apply brand judgment, ship fast.

3. Build and improve the agents

  • Write and refine agent instructions the way you'd brief a sharp junior teammate: what, when, how, not line-by-line prompts.

  • Turn repeatable work into skills and workflows so the system does more each month than the last.

  • Close the loop: capture what worked, promote it into the system, so quality compounds.

4. Give the CMO some bandwidth

  • Own execution end-to-end so decisions, not tasks, reach the CMO.

  • Report crisply: what shipped, what's working, what you'd change, in numbers.

  • Be the operator who makes a two-person function perform like ten.

 
 

The work you'll hand off to agents (a starter set)

Real jobs you'd delegate and direct in your first 90 days. Each is written so a stranger could check it's done, which is exactly how you'll brief them.

  • 20+ ad angles per campaign, each backed by real buyer language pulled from G2, Gartner Peer Insights, Reddit, and our own sales-call transcripts.

  • A rolling competitor teardown: pricing, homepage, and ad-creative changes over time, refreshed monthly, so we always know where the category is under-advertised.

  • Landing pages built fast: a competitor page plus our brand guidelines in, an on-brand page out, then run through a "copy tournament" (multiple versions judged by adversarial agents) before it ships.

  • A paid-account health pass: 90 days of ad data in, a creative-fatigue kill list and the shared traits of our winners out.

  • Product and UGC videos, from two sources: some generated by agents, some shot by our own team at the office and on customer sites. You direct both, edit them together, and ship only the ones worth our name on them.

  • Lead magnets from scratch, since we don't have any yet: both the static ones (guides, checklists, benchmark reports as PDFs) and the interactive ones (an ROI calculator, an IT-maturity quiz).

  • A quarterly "kill Harmony" red-team: an agent playing our top competitor's CMO, hunting the holes in our positioning.

  • A brand-consistency pass: our voice, best work, and transcripts in one place, used to catch where our messaging contradicts itself.

The operating method behind all of it: you brief work as a goal with a checkable "Done when..." bar, not a vague task. Vague briefs loop forever; checkable ones get finished.

 
 

Who you are

  • You've built things on the internet. Side projects, a newsletter, a viral experiment, a micro-tool, a channel you grew. You make things because you can't not.

  • You hand off whole jobs, not just tasks. The bar is not "AI helps me work faster." It's that you delegate entire jobs to agents that overdeliver, then direct and judge the output. You manage AI like a manager, not a user.

  • You're a true generalist. Comfortable being part-strategist, part-copywriter, part-designer, part-analyst in the same afternoon. You'd rather own a channel end-to-end than hand off between silos.

  • You're fluent in paid. You've run real budgets across more than one channel and can read a performance report and act on it.

  • You get inside the head of our buyers. You can think like a stretched IT or HR leader, feel their pains and pressures, and use that to judge what will actually land before you spend a dollar or ship a slide. Customer-centric thinking is how you separate the agent output that works from the output that only looks good.

  • You have taste. You know the difference between AI output and good AI output, and you close that gap by hand.

  • You move at hacker speed. You ship the MVP, measure, and iterate. You don't wait for permission or perfect.

  • You write well. Clear, concise, no fluff. You can make a slide, a banner, and a LinkedIn post all sound like us.

 
 

Nice to have

  • B2B SaaS or developer / IT-audience experience.

  • Hands-on with no-code and automation tools (Zapier, Make, n8n, Retool, or similar) and with LLM tooling.

  • Design sensibility in a deck tool and a basic creative tool.

  • Comfortable behind a camera and in a video-editing tool, and willing to travel to customer sites for shoots.

  • You've stood up a paid channel from zero.

 
 

How we'll evaluate you (the work sample beats the resume)

  • Show us something you built and grew yourself. The scrappier and more self-directed, the better.

  • Show us a marketing agent, workflow, or automation you set up, and what it now does without you.

  • A short live exercise: take one Harmony asset (a deck slide, an ad, a banner) and make it better with agents in front of us. We care how you direct the work, not just the result. Bonus if you frame it as a goal with a checkable "Done when..." bar.

Equal Employment Opportunity Harmony is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate the diverse backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences that make our team stronger. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, marital status, pregnancy, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.

jobs.title: Talent Acquisition Partner
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Harmony

Harmony gives every employee an always-on expert for every service request, inside the tools they already use. Deployed inside Slack and Microsoft Teams, its agents draw on a context graph connecting each employee's identity, devices, applications, and history, resolving requests across IT, HR, finance, procurement, and legal automatically, before a ticket ever opens.

With 100+ prebuilt agents that deploy in days, not months, and a 70% no-touch resolution rate, Harmony removes the manual work from enterprise service without removing the humans who should own the hard problems. Built for IT and HR teams that are done waiting for their service platform to catch up with the rest of the business.

About the Role

We're hiring our first dedicated talent acquisition partner. Today, hiring is distributed across founders and hiring managers. Your job is to change that. This is a founding role in the truest sense. You'll run full-cycle recruiting for our US Go-to-Market teams, Sales, Marketing, and Customer Success, while building the systems, process, and hiring bar that everyone after you will operate within. You'll work directly with our executive team, and have real influence over how we grow.

As our team scales across the US, EMEA, and Israel, there's meaningful surface area beyond recruiting — onboarding, employer brand, HR systems, and people programs — for someone who wants it.

What You'll Do

Own GTM hiring end to end

  • Run full-cycle recruiting for US Go-to-Market roles: intake, sourcing, screening, interview coordination, offer strategy, and close

  • Build and maintain outbound sourcing pipelines for hard-to-fill roles — this is a hands-on sourcing job, not a coordination job

  • Manage our ATS as the single source of truth: pipeline hygiene, stage definitions, reporting, and candidate data integrity

  • Serve as the primary point of contact for candidates, and set the tone for how people experience our company before they join

Build the recruiting function

  • Design and roll out structured interview processes: scorecards, competency frameworks, interview loops, and debrief formats

  • Hiring manager enablement — train managers to interview well and hold a consistent bar

  • Define and report on the metrics that matter: time to fill, pipeline conversion, source effectiveness, offer acceptance, quality of hire

  • Implement the tooling stack (ATS, sourcing, scheduling, assessment)

  • Reduce agency dependency by building a durable in-house sourcing capability

Partner with leadership

  • Work directly with G&A and GTM leaders and the exec team on headcount planning, role scoping, and comp calibration

  • Bring market intelligence back to the business: what candidates are seeing, where we're competitive, where we're not

Support People Ops

  • Partner on new hire onboarding and the first-90-days experience

  • Contribute to people programs and HR operations: HRIS hygiene, policy documentation, employee lifecycle workflows, and internal comms

【公司简介】

我们是全球最早也是最成熟的数字资产平台之一，服务于全球数千万用户。我们始终位列全球Top交易所之列，提供涵盖数千种数字资产的全面交易和财富管理产品。我们拥有遍布全球主要金融中心的数千名员工，秉持远程优先、高度自主的企业文化，吸引着那些在快节奏、高挑战性环境中蓬勃发展的优秀人才。

 

【关于岗位】

1、AI 到底如何帮助金融实现业务增长？这是目前全球金融行业都在探索、但尚无成熟范式可循的难题。

2、我们不想做一个挂在 App 首页、回答泛泛问题的 Chatbot。这个岗位的核心使命是：站在交易用户的视角，探索 AI Agent 如何重构用户的行情理解、交易决策与风险管理链路，并为平台带来可衡量的业务增量（激活、留存与交易转化）。

3、你不会接手一个既定的需求列表，而是需要独立拆题、提出假设、设计 MVP 并拿到成果。

 

【岗位职责】

1、C 端场景拆题与增长探索：深入用户在交易链路中的决策痛点，识别高价值 Agent 场景（如行情辅助、决策支持、策略解释、风险提醒和资产复盘），验证 AI 对业务增长的实际 ROI。

2、设计高信任度的 Agent 交互：解决 AI 幻觉在金融严肃场景下的痛点，在智能引导、风险提示、合规边界和用户自主决策之间找到平衡。

3、主导Agent产品闭环：定义产品形态、核心假设、MVP 范围与验证指标，联动算法、工程、风控及运营团队，推动上线并用业务数据复盘价值。

4、建立交易级 Agent 评测标准：针对金融场景建立评测体系（关注意图识别准确率、工具调用、事实准确性、安全兜底及业务转化效果）。

 

【任职要求】

1、大厂 / 主流 AI 公司背景：有一线大厂、头部 AI 公司或成熟 AI 产品团队经验，完整主导过面向真实用户的 AI Agent、AI 助手或 AI 原生产品。

2、金融 / 交易场景深度理解：有金融交易、投资、券商、行情、财富管理相关产品经验，理解交易用户的真实心理与决策痛点。

3、C 端业务与增长敏锐度：具备强增长视角，能从用户激活、留存、交易转化和信任建立的角度设计 AI 产品，拒绝“为了 AI 而 AI”。

4、能在高度不确定的环境中独立拆题、验证方向、推动上线，并用数据复盘产品价值。

 

【加分项】

1、有创业、早期团队或 0 到 1 商业化项目经验

2、是交易、投资的深度用户

● 这个职位为何存在？它解决什么问题？我们为什么现在需要它？
KYC 是用户准入的第一道门，直接影响转化率、欺诈与合规成本。该岗位存在的意义是：把「能过审」变成「又好又快又准」的产品体验，用指标体系定位链路断点，并用竞品与技术扫描保持方案不过时。现在需要它，是因为业务增长与审核精度、自动规则、法规解读之间需要专人持续做产品化平衡，而不是靠运营或风控临时补位。
 
● 核心职责（3-5条）
  1. 主导 KYC 产品功能设计与体验优化，提升流程转化率与核验准确性。
  2. 搭建并维护 KYC 数据指标体系，定期采集与分析使用数据，识别并推动解决转化链路中的关键痛点。
  3. 持续跟踪行业与竞品动态，结构化输出竞品能力、差异点与市场策略，反哺产品路线与优先级。
  4. 研究并评估新兴 KYC 技术（如 AI 身份识别、区块链数据共享等），判断其适用场景、风险边界与对现有产品的价值，形成可落地的引入或试点建议。
 
● 理想候选人是什么样的？
熟悉 KYC 全链路语言——从用户填表、证件采集、活体/OCR 到自动审核与人工兜底——并能用数据说话：先定义「哪里漏、哪里卡、哪里误杀」，再改交互与策略。对「秒过」有工程化理解：知道在什么合规与风险边界下追求极致体验，而不是单纯追求表面通过率。习惯主动扫厂商能力与行业方案，比较优劣后能写清楚「我们为什么选 A 不选 B」。能把法规要求读进产品规格里，而不是停留在合规部门的 PPT 上。
 
● 吸引人的亮点（1-2条）
  1. 工作直接挂钩 转化率与准确性 等可感知业务结果，改动能快速在数据上验证。
  2. 可深度接触 AI 身份识别、OCR、自动审核与风控规则 的交叉地带，并参与前沿技术方案的评估与落地路径设计。

lists.content:
• 1. 合规产品规划与管理
  • 负责数字货币交易所合规产品的规划、设计与管理，确保平台产品符合各地法律法规与行业规范。
  • 负责分站产品的规划与管理，协同各区域团队，推动产品本地化与合规适配，满足不同市场的合规要求。
  • 2. 合规政策与法规研究
  • 持续跟踪全球主要市场的数字货币合规政策与法规变化，评估与分析对公司业务的合规风险影响。
  • 根据各国监管要求，协调内部资源，推动合规政策落地及产品调整，确保业务持续合规。
  • 3. 合规性与风控产品设计
  • 设计并优化合规功能模块，如用户身份认证、反洗钱（AML）、了解客户（KYC）等，提升平台合规性与安全性。
  • 开发并完善合规工具与系统，提升合规流程的自动化与审查效率，保障用户数据安全。
  • 4. 跨部门协作与需求管理
  • 与技术、法务、风控、运营等团队紧密协作，平衡合规要求与业务需求，推动合规性优化。
  • 独立撰写合规产品需求文档（PRD），并协调各方资源完成设计、开发与上线。
  • 5. 分站本地化与市场适配

  • 与本地运营及市场团队紧密合作，了解用户需求与市场差异，推动本地化产品开发与落地。
  • 6. 合规性风险评估与监控
  • 参与平台业务的合规风险评估，制定合规性提升计划与应对策略。
  • 监控产品上线后的合规执行情况，确保持续符合各地区监管要求。
  • 7. 合规数据与报告管理
  • 设计与优化合规数据监控与报告系统，确保数据准确及时，为管理层决策提供支持。
  • 定期向管理层汇报合规产品进展、问题与优化建议，提供专业合规支持。

• 本科及以上学历，法律、金融、计算机、国际贸易等相关专业优先。
  • 2年以上互联网产品管理经验，至少1年以上合规或分站产品管理经验。
  • 熟悉数字货币行业，了解交易平台运营合规性要求及相关法规（如AML、KYC、数据保护等）。
  • 具备较强的合规风险意识，能主动识别并解决产品中的合规问题。
  • 熟悉产品全生命周期管理，能独立撰写PRD并推动产品落地。
  • 具备良好的跨部门沟通与协作能力，能与法务、风控、技术、运营团队紧密合作。
  • 英文能力优秀者优先。

jobs.description:
【岗位职责】

一、交易聚合与路由

1.负责 Web3 聚合交易系统的后端架构设计与开发，整合多条公链、多个 DEX 及做市商流动性来源。

2.设计并实现路由算法与最优路径选择策略，平衡价格、滑点、Gas、成交概率等多目标。

3.负责交易构造、签名、广播、状态追踪的完整链路，保障高并发与网络拥堵场景下的稳定性与成功率。

二、询价与做市商接入

1.设计并实现询价（RFQ / Quote）系统，接入链上池子、链下做市商、CEX 等多类报价源。

2.负责做市商接入协议的设计与实现，覆盖报价订阅、更新、成交确认与风控校验。

3.构建报价质量评估与做市商分级机制，动态调整路由权重。

三、高并发与低延迟

1.优化询价、路由、交易链路的端到端延迟与吞吐能力。

2.设计交易风控与限流机制，覆盖滑点保护、价格偏离、重放保护、Gas 异常等场景。

 

【任职要求】

一、技术基础

1.5 年以上后端开发经验，3 年以上 Golang 实战经验，精通并发模型（Goroutine / Channel）、标准库及主流框架（Gin / Go-zero / Gorm）。

2.熟练掌握微服务架构与分布式系统设计（消息队列、分布式锁、熔断限流、幂等设计等）。

3.精通 SQL / NoSQL 数据库优化，熟悉 Redis 缓存设计及 Kafka 异步处理。

具备低延迟、高并发系统的设计与优化经验。

4.至少 3 年 Web3 开发经验，理解区块链基本原理，熟悉交易流程与合约交互机制。

5.熟悉主流公链交互机制，要求熟悉 EVM 与 Solana；熟悉 Sui / Ton 者优先。

熟悉交易构造、签名、广播、Nonce 管理、Gas 策略等链上交易全链路，具备主网交易系统的实战经验。

6.熟悉主流 DEX（Uniswap V2 / V3、Curve、Raydium、Orca 等）的池子模型、价格计算与状态维护。

7.具备聚合器（如 1inch、Jupiter、OKX 等）的实际开发经验，主导或深度参与过路由算法、报价聚合或交易执行链路的设计与落地。

8.主导过中大型后端系统从 0 到 1 的架构设计与落地。

9.具备较强的学习能力，能快速跟进新技术、新公链、新协议，并判断其在业务中的实际价值与落地路径。

二、AI 工程能力

1.日常使用 AI Coding Agent 开发，并有相应工程沉淀。

2.具备搭建 Agent Harness、编写 Skills / Prompts 的实践经验。

3.了解 MCP、Tool Use、RAG、Eval 等概念及其工程落地边界。

 

【加分项】

1.有做市商系统、报价引擎、订单管理（OMS）相关的开发经验。

2.有 MEV、Mempool 监听、Bundle 提交（如 Flashbots、Jito）等相关经验。

3.有跨链桥、跨链交易、Intent-based 交易（CoW、UniswapX、Across 等）相关的开发经验。

4.有围绕 AI Coding 的内部工具、Skill 库、Agent 工作流等沉淀经验。

5.有开源社区贡献或技术博客输出。

4.至少 3 年 Web3 开发经验，理解区块链基本原理，熟悉交易流程与合约交互机制。

5.熟悉主流公链交互机制，要求熟悉 EVM 与 Solana；熟悉 Sui / Ton 者优先。

熟悉交易构造、签名、广播、Nonce 管理、Gas 策略等链上交易全链路，具备主网交易系统的实战经验。

6.熟悉主流 DEX（Uniswap V2 / V3、Curve、Raydium、Orca 等）的池子模型、价格计算与状态维护。

7.具备聚合器（如 1inch、Jupiter、OKX 等）的实际开发经验，主导或深度参与过路由算法、报价聚合或交易执行链路的设计与落地。

8.主导过中大型后端系统从 0 到 1 的架构设计与落地。

9.具备较强的学习能力，能快速跟进新技术、新公链、新协议，并判断其在业务中的实际价值与落地路径。

二、AI 工程能力

1.日常使用 AI Coding Agent 开发，并有相应工程沉淀。

2.具备搭建 Agent Harness、编写 Skills / Prompts 的实践经验。

3.了解 MCP、Tool Use、RAG、Eval 等概念及其工程落地边界。

 

【加分项】

1.有做市商系统、报价引擎、订单管理（OMS）相关的开发经验。

2.有 MEV、Mempool 监听、Bundle 提交（如 Flashbots、Jito）等相关经验。

3.有跨链桥、跨链交易、Intent-based 交易（CoW、UniswapX、Across 等）相关的开发经验。

4.有围绕 AI Coding 的内部工具、Skill 库、Agent 工作流等沉淀经验。

5.有开源社区贡献或技术博客输出。

jobs.description:
【公司简介】

我们是全球最早也是最成熟的数字资产平台之一，服务于全球数千万用户。我们始终位列全球Top交易所之列，提供涵盖数千种数字资产的全面交易和财富管理产品。我们拥有遍布全球主要金融中心的数千名员工，秉持远程优先、高度自主的企业文化，吸引着那些在快节奏、高挑战性环境中蓬勃发展的优秀人才。

 

【岗位职责】

一、行情与实时数据系统

1.负责 Web3 行情系统的后端架构设计与开发，覆盖链上行情、DEX 池子数据、订单簿、成交流、K 线等多类实时数据的采集、清洗、聚合、存储与分发。

2.构建低延迟、高吞吐、可水平扩展的实时计算链路，保障行情数据在高并发场景下的稳定性、一致性与时效性。

3.设计并实现实时数据推送服务（WebSocket / gRPC Streaming 等），支撑前端、策略、交易等下游业务对实时行情的消费需求。

二、链上数据中台建设

1.负责链上数据中台的整体设计与落地，构建从节点接入、区块解析、事件解码到结构化存储的完整数据链路。

2.负责区块、交易、事件日志的解析与解码（Log Decode、Trace 解析、内部交易还原等），将原始链上数据转化为业务可消费的结构化数据。

3.抽象多链数据模型，沉淀通用的解析框架与数据资产，支撑行情、交易、钱包、预测市场等上层业务。

4.构建实时数据监控与报警机制，覆盖节点健康度、数据延迟、数据完整性、解析异常等关键指标。

 

【任职要求】

一、技术基础

1.5 年以上后端开发经验，语言 Java 或 Go 均可，熟悉 Java 者更佳

Java 方向：3 年以上 Java 实战经验，熟悉 JVM 调优、并发编程，掌握 Spring 生态。

Go 方向：3 年以上 Golang 实战经验，精通并发模型（Goroutine / Channel）、标准库及主流框架（Gin / Go-zero / Gorm）。

2.熟练掌握微服务架构与分布式系统设计（消息队列、分布式锁、熔断限流、幂等设计等）。

3.精通 SQL / NoSQL 数据库优化，熟悉 Redis 缓存设计及 Kafka 异步处理。

4.具备实时计算系统的落地经验，熟悉状态管理、背压、容错、Exactly-Once 等机制；使用过 Akka 或 Pekko、Reactor（或 Project Reactor / RxJava）、Redis Stream。

5.至少 3 年 Web3 开发经验，理解区块链基本原理（共识、P2P、Gas / 手续费模型等），熟悉交易流程与合约交互机制。

6.熟悉主流公链交互机制，要求熟悉 EVM 与 Solana；熟悉 Move / Sui 者优先。

7.具备链上数据中台、行情系统或类似数据平台的项目经验，熟悉 Log Decode、ABI 解析、Trace / Internal Tx 处理等，主导过多链数据模型抽象或通用解析框架的建设。

8.主导过中大型后端系统或数据平台从 0 到 1 的架构设计与落地。

具备较强的学习能力，能快速跟进新技术、新公链、新协议，并判断其在业务中的实际价值与落地路径。

二、AI 工程能力

1.日常使用 AI Coding Agent 开发，并有相应工程沉淀。

2.具备搭建 Agent Harness、编写 Skills / Prompts 的实践经验。

3.了解 MCP、Tool Use、RAG、Eval 等概念及其工程落地边界。

 

【加分项】

1.有大数据实时与离线计算经验（Flink、Spark、Storm 等），熟悉 Lambda / Kappa 架构。

2.有 DEX（Uniswap V2 / V3、Curve、Raydium、Orca 等）池子状态维护、价格计算、聚合行情相关经验。

3.有 MEV、Mempool 监听、抢跑保护等相关经验。

4.有时序数据库（如 TimescaleDB、Druid、ClickHouse）在行情场景下的落地经验。

5.有围绕 AI Coding 的内部工具、Skill 库、Agent 工作流等沉淀经验。

6.有开源社区贡献或技术博客输出。

jobs.description:
【岗位职责】

一、钱包账户体系

1.负责钱包账户系统的架构设计与演进，统一管理助记词、私钥、硬件、MPC、托管（Turnkey 等）、机器人钱包、保险箱等多类账户形态。

2.主导异构账户体系的融合与抽象，沉淀统一的账户模型与 Web3 ID 能力，支撑钱包及其他业务方的接入需求。

3.设计对外可接入的钱包能力，对其他业务线开放标准化的账户、签名、交易接口，避免业务方重复自建。

二、钱包核心服务

1.负责钱包核心后端服务的设计与开发，覆盖资产管理、代币列表、交易历史、上链广播、Gas 策略等关键链路。

2.负责大规模钱包数据（账户、资产、交易历史等亿级数据量）的存储设计、查询性能与版本兼容性。

3.负责钱包与中台基础能力（行情、Token、节点 RPC、资产）的集成与解耦，推动公共能力下沉、钱包业务上浮。

三、多链支持与上链

1.负责钱包多链支持的接入与维护，覆盖 EVM、Solana 及其他主流公链。

2.负责交易构造、签名、广播、状态追踪的完整链路，保障在网络拥堵、Nonce 冲突等场景下的稳定性。

 

【任职要求】

一、技术基础

1.5 年以上后端开发经验，3 年以上 Golang 实战经验，精通并发模型（Goroutine / Channel）、标准库及主流框架（Gin / Go-zero / Gorm）。

2.熟练掌握微服务架构与分布式系统设计（消息队列、分布式锁、熔断限流、幂等设计等）。

3.精通 SQL / NoSQL 数据库优化，熟悉 Redis 缓存设计及 Kafka 异步处理；具备亿级数据量场景下的存储设计与查询优化经验。

4.主导过中大型后端系统从 0 到 1 的架构设计与落地，具备账户、订单、资产等核心域的建模经验。

5.至少 3 年 Web3 开发经验，理解区块链基本原理，熟悉交易流程与合约交互机制。

6.熟悉主流公链交互机制，要求熟悉 EVM 与 Solana；熟悉 Move / Sui 者优先。

7.熟悉交易构造、签名、广播、Nonce 管理、Gas 策略等链上交易全链路，具备主网钱包或交易系统的实战经验。

8.具备较强的学习能力，能快速跟进新技术、新公链、新协议，并判断其在业务中的实际价值与落地路径。

二、钱包专项

1.熟悉主流钱包账户体系，包括助记词 / 私钥 / 硬件钱包 / MPC / 托管钱包等的原理与差异，理解各类账户的安全模型与使用场景。

2.具备钱包后端的实际开发经验，主导或深度参与过账户系统、资产模块、交易历史等核心模块的设计与落地。

3.具备多账户体系融合、抽象与对外开放能力建设的经验，或对此方向有清晰的方法论。

三、AI 工程能力

1.日常使用 AI Coding Agent 开发，并有相应工程沉淀。

2.具备搭建 Agent Harness、编写 Skills / Prompts 的实践经验。

3.了解 MCP、Tool Use、RAG、Eval 等概念及其工程落地边界。

 

【加分项】

1.有 MPC / TSS 钱包后端的开发经验，或熟悉 Turnkey、Fireblocks、Privy 等托管钱包方案。

2.有 AA 智能合约钱包（EIP-4337 / EIP-7702、Safe、Biconomy 等）相关的开发经验。

3.有亿级数据量下的数据迁移、版本兼容、双写切换等实战经验。

4.有钱包安全相关经验（密钥管理、签名风控、欺诈检测等）。

5.有围绕 AI Coding 的内部工具、Skill 库、Agent 工作流等沉淀经验。

6.有开源社区贡献或技术博客输出。

工作内容：
 1. 核心系统开发 - 负责Web3产品（如聚合器、数据服务、钱包管理等）的后端架构设计与开发，提升系统高并发、低延迟及稳定性。 - 负责链上数据抓取、解析与结构化存储（支持主流链），构建实时数据监控与报警机制。 - 设计并实现高性能 API（RESTful/gRPC/WebSocket），优化链上链下交互流程（如交易签名、状态追踪）。 2. 智能合约与区块集成 - 开发链下服务与智能合约的交互模块（如调用合约），处理多链事件聚合与交易路由。 - 实现多链数据解析、事件监听及结构化存储，支持链下业务逻辑。 3. 基础设施与性能优化 - 设计微服务架构，利用 Docker/Kubernetes 实现容器化部署，提升系统可扩展性。 - 设计并实现微服务架构，优化数据库（SQL/NoSQL）、缓存（Redis）、消息队列（Kafka）等技术方案，保障系统高可用性。
 
任职要求：
1. 技术基础
- 5年以上后端开发经验，3年以上 Golang 实战经验，精通并发模型（Goroutine/Channel）、标准库及框架（Gin/Go-zero/Gorm）。
- 熟练掌握微服务架构，有分布式系统设计经验（消息队列/Kafka、分布式锁、熔断限流）。
2. 区块专项
- 至少2年 Web3 开发经验，深入理解区块原理及主流链的交互机制。
- 熟悉区块链交易流程和合约交互机制，具备链上数据解析、交易构造等实战经验。
3. 工具链
- 精通 SQL/NoSQL 数据库优化，熟悉 Redis 缓存设计及 Kafka 异步处理。
- 熟练使用 Docker/Kubernetes 部署生产环境，掌握 CI/CD 自动化流程。

jobs.description:
【关于公司】

我们是全球最早、最具规模的数字资产平台之一,服务全球数千万用户。作为全球排名前列的交易所之一,我们提供覆盖数千种数字资产的全套交易和财富管理产品。我们在全球主要金融中心拥有数千名员工,以远程优先、高度自主的文化运作,吸引那些在快节奏、高强度智力环境中成长的人才。我们正在构建下一代互联网的金融基础设施。

 

【为什么需要这个岗位】

Web3 产品团队需要一套能跨链、跨资产、跨钱包、跨交易与安全场景复用的基础设施能力。如果没有统一的产品标准，每条业务线都会重复建设自己的数据模型、资产逻辑、风险标签和 API 层。这个岗位要把复杂的链上与链下能力产品化，支撑钱包、交易、行情和安全等多业务线复用。

你会做什么

  • 制定链上数据、资产、交易、钱包、API、标签和安全模块等 Web3 基础设施产品的策略与架构
  • 搭建标准化 Token 与 NFT 数据体系，覆盖数据结构、字段规范、版本规则、多源币价融合，以及资产、交易、行情 API 输出
  • 定义钱包与交易产品逻辑，包括跨链交易结构、交易语义化展示、资产流转、签名链路和交互体验
  • 规划地址、合约、资产、风险和行为标签体系，沉淀聪明钱、风险地址、狙击手、可疑钱包和异常交易模式等能力
  • 产品化 DApp、合约、地址、授权、黑名单和风险 URL 安全能力，并接入第三方安全能力
  • 推动 Solana、EVM、BTC、Layer2 等生态的标准化接入与中台能力交付

 

【你需要具备什么】

Non-negotiables

  • 你交付过 Web3、数据平台、API、钱包、交易或基础设施产品，并被多条业务线真实依赖
  • 你理解链上资产、交易行为、协议机制、钱包流程和风险场景，能抽象出可复用的产品逻辑
  • 你能清楚定义数据字段、API 行为、标签规则、权限流程、异常场景、版本治理和多链差异
  • 你能推动产品、研发、数据、安全和运营团队完成架构取舍、交付推进、上线验证和效果复盘

Bonus

  • 你做过钱包、DEX 或交易产品、风控、安全审计、链上分析或区块链浏览器产品
  • 你熟悉 EVM、Solana、Cosmos、Aptos、BTC、Layer2 或其他主流链生态
  • 你能判断账户抽象、跨链基础设施、Layer2、链上安全等趋势，并转化为可落地的产品方向

jobs.description:
【岗位职责】
1、全面负责专业交易平台的产品规划、路线图设计、版本迭代和落地质量。
2、深入研究专业交易员、资深交易用户及机构/半机构用户的交易流程，抽象核心需求并转化为产品方案。
3、负责专业 K 线、行情展示、下单面板、订单管理、持仓管理、选择交易、多腿交易等核心模块设计。
4、对标主流专业版及传统金融交易终端，持续提升产品专业度和易用性。
5、与研发、设计、交易系统、风控、运营等团队协作，推动复杂交易场景高质量交付。
6、建立并跟踪产品指标，关注专业用户留存、交易转化、使用深度、交易效率和用户满意度。
6、对交易链路的效率、安全感、稳定性、信息密度和专业用户体验负责，持续打磨产品细节。

【任职要求】
1、5 年以上产品经验，有专业交易终端、行情软件、券商、期货、外汇、衍生品、金融交易平台等相关产品经验。
2、具备较深交易理解，熟悉专业交易用户的实际工作流，包括看盘、分析、下单、盯仓、止盈止损、订单管理等场景。
3、熟悉 K 线、盘口、订单簿、限价单、市价单、条件单、止盈止损、持仓、成交、资金等基础交易能力。
4、有复杂 Web 工具型产品经验，能处理高信息密度、高交互频率、高稳定性要求的产品场景。
5、具备较强产品判断力，能够识别专业用户真实痛点，而不是简单复制竞品功能。
6、具备产品负责人意识，能独立制定方向、拆解路径、推动跨团队协作，并对最终产品结果负责。
7、具备优秀的 PRD、交互方案、需求优先级判断、AI使用能力和项目推进能力。

【加分项】
1、做过聚合交易、跨所交易、多腿交易、策略交易、专业 K 线、行情系统或量化辅助工具。
2、自己有股票、期货、外汇、期权或其他衍生品交易经验，深度使用各类交易终端产品
3、有国际化交易产品经验，理解不同市场交易用户的使用习惯。
4、对交易系统、撮合、风控、行情延迟、订单状态流转等底层机制有一定理解。

jobs.description:
【关于公司】

我们是全球最早、最具规模的数字资产平台之一,服务全球数千万用户。作为全球排名前列的交易所之一,我们提供覆盖数千种数字资产的全套交易和财富管理产品。我们在全球主要金融中心拥有数千名员工,以远程优先、高度自主的文化运作,吸引那些在快节奏、高强度智力环境中成长的人才。我们正在构建下一代互联网的金融基础设施。

 

【为什么需要这个岗位】

证券交易产品对细节要求很高：订单逻辑、费用、交易时段、资产、融资融券和风险提示中任何一个断点，都可能变成用户困惑或线上风险。这个岗位要设计稳定、清晰、易用的美股及相关交易产品体验，覆盖股票、ETF、期权、行情、账户资产、订单管理、风控和交易工具。你会把市场规则、用户需求、合规约束和项目交付整合成一条清晰的产品路线。未来 12-24 个月，你需要交付能提升转化、留存、交易效率和用户信任的核心交易模块。

 

【你会做什么】

  • 规划并设计交易产品模块，覆盖股票、ETF、期权、融资融券、行情、账户资产、订单管理、风控和交易工具。
  • 将市场规则转化为产品逻辑，包括订单类型、交易时段、撮合行为、费用结构、公司行动、持仓、资产和异常流程。
  • 输出严谨的 PRD、交互流程、原型、字段逻辑、计算公式、风控规则、后台配置逻辑和上线验收标准。
  • 面向新手投资者、活跃交易用户和专业投资者，优化下单、资产展示、风险提示和交易后复盘体验。
  • 基于市场研究、竞品分析、用户反馈和数据表现，形成产品路线与优先级判断，提升交易效率和产品竞争力。
  • 安全使用 AI 工具完成竞品研究、需求梳理、PRD 撰写、原型构思、数据分析和金融产品机会发现。

 

【你需要带来什么】

Non-negotiables

  • 你交付过生产级金融交易产品，并完整经历过调研、设计、上线、复盘和持续迭代。
  • 你理解美股交易逻辑，覆盖股票、ETF、期权、融资融券、订单类型、持仓、资产、费用、行情、风控和交易时段。
  • 你能把复杂交易场景设计清楚，包括字段定义、计算逻辑、异常处理、风险提示和后台配置。
  • 你能推动研发、设计、测试、运营、合规、风控、客服和市场团队达成共识，并清楚说明方案取舍。
  • 你能有边界地使用 AI 工具，理解信息安全、数据隐私、合规限制、输出验证和二次加工的重要性。

Bonus

  • 你能用英语参与会议、邮件沟通、需求文档或竞品材料撰写。
  • 你熟悉港股市场、跨境投资、互联网券商产品，或证券、基金等金融资格体系。
  • 你探索过 AI 在用户教育、智能客服、投研辅助、交易提醒、风控提示或运营提效中的产品落地。

证券交易产品对细节要求很高：订单逻辑、费用、交易时段、资产、融资融券和风险提示中任何一个断点，都可能变成用户困惑或线上风险。这个岗位要设计稳定、清晰、易用的美股及相关交易产品体验，覆盖股票、ETF、期权、行情、账户资产、订单管理、风控和交易工具。你会把市场规则、用户需求、合规约束和项目交付整合成一条清晰的产品路线。未来 12-24 个月，你需要交付能提升转化、留存、交易效率和用户信任的核心交易模块。

 

【你会做什么】

  • 规划并设计交易产品模块，覆盖股票、ETF、期权、融资融券、行情、账户资产、订单管理、风控和交易工具。
  • 将市场规则转化为产品逻辑，包括订单类型、交易时段、撮合行为、费用结构、公司行动、持仓、资产和异常流程。
  • 输出严谨的 PRD、交互流程、原型、字段逻辑、计算公式、风控规则、后台配置逻辑和上线验收标准。
  • 面向新手投资者、活跃交易用户和专业投资者，优化下单、资产展示、风险提示和交易后复盘体验。
  • 基于市场研究、竞品分析、用户反馈和数据表现，形成产品路线与优先级判断，提升交易效率和产品竞争力。
  • 安全使用 AI 工具完成竞品研究、需求梳理、PRD 撰写、原型构思、数据分析和金融产品机会发现。

 

【你需要带来什么】

Non-negotiables

  • 你交付过生产级金融交易产品，并完整经历过调研、设计、上线、复盘和持续迭代。
  • 你理解美股交易逻辑，覆盖股票、ETF、期权、融资融券、订单类型、持仓、资产、费用、行情、风控和交易时段。
  • 你能把复杂交易场景设计清楚，包括字段定义、计算逻辑、异常处理、风险提示和后台配置。
  • 你能推动研发、设计、测试、运营、合规、风控、客服和市场团队达成共识，并清楚说明方案取舍。
  • 你能有边界地使用 AI 工具，理解信息安全、数据隐私、合规限制、输出验证和二次加工的重要性。

Bonus

  • 你能用英语参与会议、邮件沟通、需求文档或竞品材料撰写。
  • 你熟悉港股市场、跨境投资、互联网券商产品，或证券、基金等金融资格体系。
  • 你探索过 AI 在用户教育、智能客服、投研辅助、交易提醒、风控提示或运营提效中的产品落地。

关于这个方向
这块业务覆盖合约跟单、CFD 跟单、美股实盘跟单，以及现货网格、马丁策略、期限套利等机器人业务，同时正在探索 AI 对话策略方向。这不是一个维护功能列表的岗位。我们需要一个真正理解交易行为、能在产品复杂度和用户理解之间找到平衡点的人。

你会负责什么
1、深入研究新手、进阶、和专业用户如何在跟单、机器人和自建策略之间做选择，并将洞察转化为产品决策
2、与工程、量化研究、AI、风控、设计、运营等团队协同，澄清需求取舍，持续推动产品高质量上线
3、持续追踪跟单交易、量化工具和 AI 投资类产品的前沿动态，形成自己的判断，而不是机械复制功能
4、围绕量化策略方向，推动经典机器人策略优化、策略参数可理解性设计、AI 策略探索、策略表现与归因展示等功能落地
5、围绕跟单交易方向，优化交易员发现与信任体系、跟单配置与风控体验、多品类跟单建设、仓位透明度与信任信号设计

我们希望你具备
1、对交易行为和金融产品有真实兴趣，进入复杂领域时能快速找到核心逻辑，而不是停留在表面功能
2、有较强的独立驱动力；需求不清晰时，你会主动定义目标、厘清路径，而不是等待被推动
3、能理解风险决策场景下的用户心理：为什么用户会选择某个交易员、中途关掉机器人、调整参数或彻底失去信任
4、有清晰的产品判断力：一个跟单界面或策略配置页面有没有把复杂信息讲清楚、风险展示是否会造成误导，你能看出来
5、具备良好的跨职能沟通能力，能在技术、量化研究、风控和业务之间建立共识，而不只是在中间传话

加分项
1、有跟单交易、社交交易（Social Trading）、交易机器人或量化平台类产品的完整项目经验
2、对跟单或量化策略其中一个方向的交易工具有浓厚兴趣，是主流平台产品的重度用户
3、有 AI 产品方向的思考或经验，理解自然语言交互如何与专业金融工具结合
4、有用户研究、数据分析或 A/B 实验经验，能将行为数据转化为产品洞察

【公司简介】

我们是全球最早也是最成熟的数字资产平台之一，服务于全球数千万用户。我们始终位列全球Top交易所之列，提供涵盖数千种数字资产的全面交易和财富管理产品。我们拥有遍布全球主要金融中心的数千名员工，秉持远程优先、高度自主的企业文化，吸引着那些在快节奏、高挑战性环境中蓬勃发展的优秀人才。

 

【岗位职责】

1、核心研发：研发和优化核心交易组件，包括撮合模块、订单处理、订单簿数据结构和低延迟服务链路。

2、高并发与性能调优：深入代码逻辑、内存管理、并发模型（线程/协程）、网络 IO 及操作系统行为，攻克高吞吐与极低延迟场景下的性能瓶颈。

3、高可用与稳定性：落地与完善高可用机制，保障系统在极端行情、硬件故障下的故障切换、恢复、降级及业务连续性。

4、提升工程质量，完善测试、可观测性、日志、指标、链路追踪、文档和故障复盘机制。

 

【任职要求】

1、5 年以上后端经验（技术栈不限），且近几年专注于高并发高可用的核心系统

2、精通 Linux 网络编程（Socket、TCP/IP或异步 IO 模型），深入理解多线程/多进程/协程并发编程与内存模型

3、能精准定位并解决内存布局/垃圾回收（GC）、CPU Cache、网络路径及系统限制带来的性能瓶颈

4、在突发故障或极端行情高压下保持冷静，具备严谨的排障思路、谨慎的发布习惯与完善的可观测性意识

 

【加分项】

1、业务背景：有撮合引擎、订单簿、行情系统、券商系统、高频交易（HFT）开发经验

1、熟悉无锁（Lock-Free）结构、NUMA 架构、用户态网络栈（DPDK/Kernel Bypass）或硬件加速。

我们拥有遍布全球主要金融中心的数千名员工，秉持远程优先、高度自主的企业文化，吸引着那些在快节奏、高挑战性环境中蓬勃发展的优秀人才。
 
目前我们希望重构核心撮合引擎，正在寻找杰出的专业人士加入我们，我们希望你是（其中之一）：
1、大厂中负责高性能，高并发系统的
2、传统金融负责高频交易系统的（HFT 做市商、衍生品交易所、清算系统）
3、Crypto顶级交易所负责撮合引擎和高并发优化的

lists.content:
• 主导新一代撮合引擎的架构设计与落地：从撮合模型、订单簿数据结构到内存管理与无锁并发，全程负责最高技术决策，对系统核心性能指标直接担责。
  • 建立延迟与吞吐的极致工程标准：定义并量化 TPS、P99/P999 延迟等核心指标，通过技术手段驱动团队持续逼近物理极限，打破性能天花板。
  • 构建高可用灾备与全链路故障恢复机制：设计多活架构与业务连续性方案，确保系统在极端行情冲击、硬件损坏或网络分区等极端场景下实现“零中断”。
  • 搭建并领航一流工程团队：输出顶级的工程师文化，通过技术深度与工程方法论带动团队整体维度的能力升级。

• 对微、纳秒级延迟有近乎偏执的执念：你不会满足于“足够快”，而是会主动深挖 CPU 缓存行、网络协议栈底层及内核细节，寻找每一处可压榨的空间。
  • 极端压力下的系统性思维者：在行情剧烈波动的毫秒级战场上，能冷静进行架构取舍与指挥协调，而非陷入被动的“救火模式”。
  • 理论与实战的高度统一：既具备从零推演最优撮合模型的理论功底，也深谙真实生产环境下的工程约束，能在理想与现实间做出精妙的平衡。
  • 追求卓越的参照系：见过世界顶级系统的样子，对“行业最佳”有清晰的定义，并拥有缩小差距的实战方法论。

jobs.description:
岗位描述
1、负责核心交易产品的风控模型与策略体系建设，覆盖事前预警、事中拦截、事后分析全链路
2、针对交易场景设计并迭代风控策略，利用高频数据识别并实时对抗价格操纵、洗单、虚假挂单、跨市场套利滥用等异常交易行为
3、基于订单簿数据、成交流水、用户持仓、资金划转等多维交易数据，进行特征工程与变量挖掘，构建交易行为风险画像
4、参与保证金风控模型建设，包括强平模型优化、爆仓预警阈值优化、穿仓风险控制等保证金风控核心模块
5、运用图计算与社区发现算法，识别协同操盘团伙、关联账户刷量等群体，结合链上资金追踪形成完整风险闭环
6、建立交易风控指标监控体系，持续跟踪市场异常信号，输出可解释的风险评估结论，支撑业务与合规决策
7、探索 AI/LLM 技术在交易风控场景的落地应用，如异常订单行为智能检测、策略规则自动推荐、风险事件归因分析

 任职要求

jobs.description:
这个职位为何存在？
随着平台全景化业务的快速扩张，多语言文本、图片等场景下的欺诈引流、黑灰、产对抗形式日益严峻。该职位旨在建立一道坚固的交易所社交内容安全防线。
 
 解决什么问题： 
解决多语种多产品线生态下，传统风控手段对复杂欺诈变体、多模态（图文结合）违规行为（特别是引流）识别率低、对抗滞后的问题。补全目前风控团队缺失的内容风控能力板块，赋能交易所核心业务。
 
 为什么现在需要它：
 目前不法用户通过平台提供的社交功能大肆散播引流、欺诈图文，已经严重负面影响到C2C、代理、增长等核心业务，且风控团队内部暂时缺少内容风控领域人才和技术储备，急需有内容对抗经验的专家进来建设体系化的内容治理能力。
 
 核心职责（3-5条）
1、构建全球多语言、多场景下的内容安全策略矩阵，针对欺诈、引流等违规行为搭建事前防御、事中监控、事后治理的全链路体系。
2、主导黑词库、黑图库等风控基础设施建设，推进文本与图片融合的多模态内容安全识别体系落地。
3、驱动多语言NLP模型及多模态融合模型的应用与高频迭代，深度联动算法团队，将前沿AI/Agent技术转化为实际的风控生产力。
4、建立可量化的内容安全效果评估体系，对风控核心指标进行深度拆解与数据漏斗分析，确保策略的精准度与召回率。
 
理想候选人是什么样的？
1、具备敏锐的嗅觉与死磕到底的对抗精神： 对海内外社交生态中的违规变体有天然的警惕性，享受与黑灰、产博弈的过程，能从微弱的异常数据中揪出系统性风险。
2、拥有自驱型的“破局者”思维： 不满足于现成规则，面对小语种对抗等模糊、复杂的场景，能够主动拥抱AI Agent等新工具，自发寻找技术边界来拆解难题。
3、具备出色的跨界协同力： 既懂业务策略又能与研发“讲同一种语言”，能平衡风控效果与业务打扰
 
 吸引人的亮点
1、真正的全景化视野与前沿AI实战场景： 你将直接操盘头部交易所的核心安全命脉，亲手将经典内容风控体系、AI Agent及多模态大模型推向千万级用户的实战对抗一线，并带来可量化的业务价值，而非做单纯的规则修补。
2、从0到1构建内容风控体系的绝对主导权： 团队氛围自驱且技术自豪感，你将主导多模态体系与核心库的搭建，你的每一个策略都将直接定义产品的安全边界。 开放的行业/背景 国际化互联网平台（出海社交/Live/社区）、跨境电商、交易所、反欺诈/内容安全服务商。

jobs.description:
岗位职责：

区块核心模块设计与开发

系统维护及性能优化

跟进行业技术发展动态，并进行落地应用

 

任职要求

1.计算机相关专业，本科及以上学历，至少5年以上开发经验，拥有区块链底层开发经验。

2.编程语言：精通Go，Rust(必选项）

3.操作系统与网络：熟悉 Linux 系统编程、进程线程、网络 IO；掌握 P2P 网络协议（libp2p、Kademlia）、Gossip 传播机制，能实现高并发网络服务。

4.共识机制：理解 PoW、PoS、PBFT、HotStuff 等，掌握拜占庭容错与一致性原理。

5.公连知识：熟悉CosmosSDK相关原理和代码。加分项：熟悉公连的相关原理与代码。

6.密码学：精通Keccak，（ECDSA、EdDSA、BLS），（secp256k1）；（zkSNARK、zkSTARK)。

7.数据结构与存储：区块与交易结构，Merkle Tree、Patricia Trie、Verkle Tree；掌握 LevelDB/RocksDB 用于状态存储、快照与裁剪。

8.虚拟机与执行环境：理解 EVM 工作原理、Gas 模型及安全性；加分项：了解SVM和WASM。

9.工程与工具：熟悉 Docker/K8s 部署测试网络，掌握 CI/CD 与性能调优工具（perf、pprof）。

10.进阶方向：Layer2（Rollup、状态通道）、跨链协议（IBC、XCMP）、数据可用性（Celestia）、隐私技术（ZKP 电路设计）。

11. 加分项：精通SubStrate框架

jobs.descriptionPlain:
【岗位定位】
1、公司已经建立较完善的数据仓库和实时数据体系，具备数据采集、计算、存储及服务能力。随着业务规模增长和实时应用场景增加，我们希望引入两名中高级数据开发工程师，负责实时数据需求交付、任务优化及工程治理。
2、该岗位以实时数据开发为主，同时参与离线数仓建设。你将重点解决实时链路中的数据延迟、状态膨胀、资源消耗、数据质量及一致性等问题，推动实时数据体系向更稳定、更高效、更规范的方向演进。
【岗位职责】
1、负责实时数据需求的分析、方案设计和开发交付，基于Flink、Kafka等技术建设实时数据处理链路，为实时分析、监控、指标及业务决策等场景提供数据支持。
2、参与实时数仓建设及模型设计，结合业务需求完成数据分层、指标口径、维度模型和数据服务的设计与落地。
3、持续优化现有实时任务，解决数据延迟、反压、Checkpoint异常、状态膨胀、资源利用率不合理及数据不一致等问题，提升任务稳定性和计算效率。
4、参与数据治理和工程质量建设，包括任务依赖梳理、元数据管理、数据质量监控、告警机制、开发规范及问题排查体系建设。
5、参与大数据平台及计算引擎的日常维护和问题处理，协同上下游团队保障数据链路的稳定性、准确性和时效性。
6、沉淀实时开发最佳实践和技术经验，通过技术分享、代码评审及方案评审，提升团队整体实时研发能力。
【任职要求】
1、本科及以上学历，计算机、软件工程、信息技术或相关专业，具有5年及以上数据开发或大数据研发经验；能力优秀者可适当放宽。
2、具备完整的数据仓库项目经验，熟悉实时数仓架构、数据分层和数据模型设计，能够将业务需求转化为数据模型及技术方案。
3、熟练掌握Flink，具有Flink SQL、DataStream API等实际项目经验，理解State、Checkpoint、Watermark、窗口、反压和容错机制。
4、具备实时任务开发及优化经验，能够独立分析和解决任务延迟、资源消耗较高、状态异常、数据倾斜及数据一致性等问题。
