lists.content:
攻坚高性能组件开发：负责撮合逻辑、高精度风控或高速分发行路经的代码实现，压榨每一比特的计算效率。
全链路可观测性建设：将文档与可观测性视为“一等公民”，通过精细的指标监控发现潜在的性能衰减，预防由于微小扰动导致的系统抖动。
参与系统重构与逻辑优化：针对现有架构的瓶颈点进行定向爆破，持续优化内存布局、降低 Context Switch，提升单机吞吐极限。
输出高质量的代码和清晰的设计文档——让每一段实现都经得起code review和时间的考验

• 深耕底层设施的“技术极客”：对低延迟有执念，也懂权衡——知道什么时候该用无锁队列，什么时候该用读锁，也愿意为了一点点性能去抠汇编或者调内核参数
  • 对技术文档有严苛要求：认为清晰的代码逻辑与详尽的技术设计方案是高质量工程的基础，具备极强的代码审美。
  • 自驱且敏锐：对数据和系统指标有天然的敏感度，能主动预判技术风险，而非被动应付 Bug。

我们是全球最早也是最成熟的数字资产平台之一，服务于全球数千万用户。我们始终位列全球Top交易所之列，提供涵盖数千种数字资产的全面交易和财富管理产品。我们拥有遍布全球主要金融中心的数千名员工，秉持远程优先、高度自主的企业文化，吸引着那些在快节奏、高挑战性环境中蓬勃发展的优秀人才。

一、为什么需要这个岗位：
核心业务迭代速度正在提升，测试不能再只是发布前的最后一道检查。我们需要一位测试负责人，把功能、性能、安全、兼容、自动化测试整合成一套可运行、可衡量、可复制的质量体系。这个岗位要降低重大上线风险，提升研发交付确定性，并为全球化加密业务建立长期质量标准。

二、你会做什么：
1、制定核心业务测试策略，明确发布准入、风险覆盖、缺陷标准与质量结果指标
2、搭建并持续演进自动化测试框架，把覆盖率、回归效率与 CI/CD 可靠性连接到真实发布风险
3、设计测试团队组织结构，覆盖梯队建设、目标管理、绩效评估、继任规划与人才培养
4、推动测试更早融入产品、研发与安全流程，在上线前识别并关闭关键风险
5、评估新型测试工具、安全测试方法与行业实践，将有效方法沉淀为可复用标准

三、你需要具备什么
（一）必备项：
1、你带过高规模互联网或 Web3 产品的质量工程体系，理解故障对用户、资产与安全的真实影响
2、你能设计完整测试体系，覆盖功能、性能、安全、兼容与自动化，而不只是管理执行进度
3、你建设过大型测试团队，能清晰设计层级、目标、考核机制与人才成长路径
4、你能与研发、产品、安全负责人平等讨论取舍，在关键决策前把质量风险讲清楚
（二）加分项
1、你在测试、质量工程、安全测试或 Web3 工程社区具备一定行业影响力
2、你搭建过被多个团队长期采用的自动化测试框架
3、你参与过行业标准、开源测试工具或安全测试相关实践

核心业务迭代速度正在提升，测试不能再只是发布前的最后一道检查。我们需要一位测试负责人，把功能、性能、安全、兼容、自动化测试整合成一套可运行、可衡量、可复制的质量体系。这个岗位要降低重大上线风险，提升研发交付确定性，并为全球化加密业务建立长期质量标准。

二、你会做什么：
1、制定核心业务测试策略，明确发布准入、风险覆盖、缺陷标准与质量结果指标
2、搭建并持续演进自动化测试框架，把覆盖率、回归效率与 CI/CD 可靠性连接到真实发布风险
3、设计测试团队组织结构，覆盖梯队建设、目标管理、绩效评估、继任规划与人才培养
4、推动测试更早融入产品、研发与安全流程，在上线前识别并关闭关键风险
5、评估新型测试工具、安全测试方法与行业实践，将有效方法沉淀为可复用标准

三、你需要具备什么
（一）必备项：
1、你带过高规模互联网或 Web3 产品的质量工程体系，理解故障对用户、资产与安全的真实影响
2、你能设计完整测试体系，覆盖功能、性能、安全、兼容与自动化，而不只是管理执行进度
3、你建设过大型测试团队，能清晰设计层级、目标、考核机制与人才成长路径
4、你能与研发、产品、安全负责人平等讨论取舍，在关键决策前把质量风险讲清楚
（二）加分项
1、你在测试、质量工程、安全测试或 Web3 工程社区具备一定行业影响力
2、你搭建过被多个团队长期采用的自动化测试框架
3、你参与过行业标准、开源测试工具或安全测试相关实践

jobs.description:
【关于公司】
我们是全球最早、最具规模的数字资产平台之一,服务全球数千万用户。作为全球排名前列的交易所之一,我们提供覆盖数千种数字资产的全套交易和财富管理产品。我们在全球主要金融中心拥有数千名员工,以远程优先、高度自主的文化运作,吸引那些在快节奏、高强度智力环境中成长的人才。我们正在构建下一代互联网的金融基础设施。

【为什么是这个岗位】
交易平台不能只靠交易工具赢得用户注意力。下一层增长来自内容、关系、社区信任，以及用户在股票、港美股、虚拟货币和 Web3 场景中的社交决策。你将主导社交产品线从早期规模走向成熟体系，把社区行为转化为拉新、日活、留存、内容消费时长和交易转化。未来 12-24 个月，你要留下一个有差异化的社交产品矩阵、一套更清晰的增长引擎，以及一支能够持续迭代的产品团队。

【你要做什么】

  • 制定社交产品战略、定位、阶段目标和产品矩阵，覆盖主流资产交易用户与 Web3 场景
  • 推动产品从洞察、设计到上线迭代，覆盖图文社区、用户关系、群组互动、内容分发、直播和社交交易
  • 建立社交渗透率、日活、留存率、内容消费时长、创作者活跃和交易转化等指标体系，并用数据决定优先级
  • 从用户研究、竞品判断和行为数据中识别真实需求，转化为提升活跃、粘性和信任的产品决策
  • 搭建产品团队的目标、节奏和跨部门协作机制，连接增长、运营、内容、KOL、合规、安全和研发
  • 在产品设计阶段纳入内容安全、隐私保护、数据安全和行业合规要求，避免规模化之后补漏洞

【你需要带来什么】

Non-negotiables

  • 你完整主导过社交、社区、内容分发或增长产品，从策略制定到上线迭代，并拿到可衡量结果
  • 你理解交易用户如何建立判断、追踪信号、消费内容、与他人互动，并把信任转化为行动
  • 你能在用户反馈、市场变化、竞品动作、数据模式和业务目标之间提炼清晰产品方向
  • 你带过小型产品团队，能建立协作规则，并把内容安全、隐私保护、数据安全和合规要求放进产品决策

Bonus

  • 你做过金融科技社区、券商 App、交易平台、虚拟货币交易所、Web3 生态或社交交易产品
  • 你熟悉内容推流、创作者生态、社区机制、群组互动、直播内容或内容驱动增长

 

【招聘经理寄语】
我们寻找的不是一个只会做社区功能的人，而是一个真正理解内容、关系与交易如何相互驱动的产品领导者。这个岗位需要你既能看见长期趋势，也能把复杂问题拆成可落地的产品路径。我们希望你能和团队一起，打造一个不只是让用户交易，更让用户愿意停留、互动、分享和建立信任的平台。

jobs.title: Head of Marketing
jobs.descriptionHtml:
At Improbable, we build and scale ambitious AI and Web3 ventures shaping the next generation of the internet.

We’re hiring for a venture building a next-generation blockchain for real-time, large-scale applications. Designed to overcome the speed and cost limitations of traditional blockchain infrastructure, the technology is fast, cost-efficient and fully EVM-compatible, enabling developers, creators and communities to build immersive products with greater ownership and interoperability.

The ecosystem includes a first-party DEX, a prediction markets protocol and several upcoming products.

About the role

We are looking for a Head of Marketing to turn this technology and product portfolio into adoption, volume and a recognised market position.

This is the venture’s most senior marketing role. You will report to the CEO, join the leadership team and own marketing across the Layer 1 and the products built on it.

You will build a product-led marketing engine that can repeatedly take technical products to market, acquire users and turn launches into sustained growth.

This is a player-coach role. You will set the strategy, build and lead the team, and remain close enough to the work to sharpen positioning, challenge campaigns and lead important launches yourself.

What you'll be doing

  • Own the marketing and growth strategy: Set the priorities, targets and operating model across the Layer 1, first-party DEX, prediction markets protocol and future products.

  • Drive product adoption: Build measurable acquisition, activation and retention programmes for traders, developers, partners and the wider Web3 market.

  • Lead positioning and launches: Define the venture’s narrative and create clear positioning and go-to-market plans for each product.

  • Build a high-performing function: Shape the team, establish clear accountability and keep internal and external specialists focused on product and commercial outcomes.

What we are looking for

You are a product and growth-focused marketing leader who has worked successfully across both Web2 financial products and Web3.

You understand the structured, data-led approach to marketing found in fintech or traditional finance. You have also applied that experience within a Web3 environment such as a DeFi, DEX, Layer 1 or Layer 2.

  • Senior marketing leadership experience across both Web2 and Web3

  • End-to-end ownership of positioning, go-to-market and growth

  • Evidence of increasing users, trading volume, revenue or market share

  • A strong understanding of acquisition, activation and retention

  • Experience leading teams while remaining hands-on

  • The ability to use data to prioritise decisions and measure results

If you have built and scaled marketing across both Web2 financial products and Web3, and want to shape how a next-generation blockchain ecosystem goes to market, we’d like to hear from you.

Improbable Candidate Privacy Policy

jobs.title: Product Marketing Manager, DEX
jobs.descriptionHtml:
At Improbable, we build and scale ambitious AI and Web3 ventures shaping the next generation of the internet.

We’re hiring for a venture building a next-generation blockchain for real-time, large-scale applications, designed to overcome the speed and cost limitations of traditional blockchain infrastructure. The technology is fast, cost-efficient and fully EVM-compatible, enabling developers, creators and communities to build immersive products with greater ownership and interoperability.

About the role

We’re hiring a Product Marketing Manager to shape how a decentralised exchange (DEX) shows up in the world.

This is a hands-on role for someone who understands onchain trading and its audiences deeply, from alpha groups and trading communities to professional traders, and can turn that understanding into messaging that resonates with them. You’ll work closely with Product and the Head of Marketing to shape positioning, growth and how the product is talked about in the market.

What you’ll be doing

You’ll shape the positioning, launches and market story that help the product stand out.

  • Own positioning and messaging across core audiences, including alpha groups, trading communities and professional traders

  • Craft a clear differentiation story grounded in the product’s strengths as well as simplify a technical product narrative so it makes sense to both experienced traders and people coming onchain for the first time

  • Lead go-to-market activity for launches, product capabilities and ecosystem features, from brief through to post-launch measurement

  • Act as the team’s expert on the onchain derivatives and trading landscape, including trends, trader insights and market takeaways

  • Turn market intelligence into positioning, product recommendations and growth tactics

  • Support adoption and retention through tactics such as community leaderboards, yield-based rebates and referral mechanics

What we’re looking for

  • Solid experience in product marketing or a related role, including meaningful hands-on experience in Web3, consumer fintech or trading products

  • Experience with retail trading products or exchanges (DEX or CEX), and a genuine understanding of how order books and derivatives or perps work

  • A track record of leading product launches end to end, with measurable results

  • Proven ability to own positioning and messaging for a product or protocol and execute go-to-market campaigns across channels

  • Strong grasp of crypto-native culture and communities, including X, Discord and Web3 platforms

  • Highly analytical, comfortable defining and tracking growth, retention and adoption metrics

  • Comfortable operating hands-on in a fast-moving environment with significant ownership

Apply if you want to help shape how a decentralised exchange is positioned, launched and adopted.

jobs.title: Product Marketing Manager, Prediction Markets
jobs.descriptionHtml:
At Improbable, we build and scale ambitious AI and Web3 ventures shaping the next generation of the internet.

We’re hiring for a venture building a next-generation blockchain for real-time, large-scale applications, designed to overcome the speed and cost limitations of traditional blockchain infrastructure. The technology is fast, cost-efficient and fully EVM-compatible, enabling developers, creators and communities to build immersive products with greater ownership and interoperability.

About the role

We’re hiring a Web3 Product Marketing Manager to shape how a prediction protocol built for real-time markets shows up in the world. You’ll sit at the centre of product, growth, comms and community, turning a technically ambitious product into a story that traders, builders and partners can quickly understand.

This is a hands-on role for someone who likes building from scratch. You’ll own the narrative, lead launches, and run the experiments that help turn a prediction protocol into a category-defining product. The team is small, decisions are fast, and the work gets into market quickly.

What you’ll be doing

  • You’ll shape the positioning, launches and growth activity that help a prediction protocol stand out and gain traction.

  • Own the positioning and messaging for the prediction protocol end to end, including what it is, who it’s for, why it matters and what makes it different

  • Turn complex product strengths into clear, credible narratives for traders, builders and partners

  • Lead go-to-market for major launches, product milestones, partner activations and incentive-led moments

  • Define and run the marketing roadmap in partnership with product and community leads, making sure launches, campaigns and content build on each other

  • Grow the audience through always-on programmes that expand the qualified builder base

  • Run customer and market research with traders, builders and KOLs, and feed those insights back into product, pricing and creative

  • Brief and create content that earns attention in Web3, from launch threads and research-led content to explainer assets, dashboards, KOL kits and conference materials

  • Partner with comms on press, podcasts and thought leadership that reach the audiences that matter most

What we’re looking for

  • Strong experience in product marketing or a closely related role, including hands-on prediction markets/protocol experience

  • Strong understanding of crypto products and onchain user experience, with enough fluency to market credibly to Web3-native audiences

  • A track record of owning launches end to end, from initial positioning through to measurable post-launch impact

  • Strong narrative instincts and the ability to turn complex product detail into clear, compelling messaging

  • Confidence working with data and using performance insights to shape campaigns and priorities

  • A hands-on, operator mindset with a bias towards shipping and a high tolerance for ambiguity

Apply if you want to help shape how a new prediction protocol is positioned, launched and adopted.

 
 
 

Improbable Candidate Privacy Policy

The technology is fast, cost-efficient and fully EVM-compatible, enabling developers, creators and communities to build immersive products with greater ownership and interoperability.

The team is building a high-performance decentralised exchange designed to give traders fast, reliable and fair execution.

The product is live. Now we need a Product Engineer to take it to the next level.

About the role

You will own the frontend product experience for the DEX, shaping how it looks, feels and performs for traders.

This is not a narrow frontend engineering role. You will have significant influence over product decisions, user experience and the direction of future products.

You may be a founding engineer, an early product engineer or someone who has helped build a trading product from the ground up.

What matters is that you have owned real product decisions, shipped complex systems and understand what traders expect from the products they use.

What you’ll do

  • Define and own the frontend product vision for the DEX.

  • Build fast, responsive and intuitive trading experiences.

  • Turn designs and product ideas into reliable, high-quality features.

  • Manage high-impact projects from early concept through to launch.

  • Make thoughtful decisions about architecture, performance and scalability.

  • Prototype quickly, validate ideas and strengthen the features that prove valuable.

  • Work closely with engineering, design and commercial teams to improve user and business outcomes.

What we’re looking for

  • Proven experience building or scaling a DEX, trading platform or trading product.

  • Strong experience with JavaScript or TypeScript, React and Next.js.

  • A strong understanding of frontend performance, accessibility and user experience.

  • A product-builder mindset with strong ownership and self-direction.

  • The ability to make sound decisions with incomplete information.

  • Comfortable working with urgency in an early-stage, ambitious team.

If you have built trading products and want to help create a faster, fairer DEX, apply.

jobs.title: Senior Mechanical Engineer - Fusion Engine Design and Analysis
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Overview

Inertia Enterprises is developing the technologies to build the world’s first fusion energy power plant. At our 48,000 sq.ft. facility in Livermore, CA, we are seeking a Senior Mechanical Engineer - Fusion Engine Design and Analysis to lead analysis and support the mechanical design of critical components and structures of Inertia’s integrated fusion power plant.

This role will lead the design and analysis of components and structures, including the first wall and breeding blanket structures, that must survive the harshest conditions known to engineering— intense x-ray and neutron flux, high temperatures, extreme thermal gradients, corrosion, among others.

What You'll Get to Do

  • Develop the mechanical design and 3D modeling of the fusion engine key systems, structures and components: chamber, first wall, blanket, vacuum chamber, piping.

  • Lead mechanical design and thermal-structural analysis of key components such as the engine first wall and tritium breeding blanket, in steady-state and transient conditions. Optimize structures for heat removal, thermo-mechanical longevity, manufacturability.

  • Evaluate the effects of cyclic heat flux, creep loading, fatigue loading on chamber components using relevant models, codes and standards to predict the operational lifespan of the fusion core. Account for effects of irradiation (displacement per atom and helium) in thermal mechanical analyses.

  • Conducts thermal and structural analyses and parametric studies to validate and optimize materials choices and mechanical designs, capturing insights and results in technical documentation and reports

  • Actively participates in design reviews and risk matrix development, helping to identify technical gaps, track open action items, and incorporate feedback from various stakeholders into the design.

  • Support and mentor other mechanical engineers, designers, and analysts working on other company priorities such as high power laser design, fusion target design. .

What You Bring to Inertia

  • Bachelor’s or advanced degree in Mechanical, Aerospace, Materials, Nuclear, Structural or a related engineering discipline.

  • 7+ years of experience in mechanical design and analysis of structural materials in chemical, power generation, oil & gas, nuclear, defense, or aerospace industries.

  • Expert-level skills in mechanical design and computer-aided design (CAD)

  • Expertise in finite element analysis using codes such as ANSYS or Abaqus applied for stress and thermal analysis

  • Knowledge of FEA and other spatial/time discretization techniques for partial differential equation (PDE) systems.

  • Familiarity with application of numerical material models to metallic systems, structures and components

  • Experience with alloys and metals, high temperatures, high heat fluxes, and/or irradiation effects on materials

Bonus Points

  • Experience with power plant design

  • Experience in/knowledge of Computational Materials Science or Mechanics preferred

  • Experience developing scientific codes and softwares using C++, Fortran, python or similar programming language

  • Experience with fusion or nuclear technologies

  • Working knowledge of ASME Boiler and Pressure Vessel Codes, with specific interest in high-temperature service rules.

Salary & Benefits:

  • The base salary range for this role is $125,000 - $225,000; The pay range provided is an estimated base range for this role. Exact compensation may vary based on skills, experience, and education.

  • We offer market-competitive compensation and an excellent benefits program, including Medical, Dental, and Vision plans, company-paid holidays, matching 401k, and more!

About Inertia:

Inertia is taking the most direct, scientifically-proven path to commercializing fusion, leveraging the only successful achievement of fusion ignition, using a process that was pioneered at the U.S. Department of Energy’s (DOE) Lawrence Livermore National Laboratory (LLNL). With groundbreaking innovation, transformative technology, and multi-year investment, Inertia is committed to commercializing fusion energy in the next decade.

This position requires access to technology, software and other information that is subject to governmental access control restrictions, due to export controls, security classification and/or designation as Controlled Unclassified Information. Employment in this position is conditioned on the candidate’s eligibility for, obtaining and maintaining appropriate government authorization to access technology or information, to the extent required, including without limitation a security clearance, export license, or other documentation required to establish authorization to receive access to such items technology or information.

jobs.title: Mechanical Technician
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Overview

We are seeking a highly skilled Mechanical Technician to support advanced precision mechanical design, fabrication, and system integration efforts. This role requires a hands-on problem solver who can work independently, manage multiple tasks simultaneously, and contribute to innovative technical solutions.

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys ownership, variety, and solving problems without waiting for step-by-step instructions.

What You'll Get to Do

  • Design and build mechanical components and assemblies from concept to prototype.

  • Create, modify, and maintain mechanical drawings and documentation.

  • Fabricate parts using shop tools, machining, and rapid prototyping methods.

  • Work with and integrate basic electronics and electromechanical systems.

  • Troubleshoot and iterate on prototypes quickly.

  • Juggle multiple projects and shifting priorities in a startup setting.

  • Develop creative, practical solutions to open-ended technical problems.

  • Communicate clearly with engineers, founders, and teammates.

  • Document designs, changes, and build processes so others can follow.

What You Bring to Inertia

  • Experience as a mechanical technician or similar hands-on role.

  • Strong mechanical design and drawing skills.

  • Demonstrated hands-on fabrication and build experience, including minor machining, soldering, working with pressure systems, and performing equipment maintenance.

  • Working knowledge of electronics and system integration.

  • Ability to work independently with minimal supervision.

  • Comfortable wearing multiple hats and switching tasks as needed.

  • Strong problem-solving mindset — you figure things out and make them better.

  • Clear communicator who values good documentation.

Bonus Points

  • CAD experience (SolidWorks, Fusion 360, AutoCAD, etc.).

  • Experience with prototyping, R&D, or custom hardware.

Salary & Benefits:

  • The base salary range for this role is $80,000 - $110,000; The pay range provided is an estimated base range for this role. Exact compensation may vary based on skills, experience, and education.

  • We offer market-competitive compensation and an excellent benefits program, including Medical, Dental, and Vision plans, company-paid holidays, matching 401k, and more!

jobs.title: Senior Mechanical Design Engineer
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Overview

We are seeking a Senior Mechanical Design Engineer within the laser division, to play a key role in developing the next generation of ultra-high energy pulsed laser systems for fusion energy. Typical design projects would include the design and development of solid-state laser hardware and systems, large-aperture opto-mechanical mounts and positioning systems, support structures, vacuum chambers and systems, thermal management systems, and test stands and diagnostics.

What You'll Get to Do

  • Gather and develop requirements for systems with stakeholders across all disciplines.

  • Conceptualize system architectures and concepts based on high-level requirements.

  • Lead small teams in the design of precision mechanical and opto-mechanical equipment and systems for IFE facilities.

  • Design mechanical, opto-mechanical, and electro-mechanical equipment and systems.

  • Validate design work with appropriate analysis (static and modal FEA, hand calculations, etc.).

  • Present at design reviews to science and management stakeholders.

  • Work closely with other disciplines in the design and coordination of activities.

  • Integrate precision opto-mechanical, fluidic, and electrical hardware, designed both in-house and by subcontractors, into large-scale CAD assemblies that include facility BIM data.

  • Perform detailed component materials and finish specifications, manage technical data transfer to suppliers, inspect and qualify hardware following procurement.

  • Assemble prototype hardware; develop and execute test plans for subsystem performance validation.

  • Utilize large-scale CAD assemblies to provide assembly documentation and installation schedules for opto-mechanical and electrical systems.

  • Guide and mentor other engineers.

What You Bring to Inertia

  • 10+ years of experience as a mechanical design engineer.

  • Proven history of delivering novel and innovative solutions to challenging problems.

  • Proficiency with 3D CAD packages; SolidWorks (preferred), CREO, Autodesk Inventor, etc.

  • Thorough knowledge of drafting, tolerance analysis, and Geometric Dimensioning and Tolerancing (GD&T).

  • Demonstrated experience with FEA - Structural, Modal, Random Vibration with empirical validation.

  • Experience with CFD analysis with empirical validation.

  • Practical knowledge of manufacturing processes (machining, sheet metal, welding) and design for manufacturability (DFM).

  • Experience specifying components for precision design: linear stages, rotary motors, encoders, optical sensors, pneumatic components, vacuum components, etc.

  • Full design lifecycle experience including design, procurement, assembly, and test of mechanical systems.

  • Experience with cleanroom procedures, high-voltage, and high-vacuum environments.

  • Experience designing laser systems or optical instruments.

  • Due to the nature of this position, applicants must be U.S. citizens or permanent residents.

Salary & Benefits:

  • The base salary range for this role is $180,000 - $240,000 per year; The pay range provided is an estimated base range for this role. Exact compensation may vary based on skills, experience, and education.

  • We offer market-competitive compensation and an excellent benefits program, including Medical, Dental, and Vision plans, company-paid holidays, matching 401k, and more!

jobs.title: Project Manager
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Overview

Inertia is seeking a highly driven Project Manager to lead multiple concurrent, cross-functional technical programs from concept through execution. Working closely with technical leads, you will drive project planning, execution, and delivery by managing schedules, budgets, resources, risks, and stakeholder communication.

The ideal candidate combines strong project management expertise with a technical background in engineering, laser systems, or another hard science discipline. You are a proactive problem solver, an exceptional communicator, and a collaborative leader who can drive accountability and deliver results in a fast-paced, technically complex environment.

What You'll Get to Do

Project Initiation

  • Manage multiple concurrent projects from initiation through to execution.

  • Coordinate end-to-end execution of projects with project lead, including gathering requirements and managing schedule, budget, and deliverables.

  • Drive project progress by tracking tasks, managing timelines, and ensuring accountability across teams.

  • Facilitate and lead cross-functional discussions, resolving conflicts and driving decisions forward.

  • Develop project plans, charters, and reporting to communicate status, risks, and milestones clearly.

  • Identify and mitigate risks, removing blockers to keep projects on track.

  • Apply technical understanding to support decision-making and guide project direction.

Project Execution

  • Proactively identify and resolve project challenges by coordinating resources and priorities.

  • Monitor project performance and recommend corrective actions.

  • Over see day-to-day project management of $100M+ projects.

What You Bring to Inertia

  • 5+ years of experience in project management within a technical or scientific environment (Laser experience preferred).

  • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Physics, or related technical/science field.

  • PMP, PRINCE2, or Agile/Scrum certifications.

  • Proven ability to lead projects independently and drive outcomes without heavy oversight.

  • Strong experience in project lifecycle.

  • Demonstrated ability to work cross functionally and drive deliverables.

  • Experience with project management tools (MS Project required; Jira a plus).

  • Excellent communication skills, including the ability to summarize complex information clearly.

  • Strong problem-solving and conflict resolution skills.

Salary & Benefits:

  • The base salary range for this role is $120,000 - $150,000; The pay range provided is an estimated base range for this role. Exact compensation may vary based on skills, experience, and education.

  • We offer market-competitive compensation and an excellent benefits program, including Medical, Dental, and Vision plans, company-paid holidays, matching 401k, and more!

jobs.title: Optics Manufacturing Development Engineer
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Overview

At Inertia, we plan to build the world’s largest laser to initiate the world’s first fusion power plant. We need talented engineers to take on the challenge of scaling up various optical components (laser glass and optics, traditional lens, micro lens array, etc.) to unprecedented volume to supply the laser system.

This role will be critical to evaluate feasibility of suppliers, bring up pilot production, and scale up to production volume to supply the fusion power plant.

The role will report to the VP of Industrial Engineering.

What You'll Get To Do

  • Engage internal design teams to consolidate all design requirements, and document the requirements for vendor engagement.

  • Engage suppliers for feasibility, scale, and cost deep dives.

  • Monitor pilot production bring up.

jobs.title: VP, Finance
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Overview

Inertia is seeking a VP, Finance to lead the company’s finance function and build the financial foundation for our next phase of growth. This is a ground-floor opportunity to shape the systems, processes, team, and financial strategy that will support Inertia on its path toward commercializing fusion energy.

Reporting to the Head of Business, you’ll work closely with the executive team and leaders across the company, bringing financial rigor and insight to the strategic and operating decisions that matter most. You’ll be both a strategic partner and a hands-on builder, creating a finance organization designed to scale alongside the company.

This is a hybrid position, with regular in-office collaboration expected.

What You’ll Get to Do

  • Own financial planning and forecasting, including annual budgeting, long-range capital planning, and rolling forecasts that connect Inertia’s financial resources to its strategic priorities.

  • Build the finance function from the ground up, establishing the systems, processes, team, controls, and reporting rhythms needed to support a rapidly scaling company.

  • Turn financial data into actionable insight, leading monthly and quarterly reporting and helping leadership understand performance, key business drivers, opportunities, and tradeoffs.

  • Lead accounting and financial reporting, overseeing outsourced accounting partners across the general ledger, close, financial statements, tax, and audit activities.

  • Build and continuously strengthen financial systems, processes, and internal controls to support Inertia's growth.

  • Manage cash flow forecasting, treasury operations, and capital planning to support Inertia's long-term R&D and commercialization roadmap.

  • Partner cross-functionally with Science, Engineering, Operations, and Talent Acquisition teams, providing financial guidance on hiring plans, capital expenditures, and vendor and contract decisions.

  • Evaluate and implement financial systems and tools, including ERP and FP&A platforms, to support Inertia’s evolving needs.

What You Bring to Inertia

  • 15+ years of finance and accounting experience, including meaningful leadership experience in a high-growth technology, energy, deep-tech, or similarly complex environment.

  • Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, or a related field.

  • A strong foundation of U.S. GAAP, financial reporting, and technical accounting, with the ability to establish a rigorous financial foundation.

  • Proven track record building and scaling FP&A processes, including budgeting, forecasting, and board-level reporting, in a fast-growing or capital-intensive environment.

  • Experience managing external audit, tax compliance, and relationships with outside accounting and advisory firms.

  • Exceptional analytical, communication, and cross-functional partnership skills, with the ability to operate as a hands-on leader with a 0->1 mindset.

  • High integrity, discretion, and sound judgment when handling sensitive financial and strategic information.

Bonus Points

  • CPA.

  • MBA or other relevant advanced degree.

  • Experience at a VC backed, capital intensive startup, particularly in fusion, energy, hard tech, advanced manufacturing, or hardware.

  • Experience supporting fundraising and investor relations.

jobs.title: Desktop Support Technician
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Overview

The Desktop Support Technician (DST) is a hands-on IT role responsible for delivering reliable, responsive technical support to Inertia employees while assisting with the administration and operation of core corporate IT systems. The position is approximately 75% end-user support and 25% systems administration and back-end support, with additional opportunities to contribute to IT projects and strategic initiatives.

The DST will serve as a key point of contact for day-to-day IT needs and will play an important role in ensuring employees have the technology, access, and support they need to be productive.

What You’ll Get to Do

End-User & Desktop Support

  • Manage and prioritize support requests through Freshservice.

  • Troubleshoot hardware, software, Windows/macOS, network, peripheral, and access issues.

  • Provide hands-on support for laptops, desktops, mobile devices, and office technology.

  • Document resolutions, identify recurring issues, and improve support processes and knowledge resources.

  • Support conference rooms, AV equipment, and video conferencing platforms.

Employee Onboarding & Offboarding

  • Configure, deploy, and recover employee computers and other IT equipment.

  • Provision and deprovision user accounts, applications, permissions, and system access.

  • Conduct hands-on device handoff and provide new employees with technology orientation and training.

  • Maintain accurate records of assigned devices, equipment, accounts, and software access.

  • Continuously improve onboarding and offboarding processes through documentation and automation.

Systems Administration & Operations

  • Support the administration, configuration, and ongoing operation of corporate IT platforms, including:

    • Freshservice – IT service management and ticketing

    • Microsoft Intune – Windows endpoint and device management

    • Jamf – Apple endpoint and device management

    • Okta – Identity and access management

    • Microsoft 365

    • Apple Business Manager

    • Google Workspace

IT Projects & Continuous Improvement

  • Support infrastructure, security, endpoint, collaboration, and business systems projects, including evaluating, testing, and deploying new technologies.

  • Leverage AI, automation, and scripting to streamline repetitive IT workflows such as onboarding/off boarding, provisioning, device management, ticket triage, troubleshooting, and documentation.

  • Identify opportunities to reduce manual work, improve reliability, and enhance the employee technology experience while following security, privacy, and responsible AI practices.

  • Develop and maintain SOPs, technical documentation, knowledge-base content, and end-user guides.

What You Bring to Inertia

  • 5+ years of experience providing desktop, help desk, or end-user IT support in a professional environment.

  • Strong working knowledge of Windows and macOS operating systems, hardware, peripherals, and common business applications.

  • Working knowledge of networking, cloud technologies, cybersecurity, and compliance frameworks.

  • Experience supporting AV, conference room, video conferencing, and collaboration technologies.

  • Familiarity with identity and access management (IAM), endpoint management/MDM, SaaS administration, and IT service management (ITSM).

  • Familiarity with AI tools, automation, and scripting, with an interest in applying emerging technologies to improve IT operations.

  • Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills, with the ability to diagnose and resolve technical issues methodically and independently.

  • Excellent interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to effectively support users across a range of technical proficiency levels.

  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail, particularly when managing employee access, equipment, assets, and onboarding/offboarding activities.

  • Ability to prioritize competing requests and responsibilities in a fast-paced, rapidly evolving environment.

  • Demonstrated initiative, curiosity, and a willingness to learn new technologies and take on increasing levels of technical responsibility.

Bonus Points

  • Experience specifically in operationalizing compliance frameworks for Export Controlled and Controlled Unclassified Information

Salary & Benefits:

  • The base salary range for this role is $70,000 - $85,000; The pay range provided is an estimated base range for this role. Exact compensation may vary based on skills, experience, and education.

  • We offer market-competitive compensation and an excellent benefits program, including Medical, Dental, and Vision plans, company-paid holidays, matching 401k, and more!

jobs.title: Compliance Manager / Director / Counsel
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Overview:

Inertia is seeking an experienced compliance professional to lead and build our compliance function, starting with a focus on export controls and trade compliance and expanding over time into broader regulatory compliance as we scale the our operations required to commercialize fusion energy.

This is an opportunity to build the compliance infrastructure for a highly technical, rapidly growing company operating at the intersection of fusion energy, advanced technology, national laboratories, and the U.S. government. The ideal candidate is comfortable operating independently, building programs from the ground up, and wearing multiple hats as the needs of the business evolve – someone with deep expertise in trade compliance who is excited to grow into other compliance and operational areas as the function expands. We are considering candidates at the Manager, Director, or Counsel / Attorney level.

What You’ll Get to Do:

  • Own and develop Inertia's trade compliance and export control program, translating requirements under the EAR, ITAR, CUI requirements, 10 CFR Part 810, and DOE/NNSA regulations into practical guidance for controlled technologies, software, technical data, and collaborative research activities.

  • Ensure compliance with applicable federal regulations and contractual requirements governing CRADAs, SPPs, and other government-funded programs, national laboratory partnerships, and other government contracts and agreements

  • Advise teams on export classifications, licensing requirements, technology controls, deemed exports, and other compliance considerations.

  • Develop practical processes for managing controlled technical information and access by U.S. and non-U.S. persons.

  • Conduct export jurisdiction and classification analyses, including ECCN and determinations, and maintain appropriate documentation.

  • Partner closely with Engineering, Operations, Supply Chain, Talent, IT, Security, and company leadership to integrate trade compliance into business and technical processes.

  • Support compliance considerations associated with government-funded programs, national laboratory partnerships, and other government agreements.

  • Advise on trade compliance requirements within contracts, supplier relationships, technology transfers, and international activities.

  • Conduct risk assessments, internal reviews, training, and investigations and develop corrective actions where appropriate.

  • Monitor changes to applicable export control and regulatory requirements and translate them into practical guidance for the organization.

  • Build scalable compliance processes that support Inertia's continued growth without creating unnecessary barriers to execution.

What You Bring to Inertia:

  • 10+ years of experience in export controls, trade compliance, or a closely related regulatory field.

  • Deep working knowledge of the Export Administration Regulations (EAR), International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR), .

  • Experience independently analyzing complex export control questions and providing practical guidance to technical and business teams.

  • Experience with export classifications, licensing, deemed exports, technology control plans, restricted-party considerations, and compliance program development.

  • Experience working in a highly technical environment such as aerospace, defense, energy, nuclear, advanced manufacturing, national laboratories, or another regulated technology industry.

  • Ability to translate complex regulatory requirements into clear, workable processes for engineers and other non-legal stakeholders.

  • Strong judgment and the ability to balance compliance requirements with the practical needs of a fast-moving organization.

  • Ability to operate independently, identify risks proactively, and build programs and processes with limited existing infrastructure.

  • Comfort working in a startup environment where responsibilities may evolve as the company grows.

Bonus Points:

  • Experience working within the DOE, NNSA, national laboratory, nuclear energy, or fusion energy ecosystem.

  • Experience supporting government contracts or agreements and familiarity with requirements such as DFARS.

  • Legal experience beyond trade compliance, particularly in commercial contracts, corporate matters, government contracting, or other areas relevant to a growing technology company.

  • Experience establishing or scaling a trade compliance program within a startup or rapidly growing organization.

Salary & Benefits:

  • The base salary range for this role is $150,000- $250,000 The pay range provided is an estimated base range for this role. Exact compensation may vary based on skills, experience, and education.

  • We offer market-competitive compensation and an excellent benefits program, including Medical, Dental, and Vision plans, company-paid holidays, matching 401k, and more!

With groundbreaking innovation, transformative technology, and multi-year investment, Inertia is committed to commercializing fusion energy in the next decade.

jobs.title: Join the Jump Product & Design Talent Pool
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Thanks for your interest in learning more about Jump! We are always on the lookout for talented product managers and product designers to join our growing team.  So drop us a line if you're interested in being added to our talent pool. Read more about what we're building and how to stay in touch below.

Jump is transforming the live sports experience with the only end-to-end fan engagement platform built specifically for sports teams and venues. By focusing on aligned incentives between teams and fans, our platform unifies ticketing, merchandise, and game day operations - creating a smoother, more fan-friendly experience.

Founded in 2021 by e-commerce innovator Marc Lore, MLB legend Alex Rodriguez, and entrepreneur Jordy Leiser, we’ve raised over $58 million from top investors including Alexis Ohanian’s Seven Seven Six and Forerunner Ventures. Our platform powers teams across the NBA, WNBA, and NWSL helping them boost ticket sales and deliver innovative fan experiences.

We’re a remote-first team driven by core values - begin and build with trust, play like the underdog, win as a team, and do your thing. If you’re collaborative, adaptable, and eager to shape the future of live sports, Jump is the place for you.

As a member of the Product & Design team, you’ll have a strong voice in product strategy and defining the future of live event experiences. We experiment, move fast, fail quickly, and apply new learnings as we try new ideas. You will work closely with passionate leaders, engineers, and other product managers & designers to build transformational experiences for fans and teams. 

We look for people with the following traits:

  • A strong desire to learn. You are curious and willing to dive deep to become a subject matter expert in our domain

  • Tenacity. You enjoy working on challenges that others can’t or don’t want to tackle and you aren’t afraid of failing fast in order to find better solutions.

  • Passion. You love using your technical skills to build products that solve real problems. You hold yourself to a high standard and help to elevate others as well.

  • Empathy. You thrive in an environment where everyone can truly be themselves. You understand that our differing life experiences influence who we are and how we show up, and these diverse perspectives enrich both our team and our product.

  • Customer-centric mindset. You can understand the problem to be solved and who we are solving it for.

If this sounds aligned with your skills and interests, drop us your resume and we’ll reach out if there’s a role that might align with our team’s needs in the future.

 - Empathy. You thrive in an environment where everyone can truly be themselves. You understand that our differing life experiences influence who we are and how we show up, and these diverse perspectives enrich both our team and our product.

 - Customer-centric mindset. You can understand the problem to be solved and who we are solving it for.



If this sounds aligned with your skills and interests, drop us your resume and we’ll reach out if there’s a role that might align with our team’s needs in the future.

jobs.title: Senior Data Engineer
jobs.descriptionHtml:
The Company

Jump is transforming the live sports experience with the only end-to-end fan engagement platform built specifically for sports teams and venues. By focusing on aligned incentives between teams and fans, our platform unifies ticketing, merchandise, and game day operations - creating a smoother, more fan-friendly experience. Jump was founded by e-commerce innovator Marc Lore, MLB legend Alex Rodriguez, and entrepreneur Jordy Leiser. We're backed by top investors including Alexis Ohanian's Seven Seven Six and Forerunner Ventures.

Our platform powers teams across the NBA, WNBA, and NWSL among other leagues, helping them boost ticket sales and deliver innovative fan experiences. We're a remote-first team driven by core values - begin and build with trust, play like the underdog, win as a team, and do your thing. If you're collaborative, adaptable, and eager to shape the future of live sports, Jump is the place for you.

The Role

Jump is seeking a Senior Data Engineer to join our nimble Data team, where you'll help build and evolve the data platform that powers the company. You'll own the reliability and performance of our Snowflake and dbt-powered stack, building the pipelines and models that make data trustworthy and usable across Jump - from internal dashboards to client-facing products. As we create and iterate on agentic functionality across our product, you'll help shape how Jump builds on and leverages its data foundation. This is a hands-on, high-ownership role spanning data platform, analytics engineering, and data infrastructure. You'll work across the stack, solving problems end-to-end while helping shape the architecture and data practices that will support Jump as we scale.

What You'll Do

  • Build and maintain ELT pipelines that turn raw data into modular, well-tested dbt models inside Snowflake

  • Design and maintain reliable data orchestration and workflows as the platform grows in complexity

  • Write and maintain dbt tests that catch issues before they reach a critical point

  • Document models and sources so the meaning of our data is discoverable

  • Build monitoring and alerting that surfaces pipeline failures and data anomalies before anyone has to ask

  • Optimize Snowflake table design and materialization strategy to keep performance high and costs in check as data volume grows

  • Help evolve Snowflake access controls and governance, keeping roles, grants, and security aligned with organizational standards

  • Dig into what internal teams and external clients actually need from our data, not just what they ask for

  • Bring a strong engineering discipline to data work; version control, CI/CD, code review

  • Build the data infrastructure and governance needed to support new AI/ML use cases, including reliable access to high-quality, well-understood data

What We're Looking For

  • 6+ years of data engineering experience

  • Ability to independently own complex data systems from design through production and make sound architectural tradeoffs

  • Strong product and stakeholder instincts - you can translate ambiguous business needs into durable data solutions

  • Deep, production-grade SQL and Snowflake expertise

  • Deep experience with dbt, including testing, documentation, dependencies, and deployment

  • Software engineering discipline — Git-based version control, CI/CD for data pipelines, and strong Python skills for building data pipelines, orchestration, and custom transformations

  • A track record of building testing, monitoring, and alerting into pipelines before something breaks, not after

Nice to Haves

  • Familiarity with BI/analytics tools, ideally Sigma

  • Experience with orchestration and workflow tooling

  • Depth with cloud platforms

  • Exposure to supporting ML/AI pipelines or streaming and real-time data

Attributes that will make you successful on our team

  • A strong desire to learn. You are curious and willing to dive deep to become a subject matter expert in our domain

  • Tenacity. You enjoy working on challenges that others can't or don't want to tackle and you aren't afraid of failing fast in order to find better solutions.

  • Passion. You love using your skills to solve real problems. You hold yourself to a high standard and help to elevate others as well.

  • Empathy. You thrive in an environment where everyone can truly be themselves. You understand that our differing life experiences influence who we are and how we show up, and these diverse perspectives enrich both our team and our product.

  • Customer-centric mindset. You put customers at the heart of everything they do, striving to understand their needs and exceed their expectations

  • Innovation: Passion for exploring and implementing AI technologies to enhance automation, optimize workflows, and drive innovation

Benefits

  • Remote first

  • Competitive salary and equity

  • Flex PTO policy

  • 401(k)

  • Generous medical, dental and vision plans

  • 16 weeks paid parental leave for primary and secondary caregivers

  • $1,000 reimbursement for work-from-home tech setup

  • $1,000 reimbursement for learning and development

  • Company-paid sustainability subscription to ensure carbon neutrality is maintained for employee activities, such as travel

Compensation

Compensation is something we don't want our candidates or employees to worry about. Our goal is to offer competitive salaries that are regularly benchmarked against the market. The core tenants of our compensation philosophy are fairness and transparency. We have established a standardized leveling framework based on job scope and responsibilities. This means that every person at a certain level is paid the same as everyone else, regardless of their background, previous compensation, location, or any other factor. The compensation for this role is $190,000-$210,000 and includes a generous equity package.

Application

Some candidates may see the requirements and feel unsure that they match all the criteria. We encourage you to apply! There's a good chance you have important skills that we have not stated. We especially encourage members of traditionally underrepresented communities to apply, including women, nonbinary folx, people of color, members of the LGBTQ community, veterans, and people with disabilities. We're committed to building an inclusive workplace where everyone can bring their authentic self and thrive, and we value the diversity brought by different life experiences.

jobs.title: Associate Product Manager (AI)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Job Title: Associate Product Manager (AI)

About the Role

We are seeking a highly motivated, technically skilled Associate Product Manager (AI) to join our team. This role is ideal for individuals with 1–3 years of experience and a strong technical foundation, with demonstrated exposure to AI. Interns and recent graduates passionate about product management in AI are also encouraged to apply.

Key Responsibilities

  • Work closely with engineers and analytics teams to design, plan, and ship impactful features in AI products.

  • Analyze user data and feedback to inform product decisions and optimize the overall product experience.

  • Drive execution on product initiatives from ideation to launch, ensuring timely delivery and feature quality.

  • Collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders to define product requirements, set priorities, and align on roadmaps.

  • Stay current on AI trends and competitive products to help shape product vision and strategy.

  • Combine strong technical skills, business and operations sense, product taste (design), and strong intuition to deliver exceptional product outcomes.

Requirements

  • 1–3 years of experience in a technical, product, or analytics-focused role (internships included).

  • Strong technical background (CS, engineering, mathematics, or related field preferred).

  • Demonstrated exposure to AI (coursework, personal projects, internships, or previous roles).

  • Proven ability to collaborate effectively with engineering, analytics, design, and operations teams.

  • Solid planning, organizational, and problem-solving skills.

  • Excellent communication abilities, both written and verbal.

  • Keen product intuition, sense of user experience, and appreciation for good design.

  • Business and operations acumen with a data-driven mindset.

Nice to Have

  • Experience at a high-growth startup or agile product team.

  • Practical involvement in building or optimizing AI orchestration.

  • Familiarity with product management and analytics tools.

Benefits

  • Competitive salary and equity options.

  • Opportunity to learn and grow in product management with hands-on work in AI.

  • Mentorship from experienced product and engineering leaders.

  • Collaborative and innovative work environment.

What We’re Looking For

  • Proven ability to work collaboratively with engineers and analytics teams, translating ideas into actionable product features.

  • Strength in planning and prioritizing product features and optimizing the end-to-end product experience based on data and user insights.

  • A unique blend of skills: sharp technical prowess, strong product and operations sense, and a refined sense of design quality (taste).

  • An intuitive understanding of user needs and product-market fit, enabling quick yet thoughtful decision making.

  • Business mindset and operational awareness to balance user experience, technical feasibility, and business goals effectively.

If you are passionate about building the next generation of AI products, have a unique combination of technical prowess, product taste, business sense, and strong intuition, we’d love to hear from you!

Senior AI Engineer

Libra AI · Bengaluru (HSR Layout) · Full-time, on-site

We're building an agentic work OS with semantic search, 250+ integrations, and real workflows running in production. Looking for an engineer who can ship across the stack, set technical direction, and actually understands what's happening under the LLM hood.

The role

This is a hybrid IC + pod lead role. You'll be heads-down writing code on the hardest parts of the stack while also shaping how the rest of the engineering team thinks, builds, and ships. You'll architect and own the backend systems that power agentic workflows at scale (orchestration pipelines, retrieval layers, eval infra) and raise the bar for everyone around you.

What we're looking for

Must-haves

  • 4 to 5+ years in a strong SDE role, shipping production systems (Strong backend experience)

  • Hands-on experience with AI orchestration frameworks (AI SDK, LangChain, LlamaIndex, or equivalent)

  • Solid grasp of SQL, vector databases, RAG pipelines, embeddings, chunking strategies, and retrieval evals

  • Core AI fundamentals: quantization, attention, tokenization, inference economics, fine-tuning vs prompting trade-offs

  • Strong JavaScript/TypeScript chops; And system design experience

  • Architected scalable backend systems including async pipelines, queues, caching, and db design

  • Has worked on systems that have seen real scale (traffic, data, or concurrency)

  • Strong communicator who can articulate technical trade-offs clearly and bring a team along

  • Demonstrated leadership: has mentored engineers, owned architecture decisions, or led a pod

  • Genuine passion for AI. You read papers on weekends, ship side projects, and your GitHub looks like a green forest. Bonus if those side projects are AI-flavored.

Bonus

  • DevOps fluency (Docker, K8s, CI/CD, infra-as-code)

  • Prior experience at an AI-first company or shipping LLM products

  • Exposure to graph databases, agent frameworks, or multi-model routing

What we offer

  • Top-of-market cash plus meaningful early-stage equity

  • A real seat at the table. You'll architect and lead, not just implement

  • Directly work with the founder and the core team on problems that actually matter

  • High-agency environment with the resources of a well-funded pre-seed company

jobs.title: AI PM
jobs.descriptionHtml:
AI Product Manager | Libra AI, Inc

Bengaluru, KA

We’re hiring an AI PM to work directly with the founding team at Libra AI.

This is a 0→1 role. You’ll be shaping product, shipping fast, and building at the edge of what AI can do today.

What you’ll do

  • Own product end-to-end from idea to shipped feature

  • Work closely with engineering to design and ship AI-native workflows

  • Prototype fast using tools like Claude, Lovable, etc.

  • Define product direction based on user behavior, not opinions

  • Obsess over UX, details, and product quality

  • Operate with high speed and high ownership

What we’re looking for

  • 2–4 years of real product management experience (not ops/analyst roles)

  • Strong understanding of AI systems LLMs, agents, orchestration

  • Ability to independently prototype and validate ideas

  • Technical enough to work closely with engineers

  • Strong product taste: you know what good looks like

  • Extremely high attention to detail

  • High agency: you don’t wait to be told what to do

  • Can join immediately (or within 2 weeks max)

Bonus

  • Experience building or shipping AI products

  • Strong sense of design / UX

  • Experience working in fast-paced 0→1 environments

Why this role

  • Work directly with the founder

  • Top-of-market cash + meaningful equity

  • Build a foundational product in the AI era

  • Full ownership from day one

If you know you’re a fit, DM with your resume and a 2-line intro.
You’ll hear back from us.

jobs.title: Founder's Office - GTM
jobs.descriptionHtml:
GTM Intern, Founder's Office (US Market)

Location: Bengaluru, in office, full week

Term: 6months fixed-term internship, with a full-time conversion decision in 3months based on performance

Reports to: Founder/CEO

What Libra is

Libra is an agentic Work OS, a company brain that connects to the tools a company already runs on (Slack, Gmail, Notion, Jira, Drive, Salesforce, HubSpot) and executes work across them rather than just searching them. Ask it to chase the open items from yesterday's customer call and it opens the tickets, drafts the follow-up, and posts the summary in the right channel.

We hold SOC 2, ISO 27001, and GDPR, and we sign BAAs. That matters more than it sounds, because it removes the single most common blocker in regulated US buying.

We sell from Bengaluru into the United States. That is the whole GTM motion right now.

Why this role exists

We are trying to answer one question: which specific job, for which specific US buyer, gets someone to pay us. We have competing hypotheses and not enough data. Until that is settled, everything downstream (the sales hire, the ad spend, the content plan) is guesswork.

You are the instrument we use to settle it. This is not a role where you shadow a founder and summarize meetings. You will build the target lists, write and send the outbound, sit on the calls, and own the notes that turn a pile of rejections into a positioning decision.

What you'll actually do

First, get loaded. Learn the product well enough to run a live demo of a couple of workflows without help. Read every call recording and every cold reply we have received. Build the first target account list against a written ICP spec: real companies, verified contacts, disqualifications logged with reasons.

Then, run the wedge test. Competing positioning hypotheses, tested head to head with founder-signed cold email. You own list build, enrichment, sequencing, deliverability hygiene, and the reply log. Every reply gets coded: interested, wrong problem, wrong person, no budget, silence. At the end you present which hypothesis produced meetings and why, with the reply data rather than a narrative.

Then, build the machine that works. Depending on what the test says, that means some combination of: scaling outbound on the winning message, prepping founder calls with real account research (their tool stack, their org chart, their recent hires, their public pain), maintaining CRM truth, drafting the sales collateral we keep not writing (security one-pager, pilot agreement, objection handling doc), and running competitive research on Glean, Dust, and whoever shows up next.

Throughout. You write the weekly GTM update: what was sent, what came back, what it means, what changes next week. One page. It goes to the whole company.

The bar

We evaluate on outputs, not effort:

What we look at What good looks like Target lists Every account defensible on its own terms, disqualifications logged rather than deleted Outbound Personalized well above template level, at real volume, without dropping quality Deliverability Clean domain, clean bounce rate, no shortcuts that cost us the sending domain Meetings Booked with people who can actually buy, not whoever will take a call The wedge test Concluded, defensibly, with data we can act on Collateral Sales artifacts drafted, shipped, and used on live calls

A wrong hypothesis killed cleanly and early is worth more to us than a calendar full of meetings with the wrong buyers.

Who this is for

  • You can write an email an US VP of Operations actually replies to. This is the hardest skill in the role and the one we screen hardest for.

  • You are comfortable being told your work is wrong, and you would rather find out early than late.

  • You can find things: a company's tool stack from a job posting, a decision maker from a podcast appearance, a budget cycle from a filing.

  • You are technical enough to be dangerous. You can wire up an automation, read an API doc, and understand what "self-hosted deployment" means to a security team.

  • You want to be in GTM. Not consulting, not product, not "exploring."

Who this is not for

  • Anyone who needs a defined process to work inside. There is not one yet, and building it is the job.

  • Anyone who wants strategy without execution. You will spend real hours in a spreadsheet verifying email addresses.

  • Anyone who cannot hold the US overlap consistently. That overlap is non-negotiable, and it is why the role works.

How to apply

Do not send a cover letter. Send the following to careers@trylibra.ai with the subject line GTM Intern, [Your Name]:

  1. A target account list you build yourself. US companies you believe would pay for Libra. Company name, why them in one line, the named person you would contact, and their title. Spreadsheet or doc, your call.

  2. Cold emails to a few of those named people. Short. Different companies, not the same email templated.

  3. One paragraph on which account you think is the worst fit on your own list, and why you left it in.

We read the third one first.

Applications reviewed on a rolling basis. If your list is good, you will hear from us shortly.

jobs.descriptionPlain:
A Test Program Manager (or Test Engineering Program Manager) leads cross-functional teams to define, plan, and execute product testing strategies, ensuring quality from development to launch. They manage test schedules, budgets, and vendor relations while driving bug resolution and reporting status to leadership. Apple +4
Key Responsibilities
Strategy & Planning: Define comprehensive end-to-end testing strategies, covering functional, regression, and system testing.
Cross-Functional Leadership: Coordinate with software, hardware, and RF test engineers to align testing with product development.
Execution & Monitoring: Drive test readiness reviews, monitor test execution, and manage defect reporting.
Vendor & Budget Management: Manage test suppliers, vendors, and development budgets.
Risk Management: Proactively identify project risks, inter-dependencies, and bottlenecks to ensure on-time delivery. Apple +6
Required Skills & Qualifications
Technical Proficiency: Familiarity with test technologies, CICD, and automation tools.
Project Management: Experience with software development lifecycles (SDLC) and complex product testing.
Communication: Excellent leadership, presentation, and conflict-resolution skills.
Education/Experience: Often requires a degree in Engineering (Software/Electrical) and experience in testing or program management. Apple +4

About Menlo
Menlo Research is an Applied R&D lab building Asimov, an open-source humanoid robot platform, and the full software stack that powers it. Our mission is to make humanoid labor economically viable, turning software into physical labor at scale. We build across the full stack: hardware architecture, locomotion, autonomy, simulation, and infrastructure. We move fast, ship to real robots, and open-source everything we can. If you want your work to matter beyond a paper or a demo, this is the place.

The Role
As a Robotics AI Engineer, you will work at the intersection of learning and hardware, training and deploying policies that run on Asimov in the real world. This is not a research role in the traditional sense. You will be expected to get results on physical robots, not just in simulation, and to iterate fast when things break. You will work closely with the hardware, firmware, and infrastructure teams to close the loop between training and deployment.

What You Will Do

  • Design and train RL and imitation learning policies for locomotion, manipulation, or whole-body control

  • Run experiments on physical hardware and close the sim-to-real gap through systematic debugging and domain adaptation

  • Build and maintain simulation environments and data pipelines that support fast policy iteration

  • Instrument robot deployments and analyze failure modes to feed improvements back into training

  • Collaborate with hardware and firmware engineers to understand physical constraints and improve policy robustness


What We Are Looking For

  • Strong foundations in reinforcement learning or imitation learning, with hands-on experience training policies that run on real systems

  • Comfort working directly with robots, not just simulators

  • Proficiency in Python and familiarity with standard RL/ML frameworks (JAX, PyTorch, IsaacGym/IsaacLab, MuJoCo, or similar)

  • An empirical, debugging-first mindset, you care about what actually works on hardware

  • Ability to move fast and context-switch between research problems and engineering tasks


Nice to Have

  • Prior work on humanoid or legged robot platforms

  • Experience with sim-to-real transfer techniques (domain randomization, system identification, noise injection)

  • Contributions to open-source robotics projects

  • Background in control theory, trajectory optimization, or dynamics


Why Join Menlo
The policies you train do not sit in a notebook. They run on a real humanoid, in the real world, on short feedback loops. You will see your work move physical hardware within days, not quarters. You will collaborate directly with the hardware, firmware, and infrastructure teams, with high visibility and real stakes, and everything you can open-source, you will. If you want to build the systems that turn software into physical labor, this is where it happens.

A Note on AI

You don't need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect everyone at Menlo to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement. When that's the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don't treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on.

Equal Opportunity and Accommodations

We hire talented people from a wide range of backgrounds. If you're excited about a role but don't meet every bullet, we still encourage you to apply. Menlo Research is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of any legally protected characteristic. Menlo provides reasonable accommodations during the application process. If you need one, please let your recruiter know.

jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Menlo

Menlo Research is an Applied R&D lab building Asimov, an open-source humanoid robot platform, and the full software stack that powers it. Our mission is to make humanoid labor economically viable -- turning software into physical labor at scale. We build across the full stack: hardware architecture, locomotion, autonomy, simulation, and infrastructure. We move fast, ship to real robots, and open-source everything we can. If you want your work to matter beyond a paper or a demo, this is the place.

 

The Role

As an Electrical Engineer, you will own the design, integration, and bring-up of the electronic systems that power Asimov. From power distribution to motor control to sensor integration, you will work across schematics, PCB layouts, harness design, and hardware debug -- ensuring every electrical decision holds up in the field and integrates cleanly with the broader mechanical and firmware stack.

 

What You'll Do

  • Design and review schematics and PCB layouts for power distribution units, motor driver boards, and actuator control electronics

  • Integrate wiring harnesses, PCBA enclosures, and motor controllers into mechanical assemblies from the ground up

  • Lead bring-up of power systems, sensors, and actuator subassemblies; diagnose and resolve issues across multiple hardware revisions

  • Define and run electrical and system-level test protocols, analyze failure modes, and iterate based on test data

  • Work closely with firmware and controls teams to ensure electrical design choices support stable, low-latency control loops

  • Apply expertise in connector selection, grounding strategies, harness routing, and EMI suppression to ensure robust and field-reliable hardware

  • Contribute to Menlo's open-source design efforts, including PCB schematics and manufacturing documentation for the broader robotics community

 

What You'll Bring

  • 3 or more years of hands-on electrical engineering experience on high-complexity electromechanical products

  • Solid understanding of electrical and electronic systems, including motor drivers, sensors, and embedded hardware integration

  • Deep familiarity with low-voltage (under 60V) DC power systems, DC-DC converters, MOSFET gate drivers, current-sense amplifiers, and passive network design

  • Proficiency using oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, and CAN/UART sniffers for in-depth hardware debug

  • Expertise in connector selection, grounding strategies, harness routing, and EMI suppression techniques

  • Strong communication skills to drive alignment across firmware teams, mechanical engineers, and leadership


Bonus points for:

  • Experience with bipedal or humanoid robot hardware or legged locomotion platforms

  • Familiarity with CAN bus, motor controllers, and how electrical design choices affect firmware and control integration

  • Scripting experience in Python for hardware automation and data analysis

  • Familiarity with sim-to-real workflows and how hardware decisions affect locomotion policy training and transfer

 

Why Join Menlo?

You will be part of a tight-knit team defining the next generation of humanoid robots. With genuine ownership of the mechanical systems that bring Asimov to life, you will see your designs go from CAD to real-world deployments. If you thrive in fast-paced, open-collaborative environments, let's build the future of robotics together.

jobs.title: Mechanical Engineer, Robotics
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Menlo

Menlo Research is an Applied R&D lab building Asimov, an open-source humanoid robot platform, and the full software stack that powers it. Our mission is to make humanoid labor economically viable -- turning software into physical labor at scale. We build across the full stack: hardware architecture, locomotion, autonomy, simulation, and infrastructure. We move fast, ship to real robots, and open-source everything we can. If you want your work to matter beyond a paper or a demo, this is the place.

 

The Role

As a Mechanical Engineer, you will own the design, analysis, and validation of the structural and kinematic systems that make Asimov move. You will take components from concept through production-ready hardware -- working across joints, actuators, enclosures, and structural members -- ensuring every design holds up mechanically and integrates cleanly with the broader electromechanical system.

 

What You'll Do

  • Design and develop mechanical assemblies across the full humanoid body, including joints, actuators, sensor mounts, and structural members

  • Develop detailed 3D part, drawings and assembly models across plastics, metal, and composite materials in Solidworks or equivalent CAD tools

  • Run hands-on test rigs: load testing, fatigue cycling, thermal soak, and kinematic validation across body segments

  • Execute DFM reviews alongside contract manufacturers, going to the floor to understand tooling constraints, cycle times, and failure modes firsthand

  • Create and maintain production drawings with GD&T and inspection callouts for handoff to CMs and QA

  • Set up and instrument test stands, wire sensors, and collect data to analyze failure modes and close the loop on design iterations

  • Work across plastics, metals, and composites, selecting materials and joining methods appropriate for the loading conditions and production intent

  • Coordinate with firmware and electrical teams to physically integrate actuators, sensors, and PCBs into mechanical assemblies, ensuring cable routing, connector access, and serviceability are accounted for

  • Contribute to Menlo's open-source hardware releases, including build guides, BOM documentation, and assembly instructions for the communityContribute to Menlo's open-source design efforts, including CAD releases, manufacturing documentation, and build guides for the broader robotics community

 

What You'll Bring

  • 3 or more years of hands-on mechanical design experience on high-complexity electromechanical products

  • Strong proficiency in Solidworks, across both detailed parts, multibody assemblies, surfaces and drawings

  • Proven track record with sheet metal fabrication and traditional/additive manufacturing

  • Experience with GD&T and producing 2D engineering drawings for manufacturing and QA

  • Ability to run FEA simulations; static, dynamic & thermal as well as interpret results to inform design decisions

  • Comfortable working within aggressive cost and weight constraints without sacrificing reliability

  • Demonstrated hands-on experience with material selection, actuator selection, fasteners and mechanisms

  • Proficient in rapid prototyping methods (FDM, SLA, CNC, laser cutting) and able to support the team on design decisions spanning the full product lifecycle, from concept through end-of-life disassembly and material recovery

  • Strong communication skills to drive alignment across suppliers, cross-disciplinary engineers, and leadership


Bonus points for:

  • Experience with bipedal or humanoid robot hardware, legged locomotion platforms, or high DOF manipulators

  • Participated in robotics competitions

  • Familiarity with parallel mechanisms and non-standard joint configurations such as RSU ankle designs or parallel actuation

  • Knowledge of plastics engineering including material selection, shrinkage factors, and mechanical property optimization

  • Scripting or automation experience in Python to streamline CAD workflows and data analysis

  • Experience with deploying control systems to hardware

  • Familiarity with sim-to-real workflows and how hardware decisions affect locomotion policy training and transfer

  • Prior involvement in robotics or wearable systems where mechanical tolerances and ergonomics are critical

 

Why Join Menlo?

You will be part of a tight-knit team defining the next generation of humanoid robots. With genuine ownership of the mechanical systems that bring Asimov to life, you will see your designs go from CAD to real-world deployments. jobs.title: Wild Card
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Menlo is always hiring.

  • Maybe you're a designer with an anthropology habit 🗿.

  • An ex-marine turned roboticist 🤖.

  • A community builder who speaks fluent Rustacean 🦀.

  • Or maybe you're something we don't have a title for yet 👽.

That's who the Wild Card is for. The hybrid thinkers, the obsessives, the ones who don't fit neatly in a box and know they belong here anyway. Most companies don't have a slot for people like you. We built one. If that's you, let's talk.

 

The mindsets we hire for:

  • Fast and curious. You learn in public and ship before you feel ready.

  • Obsessed outliers. You go deep on things most people never notice.

  • We hire for how fast you grow, not where you're starting from.

  • Underdogs. You've been counted out before and proved it wrong.

  • We run like a pro sports team: best players in their roles, hire and cut smartly, but give teams the continuity to gel and win together.

What you'll get:

  • Real ownership, with the freedom to build what actually matters.

  • Room to do your life's best work without contorting yourself to fit a mold.

  • Some of the most curious and mission-driven people you'll ever work alongside.

  • Robots that actually move. Your work ships to hardware, not a slide or a paper

Pitch to Us:

There's no checklist here, so make the case yourself. Tell us:

  • What you're unreasonably good at, and how you know.

  • The project you'd show a stranger to explain who you are.

  • Where you'd fit at Menlo, or the role you'd invent for yourself.

  • Why now, and why us.
