jobs.title: Senior Security Engineer, DeFi
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Mysten Labs believes that decentralized and open protocols are the bedrock of the internet of value. This is why at Mysten Labs, we are creating foundational infrastructure to accelerate the adoption of decentralized protocols based on blockchain technologies.

We’re looking for a Senior Security Engineer to help protect the Sui ecosystem. You’ll uncover vulnerabilities, build monitoring tools, and assess economic risk across DeFi protocols. Working closely with external protocol teams and Mysten’s own DeFi products, including DeepBook, you’ll help address risks before they become incidents and strengthen security across the ecosystem

Responsibilities

  • Build and run continuous monitoring of the Sui DeFi ecosystem for security and economic risk: oracle issues, misconfigurations/bad economic parameters, solvency and bad-debt exposure under price shocks, liquidation capacity against on-chain liquidity depth, accounting-versus-positions reconciliation, invariants.

  • Extend security team tooling, both precise static analysis tooling and proprietary agent skills.

  • Measure and drive compliance with the DeFi security recommendations across supported protocols: run the recurring compliance cycle, fill the protocol report card, validate security claims (audits, custody, upgrade governance, oracle dependencies) against on-chain reality, track remediation commitments, and escalate when a protocol regresses or fails to disclose an incident. Partner with the ecosystem and finance owners of the process.

  • Hunt for critical vulnerabilities in the highest-TVL Sui protocols and get them fixed before they are exploited: full-package audits, variant analysis across forks, pre-execution review of multisig upgrade payloads, and forensics after incidents anywhere in the ecosystem.

  • Be the security team's point of contact for external DeFi teams and for Mysten's own DeFi products such as DeepBook: due diligence, incident coordination, and post-mortems that feed back into the recommendations and the monitors.

  • Write it down: findings, reports, and runbooks that a protocol engineer can act on and a non-technical stakeholder can understand, with every claim traceable to bytecode, chain state, or data.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, a relevant technical field, or equivalent practical experience.

  • 3+ years of hands-on experience in security engineering, smart contract security, or DeFi risk engineering, with a track record of building tools that ran in production and of finding real vulnerabilities (audit findings, bug bounty reports, published research, or incident work).

  • Strong understanding of DeFi mechanics and their failure modes: lending markets (LTV, liquidation thresholds and bonuses, close factors, bad debt), AMMs and concentrated liquidity, perpetuals, liquid staking, oracles (staleness, confidence, TWAP, multi-source aggregation), flash loans, and MEV.

  • Proficiency in TypeScript and Python, and comfort with Rust. Ability to write SQL over large datasets and to work with blockchain indexers and data warehouses.

  • Experience reading smart contract code at source or the bytecode or disassembly level, or evident ability to learn it quickly. Move experience is a plus, not a requirement; Solidity or Rust smart contract experience transfers.

  • Rigor: you verify claims against bytecode and chain state, build known-clean checks into your tools, and say what you did not verify.

  • Strong written and verbal communication, including the ability to influence external teams you have no formal authority over

  • Interest in the web3 space is required.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Sui and Move experience: the object and capability model, package upgrades and version gates, programmable transaction blocks, the Sui GraphQL and gRPC APIs.

  • Knowledge of the recent DeFi exploit history on Sui and other chains: named incidents, oracle compromises, and the defect classes behind them.

  • Experience building analysis or monitoring tools with LLM agents (Claude Code skills or comparable), and a clear sense of where models help and where deterministic tooling must do the work.

  • Static or dynamic program analysis experience: taint analysis, call graphs, symbolic execution, fuzzing, formal verification.

  • Quantitative or economic modeling experience: stress testing, liquidity modeling, risk parameters for lending markets.

  • Publications, conference talks, CVEs, or bug bounty rankings.

Employment is contingent upon the successful completion of a background check, which may include verification of employment history, education credentials, criminal history, and other relevant information.

 - Hunt for critical vulnerabilities in the highest-TVL Sui protocols and get them fixed before they are exploited: full-package audits, variant analysis across forks, pre-execution review of multisig upgrade payloads, and forensics after incidents anywhere in the ecosystem.

 - Be the security team's point of contact for external DeFi teams and for Mysten's own DeFi products such as DeepBook: due diligence, incident coordination, and post-mortems that feed back into the recommendations and the monitors.

 - Write it down: findings, reports, and runbooks that a protocol engineer can act on and a non-technical stakeholder can understand, with every claim traceable to bytecode, chain state, or data.



Minimum Qualifications

 - Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, a relevant technical field, or equivalent practical experience.

 - 3+ years of hands-on experience in security engineering, smart contract security, or DeFi risk engineering, with a track record of building tools that ran in production and of finding real vulnerabilities (audit findings, bug bounty reports, published research, or incident work).

 - Strong understanding of DeFi mechanics and their failure modes: lending markets (LTV, liquidation thresholds and bonuses, close factors, bad debt), AMMs and concentrated liquidity, perpetuals, liquid staking, oracles (staleness, confidence, TWAP, multi-source aggregation), flash loans, and MEV.

 - Proficiency in TypeScript and Python, and comfort with Rust. Ability to write SQL over large datasets and to work with blockchain indexers and data warehouses.

 - Experience reading smart contract code at source or the bytecode or disassembly level, or evident ability to learn it quickly. Move experience is a plus, not a requirement; Solidity or Rust smart contract experience transfers.

 - Rigor: you verify claims against bytecode and chain state, build known-clean checks into your tools, and say what you did not verify.

 - Strong written and verbal communication, including the ability to influence external teams you have no formal authority over

 - Interest in the web3 space is required.



Preferred Qualifications

 - Sui and Move experience: the object and capability model, package upgrades and version gates, programmable transaction blocks, the Sui GraphQL and gRPC APIs.

 - Knowledge of the recent DeFi exploit history on Sui and other chains: named incidents, oracle compromises, and the defect classes behind them.

 - Experience building analysis or monitoring tools with LLM agents (Claude Code skills or comparable), and a clear sense of where models help and where deterministic tooling must do the work.

 - Static or dynamic program analysis experience: taint analysis, call graphs, symbolic execution, fuzzing, formal verification.

 - Quantitative or economic modeling experience: stress testing, liquidity modeling, risk parameters for lending markets.

 - Publications, conference talks, CVEs, or bug bounty rankings.



Employment is contingent upon the successful completion of a background check, which may include verification of employment history, education credentials, criminal history, and other relevant information.



Regarding the recent rash of technology job scams: Be aware that emails from genuine Mysten Labs group recruiters will always come from the @mystenlabs.com http://mystenlabs.com domain or related subdomains (e.g., mystenlabs.com/careers http://mystenlabs.com/careers). Remember: you can always verify positions on our job boards at www.mystenlabs.com/careers http://www.mystenlabs.com/careers.



To support an efficient and fair hiring process, we may use technology-assisted tools, including artificial intelligence (AI), to help identify and evaluate candidates. All hiring decisions are ultimately made by human reviewers.



Our team is remote first and we are hiring across the world. Here at Mysten Labs, you’ll be joining a world-class team with tremendous growth potential as we bring the next billion users to web3. We raised a $300M Series B round from top Silicon Valley led venture funds like Jump Crypto, Andreessen Horowitz (a16z), Binance Labs, Redpoint, Lightspeed, Coinbase Ventures, Electric Capital, Standard Crypto, NFX, Slow Ventures, Scribble Ventures, Samsung Next, Lux Capital, among other investment firms and strategic partners. Come join us and build the future of web3!

jobs.title: Account Manager, North America Carrier — 3–6 Month Consultancy
Lead Software Engineer (CloudNetwork)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Nu

Nu serves more than 140 million customers, guided by a mission to fight complexity and empower people. The company has been leading an industry transformation through innovative products and human-centered services.

 

Proprietary technology and data at scale power Nu’s digital platform, built to promote financial access, advancement, and transparency. Its business model thrives on customer love and lower costs, feeding a flywheel of growth and profitability.

Visit our Institutional Page

About the role

Every transaction at Nubank travels across a network before it reaches a customer. As we grow across countries, accounts, regions and hybrid environments, the connectivity layer underneath has to stay fast, segmented, auditable and cheap to run — while never becoming the thing that takes the platform down.

 

As a Lead Software Engineer on a Cloud Network platform engineering team, you set and evolve the technical direction for how Nubank connects its cloud, hybrid and on-premises environments. You own problems whose scope spreads across several teams and business units, and you are expected to bring structure to ambiguity rather than wait for it to be resolved for you.

 

This is an IC6 role: you lead through technical depth, design authority and influence rather than direct reports. The goal you own is a cloud network platform that scales with the business, holds up under audit, and gets simpler over time instead of more complex.

You'll be responsible for

  • Setting and evolving the technical direction of the cloud network platform owned by your team, aligning with Nubank's canonical approaches and contributing back to the broader technical community.

  • Leading high-level and low-level design for connectivity patterns across multi-account, multi-region, multi-geo and hybrid-cloud topologies, independently making sound architectural decisions in multi-component, multi-team designs.

  • Managing complex network projects and processes end to end — working independently, coordinating across subjects and stakeholders, and escalating for managerial support in a timely way rather than reactively.

  • Proactively reducing long-term complexity through simplification, consolidation, deprecation and paved roads, explicitly balancing scalability, maintainability and cost, and considering both human and AI interaction with the platform.

  • Owning the operational health of the network platform in your team's scope: leading complex incident response (diagnosis, coordination, resolution), driving complex postmortems, and owning the short- and long-term tech debt strategy that comes out of them.

  • Promoting a culture of safe change — feature flags, gradual rollout, monitoring, fast rollback — applied to network changes, and driving simplification and cost optimization across the topology.

  • Setting and enforcing quality standards for the team's automation and infrastructure code: testing practices, code review bar, reusable modules, and anticipation of quality and maintainability needs coming from business strategy.

  • Defining observability for the platform — robust monitoring, controls and SLAs that surface issues proactively rather than after customer impact.

  • Bringing a strong end-to-end domain understanding: tracing a business process from product through the transactional path down to the network and data layers, and understanding how network design choices propagate through it.

  • Owning the network security posture of your scope, including PCI DSS or equivalent standards, segmentation, and controls that hold up under audit.

  • Evaluating buy vs. build options and new products and technologies, being data-driven about stability, reliability, scalability and cost before committing to a solution.

  • Mentoring IC4/IC5 engineers on the broader system landscape, design reasoning and operational practice, and raising the bar of the people around you.

  • Participating in hiring as a core part of the role, contributing to function-wide taskforces and initiatives, and documenting decisions so that knowledge travels across teams, not just within yours.

We are looking for a person who has

  • CCIE, CCNP or equivalent experience — you are comfortable designing, building, implementing, maintaining and troubleshooting complex, large-scale networking infrastructures.

  • Solid hands-on experience in infrastructure automation and cloud computing (AWS preferred), with depth in AWS networking services — Transit Gateway, VPC design, Direct Connect, PrivateLink, Route 53, NAT/egress patterns, network firewalls — or similar technologies.

  • Deep experience planning, deploying and troubleshooting network solutions at scale: IP address management, BGP and dynamic routing, firewalls, load balancers, routers and switches, and hybrid connectivity.

  • Strong coding skills (python, .Net. Java, Go etc.)

  • Experience leading incident response and root cause analysis for high-impact, ambiguous failures across team boundaries.

  • Strong leadership: you confidently lead complex projects that carry ambiguity and require strategic thinking, with or without formal authority.

  • Experienced communication: you convey complex technical messages clearly and persuasively to technical and non-technical audiences, adjusting depth and examples to the room, and you facilitate productive discussion rather than just presenting.

  • Strategic acumen and long-term perspective: you connect network platform decisions to business drivers such as operational efficiency, reliability and cost, link 6–12 month initiatives to the broader organizational strategy, and anticipate cross-team impact and trade-offs.

  • An analytical profile: you go after root causes and propose solutions that hold, working creatively and analytically in a continuous improvement environment.


    Location for this opportunity (City, Country)

  • Miami, United States

  • Washigton DC, United States

  • Durham, United States


Our Benefits

  • Opportunity of earning equity at Nu

  • Medical Insurance

  • Dental and Vision Insurance

  • Life Insurance and AD&D

  • Extended maternity and paternity leaves

  • Nucleo - Our learning platform of courses

  • NuLanguage - Our language learning program

  • NuCare - Our mental health and wellness assistance program

  • 401K Saving Plans - Health Saving Account and Flexible Spending Account

  • Work-from-home Allowance

  • Relocation Assistance Package, if applicable

Work Model for this Role

  • Hybrid 2-3 times/week: Our hybrid work model brings us to the office at least twice a week, on strategic days designed to maximize team connection and collaboration. For more details, visit https://building.nubank.com/nu-hybrid-work-model/

Our recruitment process may involve the use of artificial intelligence–enabled tools, such as automated interview transcription and analysis, to support the evaluation process. Artificial intelligence is not used to make final hiring decisions; all decisions are made by human reviewers.

To maintain a consistent and fair process for every candidate, Nu does not provide individualized technical feedback. See how our policy works here

jobs.title: Lead Security Engineer (Threat Detection)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Nu

Nu serves more than 140 million customers, guided by a mission to fight complexity and empower people. The company has been leading an industry transformation through innovative products and human-centered services.

 

Proprietary technology and data at scale power Nu’s digital platform, built to promote financial access, advancement, and transparency. Its business model thrives on customer love and lower costs, feeding a flywheel of growth and profitability.

Visit our Institutional Page

About the role

You will lead the team that stands between adversaries and 135 million customers. The Threat Detection team proactively hunts for security threats and builds robust, actionable detections to protect both customers and Nubankers — operating as a true Security Operations Center, backed by strong engineering power and intelligence from our internal Threat Intelligence team.

As Lead, you own the strategic Threat Detection program end to end: intelligence gathering, threat modeling, detection engineering, AI-assisted analysis, Purple Team validation, incident response and post-incident learning. Your goal is to make sure effective detection rules, actionable insights and AI-enabled security capabilities are in place and aligned with industry best practices, so that adversary activity across Nubank's environment is identified, prevented and detected before it reaches our customers.

You'll also build and lead a high-performing team, support Security leadership in building a world-class security organization, and ensure detection processes meet auditing requirements and support clear communication with regulatory bodies.

Learn more about Nubank Infosec: https://blog.nubank.com.br/infosec-nubank-protecao-dados/

You'll be responsible for

  • Analyzing cyber threat intelligence, emerging attack trends and security telemetry to develop robust detections and threat models, while reducing false positives and improving the efficiency of security operations.

  • Leveraging AI and machine learning across the detection lifecycle — anomaly detection, behavioral analytics, alert triage, threat intelligence enrichment, investigation prioritization and response automation — and leading their adoption so these capabilities are reliable, measurable and secure.

  • Defining validation, quality, explainability and security controls for AI-assisted capabilities, accounting for risks such as inaccurate outputs, data leakage, prompt injection, model manipulation and adversarial evasion.

  • Leading Purple Team activities with Offensive Security, Threat Intelligence, Incident Response and Engineering: translating adversary behaviors into realistic attack simulations, adversary emulation plans and detection validation scenarios mapped to frameworks such as MITRE ATT&CK.

  • Identifying detection and prevention gaps, validating security controls, measuring detection coverage and driving remediation through actionable improvement plans.

  • Establishing feedback loops between offensive and defensive teams so lessons from simulations and real incidents continuously improve detection, investigation and response.

  • Defining success criteria and tracking metrics: detection coverage, validation success rate, false-positive reduction, investigation time, response efficiency and remediation cycle time.

  • Building and leading the team — mentoring engineers and fostering a culture of ownership, accountability, collaboration and continuous learning.

  • Partnering closely with Security Engineering, Threat Intelligence, Software Engineering and Incident Response to build scalable solutions for analyzing security event data and a resilient security architecture aligned with Business Unit strategy.

We are looking for a person who has

  • Solid hands-on experience with Threat Hunting and Incident Response, including handling and resolving complex security incidents.

  • Experience as a technical leader in the identification, analysis and response to complex security threats, providing mentorship and guidance to team members.

  • Experience developing and maintaining detection-as-code solutions to automate threat identification and response.

  • Proven experience in information security operations, with expertise in managing, analyzing and deriving insights from logs and other security-related data.

  • Proficiency with SIEM and EDR tools, and with security platforms such as WAFs, firewalls (e.g. Palo Alto, Cisco ASA) and IDS/IPS.

  • Experience using and integrating threat intelligence feeds to improve detection.

  • Proficiency in SQL for querying and managing security-related databases.

  • Knowledge of cloud security principles and experience securing cloud environments across providers (e.g. AWS).

  • Track record of developing processes, measuring results and delivering continuous improvement.

  • Strong communication skills, a genuine team player and team leader, able to thrive in a team where diversity is key to high performance.

  • Advanced English.

Location for this opportunity (City, Country)

  • São Paulo, Brazil

  • Campinas, Brazil

  • Rio de Janeiro, Brazil

  • Belo Horizonte, Brazil

Our Benefits

  • Chance of earning equity at Nubank

  • Food/ Meal Card (Vale-Refeição and/or Vale Alimentação)

  • Public Transportation Commuting Benefit (Vale-Transporte)

  • NuCare – Psychological, Financial and Legal Assistance Program

  • Life Insurance

  • Medical Plan

  • Dental Plan

  • NuLanguage – Language Course Program

  • Nucleo - Our learning platform of courses

  • Extended Parental Leave

  • Daycare Allowance

  • Parental Consultancy

  • Work-from-home Allowance

  • Gym Partnerships

  • 30 days of paid vacation

  • Relocation Assistance Package, if applicable

Work Model for this Role

  • Hybrid 2-3 times/week: Our hybrid work model brings us to the office at least twice a week, on strategic days designed to maximize team connection and collaboration. For more details, visit https://building.nubank.com/nu-hybrid-work-model/

jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Nu

Nu serves more than 140 million customers, guided by a mission to fight complexity and empower people. The company has been leading an industry transformation through innovative products and human-centered services.

 

Proprietary technology and data at scale power Nu’s digital platform, built to promote financial access, advancement, and transparency. Its business model thrives on customer love and lower costs, feeding a flywheel of growth and profitability.

Visit our Institutional Page

About the role:

  • As it continues its journey of expansion into financial services, Nu Mexico faces growing regulatory requirements. Among them, many are related to AML (Anti-Money Laundering). An important part of our strategy is to be very efficient at that through technology.

  • This role plays a critical part in safeguarding Nu Mexico’s financial ecosystem against money laundering and terrorism financing, contributing to robust compliance through analytics, supporting the identification and mitigation of emerging financial crime risk through a forward-looking, data-driven AML approach aligned with the broader compliance strategy.


You’ll be Responsible for

  • As a highly specialized member of the team, execute the most complex parts of AML Analytics processes required by the Mexican banking regulation

  • Plan and deploy AML monitoring scenarios, building an efficient alert engine, as well as maintaining/improving it

  • Apply our machine learning models to systems and pipelines (alert generation, risk policies, etc.)

  • Design and implement policies/models for customer risk rating

  • Present and explain AML Analytics matters before the 1LOD (First Line of Defense), local leadership, regulators, auditors

  • Collaborate with the global AML teams at applying standards and best practices to MX

  • Follow-up AML-related Analytics and Tech projects that are executed by other teams

  • Be the local responsible for planning, project management in the area

  • Build and maintain indicators/metrics for measuring transaction monitoring, risk distribution, KYC, etc.

  • Data, framework, data warehousing, ETL contributor/developer, big data

  • Programming

    1. Paradigms and their best practices: Object Oriented, Functional

  • Technology: scaling and productivity

  • Experience with regulation/Compliance/Legal

  • Planning & Project management, roadmaps, work planning methodologies

    1. Problem-solving and decision making, in general

Proprietary technology and data at scale power Nu’s digital platform, built to promote financial access, advancement, and transparency. Its business model thrives on customer love and lower costs, feeding a flywheel of growth and profitability.

Visit our Institutional Page


About the role

As a team who drives product development from ideation to full rollout, the Design team ensures that our product experiences are valuable to our users. Designers at Nubank must deal with complex problems and transform them into intuitive, accessible and easy-to-use experiences for millions of people.
At each stage, a Designer must anticipate our customers and business needs, advocate for our users and ensure that the final design surprises and delights them. Achieving this goal requires collaboration with teams of Designers, Researchers, Business Analysts, Software Engineers, Product Managers and many other, working in projects that go from user interviews and prototypes to internal tools and brand assets.
Given this, designers must be flexible and eager to learn - it's unlikely that you'll arrive an expert in all tools and project phases, but you should be humble and have a strong desire and capacity to learn. It's critical that you are able to collaborate with people with varying backgrounds, give good feedback and apply critical feedback received. The combination of these skills along with your talent and technical competence as a designer can make you a great fit for the Nubank Design team.

jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer (Crypto, SV) - US - IC7 - 2026
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Nu

Nu serves more than 140 million customers, guided by a mission to fight complexity and empower people. The company has been leading an industry transformation through innovative products and human-centered services.

 

Proprietary technology and data at scale power Nu’s digital platform, built to promote financial access, advancement, and transparency. Its business model thrives on customer love and lower costs, feeding a flywheel of growth and profitability.

Visit our Institutional Page

About the Role

Nu is building crypto products that give customers real financial access — moving assets, interacting with blockchain networks, and managing digital assets safely and simply. As a Staff Software Engineer on our crypto product team, you will combine deep understanding of blockchain protocols with strong product instincts to decide what we build, how it works technically, and how it should feel for the customer.

You'll work hands-on with onchain data, transaction flows, signing and custody integrations, asset movement, and smart-contract interactions — not to build these as isolated platform pieces, but to turn them into product capabilities customers actually use. You'll partner closely with product and business stakeholders to shape what Nu builds, and with the core crypto team to integrate with the protocol- and security-level building blocks they provide.

You'll be responsible for

  • Understand blockchain protocols deeply enough to know how to integrate with them and what they make possible for customers — then turn that into product decisions.

  • Build and evolve product-facing capabilities involving onchain data, transaction execution, signing and custody integrations, asset movement between wallets and entities, and smart-contract interactions.

  • Partner with product and business stakeholders to define what crypto experiences Nu should offer, weighing technical feasibility, customer value, and business tradeoffs.

  • Integrate with core crypto team systems (custody, key management, security primitives), owning the product and integration layer while collaborating closely on lower-level implementation details when needed.

  • Design APIs and abstractions that let your team and others ship crypto features quickly without reproducing protocol complexity or weakening controls.

  • Establish standards for reliability, observability, data integrity, and production readiness.

  • Lead critical design reviews, major-incident response, and root-cause analysis for the systems you own.

  • Mentor senior engineers and raise the bar for technical and product judgment on the team.

We are looking for a person who has

Required

  • A track record of Staff-level impact building customer-facing products or platforms, ideally with meaningful technical depth in a specific domain.

  • Deep experience with distributed systems at scale, including transaction processing, eventual consistency, failure handling, high availability, and production operations.

  • Demonstrated ability to translate technical understanding of protocols or infrastructure into product decisions and customer-facing features.

  • Production ownership of regulated or high-stakes financial movement, blockchain integrations, or adjacent money-moving infrastructure.

  • Experience designing security-sensitive systems using threat modeling, explicit trust boundaries, defensive architecture, and rigorous review processes.

  • Comfort partnering with product and business stakeholders as a peer in shaping what gets built, not just how.

  • Experience leading complex production incidents and improving systems and operating practices afterward.

  • Strong influence, communication, and mentorship skills, including the ability to align teams without relying on reporting authority.

Nice to have

  • Experience integrating with multiple blockchain networks or protocol families.

  • Experience shaping product or business strategy for crypto or digital-asset offerings.

  • Familiarity with HSMs, secure enclaves, or hardware-backed key-management systems.

  • Experience in regulated fintech, banking, payments, or institutional digital-asset infrastructure.

  • Experience reviewing smart-contract security or integrating with DeFi protocols in production.

Location: Palo Alto, United States

Our recruitment process may involve the use of artificial intelligence–enabled tools, such as automated interview transcription and analysis, to support the evaluation process. Artificial intelligence is not used to make final hiring decisions; all decisions are made by human reviewers.

To maintain a consistent and fair process for every candidate, Nu does not provide individualized technical feedback. See how our policy works here

jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Nu

Nu serves more than 140 million customers, guided by a mission to fight complexity and empower people. The company has been leading an industry transformation through innovative products and human-centered services.

 

Proprietary technology and data at scale power Nu’s digital platform, built to promote financial access, advancement, and transparency. Its business model thrives on customer love and lower costs, feeding a flywheel of growth and profitability.

Visit our Institutional Page

About the Role

Nu is building crypto products that give millions of customers real, secure financial access — moving assets, interacting with blockchain networks, and managing digital assets safely and simply. As a Senior Staff Software Engineer, you'll be the senior-most technical leader connecting deep crypto and blockchain expertise to what Nu builds for customers, setting the multi-year direction for how we turn protocol-level capabilities into products at scale.

This role requires genuine, hands-on depth in blockchain protocols, custody, signing, and on-chain systems. At the same time, you're expected to reason beyond protocol design: partnering with product and business leaders to decide what Nu builds, how it creates value for customers, and how it fits Nu's broader strategy.

You'll operate across the full stack of crypto product development — from the technical judgment needed to evaluate protocol tradeoffs and security posture, to the product and business judgment needed to prioritize what gets built next. You'll partner closely with the core crypto team on deep technical and security work while driving the product and architectural direction that shapes what customers actually experience.

You'll be responsible for

  • Set multi-year technical and product direction for Nu's crypto systems, grounded in deep expertise in blockchain protocols, on-chain data, custody, signing, and smart-contract integrations.

  • Partner with product and business leaders to define what crypto experiences Nu should build next, weighing technical feasibility, security posture, customer value, and business strategy together.

  • Lead the architecture of highly consequential, security-critical crypto capabilities while remaining hands-on in key technical and protocol-level decisions.

  • Translate deep technical understanding of blockchain systems into concrete product capabilities and customer-facing features, not just infrastructure.

  • Anticipate scalability, reliability, security, and regulatory challenges specific to crypto/blockchain systems, and set standards that raise the bar across teams building on top of your work.

  • Drive complex initiatives across team and organizational boundaries, building alignment among engineering, product, business, risk, and compliance stakeholders.

  • Provide technical leadership through major security incidents or production events involving crypto infrastructure, translating lessons into lasting improvements.

  • Mentor Staff+ engineers and engineering leaders, and serve as one of Nu's technical reference points on crypto and blockchain systems.

We are looking for a person who has

Required

  • Deep, hands-on technical expertise in blockchain and crypto systems — protocols, on-chain data, custody, signing/key management, wallets, asset movement, or smart contracts.

  • A sustained record of Staff+ level technical leadership with impact spanning multiple teams or domains.

  • Demonstrated ability to translate deep protocol/technical understanding into customer-facing product decisions and business outcomes, not just architecture.

  • Experience leading highly complex, ambiguous, security-critical initiatives requiring both technical depth and cross-functional judgment.

  • Ability to reason about business models, product strategy, and market positioning alongside technical tradeoffs.

  • Ability to influence engineering leaders, product leaders, security, risk, and compliance stakeholders without formal authority.

  • A strong record of mentoring senior/staff engineers and raising the quality of technical and product decision-making around them.

  • Exceptional communication skills, with the ability to build alignment across technical and business audiences in high-stakes environments.

Nice to have

  • Experience shaping product or business strategy for crypto or digital-asset offerings specifically, beyond technical architecture.

  • Experience across multiple blockchain networks or protocol families.

  • Experience with HSMs, secure enclaves, or hardware-backed key-management infrastructure.

  • Experience in regulated banking, fintech, payments, or institutional digital assets.

  • Recognition as a technical reference in crypto, blockchain security, or distributed systems.

Location: Palo Alto, United States

As a Lead Software Engineer on our Palo Alto crypto team, you will build the customer-facing mobile and full-stack experiences that bring Nubank's global crypto offering to life - from the first interaction through the services that power it.

Your scope will be a meaningful product area, not a single screen or an isolated service. You will lead team-level technical design, own delivery across mobile and backend boundaries, and make the tradeoffs required to create intuitive experiences without weakening security, correctness, performance, or reliability.

You'll be responsible for

  • Make independent team-level architecture decisions and communicate tradeoffs across usability, security, performance, reliability, and delivery speed.

  • Build resilient transactional experiences with deliberate validation, error handling, recovery paths, testing, and observability.

  • Coordinate dependencies with backend, platform, security, compliance, product, and design partners to move initiatives from ambiguity to production.

  • Mentor engineers and raise the team's standards for mobile architecture, code quality, operational ownership, and customer-centered engineering.

We are looking for a person who has

Required

  • Strong experience building and operating production mobile applications, combined with the ability to work across APIs and backend services, or equivalent full-stack depth with meaningful mobile delivery experience.

  • A track record of independently leading a medium-term engineering initiative from technical design through production operation.

  • Strong foundations in client architecture, state management, API contracts, testing, performance, and reliability.

  • Product judgment and experience simplifying complex or high-stakes workflows for customers.

  • Experience designing and operating transactional or security-sensitive product features.

  • Ability to communicate technical decisions clearly and collaborate effectively with product, design, and engineering partners.

  • Experience mentoring engineers and improving team-level engineering practices.

Nice to have

  • Experience building crypto, wallet, digital-asset, or onchain product experiences.

  • First-hand familiarity with crypto products and user journeys through professional work, building, or sustained personal use.

  • Experience in fintech, payments, banking, or another regulated product environment.

  • Experience delivering products across multiple markets, platforms, or customer contexts.

Palo Alto, United States

  • Opportunity of earning equity at Nu

  • Medical Insurance

  • Life Insurance and AD&D

  • Extended maternity and paternity leaves

  • Nucleo – Our learning platform of courses

  • NuLanguage – Our language learning program

Our Engineering team helps Nu create and scale the technology that powers the best financial products in Latin America. We strive for state-of-the-art software development practices, using a variety of technologies and architectures to build resilient, secure, and highly scalable systems.

  • Participating in on-call rotations for your team and responding to incidents as necessary

  • Focusing primarily on backend applications, while being open to contributing to mobile and frontend development according to business needs

  • Advanced English skills

Mexico City, Mexico.

jobs.title: Senior Product Designer
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Nu

Nu serves more than 140 million customers, guided by a mission to fight complexity and empower people. The company has been leading an industry transformation through innovative products and human-centered services.

 

Proprietary technology and data at scale power Nu’s digital platform, built to promote financial access, advancement, and transparency. Its business model thrives on customer love and lower costs, feeding a flywheel of growth and profitability.

Visit our Institutional Page

The Role

We are looking for a Senior Product Designer (IC5/IC6) to join our Lending New Markets team in Miami or Palo Alto. This is a high-impact, high-visibility role at the center of one of Nubank's most important global expansion efforts.

You will be the primary designer responsible for adapting Nubank's unsecured loan product — already the market leader in Brazil with millions of active users — for the US market and future global launches. This is not a zero-to-one craft exercise from scratch; it is a strategic design challenge. You will figure out how to preserve the quality and essence of a proven product while thoughtfully adapting it to new cultural, regulatory, and competitive contexts.

What You'll Do

- Lead the design strategy and execution for bringing Nubank's lending products to the US market, with the MVP defined by December and delivery beginning in Q4
- Build scalable frameworks and playbooks that allow the team to launch in two new countries per year (currently covering Brazil, Mexico, Colombia, and the US)
- Partner closely with a US-based product manager, a product lead, and a researcher to run discovery, usability testing, and research in Q3
- Navigate complex cross-functional alignment across four countries and multiple time zones, representing design to senior stakeholders in Brazil and the US
- Adapt established Brazilian product experiences for the US market without losing the product-market fit that made them successful
- Work in Figma and leverage modern prototyping tools to communicate and test ideas quickly
- Contribute to the broader Global Lending design community of 25 designers, sharing learnings and frameworks

What We're Looking For

- 5+ years of product design experience with a strong portfolio demonstrating both visual craft and strategic thinking
- A strategic mindset for adaptation and localization: you know how to take something that works in one market and make it thrive in another
- Excellent stakeholder management, communication, and negotiation skills. You are comfortable navigating ambiguity and aligning teams across borders
- Experience running discovery work, usability tests, and user research — or at least a strong appetite for it
- Domain experience in fintech, banking, or lending is ideal but not required. Experience with large US banks, Capital One, SoFi, or similar is a plus
- Proficiency in Figma and modern design workflows
- Comfort working in a high-growth environment with aggressive timelines and senior visibility

Why This Matters

Nubank is already the dominant unsecured lending platform in Brazil. The US market is expected to become one of the company's top five priorities — and Lending will play a central role. You will be the designer owning that scope from the ground up. This is a rare opportunity to take a product that has already won at massive scale and adapt it for one of the world's largest and most competitive financial markets.

Location & Logistics

- Based in Miami, FL or Palo Alto, CA, working hybrid (3 days per week in office) alongside the US Lending team
- The team currently includes a US-based product manager, a product lead, and design/research counterparts in Mexico, with Carolina Perrone (Design Manager, Global Lending) as your hiring manager
- Competitive total compensation including salary and liquid RSUs as a public company
- Target start: Q3 2026 to enable Q4 product delivery

Interview Process

1. Recruiter screen with Alex Libre
2. Asynchronous portfolio review
3. Live portfolio presentation + business case exercise with senior design leaders
4. Hiring manager interview with Carolina Perrone
5. Possible additional final interview

Our recruitment process may involve the use of artificial intelligence–enabled tools, such as automated interview transcription and analysis, to support the evaluation process. Artificial intelligence is not used to make final hiring decisions; all decisions are made by human reviewers.

To maintain a consistent and fair process for every candidate, Nu does not provide individualized technical feedback. See how our policy works here

jobs.title: Senior Security Engineer (Blockchain Security)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Nu

Nu serves more than 140 million customers, guided by a mission to fight complexity and empower people. The company has been leading an industry transformation through innovative products and human-centered services.

 

Proprietary technology and data at scale power Nu’s digital platform, built to promote financial access, advancement, and transparency. Its business model thrives on customer love and lower costs, feeding a flywheel of growth and profitability.

Visit our Institutional Page

About the role

The Blockchain Security team sits within the Product Security & Assurance BA, part of the Information Technology and Security (ITSec) BU. Our mission is to support the security of Nu's crypto operation. In the context of Nu's global expansion, keeping these products secure, and demonstrably compliant with financial regulators, is a direct condition for our ability to operate and grow.

As a Senior Security Engineer on this team, you own the security posture of our crypto operation. You are the person who thinks like an attacker so our products can withstand real ones: finding vulnerabilities before adversaries do, embedding product security into how crypto products are designed and built, and making sure our controls satisfy both internal risk standards and external regulatory requirements. You won't just run security tools. You'll build and operate the ones that protect our crypto products, from hardened ingress and monitoring/alerting systems to secure secret-management and automated security-review tooling. Your work directly protects customer funds and Nu's ability to run crypto products at scale.

 

You'll be responsible for

  • Applying an offensive security mindset to our crypto and blockchain products: simulating attacks, running penetration tests and security assessments, and turning findings into concrete mitigations.

  • Driving product security across the crypto portfolio: threat modeling, security-by-design reviews, and embedding secure practices into the development lifecycle.

  • Building, operating, and improving in-house security services and tooling that integrate directly with our crypto products, for example hardened ingress/edge controls, security monitoring and anomaly alerting, secure secret-management, and automated security-review tooling.

  • Ensuring our crypto operation meets regulatory requirements: mapping controls to applicable regulations, supporting audits, and producing the evidence regulators and internal risk teams expect.

  • Collaborating with product and engineering teams to design secure blockchain architecture and embed security-by-design into new products.

  • Contributing to security policies, standards, and guidelines that govern blockchain security operations.

  • Using AI to raise the leverage and quality of security work: building and running AI-assisted tooling for tasks like threat modeling, code and vulnerability review, and attack simulation, and helping the team push the frontier of what AI-first security engineering looks like.

  • Staying current on emerging attack vectors, exploits, and best practices across product and blockchain security, and sharing that knowledge across the team.

We are looking for a person who has

Must have

  • Strong product security and/or offensive security background (penetration testing, vulnerability assessment, attack simulation, incident response).

  • Experience embedding security into product development: threat modeling, secure SDLC, security-by-design reviews.

  • Hands-on software engineering ability: you can build and operate security services and automation, not just use off-the-shelf tools. Comfortable writing production code (we work heavily in Clojure; strong experience in any modern language plus willingness to learn Clojure is fine).

  • Solid working knowledge of blockchain and cryptocurrency fundamentals, including how blockchains, wallets, keys, and smart contracts work, enough to reason about their security (expert-level depth not required, but real familiarity is).

  • Strong knowledge of recent and past attack vectors and exploits, and how to remediate them.

About Nu

Nu serves more than 140 million customers, guided by a mission to fight complexity and empower people. The company has been leading an industry transformation through innovative products and human-centered services.

 

Proprietary technology and data at scale power Nu’s digital platform, built to promote financial access, advancement, and transparency. Its business model thrives on customer love and lower costs, feeding a flywheel of growth and profitability.

Visit our Institutional Page


About the role

At AI Core, we are scaling the impact of our AI initiatives to become the primary driver of Nubank’s most critical decision systems. We are seeking  Machine Learning Engineers to lead high-impact research projects that bridge the gap between state-of-the-art AI and production-grade financial systems. You will be responsible for solving complex, ambiguous problems using Deep Learning and Foundation Models, ensuring our architectures are scalable, efficient, and driving measurable business results.

As an Machine Learning Engineer (MLE), you’re expected to:

  1. Research Execution & Technical Leadership (Complexity & Autonomy)

  • Lead and execute complex applied research initiatives independently, focusing on building and optimizing architectures (e.g., Transformers, GNNs) that can be deployed across critical use cases like Credit, RecSys, GenAI, and real-time inference.

  • Address difficult and ambiguous modeling problems that require coordination across various stakeholders (Data, Infra, Product), delivering innovative solutions with a clear focus on medium-term impact.

  • Bridge the gap between research and production by designing architectures that respect MLOps constraints, ensuring models are optimized for latency, interpretability, and cost-efficiency.

  1. Strategic Impact & Collaboration (Impact)

  • Develop and deliver innovative solutions that address project-level challenges, focusing on pushing the latest platform and AI research improvements into downstream production models.

  • Actively participate in cross-functional collaborations, ensuring that research outputs are seamlessly integrated into Nubank's decision-making engines.

  • Establish technical standards within the AI Core team for experimentation, model evaluation, and code quality, inspiring peers to raise their performance.

  1. Mentorship & Function Contribution (Function Contribution)

  • Serve as a technical mentor for senior engineers and researchers, providing guidance on deep learning fundamentals, problem formulation, and research methodology.

  • Actively contribute to the function's growth by participating in mandatory activities like hiring (interview panels) and leading internal task forces to improve our ML lifecycle.

  • Contribute to thought leadership by participating in research collaborations or internal papers that align with Nubank’s strategic goals.

What are we looking for?

  • Professional Experience: 5-7+ years in applied AI/ML, with a proven track record of delivering research-driven systems into production environments

  • Technical Mastery:

    • Deep expertise in Deep Learning architectures (Transformers, Multimodal, or GNNs).

    • Strong coding skills in Python and proficiency with frameworks like PyTorch, JAX, or TensorFlow.

    • Solid understanding of MLOps and the constraints of deploying models at scale.

  • Problem Solving: Sophisticated skills in ML problem formulation and the ability to navigate uncertainty when data is messy or unavailable.

  • Communication: Ability to communicate complex technical concepts to both technical peers and cross-functional stakeholders, ensuring alignment and buy-in.

  • Analytical Capacity: Experience with large-scale experimentation and A/B testing to validate research hypotheses.

Our Benefits

  • Opportunity of earning equity at Nu

  • Total compensation includes base salary, RSUs and benefits. Base salary range: $230k - $345k

  • Medical Insurance

  • Dental and Vision Insurance

  • Life Insurance and AD&D

  • Extended maternity and paternity leaves 

  • Nucleo - Our learning platform of courses

  • NuLanguage - Our language learning program

  • NuCare - Our mental health and wellness assistance program

  • Extended maternity and paternity leaves 

  • 401K

  • Saving Plans - Health Saving Account and Flexible Spending Account

  • Work-from-home Allowance

  • Relocation Assistance Package, if applicable.

Palo Alto, California

To maintain a consistent and fair process for every candidate, Nu does not provide individualized technical feedback. See how our policy works here

jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Nu

Nu serves more than 140 million customers, guided by a mission to fight complexity and empower people. The company has been leading an industry transformation through innovative products and human-centered services.

 

Proprietary technology and data at scale power Nu’s digital platform, built to promote financial access, advancement, and transparency. Its business model thrives on customer love and lower costs, feeding a flywheel of growth and profitability.

Visit our Institutional Page

About the role

Our Engineering team helps Nu create and scale the technology that powers the best financial products in Latin America. We strive for state-of-the-art software development practices, using a variety of technologies and architectures to build resilient, secure, and highly scalable systems.

As a Lead Software Engineer, you will play a key role in shaping the technical direction of multiple teams, driving the design and evolution of large-scale distributed systems that serve millions of customers. While we value experience with our tech stack, we are confident that engineers who are eager to learn will be successful here — and we will teach you Clojure as our main backend language.

You will build and evolve:

  • Horizontally scalable microservices written mostly in Clojure, using Finagle and leveraging functional programming techniques and hexagonal architecture

  • High-throughput jobs and inter-service communication using Kafka

  • Continuous Integration and Deployment pipelines on AWS

  • Data storage solutions using Datomic and DynamoDB

  • Monitoring and observability with Prometheus

  • Services running as much as possible in Kubernetes

We are a process-light organization that values human interactions. We work in small, independent teams that feel like startups within the company and avoid unnecessary coupling and centralization whenever realistic. We understand that execution is key to success and continuously optimize our processes to remove bottlenecks.

You'll be responsible for

  • Working with large-scale distributed systems and understanding their broad architecture and trade-offs

  • Setting technical direction for multiple teams, ensuring alignment with Business Areas and architecture strategies

  • Driving pragmatic innovation while ensuring resilient, secure, and flexible solutions that scale across products and geographies

  • Mentoring engineers across teams and helping maintain a high technical bar organization-wide

  • Writing, testing, instrumenting, documenting, and maintaining high-quality code

  • Pairing and participating in code reviews to support the growth of others in and around your teams

  • Collaborating closely with Product, Design, and Engineering leaders to build new end-to-end experiences

  • Ensuring comprehensive observability, performance monitoring, and robust error handling across team services

  • Participating in on-call rotations for your team and responding to incidents as necessary

  • Focusing primarily on backend applications, while being open to contributing to mobile and frontend development according to business needs

We are looking for a person who has

  • At least 8 years of experience developing digital products in complex environments

  • Deep expertise in distributed systems, microservices architecture, and cloud technologies

  • A proven track record of designing and delivering large-scale systems that serve thousands or millions of users

  • A strong background in object-oriented or functional programming languages, with the ability to work across multiple languages

  • Demonstrated ability to lead technical initiatives across multiple teams, even without direct authority

  • Experience mentoring senior engineers and raising the technical bar across organizations

  • Practical knowledge of agile software development methodologies and prior experience with CI/CD

  • Strong communication skills to identify and prevent risks, and explain trade-offs clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders

  • Advanced English skills

Location

Bogotá, Colombia.

 

Our Benefits

Our benefits are designed to support your wellbeing, development, and life outside of work. For Colombia, they include:

  • Chance of earning equity at Nu

  • Extended maternity and paternity leaves

  • Health and life insurance

  • NuCare – our mental health and wellness assistance program

  • Nucleo – our learning platform of courses

  • NuLanguage – our language learning program

  • Vacations of 15 workdays

  • Gym partnership

  • Work-from-home Allowance

  • Parental Consultancy

  • Relocation Assistance Package, if applicable

Even if you feel you don't meet every qualification, we encourage you to apply — your unique skills and experiences may be just what we're looking for, and we're excited to learn more about what you can bring to our team.


Work Model for this Role

Hybrid 2–3 times/week: Our hybrid work model brings us to the office at least twice a week, on strategic days designed to maximize team connection and collaboration. For more details, visit  https://building.nubank.com/nu-hybrid-work-model/.

Our recruitment process may involve the use of artificial intelligence–enabled tools, such as automated interview transcription and analysis, to support the evaluation process. Artificial intelligence is not used to make final hiring decisions; all decisions are made by human reviewers.

To maintain a consistent and fair process for every candidate, Nu does not provide individualized technical feedback. See how our policy works here

About Nu

Nu serves more than 140 million customers, guided by a mission to fight complexity and empower people. The company has been leading an industry transformation through innovative products and human-centered services.

 

Proprietary technology and data at scale power Nu’s digital platform, built to promote financial access, advancement, and transparency. Its business model thrives on customer love and lower costs, feeding a flywheel of growth and profitability.

Visit our Institutional Page


About the role

As a team who drives product development from ideation to full rollout, the Design team ensures that our product experiences are valuable to our users. Designers at Nubank must deal with complex problems and transform them into intuitive, accessible and easy-to-use experiences for millions of people.
At each stage, a Designer must anticipate our customers and business needs, advocate for our users and ensure that the final design surprises and delights them. Achieving this goal requires collaboration with teams of Designers, Researchers, Business Analysts, Software Engineers, Product Managers and many other, working in projects that go from user interviews and prototypes to internal tools and brand assets.
Given this, designers must be flexible and eager to learn - it's unlikely that you'll arrive an expert in all tools and project phases, but you should be humble and have a strong desire and capacity to learn. It's critical that you are able to collaborate with people with varying backgrounds, give good feedback and apply critical feedback received. The combination of these skills along with your talent and technical competence as a designer can make you a great fit for the Nubank Design team.

Once here, you will:

  • Be a technical reference for the team, seeking to adapt and replicate the best practices in the market, increasing the team’s bar;

  • Build links with other business areas at all levels of the organization, influencing business decisions advocating for user-centered design;

  • Inspire fellow product designers, by creating a high bar of quality design work;

  • Establish and promote a healthy team culture that works hand in hand with cross-functional partners and design teams in other Nubank offices;

  • Push the boundaries of your team’s UX/UI/visual execution and help Nubank challenge the status quo.

Requirements

  • Solid expertise in Product Design (UI, UX, and Research);

  • Experience in digital products;

  • Ability to work well in a highly collaborative and cross-functional team;

  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, dynamic startup environment;

  • Ability to influence prioritization in an agile environment. Adapt to shifting priorities and evolving stakeholder’s needs with openness and agility.

 

Our benefits

  • Top Tier Medical Insurance

  • Top Tier Dental and Vision Insurance

  • 20 days time off and 14 company holidays. 

  • Life Insurance and AD&D

  • Extended maternity and paternity leaves 

  • Nucleo - Our learning platform of courses

  • NuLanguage - Our language learning program

  • NuCare - Our mental health and wellness assistance program

  • Extended maternity and paternity leaves 

  • 401K

  • Saving Plans - Health Saving Account and Flexible Spending Account

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Nu

Nu serves more than 140 million customers, guided by a mission to fight complexity and empower people. The company has been leading an industry transformation through innovative products and human-centered services.

 

Proprietary technology and data at scale power Nu’s digital platform, built to promote financial access, advancement, and transparency. Its business model thrives on customer love and lower costs, feeding a flywheel of growth and profitability.

Visit our Institutional Page

Engineering at Nubank

At Nubank, software engineers sit at the intersection of data, intelligence, and scale. We build systems that process millions of decisions daily, from fraud detection to credit modeling and increasingly, we do this powered by AI. Machine learning is embedded across our core products: in how we assess risk, personalize experiences, and automate decisions at scale. Engineers here don't just consume AI capabilities; they help shape how intelligence is built, deployed, and maintained in production.

We do it with engineering rigor, autonomy, and a deep focus on impact. Our engineers work across the full spectrum: designing data pipelines and architectures, deploying and maintaining ML models in production, and building the distributed systems and platforms that power our products. We value small, independent teams that move fast, own their decisions end-to-end, and hold themselves to a high bar for quality and craft.

We strive for state-of-the-art software development practices across our entire stack. While we value candidates familiar with our technologies, we're confident that engineers who join Nubank will learn and grow alongside our team:

  • Horizontally scalable microservices written mostly in Clojure, leveraging functional programming and hexagonal architecture

  • High-throughput event-driven architectures for inter-service communication

  • Continuous Integration and Deployment into cloud-native infrastructure

  • Distributed transactional systems built on Datomic, modeling complex business domains with immutable data and strong consistency

  • Modern data platforms built on ETL/ELT best practices, with robust monitoring and observability

Our Software Engineers

  • Work with large scale distributed systems

  • Collaborate with building microservices

  • Design, build and maintain robust data pipelines, distributed systems and ML-enabled solutions, ensuring reliability, scalability and performance at scale

  • Deploy and maintain ML models in both batch and real-time scenarios, integrating them with other systems and monitoring through operational and business metrics

  • Lead data and engineering projects end-to-end — from requirements gathering and stakeholder alignment to delivery and iteration

  • Contribute to the design, documentation, maintenance and optimization of our data codebase, platforms and tooling

  • Translate business needs into data products and technical solutions aligned with Nubank's architecture and long-term strategy

  • Partner with technical and business stakeholders to define strategies and deliver high-impact solutions

  • Share knowledge, mentor peers and contribute to engineering and data literacy initiatives across Nubank

What We're Looking For

  • Programming experience in one or more general-purpose languages (e.g. Python, Clojure, Scala, Java)

  • Familiarity with analytical data environments and data engineering concepts: pipelines, ETL/ELT, data modeling and storage

  • Understanding of ML model lifecycle, from training and evaluation to deployment and monitoring

  • Familiarity with distributed systems, microservices and asynchronous architectures

  • Strong communication skills to collaborate with both technical and business stakeholders

  • Passion for building high-quality software and data products

Nice to Have

  • Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS, GCP or Azure

  • Knowledge of data architecture patterns (Data Lake, Data Warehouse, Data Mart)

  • Familiarity with ML frameworks and feature engineering pipelines

  • Experience with data visualization tools (Looker, Power BI, Tableau or similar)

  • Knowledge of software engineering best practices: testing, clean code, documentation

Our Benefits

  • Chance of earning equity at Nubank

  • Food/Meal Card (Vale-Refeição and/or Vale Alimentação)

  • Public Transportation Commuting Benefit (Vale-Transporte)

  • NuCare – Psychological, Financial and Legal Assistance Program

  • Life Insurance, Medical Plan and Dental Plan

  • NuLanguage – Language Course Program

  • Nucleo – Our learning platform

  • Extended Parental Leave, Daycare Allowance and Parental Consultancy

  • Work-from-home Allowance

  • Gym Partnerships

  • 30 days of paid vacation

  • Relocation Assistance Package, if applicable

Work Model

Hybrid 2–3 times/week: Our hybrid work model brings us to the office at least twice a week, on strategic days designed to maximize team connection and collaboration.

For more details, visit https://building.nubank.com/nu-hybrid-work-model/

Our recruitment process may involve the use of artificial intelligence–enabled tools, such as automated interview transcription and analysis, to support the evaluation process. Artificial intelligence is not used to make final hiring decisions; all decisions are made by human reviewers.

To maintain a consistent and fair process for every candidate, Nu does not provide individualized technical feedback. See how our policy works here

  • Leading technical direction for your team and partnering with adjacent teams to keep solutions aligned with our architecture and business strategy

  • Driving pragmatic innovation while ensuring resilient, secure, and flexible solutions that scale across products and geographies

  • Mentoring engineers within and around your team and helping maintain a high technical bar

  • Writing, testing, instrumenting, documenting, and maintaining high-quality code

  • Pairing and participating in code reviews to support the growth of others in and around your team

  • Collaborating closely with Product, Design, and Engineering leaders to build new end-to-end experiences

  • Ensuring comprehensive observability, performance monitoring, and robust error handling across your team’s services

  • Participating in on-call rotations for your team and responding to incidents as necessary

  • Focusing primarily on backend applications

We are looking for a person who has

  • At least 6 years of experience developing digital products in complex environments

  • Deep expertise in distributed systems, microservices architecture, and cloud technologies

  • A proven track record of designing and delivering large-scale systems that serve thousands or millions of users

  • Demonstrated ability to lead technical initiatives end-to-end within a team and in collaboration with partner teams

Mexico City, Mexico.

jobs.title: Senior Business Analyst
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Nu

Nu serves more than 140 million customers, guided by a mission to fight complexity and empower people. The company has been leading an industry transformation through innovative products and human-centered services.

 

Proprietary technology and data at scale power Nu’s digital platform, built to promote financial access, advancement, and transparency. Its business model thrives on customer love and lower costs, feeding a flywheel of growth and profitability.

Visit our Institutional Page


Business Analysts at Nubank
As a company at the forefront of the financial revolution in Latin America, Nubank has experienced exponential growth since its inception. To keep that growth healthy and people-centered, we constantly need to make critical, data-informed decisions — and Business Analysts are at the heart of that process.
BAs work collaboratively across teams to structure and analyze data, challenge assumptions, and translate findings into real improvements in our customers' experience. You'll have the support of a highly qualified, diverse team, and plenty of room to grow.
We're looking for people who are curious, proactive, and energized by solving complex problems — not necessarily those with all the answers, but those who know how to find them.
You can read more about it in our blog and get some insights into how we work.

As a Business Analyst, you're expected to:

  • Do investigative work focused on deciding which data makes the most sense to use in each situation — and when the data isn't there yet, design the right tests or approaches to get it

  • Work closely with your team to support data-based decisions, ensuring project flow and making the process of taking calculated risks comfortable despite uncertainties

  • Work with large volumes of data to build a solid foundation for decision-making — knowing that not all answers are in the data, and that's okay

  • Use tools like SQL, Python, and Scala for data extraction and analysis — no prior experience needed, we teach these in your first weeks

  • Understand our products and how they interact with other areas of the business

  • Learn continuously from a well-prepared and highly qualified team

  • Work in a complex, dynamic, and diverse environment on projects that will impact a large number of customers


What we're looking for:

  • Analytical capacity: comfort with numbers and calculations, and the ability to solve problems methodically

  • Business basics: understanding the dynamics between risks and opportunities, and how business and technical areas (products/engineering) interact

  • Problem solving: creativity and practicality in finding solutions to day-to-day challenges

  • Awareness of how your decisions and work impact our customers' experience, seeking results that align with our purpose

  • Willingness to learn, especially when it comes to new tools — no coding experience required before joining

  • Openness to receive feedback and incorporate it into your development

  • Adaptability to a multifunctional environment

  • A profile that adds value to Nubank's culture


Our Benefits

  • Extended Parental Leave and Daycare Allowance for all parents

  • Parental Consultancy

  • NuCare – Psychological, Financial and Legal Assistance Program

  • Medical Plan, Dental Plan, and Life Insurance

  • Work-from-home Allowance

  • NuLanguage – Language Course Program

  • Nucleo – Our internal learning platform

  • Food/Meal Card (Vale-Refeição and/or Vale Alimentação)

  • Public Transportation Commuting Benefit (Vale-Transporte)

  • Gym Partnerships

  • 30 days of paid vacation

  • Chance of earning equity at Nubank

  • Relocation Assistance Package, if applicable


Work Model for this Role
Hybrid 2–3 times/week: Our hybrid work model brings us to the office at least twice a week, on strategic days designed to maximize team connection and collaboration. For more details, visit https://building.nubank.com/nu-hybrid-work-model/

Our recruitment process may involve the use of artificial intelligence–enabled tools, such as automated interview transcription and analysis, to support the evaluation process. Artificial intelligence is not used to make final hiring decisions; all decisions are made by human reviewers.

To maintain a consistent and fair process for every candidate, Nu does not provide individualized technical feedback. See how our policy works here

You can read more about it in our blog https://building.nubank.com.br and get some insights into how we work.

 

As a Business Analyst, you’re expected to:

 - Do a lot of investigative work, focused on deciding which data makes the most sense to use in which situation. If you don't have the data, it's your job to think about what tests can be done or how to extract the information you need to answer your questions;

 - Support your team in making data-based decisions by monitoring analysis and decisions, ensuring the flow of projects and making the process of taking risks comfortable despite the uncertainties;

 - Learning how to work with a large volume of data to build a solid foundation for decision making with calculated risks - even knowing that not all the answers are in the data and/or that not all the data you would like is available;Use tools like SQL, Python and Scala - taught during your first weeks with us - for data extraction;

 - Understand our products and interactions with other areas;

 - Take advantage of opportunities to grow and learn from a well-prepared and highly qualified team;

 - Opportunity to work in a complex, dynamic and diverse environment, participating in projects that will impact a large number of clients.

 What are we looking for?

 - Analytical capacity: ease with numbers and calculations, having the ability to solve problems mathematically;

 - Business basics: dynamics between risks and opportunities, as well as interaction between business areas and technical areas (products/engineering);

 - Problem solving: ease and creativity to seek solutions to day-to-day challenges and achieve the best results;

 - Ability to understand how your decisions and work impact our customers' experience, seeking results that align with our purpose;

 - Willingness and ease of learning, especially for tools;

 - Openness to receive feedback and incorporate it into your daily life and development;

 - Adaptability to the multifunctional environment;

 - Profiles that add value to Nubank's culture.

Our Benefits

 - Chance of earning equity at Nubank

 - Food/ Meal Card (Vale-Refeição and/or Vale Alimentação)

 - Public Transportation Commuting Benefit (Vale-Transporte)

 - NuCare – Psychological, Financial and Legal Assistance Program

 - Life Insurance

 - Medical Plan

 - Dental Plan

 - NuLanguage – Language Course Program

 - Nucleo - Our learning platform of courses

 - Extended Parental Leave

 - Daycare Allowance

 - Parental Consultancy

 - Work-from-home Allowance

 - Gym Partnerships

 - 30 days of paid vacation

 - Relocation Assistance Package, if applicable


WORK MODEL FOR THIS ROLE

Hybrid 2-3 times/week: Our hybrid work model brings us to the office at least twice a week, on strategic days designed to maximize team connection and collaboration. For more details, visit https://building.nubank.com/nu-hybrid-work-model/
