jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Nu

Nu serves more than 140 million customers, guided by a mission to fight complexity and empower people. The company has been leading an industry transformation through innovative products and human-centered services.

 

Proprietary technology and data at scale power Nu’s digital platform, built to promote financial access, advancement, and transparency. Its business model thrives on customer love and lower costs, feeding a flywheel of growth and profitability.

Visit our Institutional Page

About the Team

The Non-Financial Risk (NFR) Brazil team is responsible for identifying, assessing, monitoring, and challenging non-financial risks across the organization, including operational, technology, cybersecurity, and third-party risks. The Internal Controls team is responsible to independently assess the environment and act as the second line of defense, to ensure that risk is managed proactively, effectively, and in alignment with internal policies and regulatory expectations.

About the Role

We are looking for a highly analytical and strategic Internal Controls Senior Specialist to support key initiatives of the Control Testing Hub, lead the Enterprise Risk Management in Brazil along coordination of Regulatory Reports.

In the Control Testing Hub, the focus will be on designing and executing control testing strategies that assess the effectiveness of risk mitigations in risk management areas. This includes evaluating results, collaborating with risk owners, and enabling improvements through data-driven insights. For Enterprise Risk Management, it will be required a good understanding of COSO framework application, supporting maturing the foundations of control environment oversight along with creation of KPIs and monitoring metrics.

The ideal candidate should have experience in risk governance, strong analytical skills, and the ability to translate complex risk scenarios into actionable recommendations. This position involves interacting with senior stakeholders and presenting risk assessments and key metrics in executive forums. If you are passionate about control effectiveness, innovation with responsibility, and building resilient systems, this is the perfect opportunity for you.

What We're Looking For Someone Who Has

  • Bachelor’s degree in Technology, Business Administration, Industrial Engineering, Risk Management, or related field.

  • Minimum of 8+ years of experience leading with risk management in a complex environment.

  • Strong knowledge of risk management, governance, and data analysis (ETL environment, Programming language such as SQL, scala, etc).

  • Excellent analytical, communication, and problem-solving skills.

  • Ability to work independently and collaboratively with cross-functional teams

  • Operate with limited direct supervision and exercise independence of judgment and autonomy.

  • Experience with regulatory compliance and corporate governance standards.

  • Strong knowledge of Control Testing and Monitoring throughout substantive tests.

  • Experience with Governance, Risk, and Compliance (GRC) systems, JIRA tool and agile methodology.

  • Experience in financial institutions is desirable.

  • COSO ERM and ICIF application knowledge

  • AI tools familiarity

  • Fluent in English.

São Paulo, Brazil

Work model

Hybrid

jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer - Digital Experience Platform
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Nu

Nu serves more than 140 million customers, guided by a mission to fight complexity and empower people. The company has been leading an industry transformation through innovative products and human-centered services.

 

Proprietary technology and data at scale power Nu’s digital platform, built to promote financial access, advancement, and transparency. Its business model thrives on customer love and lower costs, feeding a flywheel of growth and profitability.

Visit our Institutional Page

About the role

The Digital Experience Platform (DXP) is Nubank’s AI-first platform ecosystem designed to radically compress our product development workflow from concept to production.

Today, building “Magic App”-quality experiences in our Backend-Driven Content (BDC) stack takes ~49 working days and ~24 handoff-heavy steps — DXP exists to close this Creation Gap and Workflow Gap by making AI-native tooling the default way we design, build, and ship experiences.

We are building four core products: DXP Studio (an AI-powered creation environment that turns Figma designs into production-ready BDC code), DXP Dictionary (the curated knowledge base that makes AI agents “Nu-aware”), DXP Spec Protocol (our vendor-agnostic abstraction layer), and DXP Workflow (an orchestration platform for hybrid human + AI agent teams across the product lifecycle).

As a Staff Software Engineer – DXP, you will be the technical leader and multiplier for this initiative: shaping the architecture of an AI-native platform, driving critical decisions across the Figma-to-BDC pipeline and agent orchestration, and partnering closely with Product, Design, and Engineering leadership to prove value and scale the platform company-wide.

We’re looking for someone genuinely addicted to AI — who obsessively explores new models, agent frameworks, and AI-powered tools, and can turn that passion into leverage for thousands of Nubank engineers.

You’ll be responsible for

  • Architect the DXP Studio pipeline: Design and lead the end-to-end architecture for the Figma → DXP Spec → BDC code generation flow, ensuring vendor-agnostic abstractions (DXP Spec Protocol), NuDS component fidelity, and production-ready output quality.

  • Lead AI agent integration & orchestration: Define how AI agents (codegen, QA, design-mapping, etc.) are composed, executed, and supervised inside DXP; drive decisions on LLM provider abstraction, context-assembly strategies, MCP tool surfaces, and execution environments.

  • Own the DXP Dictionary and knowledge architecture: Architect the knowledge base that turns generic AI into Nubank-aware agents — how NuDS specs, tokens, canonical patterns and domain knowledge are ingested, structured, and consumed by generation and validation pipelines.

  • Drive cross-platform integration: Lead the technical integration model with NuDS (component catalog & tokens), BDC/Core (patterns & services), HPP (widget / homepage infrastructure), and App Excellence (observability & quality metrics), defining clear contracts that position DXP as an orchestrator on top of existing platforms.

  • Establish quality-at-generation-time: Design automated quality enforcement for generated experiences — NuDS compliance, token correctness, accessibility rules, structural integrity, golden tests — so governance happens by default at generation time, not via manual post-hoc review.

  • Set technical strategy and roadmap: Contribute to the 6–18 month technical strategy for DXP, translating strategic bets into executable plans, identifying architectural risks and trade-offs between POCs and long-term scalability.

  • Multiply engineering excellence: Mentor engineers within DXP and partner teams (NuDS, BDC, Mobile Platform), lead design reviews and RFCs, and raise the bar for AI-augmented development practices across Nubank.

We are looking for a person who has

Must Have

  • Genuine obsession with AI tools and workflows — deep, hands-on, daily experience with LLMs, AI agents and modern AI-powered dev tools (e.g., Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot, custom agents, MCP servers); you are the person who has tried new tools before others even ask about them.

  • Strong software architecture skills, with experience designing multi-component platform systems that integrate AI/LLM capabilities into production workflows.

  • Deep understanding of design-to-code pipelines, design systems or component-driven UI development, ideally bridging design tooling (e.g., Figma) and code generation.

  • Practical experience with AI/LLM integration in software products: prompt engineering, agent orchestration, context management, RAG architectures and/or MCP tool development.

  • Proven ability to lead cross-functional technical initiatives involving multiple teams and stakeholders, driving alignment and delivery in ambiguous environments.

  • Excellent communication skills, translating complex architectural decisions into clear narratives for Product, Design and senior leadership.

  • Product-minded mindset, balancing technical excellence with pragmatic delivery — comfortable proving value via POCs before scaling platform capabilities.

  • Experience with Nubank’s stack or similar patterns: BDC (Backend-Driven Content), and broader mobile/frontend ecosystems.

Will be a Plus

  • Experience with Flutter at the intersection of design systems and code generation.

  • Hands-on experience building or integrating AI coding agents (e.g., Claude Code, Devin, Cursor) into team workflows.

  • Familiarity with workflow orchestration platforms, agent farms or multi-agent systems.

  • Understanding of analytical architectures, experimentation platforms, feature flags and progressive rollout strategies for generated experiences.

  • Prior experience productizing internal developer tools or platforms that serve large engineering orgs.

  • Contributions to open-source AI developer tools or active presence in the AI-for-developers community.

Location for this opportunity

This role can be based in one of the following hubs:

  • Toronto, Canada

  • São Paulo, Brazil

  • Rio de Janeiro, Brazil

  • Campinas, Brazil

  • Belo Horizonte, Brazil 

Work Model for this Role

  • Hybrid 2–3 times/week: Our hybrid work model brings us to the office at least twice a week, on strategic days designed to maximize team connection and collaboration. For more details, visit  https://building.nubank.com/nu-hybrid-work-model/

Our Benefits – Global Roles

For global, multi-location roles like this, our benefits package is competitive in each country and generally includes:

  • Competitive compensation and the opportunity of earning equity at Nu

  • Health / Medical Insurance

  • Life Insurance (and AD&D where applicable)

  • Extended maternity and paternity leaves

  • Nucleo – our learning platform of courses

  • NuLanguage – our language learning program

  • NuCare – our mental health and wellness assistance program

  • Paid time off and local holidays

  • Retirement / savings plans (e.g., 401(k), HSA/FSA in the US; country-specific plans elsewhere)

  • Work-from-home allowance

  • Relocation assistance package, if applicable

Details for each location will be shared during the process, aligned with local regulations and practices.

Join us

If you want to define how an AI-native bank designs and ships product experiences — turning agentic workflows, design systems and code generation into everyday tools for hundreds of teams — we’d love to hear from you.

We are building four core products: DXP Studio (an AI-powered creation environment that turns Figma designs into production-ready BDC code), DXP Dictionary (the curated knowledge base that makes AI agents “Nu-aware”), DXP Spec Protocol (our vendor-agnostic abstraction layer), and DXP Workflow (an orchestration platform for hybrid human + AI agent teams across the product lifecycle).

As a Staff Software Engineer – DXP, you will be the technical leader and multiplier for this initiative: shaping the architecture of an AI-native platform, driving critical decisions across the Figma-to-BDC pipeline and agent orchestration, and partnering closely with Product, Design, and Engineering leadership to prove value and scale the platform company-wide.

We’re looking for someone genuinely addicted to AI — who obsessively explores new models, agent frameworks, and AI-powered tools, and can turn that passion into leverage for thousands of Nubank engineers.


YOU’LL BE RESPONSIBLE FOR

 - Architect the DXP Studio pipeline: Design and lead the end-to-end architecture for the Figma → DXP Spec → BDC code generation flow, ensuring vendor-agnostic abstractions (DXP Spec Protocol), NuDS component fidelity, and production-ready output quality.

 - Lead AI agent integration & orchestration: Define how AI agents (codegen, QA, design-mapping, etc.) are composed, executed, and supervised inside DXP; drive decisions on LLM provider abstraction, context-assembly strategies, MCP tool surfaces, and execution environments.

 - Own the DXP Dictionary and knowledge architecture: Architect the knowledge base that turns generic AI into Nubank-aware agents — how NuDS specs, tokens, canonical patterns and domain knowledge are ingested, structured, and consumed by generation and validation pipelines.

 - Drive cross-platform integration: Lead the technical integration model with NuDS (component catalog & tokens), BDC/Core (patterns & services), HPP (widget / homepage infrastructure), and App Excellence (observability & quality metrics), defining clear contracts that position DXP as an orchestrator on top of existing platforms.

 - Establish quality-at-generation-time: Design automated quality enforcement for generated experiences — NuDS compliance, token correctness, accessibility rules, structural integrity, golden tests — so governance happens by default at generation time, not via manual post-hoc review.

 - Set technical strategy and roadmap: Contribute to the 6–18 month technical strategy for DXP, translating strategic bets into executable plans, identifying architectural risks and trade-offs between POCs and long-term scalability.

 - Multiply engineering excellence: Mentor engineers within DXP and partner teams (NuDS, BDC, Mobile Platform), lead design reviews and RFCs, and raise the bar for AI-augmented development practices across Nubank.


WE ARE LOOKING FOR A PERSON WHO HAS

Must Have

 - Genuine obsession with AI tools and workflows — deep, hands-on, daily experience with LLMs, AI agents and modern AI-powered dev tools (e.g., Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot, custom agents, MCP servers); you are the person who has tried new tools before others even ask about them.

 - Strong software architecture skills, with experience designing multi-component platform systems that integrate AI/LLM capabilities into production workflows.

 - Deep understanding of design-to-code pipelines, design systems or component-driven UI development, ideally bridging design tooling (e.g., Figma) and code generation.

 - Practical experience with AI/LLM integration in software products: prompt engineering, agent orchestration, context management, RAG architectures and/or MCP tool development.

 - Proven ability to lead cross-functional technical initiatives involving multiple teams and stakeholders, driving alignment and delivery in ambiguous environments.

 - Excellent communication skills, translating complex architectural decisions into clear narratives for Product, Design and senior leadership.

 - Product-minded mindset, balancing technical excellence with pragmatic delivery — comfortable proving value via POCs before scaling platform capabilities.

 - Experience with Nubank’s stack or similar patterns: BDC (Backend-Driven Content), and broader mobile/frontend ecosystems.

Will be a Plus

 - Experience with Flutter at the intersection of design systems and code generation.

 - Hands-on experience building or integrating AI coding agents (e.g., Claude Code, Devin, Cursor) into team workflows.

 - Familiarity with workflow orchestration platforms, agent farms or multi-agent systems.

 - Understanding of analytical architectures, experimentation platforms, feature flags and progressive rollout strategies for generated experiences.

 - Prior experience productizing internal developer tools or platforms that serve large engineering orgs.

 - Contributions to open-source AI developer tools or active presence in the AI-for-developers community.


LOCATION FOR THIS OPPORTUNITY

This role can be based in one of the following hubs:

 - Toronto, Canada

 - São Paulo, Brazil

 - Rio de Janeiro, Brazil

 - Campinas, Brazil

 - Belo Horizonte, Brazil 


WORK MODEL FOR THIS ROLE

For global, multi-location roles like this, our benefits package is competitive in each country and generally includes:

 - Competitive compensation and the opportunity of earning equity at Nu

jobs.title: Lead Business Control Officer - Global Credit Card
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Nu

Nu serves more than 140 million customers, guided by a mission to fight complexity and empower people. The company has been leading an industry transformation through innovative products and human-centered services.

 

Proprietary technology and data at scale power Nu’s digital platform, built to promote financial access, advancement, and transparency. Its business model thrives on customer love and lower costs, feeding a flywheel of growth and profitability.

Visit our Institutional Page

About the role

As a Lead Business Control Officer (BCO) for the Global Credit Card business, you will play a critical role in strengthening Nu’s first line of defense and enabling sustainable growth of our credit card portfolio globally. You will partner closely with senior leaders across Global Credit Card, Product, Operations, and Risk to proactively identify, assess, and manage non-financial risks, ensuring that business objectives are achieved with a strong and efficient control environment.

You will be a hands-on leader, setting the bar for risk excellence while enabling innovation. You will help establish and continuously evolve the BCO model for Global Credit Card, embedding risk ownership in the first line, challenging how we work today, and helping us build best-in-class risk management practices.

You’ll be responsible for

  • Acting as the primary first-line risk partner for the Global Credit Card business, balancing risk management with business objectives and customer impact.

  • Driving a thorough understanding of end-to-end processes, risks, and controls across the Global Credit Card lifecycle, from product design and onboarding to servicing, collections, and support.

  • Designing, assessing, and continuously improving internal controls to ensure risks are identified, mitigated, and monitored effectively.

  • Leading and coordinating first-line risk management activities, including risk and control self-assessments (RCSA), loss and risk event management, issue remediation, and continuous improvement initiatives.

  • Ensuring strong governance, risk, and compliance practices in alignment with internal policies, global frameworks, and applicable external regulations.

  • Supporting product and feature development by bringing a proactive risk lens to strategic decisions, business cases, and go-to-market plans.

  • Defining, tracking, and reporting meaningful risk and control metrics (KPIs/KRIs) that enable effective monitoring of the control environment and timely decision-making.

  • Building and running pragmatic, non-bureaucratic governance forums that bring together key stakeholders to discuss risks, controls, incidents, and remediation plans.

  • Preparing and presenting clear, concise risk reports and updates to senior leadership and relevant governance bodies.

  • Partnering with second and third lines of defense to ensure alignment, transparency, and effective challenge, while maintaining strong ownership of risks in the first line.

  • Contributing to the ongoing evolution of the BCO framework at Nu, sharing best practices, proposing improvements, and helping shape how we operate as a global first-line risk team.


We are looking for a person who has

  • Proven experience working with credit card products and businesses, preferably in a global or multi-market environment.

  • Solid experience in non-financial risk management, operational risk, or related risk disciplines within financial services or fintech.

  • Strong understanding of risk and control frameworks, governance, and regulatory expectations for consumer credit products.

  • Experience designing, assessing, and improving processes and internal controls, including documentation and process mapping.

  • Proven ability to influence and build strong relationships with stakeholders at different levels of the organization, including senior leaders.

  • A hands-on, ownership-driven mindset, with the ability to dive deep into details while keeping a strategic view of risks and priorities.

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to translate complex issues into clear actions and decisions.

  • Excellent communication skills in English, with the ability to convey risk topics in a clear, concise, and structured way.

  • Independence, proactivity, and a strong desire to challenge the status quo and improve how we work.

Nice to have

  • Experience in first-line risk roles directly embedded in business or product teams.

  • Prior exposure to SOX or similar internal control over financial reporting frameworks.

  • Experience working with teams across different countries and cultures.

  • Knowledge of data, analytics, or tooling that can help automate and enhance risk and control monitoring.


Location for this opportunity

Virgínia (DC Metro)



Our Benefits (United States)

  • Opportunity of earning equity at Nu.

  • Medical Insurance.

  • Dental and Vision Insurance.

  • Life Insurance and AD&D.

  • Extended maternity and paternity leaves.

  • Nucleo - Our learning platform of courses.

  • NuLanguage - Our language learning program.

  • NuCare - Our mental health and wellness assistance program.

  • 401K.

  • Saving Plans - Health Saving Account and Flexible Spending Account.

  • Work-from-home Allowance.

  • Relocation Assistance Package, if applicable.


Work Model for this Role

Hybrid 2-3 times | week: Our hybrid work model brings us to the office at least twice a week, on strategic days designed to maximize team connection and collaboration. For more details, visit https://building.nubank.com/nu-hybrid-work-model/.

We offer relocation package for those who are available to be relocated to the DC region.

Learn more about how we build at Nu

Explore how we build products, technology, and experiences at Nu:

  • https://building.nubank.com.br

  • https://youtube.com/@building.nubank

  • https://open.spotify.com/show/4hAJnAkYKXl42hLXa4LmVQ

To maintain a consistent and fair process for every candidate, Nu does not provide individualized technical feedback. See how our policy works here

jobs.title: Credit Risk Specialist
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Nu

Nu serves more than 140 million customers, guided by a mission to fight complexity and empower people. The company has been leading an industry transformation through innovative products and human-centered services.

 

Proprietary technology and data at scale power Nu’s digital platform, built to promote financial access, advancement, and transparency. Its business model thrives on customer love and lower costs, feeding a flywheel of growth and profitability.

Visit our Institutional Page

About the Role

As a Credit Risk Specialist, you'll own how the provisioning process actually runs. Your focus is the reliability, scalability, and observability of the credit-risk data and model pipeline — the orchestration, data-quality checks, and platform capabilities that let our risk models run correctly every cycle, supporting model monitoring, use and process controls.

You bring a credit-risk analyst's judgment to the numbers, but your day-to-day is making the pipeline robust, automated, and self-monitoring. This is a role for someone who leans over data — strong on data science / ML pipeline maintenance, comfortable in code, and motivated by turning processes into dependable, low-touch systems.

You’ll be Responsible for

  • Own pipeline reliability — build, maintain, and harden the data pipelines that feed the ECL calculation, so each cycle runs low-touch and fully reproducible.

  • Maintain the model-scoring pipeline — operationalize and productionize risk models (e.g. PD/EAD/LGD scoring runs), keeping the path from model hand-off to production standardized and repeatable.

  • Manage upstream dependencies — make the pipeline resilient to external data changes; detect breakage early.

  • Build data-quality and monitoring alerts — instrument the pipeline so data and process issues surface automatically before they reach the numbers.

  • Advance the platform roadmap — contribute deliberate, roadmapped improvements so the platform stays ahead of new demands.

  • Collaborate across data engineering, modeling, and finance — partner with the teams whose data you consume and whose reports you feed.

  • Support controls and audit — help capture control and data-quality evidence continuously from source systems rather than by hand each cycle

 

What We're Looking For Someone Who Has

  • Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Data Science, Statistics, Math, Physics, Economics, or a related quantitative field.

  • Strong coding and data engineering skills — SQL and Python, with hands-on experience building and maintaining data / ML pipelines.

  • Experience keeping data science or machine-learning pipelines in production — scheduling, monitoring, data-quality checks, and debugging failures.

  • Analytical, problem-solving mindset, genuinely motivated to work with data and learn from it.

  • Working understanding of credit risk concepts and how portfolio data maps to risk metrics.

  • Adaptability to a dynamic way of working.

Location

Sao Paulo, Brazil

Work model

Hybrid 2-3 times/week: Our hybrid work model brings us to the office at least twice a week, on strategic days designed to maximize team connection and collaboration.

Office requirement

2 days per week at the office.

  • Public Transportation Commuting Benefit (Vale-Transporte)

jobs.title: AI Risk Management Senior Specialist
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Nu

Nu serves more than 140 million customers, guided by a mission to fight complexity and empower people. The company has been leading an industry transformation through innovative products and human-centered services.

 

Proprietary technology and data at scale power Nu’s digital platform, built to promote financial access, advancement, and transparency. Its business model thrives on customer love and lower costs, feeding a flywheel of growth and profitability.

Visit our Institutional Page

About the Role

This position sits within Nubank’s global risk management team and provides second-line oversight of risks arising from artificial intelligence and generative AI across the company. You will partner with AI Core, Engineering, Data, Information Security and other first-line teams from the earliest stages of initiatives, while maintaining independent challenge and accountability for risk governance.

The initial focus is to establish scalable AI risk oversight across the company, including risk assessments on cutting edge technologies, providing risk taxonomy, appetite, KRIs, risk and control matrices, control testing, incident oversight, and issue management.

You’ll be Responsible for

  • Shift-left risk management by partnering with the first line at the conception and design of AI initiatives, helping teams identify risks and shape proportionate response strategies.

  • Recommend and maintain the AI risk appetite statement, metrics, KRIs, and early-warning indicators, including thresholds and escalation logic.

  • Oversee risks introduced by AI and GenAI third-party providers, recommending governance requirements and baseline controls for their safe use.

  • Enforce consistent risk identification, recommend baseline controls, and independently test key controls.

  • Own control testing for AI-related scopes, prioritising the highest risks and most important controls.

  • Oversee AI-related incidents, connect them to risk governance, and feed lessons learned back into the taxonomy, controls, appetite, and monitoring approach.

  • Review and challenge first-line risk assessments, controls, and decisions.

  • Build strong working relationships with Model Risk, Information Security, Data Privacy, Technology Risk, Operational Risk, and other relevant risk teams to clarify roles, coordinate oversight, and avoid gaps or duplication.

 

What We're Looking For Someone Who Has

  • Senior experience in technology, ideally in a second-line risk function or a risk-heavy technical role.

  • Fluency with GenAI and large language models, including the AI lifecycle and the non-model risks associated with data, access, resilience, third parties, agentic tool use, and guardrails.

  • Strong grounding in core risk practices, including risk assessments, control testing, and risk monitoring.

  • Familiarity with relevant governance, risk, and security frameworks, such as NIST AI RMF, the EU AI Act, NIST CSF, ISO/IEC 27001, and ISO 31000, with the judgment to apply them pragmatically.

  • A mindset of constructively challenging, and being able to partner with other teams to elaborate resilient and secure solutions.

  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with confidence engaging senior leaders and presenting a clear risk picture in governance forums.

  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills, including the ability to address complex and ambiguous situations.

  • A pragmatic, builder’s mentality: comfortable standing up new frameworks and processes, operating with ambiguity, and balancing strong controls with simplicity and speed.

  • Strong team-working skills and the ability to build trust across functions, geographies, and lines of defense.

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, Risk Management, Business, or a related field.

  • Significant experience in technology areas, risk management, AI implementation and governance or a related discipline.

  • Demonstrated experience translating technical or emerging risks into practical governance, policies, controls, metrics, and testing approaches.

  • Experience working with senior stakeholders and cross-functional teams in a fast-moving, technology-led organisation.

  • Experience operating across multiple countries or regulatory environments is a plus.

  • Professional fluency in English is expected.

Location

São Paulo, SP - Brazil

Work model

Hybrid

Office requirement

2-3 days per week at the office.

  • Food/ Meal Card (Vale-Refeição and/or Vale Alimentação)

jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Nu

Nu serves more than 140 million customers, guided by a mission to fight complexity and empower people. The company has been leading an industry transformation through innovative products and human-centered services.

 

Proprietary technology and data at scale power Nu’s digital platform, built to promote financial access, advancement, and transparency. Its business model thrives on customer love and lower costs, feeding a flywheel of growth and profitability.

Visit our Institutional Page

About the Role

This position sits within Nubank’s global risk management team and provides second-line oversight of technology and information security risks across Nubank’s global systems, platforms, and processes. You will work closely with Engineering, Information Security, Data, Product, Business, and local Risk Management teams to identify, assess, and govern technology risks while enabling the company to grow safely and at speed.

The role combines hands-on risk assessment with stakeholder partnership, risk monitoring, control oversight, incident follow-up, and continuous improvement of IT Risk practices. You will help apply global frameworks and methodologies consistently across geographies, while considering local regulatory requirements and the characteristics of each technology environment.


You’ll be Responsible for

  • Conduct IT and cybersecurity risk assessments across technology domains, platforms, products, features, and critical processes, identifying threats, vulnerabilities, potential impacts, and appropriate risk responses.

  • Assess and challenge technology risks associated with new products, features, systems, infrastructure, and material changes, helping teams identify and address risks early in the lifecycle.

  • Partner with Engineering, Information Security, Data, Product, Business, and local Risk Management teams to develop mitigation plans aligned with risk appetite, global standards, and applicable regulatory requirements.

  • Support the implementation and consistent application of global IT Risk frameworks, methodologies, policies, procedures, metrics, and governance practices across Nubank’s operations.

  • Implement, mMonitor and analyse Key Risk Indicators, metrics, and dashboards for technology and cybersecurity risks, identifying changes in risk exposure and escalating matters that require attention.

  • Prepare clear risk assessments, reports, and recommendations for technical stakeholders, senior management, governance forums, and risk committees.

  • Support independent control testing and the assessment of control effectiveness, documenting gaps and recommending practical risk mitigants and action plans.

  • Monitor technology, cybersecurity, and data-platform incidents; contribute to root-cause analysis, assess systemic implications, and connect remediation plans to the risk governance framework.

  • Provide IT and cybersecurity risk expertise for third-party services, cloud environments, APIs, telecommunications infrastructure, and other technology dependencies.

  • Monitor regulatory developments, emerging threats, technology changes, and industry practices, assessing their implications for Nubank’s IT Risk posture.

  • Contribute to risk-related inquiries, workshops, thematic reviews, and governance routines, translating technical topics into actionable risk guidance.

  • Identify opportunities to improve the efficiency, consistency, and scalability of IT Risk activities through data analytics, workflow automation, AI platforms, and other technology-enabled approaches.

  • Support the development of junior colleagues and contribute to the continuous improvement of the team’s practices, tools, and methodologies.

What We're Looking For Someone Who Has

  • Strong experience in technology areas, information security, IT risk management, internal controls or another risk-heavy technical role.

  • Solid understanding of modern technology environments, including information security fundamentals, cloud-native environments such as AWS and GCP, microservices, APIs, CI/CD pipelines, containers, serverless technologies, and distributed systems.

  • Strong grounding in risk assessment, risk analysis, mitigation planning, control effectiveness, incident management, risk monitoring, and governance reporting.

  • Familiarity with risk and security frameworks and regulatory expectations, such as NIST, ISO/IEC 27001, LGPD, and applicable financial-services requirements.

  • Ability to translate complex technical topics into clear business and risk-oriented insights for audiences with different levels of technical knowledge and seniority.

  • Constructive-challenge mindset, with the ability to remain independent while building effective partnerships with first-line teams.

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, including the ability to structure ambiguous situations, prioritise risks, and make sound risk-based recommendations.

  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.

  • Ability to work effectively across global and local teams, geographies, functions, and lines of defence.

  • Pragmatic and collaborative approach to risk management, balancing robust controls with simplicity, speed, and customer focus.

  • Strong ownership, organisation, attention to detail, and ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-moving environment.

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, Business, or a related field.

  • Relevant experience in cybersecurity, technology risk, IT risk management, information security, internal controls, or a related area.

  • Demonstrated experience working with technology teams and evaluating risks across cloud environments, applications, infrastructure, data platforms, or third-party services.

  • Experience contributing to risk frameworks, policies, control assessments, KRIs, incident management, regulatory responses, or risk governance processes.

  • Experience in a regulated financial institution or fintech is a plus.

  • Experience working across countries, global technology teams, or multiple regulatory environments is a plus.

  • Relevant certifications such as CISA, CISSP, CISM, CRISC, CHE, ISO 27001, or equivalent are a plus.

  • Advanced English communication skills, both written and verbal, are essential for this global role.

Location

São Paulo - SP, Brazil

Work model

Hybrid

Office requirement

2-3 days per week at the office.

 

Our Benefits

  • Chance of earning equity at Nubank

  • Food/ Meal Card (Vale-Refeição and/or Vale Alimentação)

  • Public Transportation Commuting Benefit (Vale-Transporte)

  • NuCare – Psychological, Financial and Legal Assistance Program

  • Life Insurance

  • Medical Plan

  • 30 days of paid vacation

  • Relocation Assistance Package, if applicable

Visit our Institutional Page

Key Responsibilities

  • Invest the bank's excess liquidity under optimal conditions, within approved risk limits and permitted instruments.

  • Manage repo investments and account holdings.

  • Participate in bid placement at Banco de México bond auctions, including the new deposit and liquidity auctions the team is implementing.

  • Collaborate with finance, risk, and operations teams to develop new capabilities and bank-specific products.

  • Knowledge of ACLME.

  • Use AI tools to improve and automate treasury processes.

Who We're Looking For

  • Cash management experience, preferably in financial institutions.

  • Solid knowledge of Mexican banking regulation and treasury investment instruments.

  • Clear understanding of the split between front office (defines strategy and negotiates terms) and back office (executes money movements); back-office profiles looking to grow into front office are also welcome.

  • Current AMIB certification (level 3 or 5), or willingness to obtain it before starting.

  • Strategic vision: ability to go beyond day-to-day operations and propose improvements and new capabilities.

jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer - Insurance
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Nu

Nu serves more than 140 million customers, guided by a mission to fight complexity and empower people. The company has been leading an industry transformation through innovative products and human-centered services.

 

Proprietary technology and data at scale power Nu’s digital platform, built to promote financial access, advancement, and transparency. Its business model thrives on customer love and lower costs, feeding a flywheel of growth and profitability.

Visit our Institutional Page

About the role

Our mission is to evolve the platform architecture and workflows that let Insurance scale across more customers, more products, and new markets, and to close the gap between AI capabilities built centrally and their reliable adoption in production.

As a Staff Software Engineer - Insurance, you will be a senior technical leader across two connected fronts: diagnosing and evolving our service architecture as the platform scales, and leading the rollout of AI/agentic tooling across the team's engineering workflow, from spec and code generation to testing and validation.

You will operate at platform scale, building infrastructure and practices other teams depend on, while partnering closely with Product, Data, Security, Compliance, and Insurance partners. You'll be part of a lean, entrepreneurial team that delivers outsized business impact while protecting millions of customers, sitting at the intersection of embedded insurance, Nu's most important customer surfaces, and our insurer partners. This team is also one of the earliest adopters of agentic engineering within Nubank, putting you at the center of how that transformation actually happens.

You’ll be responsible for

  • Diagnosing and evolving our platform architecture to remove constraints on scale, supporting a growing user base, expanding product portfolio, and global expansion.

  • Providing AI-first engineering leadership, setting the standards and practices for how the team builds and evolves with AI/agentic tooling.

  • Cutting through ambiguity, surfacing trade-offs and aligning cross-functional teams (Product, Data, Security, Compliance, Insurance partners) around clear outcomes.

  • Ensuring observability for AI systems and platform services in production (tracing, logging, alerting).

  • Mentoring engineers on technical approach across both architecture and AI/agentic best practices, raising the team's execution level over time.

  • Evaluating and incorporating both internal (Nubank) and external AI tools and agents into our workflows, based on what best fits our needs.

  • Partnering with Nubank's central AI/platform teams and other BUs to share learnings and stay aligned on tooling direction.

  • Enabling more Nubankers to safely contribute to AI-powered products over time (engineers and non-engineers)

  • Embedding responsible, auditable practices in everything shipped, across platform and AI systems alike, per applicable regulations and internal risk standards.

We are looking for a person who has

Required

  • Proven technical leadership as a senior/staff engineer delivering high-impact, large-scale software systems in production.

  • Track record of mentoring and uplifting peers on technical approach and AI-native workflows.

  • Strong systems/platform engineering experience: architecture, CI/CD, test automation, able to evolve infrastructure to support reliable adoption of new technology.

  • Genuine interest and foundational knowledge of AI/LLM concepts, ready to build hands-on fluency with our agentic tooling.

  • Ownership mindset for rolling out AI/agentic tooling across a team, driving adoption of testing, CI/CD validation, and evaluation practices, not just personal use.

  • Strong full-stack thinking: ability to design maintainable codebases and APIs that bridge model inference/orchestration layers with user-facing surfaces.

  • Experience navigating ambiguous, cross-functional projects that require coordination across multiple business units and stakeholders.

  • Demonstrated strategic acumen, linking technical initiatives to business drivers such as operational efficiency, risk, and customer acquisition or engagement.

  • Experience in fintech or other regulated industries (e.g., financial services, insurance, payments) or similarly complex domains.

  • Advanced English for daily collaboration in a global environment.

Nice to Have

  • AI-first mindset with professional experience implementing LLMs, generative AI, agentic patterns and/or RAG systems in real-world products.

  • Solid understanding of prompt engineering, tool calling, context management, and agent loops, with ability to contribute to shared agent libraries and commands.

  • Experience building or contributing to automated test/CI-CD evaluation frameworks that catch and fix failures with minimal human intervention.

  • Background in insurance or embedded insurance products.

  • Experience scaling products across international markets and languages.

  • Familiarity with Portuguese and/or Spanish to read or review customer-facing copy (optional).

  • Prior experience in AI-first startups or big-tech environments with strong AI/ML teams.

Location for this opportunity

  • São Paulo, Buenos Aires

Work Model for this Role

  • Hybrid 2–3 times/week: Our hybrid work model brings us to the office at least twice a week, on strategic days designed to maximize team connection and collaboration. For more details, visit https://building.nubank.com/nu-hybrid-work-model/

Our Benefits

For this role, we offer a competitive, global-level package that currently includes:

 

  • Competitive compensation and company equity

  • Bi-annual trips to Brazil to build relationships with coworkers

  • Top-tier Medical Insurance

  • Top-tier Dental and Vision Insurance

  • Generous time off and company holidays

  • Life Insurance and AD&D

  • Extended maternity and paternity leaves

  • NuLanguage – our language learning program

  • NuCare – our mental health and wellness assistance program

Specific benefits may vary slightly by country and will be detailed during the process.

Join us

If you want to help evolve the architecture and AI-powered workflows that let Nubank’s Insurance platform scale across products and markets — combining deep systems thinking with hands-on agentic engineering — we’d love to hear from you.

Apply now to be our Staff Software Engineer – Insurance.

Our recruitment process may involve the use of artificial intelligence–enabled tools, such as automated interview transcription and analysis, to support the evaluation process. Artificial intelligence is not used to make final hiring decisions; all decisions are made by human reviewers.

To maintain a consistent and fair process for every candidate, Nu does not provide individualized technical feedback. See how our policy works here

About Nu

Nu serves more than 140 million customers, guided by a mission to fight complexity and empower people. The company has been leading an industry transformation through innovative products and human-centered services.

 

Proprietary technology and data at scale power Nu’s digital platform, built to promote financial access, advancement, and transparency. Its business model thrives on customer love and lower costs, feeding a flywheel of growth and profitability.

About the team:

The US FinCrime team, a component of Nu’s Global FinCrime Risk Department, is dedicated to the prevention of Anti-Money Laundering/Combating the Financing of Terrorism (AML/CFT) and sanctions violations. Its core mission is to manage the US AML/CFT and Sanctions program, ensuring regulatory adherence. This includes assessing the execution of related activities and promoting the standardization and efficiency of policies, processes, and systems.

As a team, our mission is to continuously develop the global management of money laundering, terrorist financing and sanctions‑prevention risks, strengthening organizational culture, policies and internal controls, preventing reputational and legal risks, and ensuring Nubank’s sustainable international growth.

You will be responsible for

In your role as an AML & OFAC Specialist within the AML Governance team, you will assess internal control efficacy and oversee systems supporting our AML/CFT and Sanctions program. Adhering to BSA and OFAC guidelines, your primary responsibilities will include:

Key Responsibilities:

  • Provide advisory to the 1LOD and various internal stakeholders on the adherence to the AML/CFT/ OFAC program requirements, FinCEN directives and internal policies and procedures.

  • Assist with updating governing documentation and procedures to guarantee the AML/sanctions program remains accurate, effective, and regulatory defensible.

  • Perform risk-based quality control and quality assurance testing of existing AML and Sanctions controls, documenting conclusions, communicating control weaknesses or gaps and tracking of corrective actions until closure.

  • Conduct scheduled and ad hoc testing of scenario thresholds, sanctions match logic, and detection rules, customer risk rating calibrations and updates, including above-the-line (ATL) and below-the-line (BTL) testing, and any model updates as needed. Work with internal and external stakeholders as needed.

  • Perform routine monitoring of transaction monitoring tools, sanctions screening filters, validating the proper updates were made to ensure control effectiveness. Perform BSA operational tasks as needed during testing activities.

  • Assist with the implementation of a new transaction monitoring system by assisting with the calibration of rules and procedures and conducting second level review of AML alerts as needed.

  • Support the AML Governance and Quality Control specialist by maintaining accurate, up-to-date model documentation and testing records.

  • Assist with AML and sanctions review of vendor assessments.

  • Data Quality & Reconciliation: Execute data reconciliation checks between core banking systems and compliance applications, document exceptions, and assist with root-cause analysis.

  • Reporting & Documentation: Maintain audit-ready test logs, evidence repositories, and performance dashboards for management and regulatory review.

  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with AML analytics, 1LOD teams, Compliance, and external vendors to facilitate system updates, support audits, and implement continuous process improvements.

  • Contribute to the development of the monitoring and testing plan, including any Global Program requirements.

  • Ad Hoc Support: Assist with ad hoc requests and tasks from the Partner Bank and other projects assigned by management including international efforts.

We are looking for a person who has

Qualifications & Skills

  • A Bachelor's, Master's, or Law degree is required in a discipline such as Business Administration, Accounting, Economics, Engineering, Finance, Information Technology, or a Risk Management-related field.

  • Professional experience, ideally within AML, Sanctions, Business analytics, Risk Management, or other control functions.

  • Prior experience in monitoring/testing or quality control roles in AML, Audit or Risk.

  • Prior AML and or KYC investigations experience in the digital asset, payments, and/or Fintech space.

  • Previous experience collaborating with global teams.

Key Skills:

  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and critical thinking abilities, with the capacity to translate complex technical data into actionable business insights.

  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, enabling effective engagement with stakeholders across various teams and seniority levels.

  • Fluency in Portuguese and/or Spanish is a plus.

  • Enthusiasm for Artificial Intelligence and coding skills (e.g., SQL, Python, Scala, or similar programming languages) are a plus.

  • Willingness to relocate to Miami, FL

Benefits

  • Opportunity of earning equity at Nu

  • Medical Insurance

  • Dental and Vision Insurance

  • Life Insurance and AD&D

  • Extended maternity and paternity leaves

  • Nucleo - Our learning platform of courses

  • NuLanguage - Our language learning program

  • NuCare - Our mental health and wellness assistance program

  • 401K Saving Plans - Health Saving Account and Flexible Spending Account

  • Work-from-home Allowance

  • Relocation Assistance Package, if applicable.

Total compensation includes base salary, RSUs and benefits. Base salary range: US$92k - US$115k.

[Miami, USA]

Hybrid 2-3 times/week: Our hybrid work model brings us to the office at least twice a week, on strategic days designed to maximize team connection and collaboration.

2 days per week at the office.

jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Nu

Nu serves more than 140 million customers, guided by a mission to fight complexity and empower people. The company has been leading an industry transformation through innovative products and human-centered services.

 

Proprietary technology and data at scale power Nu’s digital platform, built to promote financial access, advancement, and transparency. Its business model thrives on customer love and lower costs, feeding a flywheel of growth and profitability.

Visit our Institutional Page

About the Role

We are looking for a professional to join the Regulatory & Accounting Specifications (RAS) team, which is responsible for translating new products, features, and regulatory changes into clear, auditable, and implementable accounting and regulatory definitions.

This role covers the process from the initial assessment of a product or feature through implementation, testing, and delivery of specifications to partner teams. It is an opportunity to work at the intersection of Controllership, Product, Engineering, financial platforms, R2R, Tax, and regulatory teams.


You’ll be Responsible for

  • Assess the accounting feasibility and regulatory requirements of new products and features.

  • Identify impacts on accounting accounts, financial flows, entities, events, systems, and regulatory reports.

  • Define and document the end-to-end accounting flow, including events, debits, credits, recognition timing, and integrations.

  • Prepare and maintain Accounting Specifications, Rulebooks, scenario simulations, Accounting Memos, and decision records.

  • Define, request, or review accounting accounts and their mappings when necessary.

  • Assess impacts on regulatory reports and support the definition of the required logic, data, and controls.

  • Participate in accounting tests and validate consistency across product transactions, the ledger, the ERP, and regulatory reports.

  • Identify accounting, regulatory, audit, and implementation risks that may affect product launches.

  • Work with Product, Engineering, Finance Platform, R2R, FAR, GPA, Tax, FP&A, Legal, and other partner teams to resolve questions and dependencies.

  • Follow up on automation gaps and technical debt, ensuring that any manual activities have appropriate documentation, data, and controls.

  • Maintain complete, traceable, and up-to-date documentation throughout the product lifecycle.

  • Support audit inquiries and requests from regulatory authorities related to specifications owned by the team.

 

What We're Looking For Someone Who Has

  • Experience in accounting, controllership, financial products, regulatory reporting, or related areas.

  • Knowledge of applicable accounting principles, including IFRS and/or Brazilian GAAP.

  • Ability to interpret operations and translate them into accounting rules, data flows, and implementation requirements.

  • Strong written and verbal communication in English

  • Analytical mindset, with strong attention to detail and the ability to investigate complex scenarios.

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills to document decisions and align with technical and business teams.

  • Ability to work autonomously, organize priorities, and drive topics end to end.

  • Interest or experience working with systems, data, ledgers, ERPs, automation, and accounting close processes.

  • Ability to collaborate in a multidisciplinary and fast-changing environment.

 

Work Setup

Location

Sao Paulo, Brazil

Work model
Hybrid 2-3 times/week: Our hybrid work model brings us to the office at least twice a week, on strategic days designed to maximize team connection and collaboration

Office requirement

2 days per week at the office.

  • Food/ Meal Card (Vale-Refeição and/or Vale Alimentação)

  • Public Transportation Commuting Benefit (Vale-Transporte)

  • NuCare – Psychological, Financial and Legal Assistance Program

  • Life Insurance

Responsibilities assigned to you might be related to:

  • Lead efforts and align requirements towards new financial licenses.

  • Evaluate from a compliance perspective new products and features to be launched.

  • Create and update Compliance policies and procedures.

  • Liaise and work closely with various teams to enhance systems and processes related to Compliance.

jobs.title: Model Risk Senior Specialist
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Nu

Nu serves more than 140 million customers, guided by a mission to fight complexity and empower people. The company has been leading an industry transformation through innovative products and human-centered services.

 

Proprietary technology and data at scale power Nu’s digital platform, built to promote financial access, advancement, and transparency. Its business model thrives on customer love and lower costs, feeding a flywheel of growth and profitability.

Visit our Institutional Page

About Global Model Risk Management

Nubank relies extensively on data, machine learning, and quantitative models to support strategy, product decisions, risk management, and customer experiences. The Global Model Risk Management team is part of the second line of defense and provides independent review, effective challenge, and oversight across the model lifecycle.

Our work is not limited to identifying model weaknesses. We help the organization understand and manage model risk, improve decision quality, establish practical feedback loops, and evolve our governance as new techniques and applications emerge.

About the role

We are looking for a Senior Model Risk Management & Validation Specialist to join our Global MRM team as a senior US-based model risk representative.

In this role, you will independently assess and challenge models used across credit, fraud, operations, and other customer-impacting decisions. You will work with model developers, data scientists, product leaders, senior management, compliance, audit, and regulators to evaluate whether models are conceptually sound, appropriately implemented, fit for purpose, and effectively monitored.

Although based in the US, this is a global role. You will bring knowledge of US regulatory expectations, industry practices, and model risk developments to help continuously evolve Nubank’s global MRM methodology, standards, governance, playbooks, and tools. You will also collaborate with colleagues across countries to promote consistent, scalable approaches that remain appropriate for local regulatory and business contexts.

This is an opportunity to combine hands-on validation, US market expertise, and cross-border collaboration on global methodology in a fast-growing digital financial platform.


You’ll be Responsible for

  • Lead or contribute to independent validation reviews of traditional statistical, quantitative, machine-learning, generative-AI, and other emerging models.

  • Lead independent validation and effective challenge across the model lifecycle — soundness, methodology, data, implementation, and performance — using benchmarking, back-testing, and sensitivity testing to surface risks and remediation actions.

  • Evaluate AI/ML-specific risks such as bias, fairness, explainability, and drift, and translate findings into practical, business-relevant recommendations.

  • Translate validation results into clear model-risk, business, and customer implications; define relevant performance and risk indicators; and prepare reports and presentations for technical and non-technical audiences.

  • Engage with senior management, internal audit, compliance, regulators, and other stakeholders to communicate independent opinions, findings, limitations, and recommendations.

  • Follow models into production to understand how they are implemented and used in real business processes, strengthening validation, monitoring, and feedback-loop practices.

  • Support the US CRO and senior leadership in representing Global MRM to US regulators, and bring US regulatory expectations, fair-lending practices, and market knowledge into ongoing enhancements to Nubank’s global methodology, standards, and governance.

  • Contribute to scalable global validation frameworks, playbooks, monitoring practices, and guidance for traditional, AI, generative-AI, and agentic systems while accounting for local regulatory and business requirements.

  • Act as a hands-on AI practitioner within MRM: use AI coding assistants, agentic workflows, and automation (Python, SQL, Scala, Databricks) to revamp and expedite validation, documentation, and monitoring processes, and share these practices across the Global MRM team.

What We're Looking For Someone Who Has

Required

  • Experience in model validation or model risk management (second line of defense) covering quantitative, statistical, machine-learning, or AI models, ideally in credit, fraud, or other high-impact decisioning processes.

  • Proven track record independently leading model validations end-to-end, exercising sound judgment with minimal oversight.

  • Strong data science and machine-learning fundamentals, including model performance, monitoring, and lifecycle management.

  • Strong programming and data skills, particularly in Python and SQL.

  • Analytical, autonomous, organized, and detail-oriented, with the ability to learn quickly and solve complex problems.

  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to explain complex topics and provide constructive challenge to technical and non-technical stakeholders.

  • Practitioner mindset: hands-on experience using AI tools or agentic workflows to accelerate your own work (e.g., coding, documentation, research) — this role calls for someone who actively applies AI to modernize how MRM works, not only someone who evaluates AI risk in other teams’ models.

  • Working knowledge of US model risk regulatory expectations (e.g., Federal Reserve SR 11-7, SR 26-2) or comparable model risk frameworks.

 

Nice to Have

  • Experience developing models (first line), in addition to validating them — gives a practitioner’s view of the modeler’s perspective.

  • Familiarity with US fair-lending practices (e.g., ECOA, Regulation B) and their application to credit and fraud model validation.

  • Experience translating regulatory expectations into practical validation standards, governance processes, controls, or documentation.

  • Experience evaluating AI/ML, generative-AI, or agentic-AI systems, including fairness, disparate impact, explainability, drift, or post-deployment monitoring.

  • Experience with Scala, Databricks, GitHub, AI-agent tools, or similar technologies.

  • Master’s degree, PhD, or relevant academic research in a quantitative discipline.

  • Experience working across countries, regulatory regimes, or globally distributed risk teams.

  • Experience supporting or participating in regulatory examinations (e.g., Federal Reserve, OCC, CFPB) related to model risk.

  • Familiarity with model tiering, model inventory management, and model risk rating frameworks.

  • Professional certifications such as FRM, CFA, or PRM.

 

Work Setup

Office requirement

2 days per week at the office.

 

Our Benefits

  • Opportunity of earning equity at Nu

  • Medical Insurance

  • Dental and Vision Insurance

  • Life Insurance and AD&D

  • Extended maternity and paternity leaves

  • Nucleo - Our learning platform of courses

  • NuLanguage - Our language learning program

  • NuCare - Our mental health and wellness assistance program

  • 401K

  • Saving Plans - Health Saving Account and Flexible Spending Account

  • Work-from-home Allowance

  • Relocation Assistance Package, if applicable.

Our recruitment process may involve the use of artificial intelligence–enabled tools, such as automated interview transcription and analysis, to support the evaluation process. Artificial intelligence is not used to make final hiring decisions; all decisions are made by human reviewers.

To maintain a consistent and fair process for every candidate, Nu does not provide individualized technical feedback. See how our policy works here

jobs.title: Community-Led Growth Senior Specialist
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Nu

Nu serves more than 140 million customers, guided by a mission to fight complexity and empower people. The company has been leading an industry transformation through innovative products and human-centered services.

 

Proprietary technology and data at scale power Nu’s digital platform, built to promote financial access, advancement, and transparency. Its business model thrives on customer love and lower costs, feeding a flywheel of growth and profitability.

Visit our Institutional Page

Community-Led Growth Senior Specialist (Emerging Markets)

About the role

As the Community-Led Growth Senior Specialist, you'll build acquisition inside communities Nu doesn't own — WhatsApp and Telegram groups, Reddit threads, diaspora forums — where access is earned, not bought, and where most channels have no native attribution. Once inside these spaces, you'll turn community and cultural insight into content, channel activation, and outreach that drives acquisition, activation, engagement, retention, and referral — always through organic, test-and-learn methods.

You will work as the marketing counterpart to a Growth Product Manager. You own community strategy, native content, and channel activation, particularly in social and other hard-to-track spaces where the audience already lives.

This role also works closely with Business Analytics. Because most of the channels you'll operate in have incomplete or no native attribution, contributing to credible proxy measurement — in close partnership with your Growth PM and Business Analytics — is as core to this job as the content and community work itself.

You'll be responsible for

  • Build and scale community-led growth channels: find, seed, and grow presence inside WhatsApp/Telegram groups, Facebook groups, Reddit threads, and diaspora forums where the audience already congregates, without depending on paid or fully trackable channels.

  • Develop culturally fluent community content and voice: write and produce content that reads as native to each community (a Reddit post, a WhatsApp broadcast, a group meme) rather than as an ad, calibrated to the trust dynamics of expat and global professional audiences across LatAm and EU geographies.

  • Propose measurement approaches for hard-to-track channels: contribute proxy metrics, promo codes, and mixed-method measurement ideas in partnership with Business Analytics and the Growth PM, so channel impact can be argued with evidence, not anecdote.

  • Run experimentation in a test-and-learn model, in lockstep with the Growth PM: translate community insight into testable hypotheses and campaign structures, working the same backlog and review cadence as the product side rather than a parallel one.

  • Operate no-code/low-code growth tooling: build and maintain automation for community outreach and content distribution that scales without heavy engineering dependency.

  • Scout and pilot emerging channels: track and test next-wave channels (GEO/generative-engine optimization, new community platforms) before they become mainstream growth levers.

  • Bring a strong marketing point of view: partner with the Growth PM to shape the growth thesis for your workstream, and represent the marketing perspective clearly to product, data, and country stakeholders.

We are looking for a person who

  • Has solid experience in growth marketing, community marketing, or lifecycle marketing, including direct ownership of closed-community or grassroots acquisition (private groups, forums, and other low-visibility community channels) in consumer, fintech, or marketplace businesses.

  • Demonstrated track record contributing to attribution workarounds for channels with incomplete or no native tracking. This is a hands-on execution role.

  • Is comfortable operating without clean data. Makes calls with proxy evidence and mixed-method reasoning, and runs a disciplined test-and-learn cadence rather than waiting for perfect attribution.

  • Cultural fluency across LatAm and/or EU audiences, particularly expat, diaspora, and global-professional segments. Prior experience with global expansion companies or community-led growth companies is a differentiator.

  • Strong influence skills; able to represent the marketing point of view to Product and Analytics stakeholders, and make the case for channel and content calls as a senior individual contributor.

  • Fluency in English is mandatory. Proficiency in Portuguese and/or Spanish is a strong advantage. Nice to have: French, German, or Italian

  • Strategic Acumen: Links the growth-hacking workstream's near-term channel bets to Nu Global's broader expansion strategy, and helps the Growth PM and stakeholders see that connection too.

  • Analytical Ability: Analyzes incomplete, unstructured channel data with little oversight; turns it into recommendations that hold up when someone in Business Analytics pushes back.

  • Stakeholder Relationship & Management: Builds and sustains trust with Product, Business Analytics, and country teams independently; manages conflicting priorities between marketing's channel bets and product's roadmap without escalating every time.

  • Marketing Knowledge & Product Influence: Synthesizes community and cultural insight into marketing objectives, and advocates for product changes where the community signal warrants it.

  • Customer Marketing: Acts as a primary advocate for community trust dynamics in cross-functional discussions; translates research and behavioral signal into concrete channel and content decisions.

  • AI Fluency: Builds or guides no-code/low-code AI automation for growth tooling; evaluates AI initiatives on ROI, effort, and risk rather than adopting tools for their own sake.

Location for this opportunity

  • Miami, United States

Our Benefits

  • Opportunity of earning equity at Nu

  • Medical Insurance

  • Dental and Vision Insurance

  • Life Insurance and AD&D

  • Extended maternity and paternity leaves

  • Nucleo - Our learning platform of courses

  • NuLanguage - Our language learning program

  • NuCare - Our mental health and wellness assistance program

  • 401K

  • Saving Plans - Health Saving Account and Flexible Spending Account

  • Work-from-home Allowance

  • Relocation Assistance Package, if applicable.

Work Model for this Role

  • Hybrid 2-3 times/week: Our hybrid work model brings us to the office at least twice a week, on strategic days designed to maximize team connection and collaboration. For more details, visit https://building.nubank.com/nu-hybrid-work-model/

 - Operate no-code/low-code growth tooling: build and maintain automation for community outreach and content distribution that scales without heavy engineering dependency.

 - Scout and pilot emerging channels: track and test next-wave channels (GEO/generative-engine optimization, new community platforms) before they become mainstream growth levers.

 - Bring a strong marketing point of view: partner with the Growth PM to shape the growth thesis for your workstream, and represent the marketing perspective clearly to product, data, and country stakeholders.


WE ARE LOOKING FOR A PERSON WHO

 - Has solid experience in growth marketing, community marketing, or lifecycle marketing, including direct ownership of closed-community or grassroots acquisition (private groups, forums, and other low-visibility community channels) in consumer, fintech, or marketplace businesses.

 - Demonstrated track record contributing to attribution workarounds for channels with incomplete or no native tracking. This is a hands-on execution role.

 - Is comfortable operating without clean data. Makes calls with proxy evidence and mixed-method reasoning, and runs a disciplined test-and-learn cadence rather than waiting for perfect attribution.

 - Cultural fluency across LatAm and/or EU audiences, particularly expat, diaspora, and global-professional segments. Prior experience with global expansion companies or community-led growth companies is a differentiator.

 - Strong influence skills; able to represent the marketing point of view to Product and Analytics stakeholders, and make the case for channel and content calls as a senior individual contributor.

 - Fluency in English is mandatory. Proficiency in Portuguese and/or Spanish is a strong advantage. Nice to have: French, German, or Italian

 - Strategic Acumen: Links the growth-hacking workstream's near-term channel bets to Nu Global's broader expansion strategy, and helps the Growth PM and stakeholders see that connection too.

 - Customer Marketing: Acts as a primary advocate for community trust dynamics in cross-functional discussions; translates research and behavioral signal into concrete channel and content decisions.

 - AI Fluency: Builds or guides no-code/low-code AI automation for growth tooling; evaluates AI initiatives on ROI, effort, and risk rather than adopting tools for their own sake.

jobs.title: Senior Staff Product Designer, Digital Assets
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Nu

Nu serves more than 140 million customers, guided by a mission to fight complexity and empower people. The company has been leading an industry transformation through innovative products and human-centered services.

 

Proprietary technology and data at scale power Nu’s digital platform, built to promote financial access, advancement, and transparency. Its business model thrives on customer love and lower costs, feeding a flywheel of growth and profitability.

Visit our Institutional Page

Senior Staff Product Designer, Digital Assets

We are building open money and open financial services — not "crypto."

The Digital Assets team at Nubank is reimagining how a financial services platform can use blockchain technology to solve real problems for real people — without ever making customers think about the blockchain at all. We have deliberately renamed ourselves from Crypto to Digital Assets, and we have effectively banned the word "crypto" internally. We do not do crypto for crypto's sake. We do blockchain banking.

The reference point is Apple Pay. It runs on cryptography, public and private keys, and secure tokenization inside a secure enclave. Apple never says any of that. It says "on device," and "it just works." That is the standard for everything we ship.

The Role

We are looking for a Senior Staff Product Designer (IC8/IC9) to join the Digital Assets team in Palo Alto. You will be the lead design voice for a genuinely new category: making digital assets — Bitcoin, Ethereum, Solana, and stablecoins — as simple, accessible, and trusted as a debit card swipe.

This role sits at the intersection of consumer product design, financial innovation, and zero-to-one invention. Much of what you will design has never existed in consumer form before. You will not be asked to study what the incumbents did; the explicit instruction is to carve a new path.

What You Will Design

  • The buy, hold, and sell experience for Bitcoin, Ethereum, Solana, Digital Dollars, etc. — designed to feel intuitive, familiar, and clear from the first interaction.

  • Earning, also known as staking: an experience that lets customers put eligible digital assets to work and earn rewards with clarity, control, and trust — without exposing the protocol mechanics underneath.

  • Onchain transfers and payments: sending, receiving, and using digital assets in ways that feel as simple and dependable as moving money today, while the underlying blockchain complexity stays out of the customer’s way.

  • The invisible infrastructure layer that powers core functionality across the entire company, including the US build.

  • Both the customer experience and the platform that other teams will draw on for future launches.

  • New ways for people to own, move, use, and grow value across financial products and borders — shaping a flexible foundation for what open money can become without being constrained by today’s conventions.

What We Are Looking For

  • Consumer instincts over crypto fluency. Deep domain experience in crypto is not the point here — and can even work against you. If your instinct is to explain custody models or gas fees to a customer, this is not the seat.

  • Mobile expertise is a must-have. There is no desktop app in Brazil; effectively no web. Strong recent mobile work is non-negotiable, and a primarily B2B or enterprise background is a hard fit.

  • Zero-to-one experience. You have designed products that did not exist before, where there were no references to copy, and you thrived in the ambiguity.

  • A product marketing mindset. You care about the words, the positioning, and how it feels — not just the design elements. Our touchstone is "a thousand songs in your pocket," decided before the product was designed.

  • The ability to hide complexity. You have made something complicated feel obvious and delightful. Products that resonate with us: Cash App, Apple, the Tesla app, Duolingo, Wise, Revolut.

  • Fintech experience is a plus, never a requirement. We will teach you the compliance, legal, and regulatory ropes. What we cannot teach is the instinct to dream a magical experience first.

  • A short line to the business. The design team reports directly to the GM of the business unit. For a senior designer, that means unusual room to shape strategy rather than receive it.

How We Work

  • Dream first. The hiring manager's framing is: "Dream the magical experience first. We'll tell you afterwards what's not allowed."

  • No desktop-first. Everything is mobile-first, consumer-first.

  • No copy-and-paste. No copying from Coinbase or Robinhood. We are deliberately different.

  • The US is part of the trajectory. You will be shaping work that serves the next phase of global growth.

The Team

You will report directly to Michael Rihani, GM of the Digital Assets business unit. Michael is a product leader with close to twenty years of experience, including four years at Apple on Apple Pay, leading Bitcoin and consumer financial services at Cash App and Coinbase, and directing Supercharging UX and Bitcoin payments at Tesla. He believes the biggest thing the industry is missing is storytellers and design people who can make the technology disappear.

Interview Process

1. Portfolio review with Ethan Eismann (CDO, Nubank) — asynchronous

2. Live portfolio presentation with 2-3 design leaders and/or senior designers (~1 hour)

3. Hiring manager interview with Michael Rihani

4. Possible additional interviews. This interview process is subject to change, and may evolve with the hiring process. We appreciate your flexibility.

To maintain a consistent and fair process for every candidate, Nu does not provide individualized technical feedback. See how our policy works here
