jobs.title: Staff Mobile Software Engineer (AI Private Banker, SV) - US - IC7 - 2026
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Nu

Nu serves more than 140 million customers, guided by a mission to fight complexity and empower people. The company has been leading an industry transformation through innovative products and human-centered services.

 

Proprietary technology and data at scale power Nu’s digital platform, built to promote financial access, advancement, and transparency. Its business model thrives on customer love and lower costs, feeding a flywheel of growth and profitability.

Visit our Institutional Page

ABOUT THE ROLE

Nu is building the AI Private Banker, a flagship AI product designed to bring personalized financial guidance to customers directly inside the Nubank app. As a Staff Mobile Software Engineer, you will be a leading mobile technical voice for this product, shaping new conversational experiences from product definition through production and continuous evolution.

Your scope will be the mobile experience as a whole, not a single feature or set of screens inside an established flow. You will set the mobile architecture and product-engineering direction, shape how these interactions behave inside the app, and make the tradeoffs required to move quickly without compromising performance, accessibility, reliability, or customer trust.

Your impact will extend beyond the initial product experience. You will define reusable UI components, interaction patterns, and technical foundations that other teams can use to build consistent AI experiences across Nubank. You will partner closely with product, design, backend, platform, and AI/ML teams, mentor senior engineers, and remain hands-on and accountable for the experience in production.

YOU’LL BE RESPONSIBLE FOR

  • Set the technical strategy and architecture for the AI Private Banker mobile experience.

  • Lead the design, implementation, launch, and operation of a new conversational consumer product across iOS and Android.

  • Partner closely with product and design to translate emerging AI capabilities into interactions that feel simple, useful, and trustworthy.

  • Define how the experience handles dynamic responses, latency, interruptions, errors, recovery, feedback, and customer control.

  • Build reusable UI components, interaction patterns, and mobile foundations that can support AI experiences across multiple Nubank teams.

  • Own production quality across performance, accessibility, testing, instrumentation, observability, release readiness, and post-launch health.

  • Drive alignment across mobile, backend, platform, and AI/ML teams to move complex initiatives from ambiguity to production.

  • Mentor senior engineers and raise the broader organization’s standards for mobile architecture, product quality, and customer-centered engineering.

WE ARE LOOKING FOR A PERSON WHO HAS

  • A demonstrated track record as the founding or lead mobile engineer on a new consumer product or major zero-to-one launch, with ownership from early definition through production operation.

  • Deep expertise building and operating production mobile applications on either iOS or Android, with strong judgment across the broader mobile stack.

  • Experience independently setting architecture and technical direction for a meaningful product area, including making tradeoffs across customer experience, speed, maintainability, performance, and reliability.

  • Experience creating shared UI components, interaction patterns, design-system capabilities, or mobile foundations adopted by teams beyond the immediate product.

  • Strong product judgment and experience partnering closely with designers to turn ambiguous concepts into polished consumer experiences.

  • Experience building complex, stateful mobile flows with deliberate handling of performance, accessibility, testing, failure states, and recovery.

  • Staff-level influence across engineering and cross-functional teams, including aligning stakeholders, mentoring senior engineers, and raising technical standards.

  • The ability and willingness to remain hands-on while leading through technical judgment and influence.

Prior AI experience is not required. We care more about the depth of your mobile product ownership and your ability to turn an ambiguous idea into a trusted, high-quality consumer experience.

NICE TO HAVE

  • Experience building conversational, assistant, generative AI, or other adaptive product experiences.

  • Familiarity with real-time or streaming interfaces, model latency, uncertain outputs, and graceful failure states.

  • Experience launching consumer products across multiple markets, languages, or regulatory environments.

  • Experience in fintech or another domain where customer trust, privacy, and reliability are essential.

  • Experience working across mobile and API or backend boundaries.

LOCATION

This position is based in Palo Alto, California.

OUR BENEFITS

  • Equity at Nu

  • Medical insurance

  • Dental and vision insurance

  • Life and AD&D insurance

  • Extended parental leave

  • 401(k)

  • HSA and FSA options

  • NuCare, our psychological, financial, and legal assistance program

  • NuLanguage, our language-learning program

  • Nucleo, our learning and development platform

  • Work-from-home allowance

  • Relocation assistance, when applicable

WORK MODEL

Nu’s work model is hybrid, with teams working from the office two to three times per week on designated collaboration days.

Learn more about Nu’s hybrid work model.

EXPLORE HOW WE BUILD TECHNOLOGY AT NUBANK

Learn more through Building Nubank and the Building Nubank YouTube channel.

jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer - Lending Foundations (Policy & Data Platform)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Nu

Nu serves more than 140 million customers, guided by a mission to fight complexity and empower people. The company has been leading an industry transformation through innovative products and human-centered services.

 

Proprietary technology and data at scale power Nu’s digital platform, built to promote financial access, advancement, and transparency. Its business model thrives on customer love and lower costs, feeding a flywheel of growth and profitability.

Visit our Institutional Page

About the role

The Global Lending Foundations team, within our Global Lending BU, is building the platform that fundamentally changes how we design, build, and roll out lending decisions across new geographies.

Our mission is to create the tools and evolve the architecture that make it dramatically easier to launch lending products in new countries, with high business impact and direct exposure to Nu’s global expansion.

As a Staff Software Engineer, you will be a senior technical leader in this platform layer: defining the long-horizon technical direction for how Lending platforms scale across countries, products, and partners, and shaping how every future lending product is built across Brazil, the US, Mexico, Colombia and future markets.

You will operate at platform scale — building shared infrastructure that other teams depend on for years — while working in a highly engaged, multi-level engineering group and partnering closely with product and business leaders.

You'll be responsible for

  • We have a lot to offer, including professional growth and a supportive, engaging work environment. Like:

  • High Impact and Visibility: This is a high-exposure team with direct business impact on our global lending expansion. You'll interact with a wide range of stakeholders, from leadership to other business units, as you orchestrate your work across the BU.

  • Architectural Ownership: You'll help define the long-horizon technical direction of the entire Lending Platforms layer, making decisions that will outlast the cycle and shape how every Lending product is built across BR, US, MX, CO, and future countries.

  • Innovate with Us: You'll be part of a cross-impact team creating a fundamentally different way to build and roll out decisions within Lending, working alongside a heterogeneous group of engineers where your voice as a Staff engineer will set the technical bar.

  • Unmatched Support: You'll work with a highly engaged and supportive engineering team that will help you every step of the way while having fun in the process. Plus, you'll have experienced engineering leadership in the business unit to help you navigate the organization and support your growth.

Who We're Looking For

  • We're looking for an Engineer who has been in the role for at least 6 months and is ready to take on platform-scale challenges with broad architectural reach. This role is perfect for you if you:

  • Are comfortable reasoning about data at scale: the events and state this platform produces feed decisioning and analytics across the BU, so you think about schema evolution, data contracts, model & policies pipelines, and observability of what you build as first-class architectural concerns.

  • Own the data side of platform architecture: schema evolution, data contracts, and how the events and state you design get consumed downstream for decisioning and analytics across the BU.

  • Bring analytics rigor into architectural decisions: data quality, lineage, and observability aren't someone else's job, they're part of how you design the platform from day one.

  • Have deep experience with Nubank's tech stack, including Datomic, Kafka, Scala and Clojure, and are comfortable making it bend to the problem rather than the other way around.

  • Have a track record of driving alignment on hard architectural decisions across multiple teams and stakeholders, and of mentoring senior engineers toward Staff.

  • Are ready to be a key technical leader on platforms teams where the main customers are other engineering, data and product teams, and where your decisions directly shape what they can ship and how fast.

Location for this opportunity

This role can be based in one of the following hubs:

  • São Paulo, Rio de Janeiro, Campinas, or Belo Horizonte – Brazil

(We hire for one location; final base will be defined during the process.)

Work Model for this Role

  • Hybrid 2–3 times/week: Our hybrid work model brings us to the office at least twice a week, on strategic days designed to maximize team connection and collaboration. For more details, visit https://building.nubank.com/nu-hybrid-work-model/

Our Benefits

Benefits vary by country but are highly competitive in each market. For this role, they typically include:

  • Chance of earning equity at Nubank

  • Food / Meal Card (Vale-Refeição and/or Vale-Alimentação)

  • Public Transportation Commuting Benefit (Vale-Transporte)

  • NuCare – Psychological, Financial and Legal Assistance Program

  • Life Insurance

  • Medical Plan

  • Dental Plan

  • NuLanguage – Language Course Program

  • Nucleo – Our learning platform of courses

  • Extended Parental Leave

  • Daycare Allowance

  • Parental Consultancy

  • Work-from-home Allowance

  • Gym Partnerships

  • 30 days of paid vacation

  • Relocation Assistance Package, if applicable

Exact details and eligibility will be confirmed during the interview process, according to local regulations.

Join us

If you want to help design the platform that will power Nu’s lending products in every new market we enter — combining deep architecture, event-driven systems, and global impact — we’d love to hear from you.

Apply now to be our Staff Software Engineer in Brazil hubs.

The Global Lending Foundations team, within our Global Lending BU, is building the platform that fundamentally changes how we design, build, and roll out lending decisions across new geographies.

Our mission is to create the tools and evolve the architecture that make it dramatically easier to launch lending products in new countries, with high business impact and direct exposure to Nu’s global expansion.

As a Staff Software Engineer, you will be a senior technical leader in this platform layer: defining the long-horizon technical direction for how Lending platforms scale across countries, products, and partners, and shaping how every future lending product is built across Brazil, the US, Mexico, Colombia and future markets.

You will operate at platform scale — building shared infrastructure that other teams depend on for years — while working in a highly engaged, multi-level engineering group and partnering closely with product and business leaders.

You'll be responsible for

 - We have a lot to offer, including professional growth and a supportive, engaging work environment. Like:

 - High Impact and Visibility: This is a high-exposure team with direct business impact on our global lending expansion. You'll interact with a wide range of stakeholders, from leadership to other business units, as you orchestrate your work across the BU.

 - Architectural Ownership: You'll help define the long-horizon technical direction of the entire Lending Platforms layer, making decisions that will outlast the cycle and shape how every Lending product is built across BR, US, MX, CO, and future countries.

 - Innovate with Us: You'll be part of a cross-impact team creating a fundamentally different way to build and roll out decisions within Lending, working alongside a heterogeneous group of engineers where your voice as a Staff engineer will set the technical bar.

 - Unmatched Support: You'll work with a highly engaged and supportive engineering team that will help you every step of the way while having fun in the process. Plus, you'll have experienced engineering leadership in the business unit to help you navigate the organization and support your growth.

Who We're Looking For

 - We're looking for an Engineer who has been in the role for at least 6 months and is ready to take on platform-scale challenges with broad architectural reach. This role is perfect for you if you:

 - Are comfortable reasoning about data at scale: the events and state this platform produces feed decisioning and analytics across the BU, so you think about schema evolution, data contracts, model & policies pipelines, and observability of what you build as first-class architectural concerns.

 - Own the data side of platform architecture: schema evolution, data contracts, and how the events and state you design get consumed downstream for decisioning and analytics across the BU.

 - Bring analytics rigor into architectural decisions: data quality, lineage, and observability aren't someone else's job, they're part of how you design the platform from day one.

 - Have deep experience with Nubank's tech stack, including Datomic, Kafka, Scala and Clojure, and are comfortable making it bend to the problem rather than the other way around.

 - Have a track record of driving alignment on hard architectural decisions across multiple teams and stakeholders, and of mentoring senior engineers toward Staff.

 - Are ready to be a key technical leader on platforms teams where the main customers are other engineering, data and product teams, and where your decisions directly shape what they can ship and how fast.


LOCATION FOR THIS OPPORTUNITY

This role can be based in one of the following hubs:

 - São Paulo, Rio de Janeiro, Campinas, or Belo Horizonte – Brazil

(We hire for one location; final base will be defined during the process.)




WORK MODEL FOR THIS ROLE

If you want to help design the platform that will power Nu’s lending products in every new market we enter — combining deep architecture, event-driven systems, and global impact — we’d love to hear from you.

Our Engineering team helps Nu create and scale the technology that powers the best financial products in Latin America. We strive for state-of-the-art software development practices, using a variety of technologies and architectures to build resilient, secure, and highly scalable systems.

As a Lead Software Engineer , you will serve as a technical authority across entire business domains, shaping company-wide engineering strategy and driving the architectural evolution of large-scale distributed systems that power our core platform for tens of millions of customers. While we value experience with our tech stack, we are confident that top-tier technical leaders who are eager to learn will thrive here — and we will support your mastery of Clojure as our main backend language.

  3. Engineering Excellence: Setting and raising the technical bar for the entire engineering organization through systemic improvements, architectural reviews, and best-practice frameworks.

  6. Cross-Organizational Resilience: Establishing team practices for observability, failure domain isolation, disaster recovery, and incident resolution for critical systems

  2. Domain-Scale Expertise: Mastery of distributed systems design, microservices, cloud-native architectures, and failure-mode analysis in systems handling high concurrency and millions of active users.

  3. Cross-Team Influence: Demonstrated history of steering large-scale technical initiatives, aligning competing priorities across multiple engineering teams.

  4. Leadership & Sponsorship: Experience mentoring engineers

  5. Business Acumen & Communication: Exceptional communication skills with the ability to articulate complex technical trade-offs, risk profiles, and architectural decisions

  6. Language Proficiency: Advanced English skills (both written and spoken)

 

Work Setup

Location

Buenos Aires, Argentina
Argentina · Avenida del Libertador General San Martín 1000 – Vicente López
Hybrid

jobs.title: Senior Media Specialist
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Nu

Nu serves more than 140 million customers, guided by a mission to fight complexity and empower people. The company has been leading an industry transformation through innovative products and human-centered services.

 

Proprietary technology and data at scale power Nu’s digital platform, built to promote financial access, advancement, and transparency. Its business model thrives on customer love and lower costs, feeding a flywheel of growth and profitability.

Visit our Institutional Page

About the role

As the Senior Media Specialist - Marketing (US), you will drive Nu's paid media strategy in the US, translating business goals into full-funnel media plans across digital and offline channels, and helping build the measurement infrastructure needed to prove what's working. This role exists to help Nu grow efficiently and profitably in a market that's still early — you'll be one of the first people building the paid media engine for the US from the ground up, working independently to stand up the building blocks that don't yet exist.

You will propose, build, implement, optimize, and measure paid media campaigns end to end, operating in a test-and-learn model to find the most efficient paths to reach and convert audiences — with particular focus on the mass affluent target, reaching them in the key demographic and geographic areas aligned to Nu's product offerings, from national brand campaigns down to regional, state, and city-level activation.

This role also works closely with Business Analytics, Finance, and other marketing teams to build the first paid media measurement models for the US, translating spend into credible ROI and ROAS reporting that can hold up under scrutiny.

Key responsibilities and Expectations

  • Propose, build, implement, optimize, and measure paid media strategies across digital and offline channels (search, social, programmatic, video, CTV/OOH, direct mail, and others), matched to the right objective and funnel stage.

  • Set up the foundational building blocks for US paid media: platform accounts, tracking, tagging, and reporting infrastructure, working self-directed since much of this doesn't yet exist.

  • Run a disciplined test-and-learn model: design experiments across channel, audience, and creative to find efficient paths to growth, and scale what works.

  • Target and reach the mass affluent audience with precision: focus spend on the demographic and geographic areas that align to Nu's product offerings, balancing reach with efficiency.

  • Partner with Business Analytics and Finance to build the first paid media measurement models for the US: contribute to ROI/ROAS frameworks, incrementality approaches, and reporting that connects media spend to business outcomes.

  • Translate business goals into media strategy: work with brand, growth, and other marketing teams to turn objectives (awareness, acquisition, specific product goals) into channel plans and budget allocation.

  • Manage external media and creative agencies, and work directly with media platforms (Google, Meta, TikTok, and others) for platform best practices, beta access, and troubleshooting.

  • Bring a strong media point of view, grounded in external benchmarks and references where Nu's own US data doesn't yet exist: partner with marketing, product, and finance stakeholders to shape the US paid media approach, and represent that point of view clearly across teams.

Qualifications

  • Experience: 6–9 years in paid media or performance marketing, including hands-on ownership of multi-channel campaigns across national and regional/local levels.

  • Industry Experience: Background in tech, e-commerce, mobile app, or financial services is a strong plus — particularly experience with mobile app install/conversion campaigns and mobile measurement (SDKs, MMPs such as AppsFlyer or Adjust), given Nu's app-first product.

  • Technical Expertise: Deep hands-on experience across digital platforms (Google, Meta, TikTok, programmatic/DSPs, and others) and offline channels (TV, OOH, direct mail, radio), with fluency in ROI, ROAS, CPA, and other core media and marketing metrics.

  • Mindset: Highly detail-oriented, disciplined, and rigorous in campaign execution and reporting; self-directed and independent, comfortable building measurement and infrastructure from scratch, and runs a test-and-learn cadence rather than waiting for perfect data.

  • Agency & Platform Management: Proven experience managing external media and creative agencies, plus direct working relationships with media platforms themselves, including scoping, performance accountability, and budget oversight.

  • Market Knowledge: Experience planning and executing media at national, regional, and state/city levels in the US, with the ability to identify and prioritize the geographic and demographic areas that best align to a mass affluent target, and to bring outside benchmarks to fill data gaps.

  • Communication: Strong influence skills; able to represent the media point of view to marketing, finance, and analytics stakeholders as a senior individual contributor.

  • Languages: Fluent or native English required. Portuguese and/or Spanish preferred.

Core Skills

  • Strategic Acumen: Links near-term paid media bets to Nu's broader US growth strategy, and helps stakeholders see that connection too.

  • Analytical Ability: Analyzes performance and spend data with rigor and little oversight; turns it into recommendations that hold up when Finance or Business Analytics pushes back.

  • Stakeholder Relationship & Management: Builds and sustains trust with Business Analytics, Finance, and other marketing teams independently; manages conflicting priorities between paid media bets and broader marketing plans without escalating every time.

  • Marketing Knowledge & Channel Influence: Synthesizes performance data and market insight into media objectives, and advocates for budget or channel shifts where the data warrants it.

  • Customer & Audience Insight: Acts as a primary advocate for precise, well-targeted audience strategy in cross-functional discussions; translates data and market signal into concrete channel, budget, and creative decisions.

  • AI Fluency: Uses AI tools to improve targeting, creative testing, or media efficiency; evaluates AI initiatives on ROI, effort, and risk rather than adopting tools for their own sake.

 

Work Setup

Miami, US

Work model

[Hybrid / On-Site]

Office requirement

2 days per week at the office.

 

Our Benefits

  • Opportunity of earning equity at Nu

  • Medical Insurance

  • Dental and Vision Insurance

  • Life Insurance and AD&D

  • Extended maternity and paternity leaves

  • Nucleo - Our learning platform of courses

  • NuLanguage - Our language learning program

  • NuCare - Our mental health and wellness assistance program

  • 401K

  • Saving Plans - Health Saving Account and Flexible Spending Account

  • Work-from-home Allowance

  • Relocation Assistance Package, if applicable.

Our recruitment process may involve the use of artificial intelligence–enabled tools, such as automated interview transcription and analysis, to support the evaluation process. Artificial intelligence is not used to make final hiring decisions; all decisions are made by human reviewers.

To maintain a consistent and fair process for every candidate, Nu does not provide individualized technical feedback. See how our policy works here

Nu serves more than 140 million customers, guided by a mission to fight complexity and empower people. The company has been leading an industry transformation through innovative products and human-centered services.

 

Proprietary technology and data at scale power Nu’s digital platform, built to promote financial access, advancement, and transparency. Its business model thrives on customer love and lower costs, feeding a flywheel of growth and profitability.

Visit our Institutional Page

At Nubank, software engineers sit at the intersection of data, intelligence, and scale. We build systems that process millions of decisions daily, from fraud detection to credit modeling and increasingly, we do this powered by AI. Machine learning is embedded across our core products: in how we assess risk, personalize experiences, and automate decisions at scale. Engineers here don't just consume AI capabilities; they help shape how intelligence is built, deployed, and maintained in production.

We do it with engineering rigor, autonomy, and a deep focus on impact. Our engineers work across the full spectrum: designing data pipelines and architectures, deploying and maintaining ML models in production, and building the distributed systems and platforms that power our products. We value small, independent teams that move fast, own their decisions end-to-end, and hold themselves to a high bar for quality and craft.

We strive for state-of-the-art software development practices across our entire stack. While we value candidates familiar with our technologies, we're confident that engineers who join Nubank will learn and grow alongside our team:

  • Horizontally scalable microservices written mostly in Clojure, leveraging functional programming and hexagonal architecture

  • High-throughput event-driven architectures for inter-service communication

  • Continuous Integration and Deployment into cloud-native infrastructure

  • Distributed transactional systems built on Datomic, modeling complex business domains with immutable data and strong consistency

  • Modern data platforms built on ETL/ELT best practices, with robust monitoring and observability

Our Software Engineers

  • Work with large scale distributed systems

  • Collaborate with building microservices

  • Design, build and maintain robust data pipelines, distributed systems and ML-enabled solutions, ensuring reliability, scalability and performance at scale

  • Deploy and maintain ML models in both batch and real-time scenarios, integrating them with other systems and monitoring through operational and business metrics

  • Lead data and engineering projects end-to-end — from requirements gathering and stakeholder alignment to delivery and iteration

  • Contribute to the design, documentation, maintenance and optimization of our data codebase, platforms and tooling

  • Translate business needs into data products and technical solutions aligned with Nubank's architecture and long-term strategy

  • Partner with technical and business stakeholders to define strategies and deliver high-impact solutions

  • Share knowledge, mentor peers and contribute to engineering and data literacy initiatives across Nubank

What We're Looking For

  • Programming experience in one or more general-purpose languages (e.g. Python, Clojure, Scala, Java)

  • Familiarity with analytical data environments and data engineering concepts: pipelines, ETL/ELT, data modeling and storage

  • Understanding of ML model lifecycle, from training and evaluation to deployment and monitoring

  • Familiarity with distributed systems, microservices and asynchronous architectures

  • Strong communication skills to collaborate with both technical and business stakeholders

  • Passion for building high-quality software and data products

Nice to Have

  • Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS, GCP or Azure

  • Knowledge of data architecture patterns (Data Lake, Data Warehouse, Data Mart)

  • Familiarity with ML frameworks and feature engineering pipelines

  • Experience with data visualization tools (Looker, Power BI, Tableau or similar)

  • Knowledge of software engineering best practices: testing, clean code, documentation

Our Benefits

  • Chance of earning equity at Nubank

  • Food/Meal Card (Vale-Refeição and/or Vale Alimentação)

  • Public Transportation Commuting Benefit (Vale-Transporte)

  • NuCare – Psychological, Financial and Legal Assistance Program

  • Life Insurance, Medical Plan and Dental Plan

  • NuLanguage – Language Course Program

  • Nucleo – Our learning platform

  • Extended Parental Leave, Daycare Allowance and Parental Consultancy

  • Work-from-home Allowance

  • Gym Partnerships

  • 30 days of paid vacation

  • Relocation Assistance Package, if applicable

jobs.title: Senior Staff Software Engineer - Money Boxes
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Nu

Nu serves more than 140 million customers, guided by a mission to fight complexity and empower people. The company has been leading an industry transformation through innovative products and human-centered services.

 

Proprietary technology and data at scale power Nu’s digital platform, built to promote financial access, advancement, and transparency. Its business model thrives on customer love and lower costs, feeding a flywheel of growth and profitability.

Visit our Institutional Page

About the role
Money Boxes ("Caixinhas") is one of Nubank’s most strategic product innovations, transforming how millions of customers organize, save, and grow their money across Latin America. As Nubank expands into new geographies and financial verticals, we are looking for an exceptional Senior Staff Software Engineer to serve as the chief technical authority for our Money Boxes core platform.

In this role, you will operate at the intersection of high-concurrency distributed systems, transactional ledgering, investment asset allocation, and liquidity orchestration. You won't just maintain existing product flows—you will architect the foundational engines that enable millions of users to dynamically deposit, segment, and yield return on their savings instantly, securely, and at massive scale.

Your Mission: scale an extensible, multi-tenant Money Boxes platform that abstracts complex investment assets, yield generation mechanisms, and regulatory ledgering into simple, bulletproof platform capabilities across multiple international markets.

What You Will Own & Build

  • Money Boxes Platform Architecture: Define and execute the multi-year technical vision for Money Boxes backend architecture, ensuring high extensibility to support diverse underlying assets (e.g., fixed income, yield-bearing accounts, money market funds) across different countries.

  • Core Ledgering & Transaction Engines: Architect high-throughput, double-entry accounting engines and balance tracking systems that guarantee exact-once delivery, deterministic reconciliation, and real-time calculation of accruals and yield.

  • Liquidity & Asset Routing Infrastructure: Design resilient execution flows for deposits, withdrawals, and auto-investments, managing real-time settlement with internal brokerages, clearinghouses, and banking rails with low latencies and zero transactional error margin.

  • Multi-Country & Multi-Currency Abstractions: Abstract regional regulatory rules, local tax logic, and currency nuances into clean platform boundaries so product squads can launch localized Money Boxes experiences in record time.

  • Technical RFC Leadership: Author comprehensive design documents (RFCs) and drive architectural consensus across Payments, Core Banking, Investments, and Security leadership.

  • Engineering Mentorship & Technical Rigor: Elevate engineering standards across Money Boxes squads by mentoring senior engineers in distributed systems design, resilience patterns, fault tolerance, and domain-driven design.

What We Are Looking For

  • Senior IC Track Record: Proven experience as a senior technical leader (Staff/Senior Staff level) designing, operating, and scaling highly available, mission-critical distributed systems.

  • Fintech, Banking, or Investments Domain Depth: Deep hands-on experience building systems in transactional environments—such as savings platforms, ledger/accounting engines, investment order management, custody, or core banking infrastructure.

  • Distributed Systems Mastery: Exceptional fluency in event-driven architectures, transactional consistency, distributed sagas, domain-driven design (DDD), and high-concurrency microservices.

  • Platform & API Mindset: Demonstrated ability to build domain-agnostic, developer-friendly platforms and APIs with explicit contracts, SLAs, and high observability that allow consuming product teams to innovate rapidly.

  • Strategic & Horizontal Influence: Proven success driving cross-organizational technical alignment, navigating architectural trade-offs, and communicating technical strategy clearly to engineering leaders, Product Managers, and General Managers.

  • Language & Location: Professional fluency in English is required for international collaboration. Portuguese or Spanish is a plus. Roles are open in Brazil (hybrid model) or key US hubs..

Why Join Us?

You will join a high-bar engineering culture that values architectural clarity, technical depth, and rapid execution speed. You will directly own the systems that help over 140 million people build financial security and grow their wealth—shaping the future of personal finance technology across global markets.


Work Setup

Work model

[Hybrid / On-Site]

Office requirement

2 days per week at the office.

  • NuCare – Psychological, Financial and Legal Assistance Program

jobs.title: Senior Staff Systems Engineer - Performance Engineer
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Nu

Nu serves more than 140 million customers, guided by a mission to fight complexity and empower people. The company has been leading an industry transformation through innovative products and human-centered services.

 

Proprietary technology and data at scale power Nu’s digital platform, built to promote financial access, advancement, and transparency. Its business model thrives on customer love and lower costs, feeding a flywheel of growth and profitability.

Visit our Institutional Page


About the Role

The Systems Performance team is part of the Computing Squad consists of two distinct workstreams —Orchestration and System Performance —each with its own approach and challenges on managing and improving the foundational infrastructure where the majority of the Nubank's workloads runs. 

The Performance team is focused on building deep diagnostic tools and performing high-level analysis to reduce latency,  infrastructure costs and increase services efficiency.

You will be responsible for leading complex performance investigations, identifying systemic bottlenecks, and driving efficiency across one of the largest JVM-based microservice architectures in the world.

Our core principles and behaviors include ownership, simplicity, veracity-first, teamwork, and a focus on quality over quantity. During a normal work day, you will interact with critical infrastructure layers, from the Linux Kernel and JVM internals to cloud-wide orchestration.

You'll be responsible for

  • Leading Deep-Dive Investigations: Conduct high-level performance analysis to identify and resolve systemic bottlenecks across our global JVM-based microservices architecture.

  • Optimizing Resource Efficiency: Drive initiatives to reduce infrastructure costs and latency by fine-tuning JVM parameters, Garbage Collection (ZGC, G1), and memory management (heap and off-heap).

  • Building Diagnostic Tooling: Develop and implement advanced observability tools using eBPF, JFR, and Flamegraphs to provide real-time insights into kernel and runtime behavior.

  • Kernel & Runtime Alignment: Bridge the gap between the Linux Kernel and the JVM, optimizing thread scheduling (CFS/EEVDF) and managing resource isolation (cgroups/throttling) within our Kubernetes environment.

  • Architecting Scalable Solutions: Design and deliver innovative infrastructure improvements that address long-term performance challenges, ensuring our systems scale ahead of demand.

  • Technical Mentorship & Culture: Share expertise on JVM internals and performance best practices with the wider Engineering team, fostering a culture of technical excellence and "quality over quantity."

  • Root Cause Excellence: Deep dive into complex concurrency issues, lock contentions, and memory leaks, providing definitive fixes for high-impact technical debt.

  • Strategic Collaboration: Work closely with the Computing Squad to align orchestration strategies with system performance goals, ensuring a seamless interface between infrastructure and workloads.

We are looking for a person who has

  • Expertise in JVM Internals: Deep, low-level knowledge of the JVM is essential. You must understand how the JVM works "under the hood," including JIT compilation (C1/C2), class loading, and intrinsic methods.

  • JVM Tuning & Garbage Collection: Extensive experience with GC algorithms (ZGC, G1, Shenandoah), including the ability to tune them for massive heaps and ultra-low latency requirements.

  • OpenJDK Contribution (Major Plus): Previous experience contributing to the OpenJDK project or other low-level runtime environments is a significant advantage.

  • Linux Kernel & Scheduling: Deep understanding of the Linux Scheduler (CFS/EEVDF), thread scheduling, and how the kernel manages high-concurrency Java workloads.

  • Memory Architecture: Mastery of heap and off-heap memory management, including Direct Buffers, memory-mapped files, and diagnosing complex memory leaks.

  • Advanced Diagnostics: Mastery of diagnostic tools such as Flamegraphs, JFR (Java Flight Recorder), eBPF, and performing large-scale heap dump analysis.

  • Resource Isolation: Extensive experience with cgroups and the impact of CPU Throttling on JVM quotas within Kubernetes/EKS.

  • Concurrency: Proven ability to diagnose and resolve complex concurrency problems, including lock contention and race conditions at the instruction level.

  • Cloud Platforms: Knowledge of AWS infrastructure and its performance characteristics.

jobs.title: Head of Design, Global Expansion
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Nu

Nu serves more than 140 million customers, guided by a mission to fight complexity and empower people. The company has been leading an industry transformation through innovative products and human-centered services.

 

Proprietary technology and data at scale power Nu’s digital platform, built to promote financial access, advancement, and transparency. Its business model thrives on customer love and lower costs, feeding a flywheel of growth and profitability.

Visit our Institutional Page

Location: East Coast of U.S./Canada or Brazil (Eastern timezone for Europe-compatibility)

---

The Role

We're launching a brand-new global account into dozens of markets at once — multi-currency holdings, yield, diversification across digital assets, and a suite of debit cards, built for people whose work and family span borders. The infrastructure underneath is powered by stablecoins and open financial services, but that complexity is fully abstracted. What the customer feels is a delightful, magical consumer product — as simple and effortless as anything Apple makes.

This is the project where every new thing at Nu lands first: the Magic App, the next evolution of the design system, new components and patterns. You'd have unusual room to experiment, iterate, and push the system forward rather than just consume it. The benchmark isn't the domestic market — it's global leaders like Revolut and Wise, and we're building to raise the bar past them.

As Head of Design for this initiative, you'll own the design function for the entire project. This is a player-coach role: you'll manage a team, but you'll also stay deeply in the craft — prototyping, refining, and setting the standard by doing, not just by directing. We need someone whose work itself is the bar.

What You'll Do

* Lead the design function for Nubank's most ambitious global expansion — a multi-currency, multi-market account launching to 40+ countries simultaneously.

* Set and hold the craft bar at a global standard, benchmarking against the best fintech products in the world (Revolut, Wise, and beyond).

* Stay hands-on. You manage people, but you're also in the work — shipping design, prototyping, and elevating every surface and interaction.

* Push the design system forward. This product is the proving ground for new components and patterns that flow back into Nu's global design system. You don't just use the system; you evolve it.

* Navigate the balance between creative freedom and organizational maturity — earning autonomy by influencing and persuading the central design organization, contributing patterns back to the system, and building bridges rather than working in isolation.

* Collaborate closely with engineering, product, and the broader design organization to ship experiences that feel magical and effortless to customers across China, Italy, Spain, and dozens of other markets.

What We're Looking For

* Craft first. Extreme attention to detail and a portfolio that demonstrates world-class product design — the kind of work that stands out against Revolut, Wise, or Apple.

* A hands-on manager. You've led teams, but you still design. You set the bar by doing, not just by directing.

* Fintech-adjacent domain experience. You've worked in or around financial products — payments, cards, banking, digital assets, consumer finance. If you come from outside finance, you should have extraordinary craft and a track record of making complex products feel dead simple.

* A system-level collaborator. You know how to operate within a mature design organization — influencing the global system, contributing patterns, and partnering with central teams rather than working around them.

* A bar-raiser. You're not satisfied with "good enough." You push your team and yourself to the next level, especially when competing against the best in the world.

About the Product

A global account designed for people with cross-border lives — those who work across markets, have family in different countries, or need to move money internationally with ease. It offers multi-currency holdings, yield, diversification across digital assets, and a set of debit cards. The underlying technology is powered by stablecoins and open financial services, but that's invisible to the user. What they experience is a consumer product that feels as simple and delightful as anything Apple makes.

The product is launching nonlinearly into 40+ countries simultaneously — customers in China, Italy, Spain, and beyond. This is Nubank's most ambitious global expansion to date, and the design bar must match the ambition.

Interview Process

1. Async portfolio review with Ethan Eismann (CDO).

2. Live portfolio presentation (1 hour) — walkthrough of your best work with the design leadership team.

3. Hiring manager interview (45–60 min) with Thomaz Fortes and Thais Burin.

4. Final conversation with Ethan if needed.

---

Hiring managers: Thomaz Fortes & Thais Burin · CDO: Ethan Eismann

* Navigate the balance between creative freedom and organizational maturity — earning autonomy by influencing and persuading the central design organization, contributing patterns back to the system, and building bridges rather than working in isolation.

* Collaborate closely with engineering, product, and the broader design organization to ship experiences that feel magical and effortless to customers across China, Italy, Spain, and dozens of other markets.




WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

* Craft first. Extreme attention to detail and a portfolio that demonstrates world-class product design — the kind of work that stands out against Revolut, Wise, or Apple.

* A hands-on manager. You've led teams, but you still design. You set the bar by doing, not just by directing.

* Fintech-adjacent domain experience. You've worked in or around financial products — payments, cards, banking, digital assets, consumer finance. If you come from outside finance, you should have extraordinary craft and a track record of making complex products feel dead simple.

* A system-level collaborator. You know how to operate within a mature design organization — influencing the global system, contributing patterns, and partnering with central teams rather than working around them.

* A bar-raiser. You're not satisfied with "good enough." You push your team and yourself to the next level, especially when competing against the best in the world.




ABOUT THE PRODUCT

A global account designed for people with cross-border lives — those who work across markets, have family in different countries, or need to move money internationally with ease. It offers multi-currency holdings, yield, diversification across digital assets, and a set of debit cards. The underlying technology is powered by stablecoins and open financial services, but that's invisible to the user. What they experience is a consumer product that feels as simple and delightful as anything Apple makes.

The product is launching nonlinearly into 40+ countries simultaneously — customers in China, Italy, Spain, and beyond. This is Nubank's most ambitious global expansion to date, and the design bar must match the ambition.




INTERVIEW PROCESS

1. Async portfolio review with Ethan Eismann (CDO).

2. Live portfolio presentation (1 hour) — walkthrough of your best work with the design leadership team.

3. Hiring manager interview (45–60 min) with Thomaz Fortes and Thais Burin.

4. Final conversation with Ethan if needed.

Proprietary technology and data at scale power Nu’s digital platform, built to promote financial access, advancement, and transparency. Its business model thrives on customer love and lower costs, feeding a flywheel of growth and profitability.

Visit our Institutional Page

About the Role

We are looking for a Compliance Analyst to work on topics related to Prudential regulation (including integrated risk management), treasury, governance, and accounting regulation (including regulatory reporting).

The role requires working and interfacing with multiple partners and teams (mostly in Brazil, but also across other geographies), assessing new regulations, and supporting business areas by providing regulatory advice on products and procedures, participating in discussions to define action plans to comply with regulatory requirements, and reporting regulatory risks through the established governance processes.


You’ll be Responsible for

  • Daily monitoring of newly issued regulations and tracking implementation status through to completion;

  • Coordinating regulator requests across multiple stakeholders and ensuring the quality and consistency of information provided to the regulator;

  • Assessing regulations related to the role’s key topics, engaging in projects when needed, and identifying impacts where applicable;

  • Supporting both the Compliance team across its various demands and the business areas by providing regulatory advisory support;

  • Assessing new products through the lens of the key topics when needed, identifying potential risks and implementation/adaptation requirements across the company and different areas;

  • Recording and tracking action plans to meet regulatory requirements and deadlines, and preparing presentations or reports to provide visibility to relevant stakeholders;

  • Supporting the review of regulatory policies within the covered topics, ensuring regulatory adherence and alignment with minimum regulatory standards.

 

What We're Looking For Someone Who Has

  • +4 years of experience in similar positions.

  • Knowledge of Central Bank regulation, especially Prudential regulation, Integrated Risk Management, governance, and accounting regulation (mandatory)

  • Analytical profile and proficiency in using AI.

  • Proven experience working autonomously.

  • Hungry, eager to make a difference, and able to learn quickly.

jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Nu

Nu serves more than 140 million customers, guided by a mission to fight complexity and empower people. The company has been leading an industry transformation through innovative products and human-centered services.

 

Proprietary technology and data at scale power Nu’s digital platform, built to promote financial access, advancement, and transparency. Its business model thrives on customer love and lower costs, feeding a flywheel of growth and profitability.

Visit our Institutional Page

About the Role

The BI Intelligence team builds and evolves the platforms that allow every Nubanker to consume data easily, safely, at scale and with lower cost. Databricks is one of the foundations of our internal analytics ecosystem, alongside technologies that support business intelligence, exploration and decision-making across the company.

Analytics is entering a fundamental shift. We are moving beyond predefined dashboards and manually written queries toward conversational and agentic experiences, where people can ask questions in natural language, explore relationships, create and validate metrics, and move from question to insight faster.

As a Staff Software Engineer – BI Intelligence, you will help shape this next generation of analytics. You will work at the intersection of software engineering, SRE, data platforms and applied AI, building reliable and governed systems that make data more accessible while protecting security, quality, traceability and cost.


You’ll be Responsible for

  • Designing and evolving analytics platforms that serve Nubankers and business units across the company.

  • Building AI-powered data experiences, including natural-language interfaces, query generation, tool orchestration, grounding and feedback mechanisms.

  • Developing the foundations required for trustworthy AI analytics: semantic context, governed metrics, data contracts, lineage, quality, access control and evaluation.

  • Designing and operating reliable distributed systems with strong observability, service objectives, security, performance and cost controls.

  • Driving technical direction and making architectural decisions in partnership with engineering leadership and cross-functional stakeholders.

  • Translating ambiguous problems into clear technical options, trade-offs and execution plans.

  • Mentoring engineers and raising the engineering bar through design reviews, pairing, documentation and operational practices.

  • Helping turn promising AI capabilities into dependable products that improve how Nubankers work with data.

 

What We're Looking For Someone Who Has

Required

  • Proven experience as a Staff-level Software Engineer or equivalent technical leader delivering high-impact systems in production.

  • Strong software engineering fundamentals and an SRE mindset, including experience designing reliable distributed systems, defining service objectives and improving observability.

  • Experience with data platforms or analytics infrastructure, such as Databricks, distributed query engines, metadata catalogs, semantic layers or large-scale data systems.

  • Deep understanding of data semantics, metric definitions, data contracts, lineage, data quality and access control.

  • Experience designing or integrating AI/LLM-powered products, including natural-language interfaces, RAG, tool use, query generation, grounding or evaluation.

  • Ability to balance security, governance, reliability, latency, performance and cost at scale.

  • Proven ability to lead ambiguous, cross-functional initiatives and drive alignment across teams and stakeholders.

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain complex technical decisions clearly.

  • Experience mentoring engineers and influencing technical direction beyond your immediate team.

Nice to Have

  • Experience building conversational analytics, agentic workflows or AI-powered developer/data tools.

  • Experience with evaluation frameworks, guardrails and monitoring for AI-generated outputs.

  • Background in financial services, fintech or other regulated environments.

 

Work Setup

Location

Brazil

Work model

Hybrid

Office requirement

Hybrid 2–3 times/week: Our hybrid work model brings us to the office at least twice a week, on strategic days designed to maximize team connection and collaboration. For more details, visit https://building.nubank.com/nu-hybrid-work-model/

jobs.title: Product Leadership (Director, Sr Director, VP)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Nu

Nu serves more than 140 million customers, guided by a mission to fight complexity and empower people. The company has been leading an industry transformation through innovative products and human-centered services.

 

Proprietary technology and data at scale power Nu’s digital platform, built to promote financial access, advancement, and transparency. Its business model thrives on customer love and lower costs, feeding a flywheel of growth and profitability.

Visit our Institutional Page

This is a general pipeline as we're working on a few very senior Product roles here.

Product Leadership at Nu
At Nubank, we want to deliver the best possible products to our customers. This aspiration guides our product, engineering, and design decisions from the moment we conceive of an idea to the first version of a product we put in a user’s hands to the endless iterations we make after that. Product development at Nubank is fundamentally about impact, and this is where we start when we evaluate new ideas. We want to have meaningful, long-term value for our customers by providing products that are truly empowering and life-improving. Or, as one of our company values says: “We want our customers to love us fanatically.”

We're always looking for exceptional product leaders to reinvent the future of financial services. We do not look for opportunities that are small or use cases where good solutions already exist. We look for big problems that cause people (and companies) enormous amounts of frustration and pain. One of our other company values emphasizes this point: “We are hungry and challenge the status quo.” In financial services, this boldness often means targeting the complexity that is endemic to financial products.

What you'd be taking on
Product leaders at Nubank are in the intersection of massive scale and insurgent mindset. Nubank products have massive scale across the globe, reaching more than 135 million people across Brazil, Mexico and Colombia. It means our product leaders operate at a level of complexity that is hard to find anywhere else. Furthermore, the road ahead is incredibly more complex and exciting than what we have achieved so far, as we expand into new countries, business lines and customers' lives. As a product leader, you own the vision, the strategy, the trade-offs, the launch, and the numbers afterward. You're a fit first and foremost if you're fanatical about our customers and you want to challenge the status quo.

You should apply if

  • You set the vision, not just the roadmap. You can define where a business unit or building block is going two-plus years out, and defend it with customer insight, business logic and technical depth in equal measure.

  • You've built the teams that build the products. You've grown and coached multiple product teams — not one — and you've hired and levelled up product managers who went on to do the same. That track record tells us more than a number of years ever could.

  • You have genuine product approach. You stay close to the data, the customer and the market.

  • You build with AI. You've used AI to change how your teams discover, prototype and ship — and you have a clear, practical view of where it belongs in the product itself and where it doesn't.

  • You're hands-on at a senior level. Our most senior product people still get into the details of the product and the market.

Proprietary technology and data at scale power Nu’s digital platform, built to promote financial access, advancement, and transparency. Its business model thrives on customer love and lower costs, feeding a flywheel of growth and profitability.

Visit our Institutional Page

About the role

Our Engineering team helps Nubank to create and use the technology that provides us to build the best financial products. We strive for state-of-the-art software development practices that currently include a variety of technologies. While we value candidates that are familiar with them, we are also confident that software engineers who are interested in joining Nubank will be able to learn from our team. The software engineer is focused on software development with Clojure as main programming language (We will teach you Clojure), understanding how the created services produce and consume data—including the downstream impact of schema changes, data contracts, and data quality.

  • Horizontally scalable microservices written mostly in Clojure, using Finagle and leveraging upon functional programming techniques and hexagonal architecture

  • High throughput jobs and inter-service communication using Kafka

  • Continuous Integration and Deployment into AWS

  • Storing and managing data across ecosystems, including ETL pipelines, Datomic, and DynamoDB.

  • Monitoring and observability with Prometheus

  • Running as much as possible in Kubernetes


    You will be responsible for

  • Work with large scale distributed systems, understanding their broad architecture

  • Plan and execute on entire features, collaborating with peers while planning the work ahead, and seeing it through

  • Collaborate in building microservices and work with continuous delivery and infrastructure as code

  • Work with agile software development methodologies

  • Write, test, instrument, document, and maintain code

  • Pair, and participate in code reviews, to grow and contribute to the growth of others in and around the team

  • Collaborate closely with Product, Design, and partner Engineering teams to build new experiences

  • Participate in on-call rotations for your team and respond to incidents as necessary

  • Work focused on backend applications, and be open to contribute to mobile and frontend development, according to business needs.

  • Baseline understanding of data manipulation and data processing at scale.

  • Familiarity with both transactional and analytical environments.


We are looking for a person who has

  • At least 4 years of experience developing digital products

  • Ability to quickly understand technical and business requirements, translating them into technical design and implementation

  • A problem-solver who is able to communicate effectively across functional teams

  • A software engineer who cares deeply about user experience

  • Proven understanding of object-oriented or functional programming language

  • Collaborate with building microservices

  • Notions of distributed systems and familiarity with cloud technologies

  • Have practical knowledge of agile software development methodologies and previous experience with CI/CD

  • Curiosity and willingness to develop breadth beyond the candidate’s primary specialty.

  • Ability to reason about how backend systems affect downstream data products.

  • Advanced English skills

Mexico City, Mexico.

  • Chance of earning equity at Nu

  • Health and life insurance

  • Dental and Vision Insurance

  • NuCare – our mental health and wellness assistance program

  • Nucleo – our learning platform of courses

  • NuLanguage – our language learning program

Proprietary technology and data at scale power Nu’s digital platform, built to promote financial access, advancement, and transparency. Its business model thrives on customer love and lower costs, feeding a flywheel of growth and profitability.

Visit our Institutional Page https://www.nu.com/2026-en

About the role

Our Engineering team helps Nubank to create and use the technology that provides us to build the best financial products. We strive for state-of-the-art software development practices that currently include a variety of technologies. While we value candidates that are familiar with them, we are also confident that software engineers who are interested in joining Nubank will be able to learn from our team. The software engineer is focused on software development with Clojure as main programming language (We will teach you Clojure), understanding how the created services produce and consume data—including the downstream impact of schema changes, data contracts, and data quality.

 - Horizontally scalable microservices written mostly in Clojure, using Finagle and leveraging upon functional programming techniques and hexagonal architecture

 - High throughput jobs and inter-service communication using Kafka

 - Continuous Integration and Deployment into AWS

 - Storing and managing data across ecosystems, including ETL pipelines, Datomic, and DynamoDB.

 - Monitoring and observability with Prometheus

 - Running as much as possible in Kubernetes
   
   
   You will be responsible for
   

 - Work with large scale distributed systems, understanding their broad architecture

 - Plan and execute on entire features, collaborating with peers while planning the work ahead, and seeing it through

 - Collaborate in building microservices and work with continuous delivery and infrastructure as code

 - Work with agile software development methodologies

 - Write, test, instrument, document, and maintain code

 - Pair, and participate in code reviews, to grow and contribute to the growth of others in and around the team

 - Collaborate closely with Product, Design, and partner Engineering teams to build new experiences

 - Participate in on-call rotations for your team and respond to incidents as necessary

 - Work focused on backend applications, and be open to contribute to mobile and frontend development, according to business needs.

 - Baseline understanding of data manipulation and data processing at scale.

 - Familiarity with both transactional and analytical environments.


We are looking for a person who has

 - At least 4 years of experience developing digital products

 - Ability to quickly understand technical and business requirements, translating them into technical design and implementation

 - A problem-solver who is able to communicate effectively across functional teams

 - A software engineer who cares deeply about user experience

 - Proven understanding of object-oriented or functional programming language

 - Collaborate with building microservices

 - Notions of distributed systems and familiarity with cloud technologies

 - Have practical knowledge of agile software development methodologies and previous experience with CI/CD

 - Curiosity and willingness to develop breadth beyond the candidate’s primary specialty.

 - Ability to reason about how backend systems affect downstream data products.

 - Advanced English skills


LOCATION

Mexico City, Mexico.

 - NuCare – our mental health and wellness assistance program

 - Nucleo – our learning platform of courses

Even if you feel you don't meet every qualification, we encourage you to apply — your unique skills and experiences may be just what we're looking for, and we're excited to learn more about what you can bring to our team.

jobs.title: AML/CFT Ops Analyst
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Nu

Nu serves more than 140 million customers, guided by a mission to fight complexity and empower people. The company has been leading an industry transformation through innovative products and human-centered services.

 

Proprietary technology and data at scale power Nu’s digital platform, built to promote financial access, advancement, and transparency. Its business model thrives on customer love and lower costs, feeding a flywheel of growth and profitability.

Visit our Institutional Page

About the Role

Millions of people trust Nu with their money every day. Protecting that trust — and the integrity of the financial system around it — is the work of our Ops Defense team.

As an AML/CFT Ops Analyst, you'll investigate the transactional alerts our monitoring systems raise, decide what is genuinely suspicious, and build the case files that regulators and auditors rely on. Your judgment directly shapes how Nu detects money laundering and terrorist financing in Colombia.

The work is analytical and high-stakes, and increasingly involves crypto and virtual asset flows. Beyond individual cases, you'll help sharpen the system itself — tuning scenarios and thresholds so we surface more of what matters and less of what doesn't.

Compliant operations are a driving force behind Nu's growth, and this role sits at the center of that.

 

You'll be responsible for

  • Analyze transactional alerts generated by Nu's AML monitoring system to identify suspicious activity, including crypto and virtual asset flows.

  • Investigate AML cases end to end, applying network analysis, escalating where needed, and preparing complete investigation files.

  • Document rationale and decisions with the quality and traceability required for regulatory and audit scrutiny.

  • Drive the tuning and continuous improvement of transaction monitoring scenarios, thresholds, and operational routines.

  • Own decisions that affect customers and Nu, grounded in AML policy and applicable local and global regulation.

  • Build metrics, KPIs, and deep dives that measure the efficiency and regulatory adherence of transaction monitoring.

  • Partner with AML Governance and cross-functional teams to turn regulatory challenges into practical, scalable solutions.

 

We are looking for a person who has

Required

  • Bachelor's degree.

  • 3+ years of experience in AML processes such as transaction monitoring, PEPs, sanctions, or investigations.

  • Hands-on experience conducting AML investigations and network analysis.

  • Experience with crypto, blockchain analytics, or monitoring of crypto-related transactions.

  • Familiarity with transaction monitoring systems and case management tools.

  • A solid analytical background, comfort manipulating data, and genuine interest in learning basic data analysis (SQL, Python).

  • Advanced or native Spanish and advanced English, with strong communication skills across different backgrounds and cultures.

Nice to have

  • Working knowledge of SQL or Python applied to AML analysis.

  • Experience with KYC, enhanced due diligence, FATCA/CRS, or sanctions screening routines.

  • Experience contributing to the tuning of monitoring scenarios or thresholds.

  • AML certifications such as CAMS or equivalent.

 

Location for this opportunity

Bogotá, Colombia - Onsite role

 

Our Benefits

  • Chance of earning equity at Nu

  • Extended maternity and paternity leaves

  • Health and life insurance

  • NuCare - Our mental health and wellness assistance program

  • Nucleo - Our learning platform of courses

  • NuLanguage - Our language learning program

  • Vacations of 15 workdays

  • Gym partnership

  • Work-from-home Allowance

  • Parental Consultancy

  • Relocation Assistance Package, if applicable

 

Work Model for this Role

This role is fully onsite at our Bogotá office. For more details on how we work, visit https://building.nubank.com/nu-hybrid-work-model/

jobs.title: Global Software Asset Management Lead
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Nu

Nu serves more than 140 million customers, guided by a mission to fight complexity and empower people. The company has been leading an industry transformation through innovative products and human-centered services.

 

Proprietary technology and data at scale power Nu’s digital platform, built to promote financial access, advancement, and transparency. Its business model thrives on customer love and lower costs, feeding a flywheel of growth and profitability.

Visit our Institutional Page

About the role

Nubank is building a global Software Asset Management (SAM) capability to govern how software is requested, acquired, secured, provisioned, optimized, renewed, and retired across the company. Software is one of our largest and fastest-growing technology spend categories, and it carries real security, privacy, and audit exposure — every tool we buy creates licenses to optimize, access to control, contracts to honor, and data to protect.

We are looking for a senior individual contributor to lead this transformation globally. This role owns the design and implementation of Nubank's SAM operating model, working across Enterprise Technology Services (ETS), Information Security, IAM, Procurement, Finance, Legal, Data Protection, and business areas.

This is an IC6 role: you will lead through deep expertise, influence, and execution across multiple functions and geographies. You will not be expected to manage a large team directly; instead, you will set the technical and operational direction for SAM and enable partner teams to execute consistently.

You own a clear goal: a trusted, governed, and cost-efficient global software portfolio — with complete inventory, right-sized licenses, controlled access, audit-ready evidence, and measurable savings.

You'll be responsible for

  • Leading the global implementation of Nubank's Software Asset Management framework, from intake through acquisition, lifecycle management, renewal, and decommissioning.

  • Establishing ETS as the operational owner of the software portfolio and creating clear interfaces with ITSec, IAM, Procurement, Legal, DPO, Finance, and business owners.

  • Implementing an intake-first operating model in which software needs are assessed for catalog fit, duplication, build-vs-buy, security, open source governance, and data-protection requirements before commercial negotiation begins.

  • Defining and operationalizing the Software Catalog as the single source of truth for software assets, owners, licenses, spend, contracts, renewals, usage, risk classification, and access posture.

  • Driving the separation of license management from access management, partnering with IAM to ensure least-privilege access, automated provisioning/deprovisioning, and reliable license reclamation.

  • Designing risk-tiered workflows for SaaS, AI tools, FOSS, browser extensions, connectors, pilots, and exceptions.

  • Establishing lifecycle automation, including renewal alerts, inactivity-based reclamation, ownership reassignment, offboarding workflows, and Shadow IT detection/remediation.

  • Leading the Software Asset Selection Committee and defining decision criteria, escalation paths, exception handling, and governance cadence.

  • Building global SAM standards, policies, RACI, controls, SLAs, playbooks, and reporting practices that meet Nubank's security, regulatory, and audit needs.

  • Partnering with Procurement to improve vendor negotiations through usage data, right-sizing, duplicate-tool consolidation, and early renewal decisions.

  • Defining and reporting the SAM performance framework: inventory completeness, license utilization, reclaimed spend, duplicate-tool reduction, renewal readiness, intake cycle time, access-review completion, and Shadow IT trends.

  • Leading phased adoption across countries and business units, balancing global standards with local regulatory and operating needs.

  • Serving as Nubank's internal subject-matter expert for SAM, ITAM, SaaS governance, and software lifecycle controls.

    We are looking for a person who has

    • Significant experience leading Software Asset Management, IT Asset Management, SaaS Management, or adjacent enterprise technology governance programs in a complex global environment.

    • A recognized SAM/ITAM certification, such as IAITAM CSAM, CITAM, or equivalent certification/experience.

    • Proven experience implementing or significantly evolving a SAM operating model, including tooling, process design, governance, integrations, and adoption.

    • Strong knowledge of software licensing, SaaS contracts, renewals, vendor management, license optimization, and audit/compliance requirements.

    • Practical experience with SAM platforms such as Zylo, Flexera, ServiceNow SAM, Snow, SaaS Management platforms, or similar.

    • Experience working with IAM and identity platforms such as Okta, including the distinction between license entitlement and application access.

    • Ability to design scalable workflows and automation across HRIS, IAM, procurement, ticketing, catalog, finance, and security systems.

    • Strong executive communication skills, with the ability to turn complex operational issues into clear decisions, trade-offs, and measurable outcomes.

    • Demonstrated ability to influence senior stakeholders across Security, Procurement, Finance, Legal, Engineering, and Product without direct authority.

    • Fluency in English; Portuguese or Spanish is a plus.

      Location for this opportunity (City, Country)

      São Paulo, Brazil

      Our Benefits

      • Chance of earning equity at Nubank

      • Food/ Meal Card (Vale-Refeição and/or Vale Alimentação)

      • Public Transportation Commuting Benefit (Vale-Transporte)

      • NuCare – Psychological, Financial and Legal Assistance Program

      • Life Insurance

      • Medical Plan

      • Dental Plan

      • NuLanguage – Language Course Program

      • Nucleo - Our learning platform of courses

      • Extended Parental Leave

      • Daycare Allowance

      • Parental Consultancy

      • Work-from-home Allowance

      • Gym Partnerships

      • 30 days of paid vacation

      • Relocation Assistance Package, if applicable

      Work Model for this Role

      Hybrid 2-3 times/week: Our hybrid work model brings us to the office at least twice a week, on strategic days designed to maximize team connection and collaboration. For more details, visit https://building.nubank.com/nu-hybrid-work-model/
