jobs.title: Lead Data Center Engineer - Global Office IT Physical Infra
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Nu

Nu serves more than 140 million customers, guided by a mission to fight complexity and empower people. The company has been leading an industry transformation through innovative products and human-centered services.

 

Proprietary technology and data at scale power Nu’s digital platform, built to promote financial access, advancement, and transparency. Its business model thrives on customer love and lower costs, feeding a flywheel of growth and profitability.

Visit our Institutional Page

About the role

Every Nubank office runs on an IT Room that most people never see. Power distribution, cooling, structured cabling and fiber are the layer that keeps thousands of Nubankers connected and working — and when that layer fails, entire sites stop.

Nubank's office portfolio is growing across countries, and today each site has been built to its own standard. The ETS team owns the physical layer of these environments — structured cabling, optical fiber and, in partnership with other teams, power distribution, HVAC, fire protection and physical security systems. This role exists to bring one engineering standard to all of them.

As Lead Infrastructure Engineer for Global Office IT Physical Infra, you are the technical reference for IT Room infrastructure across Nubank's global office portfolio. You assess and size environments, define the technical specifications new sites and expansions must meet, and coordinate the vendors and construction teams who build them — so that an IT Room in Miami, São Paulo or Mexico City is built, documented and operated the same way.

This is a senior individual contributor role with technical authority rather than direct reports. You set the standard, you review the projects against it, and you catch the gaps before they become outages.

You'll be responsible for

  • Assessing and sizing IT Rooms for expansion and improvement projects, defining the technical and physical specifications that meet real capacity needs, optimize resource use, and hold to operational standards.

  • Executing deployment projects for new environments and expansions in compliance with established technical specifications, and coordinating deployment logistics end to end while ensuring quality standards throughout.

  • Acting as the interface between internal teams and external vendors — translating business needs into infrastructure requirements, work orders and technical specifications — and managing those vendors and service providers to quality, deadline and compliance with Nubank's standards.

  • Coordinating with construction and engineering teams during the build-out of new offices, ensuring IT Room specifications are met from the earliest project phases rather than retrofitted later.

  • Creating and maintaining clear, current technical documentation — standards, procedures, capacity plans, topology diagrams, bayfaces — so that every site is aligned and auditable.

  • Ensuring alignment between physical infrastructure and IT operations, including cabling changes, equipment installation, capacity planning and structured cabling terminations.

  • Driving continuous improvement in the availability, resilience and efficiency of IT Room physical infrastructure: HVAC, structured cabling, optical fiber, power distribution, generators, UPS units and fire protection.

  • Supporting the assessment of the global IT Room portfolio across corporate offices, identifying gaps and standardization opportunities across multiple sites and countries.

We are looking for a person who has

  • Solid experience with mission-critical environment infrastructure, including the deployment and operation of physical infrastructure in corporate offices or data center facilities.

  • Strong hands-on command of mission-critical infrastructure systems: HVAC and air conditioning, structured cabling, optical fiber, low-voltage power distribution, UPS units, generators, and fire detection and suppression.

  • Proven experience coordinating deployment projects that run structured cabling, electrical, mechanical and civil scopes simultaneously.

  • Experience managing vendors and service providers on infrastructure projects from technical specification through execution and acceptance.

  • A consistent track record of creating and maintaining clear technical documentation for infrastructure standards, procedures and projects.

  • A completed degree in Electrical, Electronic or Mechanical Engineering, or an equivalent technical background.

  • Proficiency in AutoCAD.

  • Availability to work in a hybrid model and to travel internationally to Nubank office locations for site assessments and deployments.


Location for this opportunity (City, Country)

Miami, United States


Our Benefits

  • Opportunity of earning equity at Nu

  • Medical Insurance

  • Dental and Vision Insurance

  • Life Insurance and AD&D

  • Extended maternity and paternity leaves

  • Nucleo — Our learning platform of courses

  • NuLanguage — Our language learning program

  • NuCare — Our mental health and wellness assistance program

  • 401K

  • Saving Plans — Health Saving Account and Flexible Spending Account

  • Work-from-home Allowance

  • Relocation Assistance Package, if applicable

Work Model for this Role

Hybrid 2-3 times/week: Our hybrid work model brings us to the office at least twice a week, on strategic days designed to maximize team connection and collaboration. For more details, visit https://building.nubank.com/nu-hybrid-work-model/

jobs.title: Lead Software Engineer (Cloud Network)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Nu

Nu serves more than 140 million customers, guided by a mission to fight complexity and empower people. The company has been leading an industry transformation through innovative products and human-centered services.

 

Proprietary technology and data at scale power Nu’s digital platform, built to promote financial access, advancement, and transparency. Its business model thrives on customer love and lower costs, feeding a flywheel of growth and profitability.

Visit our Institutional Page

About the role

Every transaction at Nubank travels across a network before it reaches a customer. As we grow across countries, accounts, regions and hybrid environments, the connectivity layer underneath has to stay fast, segmented, auditable and cheap to run — while never becoming the thing that takes the platform down.

As a Lead Software Engineer on a Cloud Network platform engineering team, you set and evolve the technical direction for how Nubank connects its cloud, hybrid and on-premises environments. You own problems whose scope spreads across several teams and business units, and you are expected to bring structure to ambiguity rather than wait for it to be resolved for you.

This is an IC6 role: you lead through technical depth, design authority and influence rather than direct reports. The goal you own is a cloud network platform that scales with the business, holds up under audit, and gets simpler over time instead of more complex.

You'll be responsible for

  • Setting and evolving the technical direction of the cloud network platform owned by your team, aligning with Nubank's canonical approaches and contributing back to the broader technical community.

  • Leading high-level and low-level design for connectivity patterns across multi-account, multi-region, multi-geo and hybrid-cloud topologies, independently making sound architectural decisions in multi-component, multi-team designs.

  • Managing complex network projects and processes end to end — working independently, coordinating across subjects and stakeholders, and escalating for managerial support in a timely way rather than reactively.

  • Proactively reducing long-term complexity through simplification, consolidation, deprecation and paved roads, explicitly balancing scalability, maintainability and cost, and considering both human and AI interaction with the platform.

  • Owning the operational health of the network platform in your team's scope: leading complex incident response (diagnosis, coordination, resolution), driving complex postmortems, and owning the short- and long-term tech debt strategy that comes out of them.

  • Promoting a culture of safe change — feature flags, gradual rollout, monitoring, fast rollback — applied to network changes, and driving simplification and cost optimization across the topology.

  • Setting and enforcing quality standards for the team's automation and infrastructure code: testing practices, code review bar, reusable modules, and anticipation of quality and maintainability needs coming from business strategy.

  • Defining observability for the platform — robust monitoring, controls and SLAs that surface issues proactively rather than after customer impact.

  • Bringing a strong end-to-end domain understanding: tracing a business process from product through the transactional path down to the network and data layers, and understanding how network design choices propagate through it.

  • Owning the network security posture of your scope, including PCI DSS or equivalent standards, segmentation, and controls that hold up under audit.

  • Evaluating buy vs. build options and new products and technologies, being data-driven about stability, reliability, scalability and cost before committing to a solution.

  • Mentoring IC4/IC5 engineers on the broader system landscape, design reasoning and operational practice, and raising the bar of the people around you.

  • Participating in hiring as a core part of the role, contributing to function-wide taskforces and initiatives, and documenting decisions so that knowledge travels across teams, not just within yours.

We are looking for a person who has

  • CCIE, CCNP or equivalent experience — you are comfortable designing, building, implementing, maintaining and troubleshooting complex, large-scale networking infrastructures.

  • Solid hands-on experience in infrastructure automation and cloud computing (AWS preferred), with depth in AWS networking services — Transit Gateway, VPC design, Direct Connect, PrivateLink, Route 53, NAT/egress patterns, network firewalls — or similar technologies.

  • Deep experience planning, deploying and troubleshooting network solutions at scale: IP address management, BGP and dynamic routing, firewalls, load balancers, routers and switches, and hybrid connectivity.

  • Strong coding skills (python, .Net. Java, Go etc.)

  • Experience leading incident response and root cause analysis for high-impact, ambiguous failures across team boundaries.

  • Strong leadership: you confidently lead complex projects that carry ambiguity and require strategic thinking, with or without formal authority.

  • Experienced communication: you convey complex technical messages clearly and persuasively to technical and non-technical audiences, adjusting depth and examples to the room, and you facilitate productive discussion rather than just presenting.

  • Strategic acumen and long-term perspective: you connect network platform decisions to business drivers such as operational efficiency, reliability and cost, link 6–12 month initiatives to the broader organizational strategy, and anticipate cross-team impact and trade-offs.

  • An analytical profile: you go after root causes and propose solutions that hold, working creatively and analytically in a continuous improvement environment.


    Location for this opportunity (City, Country)

  • Palo Alto, United States


Our Benefits

  • Opportunity of earning equity at Nu

  • Medical Insurance

  • Dental and Vision Insurance

  • Life Insurance and AD&D

  • Extended maternity and paternity leaves

  • Nucleo - Our learning platform of courses

  • NuLanguage - Our language learning program

  • NuCare - Our mental health and wellness assistance program

  • 401K Saving Plans - Health Saving Account and Flexible Spending Account

  • Work-from-home Allowance

  • Relocation Assistance Package, if applicable

  • Compensation: $184k - $230k

Work Model for this Role

  • Hybrid 2-3 times/week: Our hybrid work model brings us to the office at least twice a week, on strategic days designed to maximize team connection and collaboration. For more details, visit https://building.nubank.com/nu-hybrid-work-model/

To maintain a consistent and fair process for every candidate, Nu does not provide individualized technical feedback. See how our policy works here

jobs.title: Operational Risk Senior Specialist
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Nu

Nu serves more than 140 million customers, guided by a mission to fight complexity and empower people. The company has been leading an industry transformation through innovative products and human-centered services.

 

Proprietary technology and data at scale power Nu’s digital platform, built to promote financial access, advancement, and transparency. Its business model thrives on customer love and lower costs, feeding a flywheel of growth and profitability.

Visit our Institutional Page

About the Role

The Operational Risk Specialist, plays a vital role within the operational risk management function at Nu Mexico. The main duties involve identifying, assessing, monitoring, and mitigating operational risks that may hinder the company from reaching its objectives. This is accomplished by developing methodologies and ensuring their implementation and execution within the first line of defense. This process includes training, review and challenge, monitoring key risk indicators, and escalating issues in appropriate Risk Forums. This role involves close collaboration with different departments and teams to execute various Operational Risk programs aimed at reducing and controlling the likelihood and impact of adverse operational risk events.


You’ll be Responsible for

  1. Lead the oversight and continuous improvement of the Op Risk Management System, ensuring that policies, methodologies, procedures, governance practices, and supporting documentation remain aligned with local regulation and global standards.

  2. Lead and coordinate the annual and continuous RCSA process, maintaining high-quality risk and control matrices by ensuring that operational risks are properly identified, documented, classified, assigned to processes and business lines, and linked to accountable owners and controls.

  3. Perform independent 2LoD review and challenge of 1LoD risk assessments and controls, including the evaluation of inherent risk, residual risk, control design, control execution, supporting evidence, and overall control effectiveness.

  4. Own the governance and periodic maintenance of risk matrices across macroprocesses, ensuring that changes in products, processes, regulations, systems, incidents, control gaps, and organizational priorities are properly reflected, documented, and traceable in the institutional risk inventory.

  5. Assess complex operational risks and define appropriate treatment strategies based on inherent and residual risk exposure, risk appetite, and tolerance thresholds, including mitigation plans, risk transfers, formal risk acceptances, and escalation of risks outside tolerance.

  6. Monitor operational loss events, incidents, and control gaps; lead or support root cause analysis; ensure accurate and timely registration; and define corrective, preventive, and improvement actions to reduce the likelihood of recurrence.

  7. Design, manage, and enhance the Key Risk Indicator program for priority operational risks, ensuring that each applicable risk in the RCM has measurable indicators, defined amber and red thresholds, reliable data sources, periodic monitoring, documented analysis, and appropriate escalation.

  8. Evaluate operational risks associated with new products, features, processes, operational changes, and other initiatives, ensuring that potential control gaps are identified, mitigation plans are defined, and required actions are completed before launch or formal implementation.

  9. Prepare and present accurate, well-structured risk reports, dashboards, and management materials for senior leadership, the Non-Financial Risk Technical Forum, the Risk Committee, and other governance bodies, ensuring consistency and traceability to the RCM, loss-event database, KRI inventory, and control-gap management tools.

  10. Operate with limited direct supervision and act as a subject matter expert, providing strategic guidance, training, and constructive challenge to business areas and specialized risk teams while escalating material residual risks, control weaknesses, and non-compliance issues to the appropriate governance forums.

 

What We're Looking For Someone Who Has

Required

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Industrial Engineer, Risk Management or related field.

  • Minimum of 3+ years experience in operational risk management, internal audit, compliance, consulting.

  • Strong knowledge of the operational risk management frameworks (RCSA, Loss Database, Third Party Risk Management, Risk assessment of new products, etc).

  • Strong regulatory knowledge

  • Excellent analytical, communication, and problem-solving skills.

  • Ability to work independently and collaboratively with cross-functional teams

  • Ability to work with databases, ETL

  • Experience with regulatory compliance and corporate governance standards.

  • Strong knowledge of Control Testing and Monitoring throughout substantive testing and Key Risk Indicators (KRIs).

  • Experience with Governance, Risk and Compliance (GRC) systems.

  • Demonstrated ability to thrive in a fast-paced, rapidly evolving environment and adapt quickly to shifting priorities and changes in processes or regulations.

  • Fluent in English is a must.

 

Work Setup

Location

Mexico City, Mexico

Work model

[Hybrid / On-Site]

Office requirement

2 - 3 days per week at the office.

Nu serves more than 140 million customers, guided by a mission to fight complexity and empower people. The company has been leading an industry transformation through innovative products and human-centered services.

 

Proprietary technology and data at scale power Nu’s digital platform, built to promote financial access, advancement, and transparency. Its business model thrives on customer love and lower costs, feeding a flywheel of growth and profitability.

Visit our Institutional Page https://www.nu.com/2026-en


ABOUT THE ROLE 

The Operational Risk Specialist, plays a vital role within the operational risk management function at Nu Mexico. The main duties involve identifying, assessing, monitoring, and mitigating operational risks that may hinder the company from reaching its objectives. This is accomplished by developing methodologies and ensuring their implementation and execution within the first line of defense. This process includes training, review and challenge, monitoring key risk indicators, and escalating issues in appropriate Risk Forums. This role involves close collaboration with different departments and teams to execute various Operational Risk programs aimed at reducing and controlling the likelihood and impact of adverse operational risk events.



YOU’LL BE RESPONSIBLE FOR 

 1.  Lead the oversight and continuous improvement of the Op Risk Management System, ensuring that policies, methodologies, procedures, governance practices, and supporting documentation remain aligned with local regulation and global standards.

 2.  Lead and coordinate the annual and continuous RCSA process, maintaining high-quality risk and control matrices by ensuring that operational risks are properly identified, documented, classified, assigned to processes and business lines, and linked to accountable owners and controls.

 3.  Perform independent 2LoD review and challenge of 1LoD risk assessments and controls, including the evaluation of inherent risk, residual risk, control design, control execution, supporting evidence, and overall control effectiveness.

 4.  Own the governance and periodic maintenance of risk matrices across macroprocesses, ensuring that changes in products, processes, regulations, systems, incidents, control gaps, and organizational priorities are properly reflected, documented, and traceable in the institutional risk inventory.

 5.  Assess complex operational risks and define appropriate treatment strategies based on inherent and residual risk exposure, risk appetite, and tolerance thresholds, including mitigation plans, risk transfers, formal risk acceptances, and escalation of risks outside tolerance.

 6.  Monitor operational loss events, incidents, and control gaps; lead or support root cause analysis; ensure accurate and timely registration; and define corrective, preventive, and improvement actions to reduce the likelihood of recurrence.

 7.  Design, manage, and enhance the Key Risk Indicator program for priority operational risks, ensuring that each applicable risk in the RCM has measurable indicators, defined amber and red thresholds, reliable data sources, periodic monitoring, documented analysis, and appropriate escalation.

 8.  Evaluate operational risks associated with new products, features, processes, operational changes, and other initiatives, ensuring that potential control gaps are identified, mitigation plans are defined, and required actions are completed before launch or formal implementation.

 9.  Prepare and present accurate, well-structured risk reports, dashboards, and management materials for senior leadership, the Non-Financial Risk Technical Forum, the Risk Committee, and other governance bodies, ensuring consistency and traceability to the RCM, loss-event database, KRI inventory, and control-gap management tools.

 10. Operate with limited direct supervision and act as a subject matter expert, providing strategic guidance, training, and constructive challenge to business areas and specialized risk teams while escalating material residual risks, control weaknesses, and non-compliance issues to the appropriate governance forums.

 


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR SOMEONE WHO HAS

Required

 - Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Industrial Engineer, Risk Management or related field.

 - Minimum of 3+ years experience in operational risk management, internal audit, compliance, consulting.

 - Strong knowledge of the operational risk management frameworks (RCSA, Loss Database, Third Party Risk Management, Risk assessment of new products, etc).

 - Strong regulatory knowledge

 - Excellent analytical, communication, and problem-solving skills.

 - Ability to work independently and collaboratively with cross-functional teams

 - Ability to work with databases, ETL

 - Experience with regulatory compliance and corporate governance standards.

 - Strong knowledge of Control Testing and Monitoring throughout substantive testing and Key Risk Indicators (KRIs).

 - Experience with Governance, Risk and Compliance (GRC) systems.

 - Demonstrated ability to thrive in a fast-paced, rapidly evolving environment and adapt quickly to shifting priorities and changes in processes or regulations.

 - Fluent in English is a must.

 


WORK SETUP 

Location

Mexico City, Mexico

Work model

[Hybrid / On-Site]

Office requirement

2 - 3 days per week at the office.

 


OUR BENEFITS 

MEXICO JOBS:

 - Chance of earning equity at Nubank - [Reminder: Ops Teams don't have equity];

 - Food Card

 - NuCare – Psychological, Financial and Legal Assistance Program

 - Life Insurance

 - Medical Plan

 - Dental Plan

 - NuLanguage – Language Course Program

 - Nucleo - Our learning platform of courses

 - Extended Parental Leave

 - Daycare Allowance

 - Parental Consultancy

 - Work-from-home Allowance

 - Gym Partnerships

 - Holiday Bonus ("Aguinaldo") of 30 days of pay per year

 - 17 days of paid vacation with 25% vacation bonus

 - Relocation Assistance Package, if applicable

jobs.title: Staff IT Engineer - Service Management
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Nu

Nu serves more than 140 million customers, guided by a mission to fight complexity and empower people. The company has been leading an industry transformation through innovative products and human-centered services.

 

Proprietary technology and data at scale power Nu’s digital platform, built to promote financial access, advancement, and transparency. Its business model thrives on customer love and lower costs, feeding a flywheel of growth and profitability.

Visit our Institutional Page


About the Team

The IT team is the operational backbone of Nubank’s internal infrastructure. As the company scales, we’re building the service management foundations that let engineering teams move faster with more confidence — turning IT operations into a strategic advantage, not just a support function.

About the Role

As a Staff IT Engineer - Service Management, you will own and evolve Nubank’s IT Service Management (ITSM) practice end to end. You’ll design and implement processes, tools, and governance that keep our internal services reliable, auditable, and efficient, enabling engineering teams to focus on high-impact work while maintaining strong operational controls in a regulated environment.

You’ll Be Responsible For

  • Continuing to build and own Nubank's ITSM practice, defining and implementing core ITIL v4 processes: incident, problem, change, service request, and knowledge management.

  • Establishing a service catalog with clearly defined SLAs and OLAs aligned with internal stakeholder expectations.

  • Owning the end-to-end ITSM toolchain (Jira Service Management or equivalent): configuration, workflow design, form logic, SLA rules, and integrations with adjacent systems.

  • Identifying and closing automation gaps — routing, escalation, notifications, and reporting — partnering with engineering teams to reduce manual toil across operations.

  • Defining and tracking operational KPIs (MTTR, SLA compliance, first-contact resolution, change success rate) and building regular reporting cadences for leadership and stakeholders.

  • Establishing a Change Advisory Board (CAB) with structured documentation and approval workflows.

  • Supporting audit and compliance requirements with structured evidence of IT operational controls, essential in a regulated financial environment.

  • Driving ITSM adoption across the organization, creating runbooks, training materials, and documentation that embed service management culture at scale.

We Are Looking For a Person Who Has

Mandatory qualifications

  • Solid experience in IT service management, IT operations, or a related discipline.

  • Deep ITIL v4 expertise; ITIL 4 Foundation or Managing Professional certification strongly preferred.

  • Proven track record of building ITSM practices from scratch or significantly transforming an existing function.

  • Hands-on experience owning and configuring ITSM tooling end-to-end (Jira Service Management, ServiceNow, or equivalent) — not just using it, but designing it.

  • Ability to work cross-functionally in a fast-paced, engineering-led environment, with strong influence-without-authority skills.

  • Strong written and verbal communication, including the ability to present to senior leadership.

Nice-to-have qualifications

  • Experience in fintech, high-growth tech, or other regulated industries.

  • Familiarity with adjacent frameworks: COBIT, ISO 20000, or SRE principles.

  • Experience partnering with Security and/or Platform Engineering teams.

  • Fluent English.

What We Offer

  • Greenfield, high-visibility scope: you’ll define what “good” ITSM looks like at Nubank’s scale — from zero.

  • Direct exposure to senior leadership across IT and Engineering.

A culture that values ownership and getting foundations right, without bureaucracy for its own sake.

Location

  • São Paulo, Brazil

  • Campinas, Brazil

  • Rio de Janeiro, Brazil

  • Belo Horizonte, Brazil

Our Benefits

  • Chance of earning equity at Nubank

  • Food/ Meal Card (Vale-Refeição and/or Vale Alimentação)

  • Public Transportation Commuting Benefit (Vale-Transporte)

  • NuCare – Psychological, Financial and Legal Assistance Program

  • Life Insurance

  • Medical Plan

  • Dental Plan

  • NuLanguage – Language Course Program

  • Nucleo - Our learning platform of courses

  • Extended Parental Leave

  • Daycare Allowance

  • Parental Consultancy

  • Work-from-home Allowance

  • Gym Partnerships

  • 30 days of paid vacation

  • Relocation Assistance Package, if applicable

Work Model for this Role

Hybrid 2–3 times/week: Our hybrid work model brings us to the office at least twice a week, on strategic days designed to maximize team connection and collaboration. For more details, visit https://building.nubank.com/nu-hybrid-work-model/

 

Our recruitment process may involve the use of artificial intelligence–enabled tools, such as automated interview transcription and analysis, to support the evaluation process. Artificial intelligence is not used to make final hiring decisions; all decisions are made by human reviewers.

To maintain a consistent and fair process for every candidate, Nu does not provide individualized technical feedback. See how our policy works here

Proprietary technology and data at scale power Nu’s digital platform, built to promote financial access, advancement, and transparency. Its business model thrives on customer love and lower costs, feeding a flywheel of growth and profitability.

Visit our Institutional Page


About the role

The Nubank Security team actively seeks out potential security threats to protect both our customers and Nubankers. We respond swiftly to security incidents, conduct thorough investigations, and implement measures to mitigate risks. Our strong engineering capabilities allow us to reduce response times through automation and specialized micro-services.

Our Incident Response Team is focused on managing incidents and is constantly enhancing its skills and maturity. Additionally, the Nubank CSIRT is a proud member of the FIRST (Forum of Incident Response and Security Teams) community. You can find more about Nubank Infosec here:

https://blog.nubank.com.br/infosec-nubank-protecao-dados/

You will be responsible for

  • Investigate complex cases to understand the mechanisms of abuse and guide strategies to mitigate or detect the anomaly

  • Incident Command: Act as the technical Incident Commander during major crises, coordinating technical workstreams and providing clear, data-driven updates to stakeholders.

  • Engineering & Automation: Drive the creation and refinement of SOAR playbooks and Python-based tools to automate repetitive tasks and scale the operation.

  • Data Interpretation: Analyze large datasets to identify emerging threat trends, supporting long-term detection improvements and quantifying risk.


We are looking for a person who has

  • Proven IR Experience: Solid experience as an Incident Response Analyst/Specialist, with a track record of handling investigations in complex, high-scale environments.

  • Technical Authority: Deep understanding of security vulnerabilities, attacker TTPs (Mitre ATT&CK), and modern remediation methodologies.

  • Cloud IR Mastery: Hands-on experience with incident response and management within cloud infrastructures (AWS/GCP/Azure).

  • Automation Engineering: Strong skills in Python and SOAR platforms to build self-healing or automated response workflows.

  • Communication: Ability to translate complex technical findings into clear, actionable reports for both technical peers and executive leadership.

  • English Proficiency: Proficient in both understanding and speaking English for global collaboration.

jobs.title: Compliance Analyst
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Nu

Nu serves more than 140 million customers, guided by a mission to fight complexity and empower people. The company has been leading an industry transformation through innovative products and human-centered services.

 

Proprietary technology and data at scale power Nu’s digital platform, built to promote financial access, advancement, and transparency. Its business model thrives on customer love and lower costs, feeding a flywheel of growth and profitability.

Visit our Institutional Page

About the Role

We are looking for a Compliance Analyst to support regulatory topics across the many of our agenda — payments, credit, credit cards, Open Finance — with a focus on Central Bank regulation. You will be accountable for your own analyses, advisories, and deliverables, and you will work shoulder to shoulder with other analysts and specialists on the team's most complex regulatory matters.

This is a hands-on position with real ownership. Because our agenda evolves with the regulatory landscape, the scope of topics you cover will change over time: we are looking for someone who treats that breadth as an advantage, not a burden, and who can reach a high standard of analysis quickly on a subject they have never worked on before.

We are also actively rethinking how compliance work gets done, using AI and automation to raise the quality and the speed of our analyses. This role is expected to be part of that: not only using AI in the day-to-day, but questioning our own processes and flows and proposing better ones.

The position requires working and interfacing with multiple partners and teams, evaluating new regulations, and advising business areas on products and procedures.


You’ll be Responsible for

  • Monitoring newly published regulation and market best practices, and summarizing the main changes and to-dos of a new rule with precision;

  • Analyzing regulations in depth and determining their impacts on our products, processes, and environment;

  • Advising business areas on regulatory matters related to products and procedures, and assisting in decision-making;

  • Performing regulatory analysis in the approval flow of new products, services, and features;

  • Assessing and challenging the action plans defined by business units, and monitoring their implementation;

  • Registering and tracking action plans to comply with regulatory requirements and deadlines;

  • Running regulatory tests together with the Compliance team;

  • Prevention and detection of anomalies that may result in regulatory gaps;

  • Coordinating, monitoring, and answering inquiries, inspections, and requests from regulators;

  • Managing your own activities and prioritization to meet internal and regulatory deadlines;

  • Preparing and delivering training related to compliance matters;

  • Applying AI tools to your own routines and reviewing our processes and flows with a critical eye, proposing and implementing improvements that make the team's work more efficient and more reliable;

  • Contributing to the team's cross-cutting demands, including the operational routines that sustain our regulatory agenda.

 

We're Looking For Someone Who Has

Required

  • Previous experience in compliance itself — regulatory compliance activities, interactions with regulators, regulatory matters related to financial products and services, controls, and/or risk management in a financial or tech company;

  • Experience with at least one of our core themes: payments, credit, credit cards, or Open Finance;

  • Experience interpreting regulation related to banking products and processes (Central Bank regulation), whether through assessment, implementation, or consultancy.

  • Clear, structured, and objective communication. You can take a dense piece of regulation and explain what matters, to whom, and by when — in writing and in presentations — without losing rigor;

  • Fast learning. You reach a reliable level of analysis on an unfamiliar regulation or business context quickly, going after information and knowledge independently rather than waiting to be briefed;

  • Ability to handle multidisciplinarity. You can carry several distinct topics at the same time and switch between them without dropping quality or deadlines;

  • Curiosity, motivation, and energy to take on any theme in our scope, with a genuine interest in understanding how the business works behind the rule;

  • Fluency and curiosity with AI. You are comfortable using AI in your daily work — and curious about where else it could be applied — with the judgment to know when its output needs to be checked. You will be expected to bring that curiosity to our own routines: mapping how a process works today, spotting what is manual or repetitive, and proposing flows that deliver the same control with less effort;

  • Continuous improvement mindset. You question why a process works the way it does instead of simply inheriting it, and you turn that into concrete proposals;

  • Strong interpretation and logical thinking, with the ability to analyze new rules in depth and assess their impacts;

  • Hands-on approach and ownership mentality;

  • Negotiation, prioritization, and organizational skills;

  • Ability to connect and build strong relationships with squads and stakeholders, negotiating deadlines and implementations, and knowing when to escalate;

  • Ability to work autonomously, with high standards for your own deliverables;

  • Intermediate or Advanced English.

Nice to Have

  • Experience structuring and measuring KPIs/KRIs and presenting information in dashboard and report formats;

  • Familiarity with JIRA, automation, queries, SQL, or other programming languages to extract and manipulate data;

  • Concrete examples of process or workflow improvements you have designed and implemented, with or without AI;

Location

São Paulo - SP, Brazil

Work model

Hybrid

Office requirement

2 days per week at the office.

jobs.title: Business Analyst Manager
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Nu

Nu serves more than 140 million customers, guided by a mission to fight complexity and empower people. The company has been leading an industry transformation through innovative products and human-centered services.

 

Proprietary technology and data at scale power Nu’s digital platform, built to promote financial access, advancement, and transparency. Its business model thrives on customer love and lower costs, feeding a flywheel of growth and profitability.

Visit our Institutional Page

Business Analysts at Nubank

As a company at the forefront of the financial revolution in Brazil, Nubank has experienced exponential growth since its inception. To keep your growth path healthy, numerous critical decisions constantly need to be made. Business Analysts are fundamental in the decision process because they must not only be able to deal with large amounts of information and data, but also always think of ways to improve our clients' experience.

It is BA's responsibility to structure the data, analyze it and use the results to test different solutions with the aim of improving Nubank's efficiency.

We are looking for people who are independent and who are not afraid to take the initiative to identify and solve problems that are not necessarily obvious.

You can read more about it in our blog and get some insights into how we work.

 

As a Business Analytics Manager, you’re expected to:

  • Do a lot of investigative work, focused on deciding which data makes the most sense to use in which situation. If you don't have the data, it's your job to think about what tests can be done or how to extract the information you need to answer your questions;

  • Support your team in making data-based decisions by monitoring analysis and decisions, ensuring the flow of projects and making the process of taking risks comfortable despite the uncertainties;

  • Mentor the team

  • Learning how to work with a large volume of data to build a solid foundation for decision making with calculated risks - even knowing that not all the answers are in the data and/or that not all the data you would like is available; Use tools like SQL, Python and Scala - taught during your first weeks with us - for data extraction;

  • Understand our products and interactions with other areas;

  • Take advantage of opportunities to grow and learn from a well-prepared and highly qualified team;

  • Opportunity to work in a complex, dynamic and diverse environment, participating in projects that will impact a large number of clients.

  • Drive customer growth for one of Latin America's leading digital banks, owning the analytics function that powers credit card and savings account acquisition, activation, and channel strategy, connecting data to the decisions that determine how millions of Colombians access financial products.

  • Lead and develop a team of business analysts embedded across the Business Unit area, setting the analytics roadmap, owning the squad's OKRs, and building the operating model that turns acquisition and activation data into decisions that move the business.

  • Own performance and budget optimization, bringing rigor to how the BU allocates spend across channels ensuring sustainable growth.

  • Modernize how to make decisions at scale, leading the migration to an AI-ready data architecture and building the experimentation and monitoring infrastructure that allows teams to move fast with confidence.

What are we looking for?

About Nu

Nu serves more than 140 million customers, guided by a mission to fight complexity and empower people. The company has been leading an industry transformation through innovative products and human-centered services.

 

Proprietary technology and data at scale power Nu’s digital platform, built to promote financial access, advancement, and transparency. Its business model thrives on customer love and lower costs, feeding a flywheel of growth and profitability.

Visit our Institutional Page

About the Role

You will play a crucial role in Nubank's balance sheet management. Your responsibilities will focus on optimizing risk-adjusted returns for the bank, involving daily assessment of the balance sheet, funding and liquidity needs, understanding trading positioning, and identifying potential levers to generate value for the company. Initially, you'll be tasked with the development and implementation of new products, and with supporting and automating traders' routines, but as you gain experience and develop, you will take on broader responsibilities across the desk.

What You'll Do

  • Support day-to-day treasury activities, including the sizing and implementation of cash and derivative trades, portfolio optimization, P&L calculation, and trading limit control.

  • Develop internal modeling and data visualization tools to support traders' decision-making processes and automate daily workflows.

  • Coordinate with other teams and build strong working partnerships, primarily with — but not limited to — ALM, Finance, and Risk teams.

  • Engage in ad-hoc projects related to new trading strategies, funding strategies, and other treasury solutions.

  • Contribute to the design, structuring, and implementation of new products, eventually including IRS, FX derivatives, and bond portfolios.

  • Act as a back up for the funding desk

What We're Looking For

  • At least 5 years of experience in financial sector.

  • Market experience and technical knowledge of fixed-income products, understanding how financial instruments are priced and traded.

  • Prior experience with derivatives (IRS, FX) and bond portfolio management in a treasury or trading desk environment.

  • Experience designing and developing analytical tools or data visualizations.

  • Excellent analytical skills, with a meticulous and detail-oriented approach.

  • Technical proficiency in Python and/or other programming languages.

  • Ability to multi-task and adapt, delivering across a variety of topics in a fast-paced environment.

  • Strong communication and presentation skills.

  • Fluent in English.

  • AMIB 3/5 certification — required.

jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer, AI & Credit Card Platform
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Nu

Nu serves more than 140 million customers, guided by a mission to fight complexity and empower people. The company has been leading an industry transformation through innovative products and human-centered services.

 

Proprietary technology and data at scale power Nu’s digital platform, built to promote financial access, advancement, and transparency. Its business model thrives on customer love and lower costs, feeding a flywheel of growth and profitability.

Visit our Institutional Page

About the role

The CC Factory, within Nubank’s Credit Card Business Unit, is responsible for internationalizing our credit card product and creating a reusable foundation for launching it in new markets. The team recently launched credit card capabilities in the United States and is building the frameworks, platforms and AI-enabled practices required to scale into future countries.

As a Staff Software Engineer, AI & Credit Card Platform, you will operate across multiple squads and technical domains, helping shape how credit card products adapt to new markets. This is a strongly cross-functional role involving Product, Engineering, Business, Legal, Compliance and platform partners.

You will combine deep technical leadership with hands-on execution: building reusable country-launch capabilities, driving AI transformation across the engineering lifecycle, and guiding architecture across three to four squads. This is a Staff-level role with potential to grow toward broader technical scope over time


You’ll be Responsible for

  • Building the Country Launch Engine: Create reusable systems that reduce the time and effort required to launch credit card products in new markets, replacing country-specific documentation and repeated discovery with scalable capabilities.

  • Automating country readiness: Help translate regulatory requirements and market capabilities into destination architecture and configurable product behavior.

  • Driving AI transformation across CC Factory: Diagnose engineering friction, establish productivity baselines, run experiments, measure impact and scale the AI practices that work.

  • Building domain-grounded AI systems: Develop context engineering foundations, domain skills and repository context so AI agents can support credit card configuration and international launches with reliable outputs.

  • Defining AI risk and governance: Establish appropriate human-in-the-loop controls, evaluation, monitoring and auditability for AI used in regulated financial workflows.

  • Leading technical architecture across multiple squads: Serve as a technical anchor across areas such as Collateral Lines, Cashback and adjacent credit card platforms, guiding architecture and unblocking complex work.

  • Partnering across the organization: Align Product, Engineering, Business, Legal, Compliance and platform teams around technical direction, dependencies and launch priorities.

  • Staying hands-on: Prototype, code and contribute directly when needed, while adapting quickly as business priorities and market opportunities evolve.

 

What We're Looking For Someone Who Has

Required

  • Software engineering experience, with demonstrated Staff-level scope across multiple teams and domains.

  • A track record of designing and shipping reusable platform or systemic solutions adopted by other teams.

  • Current, hands-on experience with agentic AI, including coding agents, tools, skills, context engineering or RAG in production or near-production environments.

  • Strong backend and distributed-systems depth, sufficient to hold architectural authority across multiple products and platforms.

  • Ability to operate under deep ambiguity, structure undefined problems and make progress even when future market requirements are not yet confirmed.

  • Quantitative rigor: ability to define baselines, design experiments, measure outcomes and stop initiatives that do not create value.

  • Strong technical leadership and influence without authority across Engineering, Product, Business, Legal and Compliance stakeholders.

  • Ability to communicate clearly in written and spoken English, including technical documents, plans and playbooks read by teams across countries.

  • Willingness to work hands-on and adapt quickly to changing priorities.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with multi-country or internationalized product platforms, particularly regulatory-driven variation, multi-currency or installments.

  • Experience in banking, credit cards, financial services or another regulated domain.

  • Experience with configuration-driven product architecture.

  • Experience with Clojure, functional programming or large-scale microservice architectures.

  • Experience mentoring senior engineers and running technical enablement across an organization.

 

Location for this opportunity

This role can be based in:

  • Toronto, Canada

  • Virginia, United States

  • Miami, United States

  • Palo Alto, United States

Work Model for this Role

  • Hybrid 2–3 times/week: Our hybrid work model brings us to the office at least twice a week, on strategic days designed to maximize team connection and collaboration. For more details, visit https://building.nubank.com/nu-hybrid-work-model/

Our Benefits

Benefits vary by country and local regulations.

Canada

  • Health Insurance

  • Life Insurance

  • Pension Plan

  • Extended maternity and paternity leaves

  • Nucleo – our learning platform of courses

  • NuLanguage – our language learning program

  • NuCare – our mental health and wellness assistance program

  • Vacations

United States

  • Opportunity of earning equity at Nu

  • Medical Insurance

  • Dental and Vision Insurance

  • Life Insurance and AD&D

  • Extended maternity and paternity leaves

  • Nucleo – our learning platform of courses

  • NuLanguage – our language learning program

  • NuCare – our mental health and wellness assistance program

  • 401(k)

  • Health Savings Account and Flexible Spending Account

  • Work-from-home Allowance

  • Relocation Assistance Package, if applicable

Location-Specific Disclosures

Palo Alto: Total compensation includes base salary, RSUs and benefits. Base salary range: $19.200 - $24.000

Toronto: Total compensation includes base salary, RSUs and benefits. Base salary range: $20.000 - $24.000

jobs.title: FP&A Sr Expert
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Nu

Nu serves more than 140 million customers, guided by a mission to fight complexity and empower people. The company has been leading an industry transformation through innovative products and human-centered services.

 

Proprietary technology and data at scale power Nu’s digital platform, built to promote financial access, advancement, and transparency. Its business model thrives on customer love and lower costs, feeding a flywheel of growth and profitability.

Visit our Institutional Page

About the Team

Nubank's Finance organization is structured into functional areas that together safeguard financial stability, compliance and strategic decision-making. Most core finance functions operate under a dual reporting structure — reporting directly into the global Finance team, with a dotted line to the business they support — which keeps us close to the operation while holding a consistent global standard.

Within Finance, FP&A owns budgeting, forecasting and long-term financial planning, and acts as the analytical partner behind the company's biggest decisions. The team drives profitable growth by improving visibility, forecasting quality, consolidation and analysis of results and key metrics, translating them into insights and recommended actions for senior management. It also defines the performance metrics that create accountability and ownership across FP&A and the business units — tracking them consistently to measure progress, monitor KPIs and drive cost optimization.


About the Role

We're looking for a Senior Expert to bring FP&A rigor and planning discipline to Nubank's Central Bank agenda and Finance governance. You'll make sure Finance, Risk, Capital, and the business arrive at every regulatory interaction and governance forum aligned, prepared and with a consistent story — translating capital, risk and performance metrics into the forecasts, plans and narratives that guide executives and the board. This is a role with a strong operating cadence, where regulatory and accounting impacts, provisioning distortions and metric consolidation are tracked as part of the regular FP&A cycle, not just project by project — and where you'll lead the improvements in process, systems and reporting that let us keep scaling and maturing as a multi-dimensional finance organization.


You’ll be Responsible for

  • Central Bank reports and interactions: Drive the internal preparation for quarterly performance meetings with the Central Bank, ad-hoc topic meetings, and one-off interactions (provisioning, regulatory blocks, and similar) — aligning with Credit, Risk, and Finance teams across Nubank to gather inputs, and build a consistent story before it reaches Bacen. Maintain the calendar of formal obligations and filing deadlines.

  • ICAAP, capital and budget planning: Drive the internal alignment behind Nubank's ICAAP, working closely with Risk, Capital, and business unit teams to gather inputs from business and consolidate the final submission related to the market to support the Governance team. Connect ICAAP assumptions, risk metrics and regulatory impact analyses to the budget and business plan — working with the planning team to translate them into assumptions, scenarios and targets that feed the annual budget and rolling forecasts.

  • Governance forums: Ensure FP&A and business alignment ahead of ALCO, risk and capital committee discussions — consolidating inputs and positions from Risk, Capital, and business teams — and drive the follow-through afterward, translating decisions into concrete unfoldings within FP&A and the business.

  • Earnings disclosure: Support the earnings FAQ exercise by aligning with Accounting, Tax, and business teams — gathering inputs and helping shape the financial narrative across topics such as ETR/CSLL, payroll loans, segmentation and deposits.

  • P&L impact analysis: regulatory and accounting: Continuously track and quantify the financial impact of regulatory developments (IOF/RDB, Desenrola, CLP and etc) as part of the regular FP&A cycle, feeding the analysis into forecasts and decision makers on an ongoing basis — including occasional direct discussion with the BUs when the impact needs to be sized or explained together. Also own, as a recurring exercise, the explanation of P&L distortions arising from Conglomerado Prudencial consolidation, local accounting rules (COSIF, BRGAAP) and similar effects, translating technical/regulatory noise into a clear read on underlying business performance month after month. Drive improvements to systems and reporting so this view — regulatory impact and accounting distortions — is properly captured and readily available, rather than rebuilt from scratch each cycle.

  • Standardization across countries: Coordinate the standardization of processes, metrics and discussions across Brazil, Colombia and Mexico, so Finance speaks one language regionally

 

What We're Looking For Someone Who Has

Required

  • Solid FP&A or Finance foundation — financial modeling, planning cycles, variance analysis and building a number from first principles

  • Experience with financial regulation in banking or financial services — ideally direct exposure to Central Bank (BACEN) interactions, regulatory reporting, or prudential topics

  • Working knowledge of capital and liquidity concepts (ICAAP, capital adequacy, LCR, EVE, VaR)

  • Strong executive communication: you can take a dense technical topic and make it land with a board in three slides

  • Comfort operating in governance forums with senior stakeholders, and the maturity to hold a position with Risk, Legal, Accounting and the business

  • Organized and self-directed

  • Fluent English and Portuguese; Spanish is a plus given the LatAm scope

Work Setup

Location

São Paulo, Brasil

Work model

Hybrid

Office requirement

2 /3 days per week at the office.

We're looking for a Senior Expert to bring FP&A rigor and planning discipline to Nubank's Central Bank agenda and Finance governance. You'll make sure Finance, Risk, Capital, and the business arrive at every regulatory interaction and governance forum aligned, prepared and with a consistent story — translating capital, risk and performance metrics into the forecasts, plans and narratives that guide executives and the board. This is a role with a strong operating cadence, where regulatory and accounting impacts, provisioning distortions and metric consolidation are tracked as part of the regular FP&A cycle, not just project by project — and where you'll lead the improvements in process, systems and reporting that let us keep scaling and maturing as a multi-dimensional finance organization.


You’ll be Responsible for 



 - Central Bank reports and interactions: Drive the internal preparation for quarterly performance meetings with the Central Bank, ad-hoc topic meetings, and one-off interactions (provisioning, regulatory blocks, and similar) — aligning with Credit, Risk, and Finance teams across Nubank to gather inputs, and build a consistent story before it reaches Bacen. Maintain the calendar of formal obligations and filing deadlines.

 - ICAAP, capital and budget planning: Drive the internal alignment behind Nubank's ICAAP, working closely with Risk, Capital, and business unit teams to gather inputs from business and consolidate the final submission related to the market to support the Governance team. Connect ICAAP assumptions, risk metrics and regulatory impact analyses to the budget and business plan — working with the planning team to translate them into assumptions, scenarios and targets that feed the annual budget and rolling forecasts.

 - Governance forums: Ensure FP&A and business alignment ahead of ALCO, risk and capital committee discussions — consolidating inputs and positions from Risk, Capital, and business teams — and drive the follow-through afterward, translating decisions into concrete unfoldings within FP&A and the business.

 - Earnings disclosure: Support the earnings FAQ exercise by aligning with Accounting, Tax, and business teams — gathering inputs and helping shape the financial narrative across topics such as ETR/CSLL, payroll loans, segmentation and deposits.

 - P&L impact analysis: regulatory and accounting: Continuously track and quantify the financial impact of regulatory developments (IOF/RDB, Desenrola, CLP and etc) as part of the regular FP&A cycle, feeding the analysis into forecasts and decision makers on an ongoing basis — including occasional direct discussion with the BUs when the impact needs to be sized or explained together. Also own, as a recurring exercise, the explanation of P&L distortions arising from Conglomerado Prudencial consolidation, local accounting rules (COSIF, BRGAAP) and similar effects, translating technical/regulatory noise into a clear read on underlying business performance month after month. Drive improvements to systems and reporting so this view — regulatory impact and accounting distortions — is properly captured and readily available, rather than rebuilt from scratch each cycle.

 - Standardization across countries: Coordinate the standardization of processes, metrics and discussions across Brazil, Colombia and Mexico, so Finance speaks one language regionally

 


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR SOMEONE WHO HAS

Required

 - Solid FP&A or Finance foundation — financial modeling, planning cycles, variance analysis and building a number from first principles

 - Experience with financial regulation in banking or financial services — ideally direct exposure to Central Bank (BACEN) interactions, regulatory reporting, or prudential topics

 - Working knowledge of capital and liquidity concepts (ICAAP, capital adequacy, LCR, EVE, VaR)

 - Strong executive communication: you can take a dense technical topic and make it land with a board in three slides

 - Comfort operating in governance forums with senior stakeholders, and the maturity to hold a position with Risk, Legal, Accounting and the business

 - Organized and self-directed

 - Fluent English and Portuguese; Spanish is a plus given the LatAm scope

jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer - Deposits
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Nu

Nu serves more than 140 million customers, guided by a mission to fight complexity and empower people. The company has been leading an industry transformation through innovative products and human-centered services.

 

Proprietary technology and data at scale power Nu’s digital platform, built to promote financial access, advancement, and transparency. Its business model thrives on customer love and lower costs, feeding a flywheel of growth and profitability.

Visit our Institutional Page

About the Role

The GBA Core Infrastructure / Deposits team builds and operates the platform that makes Nubank accounts work. Whenever money enters or leaves an account, our systems create and manage the deposit records behind balances, calculate yield and taxes, and make funds available for payments, transfers, Pix, debit card purchases and other customer transactions.

We are evolving country-specific legacy systems into a global deposits platform that can support different products, regulations and markets with less duplication and safer expansion. This is a backend transactional systems role at the intersection of distributed systems, accounting, regulation and product platforms.

As a Staff Software Engineer — Deposits, you will be one of the team’s primary technical leaders, shaping the platform’s medium- and long-term evolution while remaining hands-on in the most critical and complex areas.


You’ll be Responsible for

  • Defining and evolving the target architecture and technical strategy for the global Deposits platform.

  • Guiding the next stages of the platform and sequencing migrations from legacy systems while balancing safety, business priorities, regulatory requirements and sustainable delivery.

  • Setting a high technical bar for distributed transaction processing, accounting integrity, yield and tax calculations, reliability, observability and operational recovery.

  • Leading high-impact technical decisions across services and markets, making trade-offs explicit and driving decisions to closure.

  • Representing Deposits in cross-team alignment with Product, other platform owners and senior stakeholders.

  • Turning ambiguous problems into clear technical direction through RFCs, design documents, migration plans, decision records and executable milestones.

  • Multiplying the team through mentoring, architecture reviews, code reviews and reusable engineering standards.

  • Remaining hands-on and leading by example on the platform’s most critical or complex components

 

What We're Looking For Someone Who Has

Required

  • A Staff-level track record leading architecture and technical strategy for large-scale distributed systems.

  • Strong backend engineering depth, including asynchronous workflows, eventual consistency, concurrency, high-throughput processing, performance and failure recovery.

  • Ability to design for the long term while evolving complex systems incrementally and safely.

  • Sound judgment in high-impact decisions, including the ability to frame options, define decision criteria and communicate trade-offs clearly.

  • Experience influencing senior stakeholders and aligning teams with different priorities or constraints.

  • A multiplier mindset: you create clarity, raise the technical bar, mentor engineers and enable others to execute independently.

  • Comfort navigating ambiguity, complex domain rules and different regulatory or product requirements across markets.

  • Strong communication skills in English for a global, cross-functional environment.

  • Ability to deeply learn complex domains and reason about business-critical systems.

Nice to Have

  • Experience in financial services, banking, payments or accounting platforms. Financial-services experience is welcome but not required.

  • Experience with Clojure, Datomic, DynamoDB, Redis, Kafka or comparable technologies.

  • Experience designing platforms that support multiple countries, products and regulatory environments.

 

Work Setup

Location

This role can be based in:

  • Brazil

  • United States

  • Canada

Work model

Hybrid 2–3 times/week: Our hybrid work model brings us to the office at least twice a week, on strategic days designed to maximize connection and collaboration. For more details, visit https://building.nubank.com/nu-hybrid-work-model/

Office requirement

2 days per week at the office.

 

For Palo Alto: Total compensation includes base salary, RSUs and benefits. Base salary range: $19.200 - $24.000

Our Benefits

  • Chance of earning equity at Nubank;

  • Food/ Meal Card (Vale-Refeição and/or Vale Alimentação)

  • Public Transportation Commuting Benefit (Vale-Transporte)

  • NuCare – Psychological, Financial and Legal Assistance Program

  • Life Insurance

  • Medical Plan

  • Dental Plan

  • NuLanguage – Language Course Program

  • Nucleo - Our learning platform of courses

  • Extended Parental Leave

  • Daycare Allowance

  • Parental Consultancy

  • Work-from-home Allowance

  • Gym Partnerships

  • 30 days of paid vacation

  • Relocation Assistance Package, if applicable

Location-Specific Disclosures

Palo Alto: Total compensation includes base salary, RSUs and benefits. Base salary range: $19.200 - $24.000

Toronto: Total compensation includes base salary, RSUs and benefits. Base salary range: $20.000 - $24.000

jobs.title: Reliability Engineer — Regulatory Reliability
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Nu

Nu serves more than 140 million customers, guided by a mission to fight complexity and empower people. The company has been leading an industry transformation through innovative products and human-centered services.

 

Proprietary technology and data at scale power Nu’s digital platform, built to promote financial access, advancement, and transparency. Its business model thrives on customer love and lower costs, feeding a flywheel of growth and profitability.

Visit our Institutional Page

About the role

We are looking for a Reliability Engineer to drive reliability, resilience, and operational excellence for Nubank's regulatory infrastructure. In this role, you will own critical reliability outcomes for systems that support real-time interbank transfers, regulatory integrations and key regulatory platforms. You will work across infrastructure, software, networking, security, and operations to keep mission-critical services available, observable, and resilient under demanding regulatory and operational constraints.

What you'll do

  • Own end-to-end reliability for IT regulatory infrastructure services, including connectivity, transaction processing flows, and settlement-related operational workflows.

  • Define, measure, and continuously improve SLIs, SLOs, and operational health indicators for critical transactions and platforms.

  • Lead incident response for different severity production events, coordinate recovery, and drive high-quality postmortems with concrete follow-through on corrective actions.

  • Design and evolve observability for the platform, with emphasis on tracing, queue health, signature validation, infrastructure signals, and early detection of degraded regulatory links or transaction bottlenecks.

  • Plan and execute disaster recovery and business continuity exercises, including failover validation, contingency readiness, and RTO/RPO verification.

  • Reduce operational toil through automation, tooling, and improved runbooks for recurring failure and operational procedures.

  • Drive capacity planning and performance engineering to ensure the platforms can safely absorb peak transaction volumes and evolving business demand.

  • Partner closely with security, networking, middleware, and software engineering teams to improve platform hardening, resilience, and change management safety.

  • Participate in an on-call rotation.

What we're looking for

  • Experience with SRE, DevOps, or production engineering experience operating mission-critical, high-availability systems.

  • Hands-on experience with IT infrastructure platforms, virtualized and hyperconverged environments such as VxRail, and physical production infrastructure.

  • Hands-on experience with Linux systems, including performance tuning, kernel parameters, and security hardening.

  • Track record leading incident response and postmortem processes for customer-impacting services.

  • Solid knowledge of networking fundamentals: TCP/IP and routing.

  • Proficiency in at least one scripting or programming language (Python, Shell scripting) for automation and tooling.

  • Experience with observability stacks (Prometheus, Grafana) and distributed tracing.

  • AWS infrastructure experience across services like EC2, S3, CloudWatch, KMS, EKS/ECS, VPCs, RDS/DynamoDB, and SQS/SNS.

  • IT Regulatory audit experience, including evidence gathering, control validation, audit prep, and remediation follow-through.

  • Experience with infrastructure-as-code tools (like Puppet) and Git-based workflows.

  • Working knowledge of AI-assisted engineering tools (Claude, Cursor, Claude Code).

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills in Spanish and English.

Nice to have

  • Experience with Mexican payment rails (SPEI)

  • SQL knowledge for operational analysis and troubleshooting.

Relevant cloud (AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner certification or higher) or IT infrastructure certifications.

Location for this opportunity

  • Mexico City, Mexico

Our Benefits

  • Chance of earning equity at Nu

  • Extended maternity and paternity leaves

  • Health and life insurance

  • Dental and Vision Insurance

  • NuCare - Our mental health and wellness assistance program

  • Nucleo - Our learning platform of courses

  • NuLanguage - Our language learning program

  • Holiday Bonus ("Aguinaldo") of 30 days of pay per year

  • 17 days of paid vacation with 25% vacation bonus

  • Gym partnership

  • Food card

  • Work-from-home Allowance

  • Parental Consultancy

  • Relocation Assistance Package, if applicable

jobs.title: Senior Staff Software Engineer - Developer Experience
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Nu

Nu serves more than 140 million customers, guided by a mission to fight complexity and empower people. The company has been leading an industry transformation through innovative products and human-centered services.

 

Proprietary technology and data at scale power Nu’s digital platform, built to promote financial access, advancement, and transparency. Its business model thrives on customer love and lower costs, feeding a flywheel of growth and profitability.

Visit our Institutional Page

About the role
We are looking for a Senior Staff Software Engineer to drive the overarching strategy, technical vision, and execution across Nubank’s Quality & Developer Experience ecosystem. You will sit at the epicenter of our engineering transformation.

This role goes far beyond traditional quality assurance or testing; you will own the end-to-end (E2E) Developer Experience (DevEx) across the entire Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC). From internal developer platform tools and boundary APIs to our suite of testing mechanisms and automated code reviews, your mission will be to architect AI-native systems that drastically reduce review latency, guarantee architectural correctness, and double engineering productivity across Nubank. Working alongside our most tenured engineering leaders and reporting into platform leadership, you will serve as the technical authority who brings fresh, market-leading perspectives from high-velocity environments to elevate our foundational standards.

Mission
Architect, scale, and operationalize an AI-transformed Developer Experience & Quality strategy so that:

  • The "Secure and Quality Path" is the Default: Automated mechanisms, linting, and smart context-aware agents enforce strict architectural standards, eliminating code quality degradation caused by high-volume AI code generation.

  • Developer Velocity Doubles (2x): The friction in review latency, pull request (PR) approvals, and continuous integration is systematically dismantled, enabling thousands of engineers to ship features safely to 140M+ customers at unprecedented speeds.

  • SDLC is Re-imagined for AI: Foundational tools across code authorship, testing, boundary APIs, and PR reviews are seamlessly integrated with state-of-the-art AI frameworks, smart LLM evaluations, and context-engineering hooks.

  • Automated Approval Standards are Built: Clear deterministic checks and intelligent human-in-the-loop triggers are established to achieve safe, automated PR approvals without manual bottlenecks.

Core Responsibilities

  • Architect E2E Quality & DevEx Platforms: Define and evolve the multi-year vision for our developer tooling ecosystem—covering internal developer platforms, boundary APIs, test automation suites, and pull request review systems.

  • Lead the AI-Driven Code Review Evolution: Architect automated review mechanisms that leverage multi-model evaluations (e.g., using specialized LLMs to audit generated code), custom IDE/GitHub plugins, and deterministic linting to accelerate PR merge times while preventing code bloat or quality degradation.

  • Define Human-in-the-Loop Boundaries: Set company-wide paradigms for when code changes can be automatically approved and merged versus when human intervention or secondary AI audits are required.

  • Partner & Mentor Across Engineering: Act as a force multiplier by partnering with engineers and product managers, elevating the technical bar and instilling modern, high-velocity DevEx practices.

  • Balance AI Speed with System Integrity: Establish observability, defect-tracking metrics, and safety rails to ensure that rapid AI-assisted development does not introduce structural fragility into Nubank's core services.

  • Influence Build vs. Buy Strategy: Evaluate top-tier market tools, AI coding frameworks, and internal platforms to decide when to build bespoke internal agents or integrate emerging third-party tooling.

Key Business & Engineering Metrics You Will Influence

  • Developer Productivity & Velocity

    • Achieve a 2x improvement in overall engineering productivity across Nubank's engineering organization.

  • PR Review Latency

    • Direct reduction in time-to-merge for pull requests across all BUs and countries.

  • Code Base Health & Quality

    • Zero degradation in code quality and zero increase in system defects despite exponentially higher volumes of AI-generated code.

  • Automated PR Approvals

    • Increase in the percentage of routine, low-risk code changes safely approved and merged via automated mechanisms.

  • Platform Adoption & Satisfaction

    • High adoption and developer satisfaction (CSAT) across proprietary internal DevEx tools and boundary APIs

Challenges and Opportunities (What You’ll Own)

  • Navigating Scale: Every change you introduce to the SDLC impacts thousands of microservices and hundreds of engineering teams delivering features to over 140 million users.

  • Tackling "Code Slop" at the Root: As AI agents generate code faster than humans can read it, you will solve one of the industry's newest and hardest problems: keeping codebase quality high without slowing down the team.

  • High Autonomy & Strategic Breadth: You will operate with autonomy, driving horizontal technical alignment without needing micro-oversight, helping lead our joint DevEx technical council.

Core Qualifications (What We're Looking For)

  • Senior IC Leadership Track Record: backend software engineering experience, with a proven track record designing developer platforms, core infra, or DevEx systems at high scale.

  • Deep DevEx & SDLC Expertise: Extensive domain depth in code review systems, test automation platforms, CI/CD pipelines, developer platforms, or static analysis tools built for massive engineering organizations.

  • AI Transformation & Tooling Experience: Direct hands-on experience or deep technical familiarity with AI-assisted software development—including LLM evaluation pipelines, GitHub Copilot/agent integrations, prompt/context/graph engineering, or AI-driven code review frameworks.

  • Autonomous & Opinionated Technical Leader: Demonstrable history of driving technical strategy independently, navigating ambiguity, and bringing strong, battle-tested opinions on "what good looks like" in modern software development.

  • High-Velocity Culture Fit: Experience operating in fast-moving, high-bar environments (e.g., top-tier tech firms, high-growth AI/DevEx startups, or elite AI labs) where speed of execution and technical rigor are equally valued.

 

Work Setup

Work model

Hybrid / On-Site

Office requirement

2 days per week at the office.

 

Our Benefits

- Opportunity of earning equity at Nu (RSUs as a public company)
- Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance
- Life Insurance and AD&D
- Extended maternity and paternity leaves
- Nucleo - Our learning platform of courses
- NuLanguage - Our language learning program
- NuCare - Our mental health and wellness assistance program
- 401K
- Health Savings Account and Flexible Spending Account
- Work-from-home allowance
- Relocation assistance package

To maintain a consistent and fair process for every candidate, Nu does not provide individualized technical feedback. See how our policy works here
