Architect, scale, and operationalize an AI-transformed Developer Experience & Quality strategy so that:

 - The "Secure and Quality Path" is the Default: Automated mechanisms, linting, and smart context-aware agents enforce strict architectural standards, eliminating code quality degradation caused by high-volume AI code generation.

 - Developer Velocity Doubles (2x): The friction in review latency, pull request (PR) approvals, and continuous integration is systematically dismantled, enabling thousands of engineers to ship features safely to 140M+ customers at unprecedented speeds.

 - SDLC is Re-imagined for AI: Foundational tools across code authorship, testing, boundary APIs, and PR reviews are seamlessly integrated with state-of-the-art AI frameworks, smart LLM evaluations, and context-engineering hooks.

 - Automated Approval Standards are Built: Clear deterministic checks and intelligent human-in-the-loop triggers are established to achieve safe, automated PR approvals without manual bottlenecks.



Core Responsibilities

 - Architect E2E Quality & DevEx Platforms: Define and evolve the multi-year vision for our developer tooling ecosystem—covering internal developer platforms, boundary APIs, test automation suites, and pull request review systems.

 - Lead the AI-Driven Code Review Evolution: Architect automated review mechanisms that leverage multi-model evaluations (e.g., using specialized LLMs to audit generated code), custom IDE/GitHub plugins, and deterministic linting to accelerate PR merge times while preventing code bloat or quality degradation.

 - Define Human-in-the-Loop Boundaries: Set company-wide paradigms for when code changes can be automatically approved and merged versus when human intervention or secondary AI audits are required.

 - Partner & Mentor Across Engineering: Act as a force multiplier by partnering with engineers and product managers, elevating the technical bar and instilling modern, high-velocity DevEx practices.

 - Balance AI Speed with System Integrity: Establish observability, defect-tracking metrics, and safety rails to ensure that rapid AI-assisted development does not introduce structural fragility into Nubank's core services.

 - Influence Build vs. Buy Strategy: Evaluate top-tier market tools, AI coding frameworks, and internal platforms to decide when to build bespoke internal agents or integrate emerging third-party tooling.

Key Business & Engineering Metrics You Will Influence

 - Developer Productivity & Velocity
   
   - Achieve a 2x improvement in overall engineering productivity across Nubank's engineering organization.

 - PR Review Latency
   
   - Direct reduction in time-to-merge for pull requests across all BUs and countries.

 - Code Base Health & Quality
   
   - Zero degradation in code quality and zero increase in system defects despite exponentially higher volumes of AI-generated code.

 - Automated PR Approvals
   
   - Increase in the percentage of routine, low-risk code changes safely approved and merged via automated mechanisms.

 - Platform Adoption & Satisfaction
   
   - High adoption and developer satisfaction (CSAT) across proprietary internal DevEx tools and boundary APIs

Challenges and Opportunities (What You’ll Own)

 - Navigating Scale: Every change you introduce to the SDLC impacts thousands of microservices and hundreds of engineering teams delivering features to over 140 million users.

 - Tackling "Code Slop" at the Root: As AI agents generate code faster than humans can read it, you will solve one of the industry's newest and hardest problems: keeping codebase quality high without slowing down the team.

 - High Autonomy & Strategic Breadth: You will operate with autonomy, driving horizontal technical alignment without needing micro-oversight, helping lead our joint DevEx technical council.

Core Qualifications (What We're Looking For)

 - Senior IC Leadership Track Record: backend software engineering experience, with a proven track record designing developer platforms, core infra, or DevEx systems at high scale.

 - Deep DevEx & SDLC Expertise: Extensive domain depth in code review systems, test automation platforms, CI/CD pipelines, developer platforms, or static analysis tools built for massive engineering organizations.

 - AI Transformation & Tooling Experience: Direct hands-on experience or deep technical familiarity with AI-assisted software development—including LLM evaluation pipelines, GitHub Copilot/agent integrations, prompt/context/graph engineering, or AI-driven code review frameworks.

 - Autonomous & Opinionated Technical Leader: Demonstrable history of driving technical strategy independently, navigating ambiguity, and bringing strong, battle-tested opinions on "what good looks like" in modern software development.

 - High-Velocity Culture Fit: Experience operating in fast-moving, high-bar environments (e.g., top-tier tech firms, high-growth AI/DevEx startups, or elite AI labs) where speed of execution and technical rigor are equally valued.

 


WORK SETUP 

Work model

Hybrid / On-Site

Office requirement

- Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance

jobs.title: Senior Staff Software Engineer - Remittance
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Nu

Nu serves more than 140 million customers, guided by a mission to fight complexity and empower people. The company has been leading an industry transformation through innovative products and human-centered services.

 

Proprietary technology and data at scale power Nu’s digital platform, built to promote financial access, advancement, and transparency. Its business model thrives on customer love and lower costs, feeding a flywheel of growth and profitability.

Visit our Institutional Page

About the role
As Nubank scales its footprint globally, seamless international money movement is a cornerstone of our growth. We are looking for a Senior Staff Software Engineer to own the overarching architecture for Nubank’s global Remittance and Cross-Border Payment Platforms. In this role, you will sit at the strategic intersection of high-scale distributed backend systems, foreign exchange (FX) engines, international payment rails, and global compliance platforms. You won't just maintain existing pipelines, you will architect the foundation that enables instant, low-cost, multi-currency money movement for millions of users across borders.Your mission: maintain and grow a resilient, multi-country remittance engine that abstracts away complex global payment rails and regulatory requirements into simple, reliable platform capabilities.

What You Will Own & Build

  • Core Remittance Platform Architecture: Design and evolve the long-term technical vision for multi-currency money movement, FX rate locking, payout routing, and ledgering across international corridors.

  • Global Rail Integration Strategy: Architect plug-and-play integrations with global payout partners, banking networks, and local clearing rails (e.g., PIX, SPEI, FedNow, SWIFT) with ultra-high reliability and low latencies.

  • Resilient Ledgering & FX Management: Build transaction execution engines that guarantee exact-once delivery, deterministic ledger balancing, real-time liquidity management, and auditability under massive concurrency.

  • Compliance & Risk System Abstractions: Partner with AML, KYC, Sanctions Screening, and Regulatory Engineering teams to embed real-time screening seamlessly into payment paths without degrading user experience or throughput.

  • Technical RFC Leadership: Drive cross-organizational consensus on high-impact architectural decisions through detailed RFCs, design reviews, and technical documentation.

  • Engineering Mentorship: Multiply organizational velocity by mentoring senior engineers across payments squads in distributed systems principles, resilience engineering, and payment domain knowledge.

What We Are Looking For

  • Tenure in Backend Software Engineering: Proven track record of designing, operating, and scaling highly available, mission-critical backend distributed platforms in demanding environments (e.g., fintech, payments, banking, or cloud platform infrastructure).

  • Deep Payments Domain Expertise: Hands-on experience building remittance systems, cross-border payments, multi-currency ledger engines, FX execution services, or integrations with international payment clearing systems.

  • Distributed Systems Mastery: High fluency with event-driven architectures, transactional consistency, distributed sagas/orchestration, double-entry accounting engines, and high-concurrency microservices.

  • Platform Mindset: Experience designing clean, developer-friendly APIs, SDKs, and platform boundaries that enable product teams to quickly launch consumer-facing remittance journeys.

  • Cross-Functional Influence: Proven ability to act as a horizontal technical leader, writing comprehensive design documents (RFCs), guiding executive leadership on technical trade-offs, and building consensus across geographically distributed teams.

  • Language & Location: Fluent English is required for international engineering collaboration. Portuguese or Spanish is a plus. Roles are open in Brazil (hybrid model) or key US hubs.

Why Join Us?

You will join a world-class engineering organization that values technical depth, architectural clarity, and high execution speed. You will own the technology powering one of the most strategic growth vectors at Nubank, building cross-border payment infrastructure that unlocks financial freedom for tens of millions of people.

Work model

2 days per week at the office.

About the Role

Controllership team breaks the status quo by facing challenges from the perspective of technological innovation as a tool to automate and make our processes run more efficiently. Our goal is to build a strong and diverse team that looks to create something worthwhile. And has at its core values to pursue smart efficiency, this comes hand in hand with our drive to remain as a strategic partner for all cross chapters teams within NU Mexico.

jobs.title: Head of Total Rewards
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Nu

Nu serves more than 140 million customers, guided by a mission to fight complexity and empower people. The company has been leading an industry transformation through innovative products and human-centered services.

 

Proprietary technology and data at scale power Nu’s digital platform, built to promote financial access, advancement, and transparency. Its business model thrives on customer love and lower costs, feeding a flywheel of growth and profitability.

Visit our Institutional Page

We're now entering our next growth cycle — accelerating internationalization beyond Latin America and expanding into new verticals beyond financial services.

Here's the question this role exists to answer: as Nubank moves from a Latin American digital bank into a globally distributed company operating across dozens of jurisdictions and new verticals - competing simultaneously for regulated banking talent and frontier tech talent - how do we build a Rewards architecture that scales without fragmenting, stays competitive, efficient & effective, and reinforces a single culture across radically different labor markets?

The frameworks that took us from zero to over 135M customers across three countries are not the frameworks that will take us to 40+ markets. You will be the person who decides what scales, what gets rebuilt, and what gets retired.

Why this matters: Compensation, benefits, equity, and executive pay are the contracts we write with every person we hire - and at our scale, those contracts are also the operating system that determines where we can grow, how fast, and at what cost. This isn't a function that administers programs handed down by the business. It's the function that decides what's possible.

What you'll own

You will lead global compensation, benefits, wellness, and executive compensation end-to-end, sit on the Executive Committee, and partner directly with our CEO and CHRO on the most consequential people decisions we make: site location strategy, M&A diligence, market entry, AI transformation, and the deals that secure the leaders defining Nubank's next chapter.

  • Design the global Rewards architecture - compensation, benefits, wellness, and executive compensation - coherent globally, adaptable locally, built to scale from 3 markets to 40+.

  • Partner on globalization and M&A, including site location, deal structuring, and post-merger integration. Bring the Rewards lens on the right talent strategy across the globe.

  • Operate at the People leadership team partnering directly with the CEO and CHRO on executive compensation, equity design, and senior leadership talent strategy.

  • Own the relationship with our Compensation Committee chair and Board members on executive comp and governance.

  • Lead with data - assess effectiveness, guide design, and demonstrate impact in language the business understands.

  • Shape the people implications of AI transformation - how AI changes job architecture, critical talent needs, workforce planning, and the reward mechanisms that reinforce the capabilities Nubank needs next.

  • Build and develop your team, fostering ownership and continuous improvement in a high-velocity environment.

Rewards is the non-negotiable core of this role. Depending on your background, scope may also extend into other disciplines.

What we're looking for

  • 10+ years leading global Total Rewards functions in complex, multi-country environments.

  • Deep expertise in compensation, benefits, and executive compensation design.

  • Experience in high-growth or tech-driven organizations - you know what breaks when a company scales fast.

  • A track record leading large-scale organizational change through complex, cross-functional projects.

  • The communication range to make complex trade-offs clear and compelling to a C-level and Board audience.

  • A strategic, data-driven mindset - and the operational discipline to actually ship the work, not just design it.

  • Comfort with ambiguity, high-velocity change, and being the one who has to decide, not just advise.

The bigger picture

This is not a maintenance role. It's the chance to design Total Rewards for one of the most ambitious companies operating today, at the exact moment the design choices matter most.

Location: São Paulo (Brazil) or Palo Alto, Miami, or Washington, D.C. (USA)

Reports to: Chief People Officer

To maintain a consistent and fair process for every candidate, Nu does not provide individualized technical feedback. See how our policy works here

As a Customer Experience Analyst on our internationalization team, you’ll be a founding member of a CX operation built from scratch in a brand-new country. That means you’ll do more than handle customer interactions — you’ll help shape how we operate, train, and grow across borders. From delivering mind-blowingly great support to identifying process gaps and turning customer feedback into business insight, your work will directly influence what Nu looks like for customers in new markets around the world.

This is a role for someone who thrives in fast-moving environments, cares deeply about people, and is excited by the challenge of building something from the ground up — with the full backing of a global platform behind them.

jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Nu

Nu serves more than 140 million customers, guided by a mission to fight complexity and empower people. The company has been leading an industry transformation through innovative products and human-centered services.

 

Proprietary technology and data at scale power Nu’s digital platform, built to promote financial access, advancement, and transparency. Its business model thrives on customer love and lower costs, feeding a flywheel of growth and profitability.

Visit our Institutional Page

About the Role

At the core of this position is ensuring a large-scale customer operation can adapt and expand its knowledge rapidly. Seamless product launches rely on thousands of team members delivering accurate support from day one; any delay in enablement directly jeopardizes both customer satisfaction and operational productivity.

You'll own CX Academy & Capabilities: the full strategy for how Colombia's entire Customer Experience operation is trained, enabled, and kept current — including governance of the proprietary AI tools that generate content, detect gaps, and simulate practice at scale.

This is one of the highest-surface-area roles in CX Colombia, with direct accountability for tNPS, Quality, and Operational Efficiency, and a seat representing Colombia in Nu's global Training and Content workstreams.

You'll be responsible for

  • Own the end-to-end learning strategy, roadmap, and tech stack for CX Colombia, deciding which tools, platforms, and methodologies power enablement at scale.

  • Govern the use of Nu's proprietary AI tools for content generation, gap detection, and practice simulation, ensuring quality scales alongside speed.

  • Lead a team of CX Academy specialists through influence, setting the standard for training and content across the operation.

  • Represent Colombia in Nu's global Training and Content workstreams, shaping cross-market standardization decisions.

  • Audit and align BPO training teams' execution to Nu's standard, engaging directly on the operations floor when needed.

  • Drive direct accountability for tNPS, Quality, and Operational Efficiency through the enablement system you build.

  • Partner with squads and stakeholders to diagnose enablement gaps and redesign the processes behind them.

We are looking for a person who has

Required

  • Real experience leading teams — giving difficult feedback, developing underperformers, and holding the standard without oversight.

  • A track record of diagnosing systemic problems and redesigning processes end-to-end, rather than patching symptoms.

  • Demonstrated ability to learn unfamiliar operations quickly, understanding new processes, tools, and stakeholders within weeks rather than quarters.

  • Experience leading through influence — mobilizing teams outside your direct line and shifting senior stakeholders' views with data, not escalation.

  • Comfort using AI as a core part of your daily workflow, paired with sound judgment about where AI should and shouldn't be trusted.

  • Ideally 5+ years of experience across business operations, strategy & ops, consulting, transformation, product ops, or training.

  • English proficiency at B2 or above; approximately 30% of your time will be spent working in English.

Nice to have

  • Experience working with BPOs or outsourced service operations from the client side.

  • A background in training or learning design, particularly in system redesign rather than catalog management.

Location for this opportunity

Bogotá, Colombia

Our Benefits

  • Chance of earning equity at Nu

  • Extended maternity and paternity leaves

  • Health and life insurance

  • NuCare - Our mental health and wellness assistance program

  • Nucleo - Our learning platform of courses

  • NuLanguage - Our language learning program

  • Vacations of 15 workdays

  • Gym partnership

  • Work-from-home Allowance

  • Parental Consultancy

  • Relocation Assistance Package, if applicable

Our hybrid work model brings us to the office at least twice a week, on strategic days designed to maximize team connection and collaboration. For more details, visit building.nubank.com/nu-hybrid-work-model

jobs.title: Controllership Expert - Record to Report
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Nu

Nu serves more than 140 million customers, guided by a mission to fight complexity and empower people. The company has been leading an industry transformation through innovative products and human-centered services.

 

Proprietary technology and data at scale power Nu’s digital platform, built to promote financial access, advancement, and transparency. Its business model thrives on customer love and lower costs, feeding a flywheel of growth and profitability.

Visit our Institutional Page

About the Role

We are looking for a Controllership Expert to join Record to Report within Global Service Platform (GSP). GSP provides standardized, cross-functional services that enable the rest of the bank to operate at scale. The Record team processes information from Nubank’s ledgers, translates treasury and product activity into an accounting view, supports daily close and financial analysis, and provides the control foundation for all geographies.

This is an strategic individual contributor role for someone who combines finance and controls expertise with a strong affinity for process, data, and technology. You will act as a central orchestrator across the Record organization, partnering with functional managers and senior stakeholders to manage cross-team projects, establish delivery metrics, and consolidate reconciliation goals and performance.

The role is designed for someone who can operate autonomously, bring structure to ambiguous agendas, and lead through influence without direct people-management responsibility. You will help the leadership team focus on product and service lines by creating a reliable operating system for controls, projects, metrics, and continuous improvement.

This role is based in São Paulo, Brazil, and works across a global organization serving Brazil, Mexico, Colombia, and other Nubank geographies.


You’ll be Responsible for

  • Manage a portfolio of cross-team Record to Report and controllership projects, translating strategic priorities into clear plans, milestones, owners, dependencies, risks, and governance.

  • Track delivery commitments and create the metrics, dashboards, and communication cadences that give leaders a clear view of progress, bottlenecks, risks, and decisions required.

  • Consolidate reconciliation metrics across processes, entities, accounts, and teams, creating common definitions for completion, timeliness, aging, breaks, materiality, root cause, and remediation.

  • Partner with process owners and managers to define reconciliation goals, leading indicators, thresholds, and action plans, and lead recurring performance reviews.

  • Identify recurring breaks, delays, and control gaps and coordinate root-cause remediation across process, data, system, and operational teams.

  • Establish scalable operating mechanisms for controls, close readiness, issue management, and follow-up to reduce dependence on manual tracking and one-off heroics.

  • Work with Finance Platform, Finance Systems, Data, Engineering, Tax, Treasury, FP&A, Internal Audit, Risk, and other partners to improve tools, workflows, data quality, and operational visibility.

  • Translate complex financial and operational topics into concise narratives, viable options, trade-offs, and clear recommendations for senior stakeholders.

  • Clarify accountability and decision rights using practical mechanisms such as RACI or RAPID when work spans multiple teams.

  • Support the evolution of Record’s operating model as new global processes, including tax compliance activities, are brought into the organization.

  • Turn successful improvements into repeatable standards, playbooks, and ways of working that can be adopted across geographies.

 

What We're Looking For Someone Who Has

Required

  • Significant experience in controllership, accounting operations, financial close, reconciliations, controls, risk, finance operations, or a related discipline.

  • A degree in Accounting, Economics, Business Administration, Finance, or a related field. Other backgrounds may also be considered when paired with strong, relevant experience.

  • A track record of leading complex, cross-functional initiatives from an ambiguous problem statement through implementation and sustained adoption.

  • Strong understanding of processes and controls, with the judgment to balance accounting accuracy, control quality, operational efficiency, and delivery speed.

  • Experience designing metrics, setting goals, analyzing performance, identifying root causes, and turning data into decisions and measurable improvements.

  • Advanced English communication skills, enabling effective collaboration with global teams and stakeholders.

  • Practical familiarity with data analysis using Python and SQL. You do not need to be a software engineer, but you should be comfortable understanding data, working with technical partners, and using these tools to investigate and improve processes.

  • Strong stakeholder-management and communication skills, with the ability to influence senior partners without direct authority.

  • A high degree of autonomy, confidence, and ownership: someone who can take an agenda forward, bring ideas, circulate effectively among managers, and ask for support when a decision truly requires escalation.

  • Comfort working as a senior individual contributor and interested in growing through an expert career path rather than requiring formal people management.

Nice to Have

  • Experience in a technology company, fintech, bank, shared-services environment, or a global organization with complex financial operations.

  • Experience with finance systems, ledgers, reconciliation platforms, workflow tools, automation, or data products.

  • Experience supporting daily or near-real-time close, tax compliance processes, audit readiness, or multi-geography controllership.

  • Product, program, or project management experience, especially in roles that required coordinating multiple teams and turning broad priorities into execution.

  • Experience in reducing recurring exceptions, manual effort, cycle time, or rework through process redesign and automation.

  • A practical, generalist mindset: the ability to move between finance, controls, data, technology, and stakeholder problems while maintaining rigor.

Location

São Paulo, Brazil

Work model

Hybrid

Office requirement

2 days per week at the office.

 

Our Benefits

  • Chance of earning equity at Nubank

  • Food/ Meal Card (Vale-Refeição and/or Vale Alimentação)

  • Public Transportation Commuting Benefit (Vale-Transporte)

  • NuCare – Psychological, Financial and Legal Assistance Program

  • Life Insurance

  • Medical Plan

  • Dental Plan

  • NuLanguage – Language Course Program

  • Nucleo - Our learning platform of courses

  • Extended Parental Leave

  • Daycare Allowance

  • Parental Consultancy

  • Work-from-home Allowance

  • Gym Partnerships

  • 30 days of paid vacation

  • Relocation Assistance Package, if applicable

Our recruitment process may involve the use of artificial intelligence–enabled tools, such as automated interview transcription and analysis, to support the evaluation process. Artificial intelligence is not used to make final hiring decisions; all decisions are made by human reviewers.

To maintain a consistent and fair process for every candidate, Nu does not provide individualized technical feedback. See how our policy works here

lists.content: Você fará parte da Business Unit de Cards Acquisition, integrando um time enxuto e de alto impacto focado no crescimento do principal produto financeiro da Neon: o Cartão de Crédito. Sua missão possui dois pilares estratégicos: garantir a ativação e o uso recorrente dos clientes aprovados, e reter usuários não aprovados por meio de produtos alternativos e inovadores, como iniciativas de credit building.

Buscamos um profissional com perfil analítico e pragmático, que possua um forte mindset de problem solving e raciocínio crítico para decompor problemas complexos e formular hipóteses de forma totalmente autônoma. Nosso foco está em identificar alguém que consiga olhar para os dados internos, extrair inteligência deles e traduzi-los em oportunidades de negócio.

• Monitorar resultados e indicadores de performance do funil de clientes, implementando dashboards e automatizações para esses acompanhamentos.
  • Liderar estratégias de aquisição de produtos e engajamento, focando na conversão de clientes novos e existentes da Neon dentro e fora do aplicativo, através de canais como Push, E-mail e WhatsApp.
  • Realizar análises de dados profundas para a geração de insights e identificação de novas oportunidades de negócio.
  • Avaliar novos projetos, produtos e features, auxiliando diretamente na priorização dos roadmaps junto aos times de engenharia e produto.
  • Desenhar e liderar testes de growth e experimentos de ponta a ponta, sendo responsável desde a geração da hipótese e delineamento do experimento, até a execução, mensuração e comunicação dos resultados.
  • Apresentar resultados e teses de crescimento estruturadas em fóruns de liderança, garantindo o alinhamento estratégico das iniciativas.

• Forte capacidade analítica e habilidade para estruturar e resolver problemas complexos através de dados.
  • Iniciativa, proatividade e sentimento de dono para identificar oportunidades e propor planos de ação.
  • Excelente comunicação verbal e escrita, com capacidade de síntese para reportar aprendizados.
  • Adaptabilidade a diferentes cenários, mudanças e capacidade de oferecer cobertura mútua em um time enxuto.
  • Capacidade de construir relacionamentos robustos com outras áreas, engajando stakeholders e pessoas no dia a dia.
  • Conhecimento avançado de Google Sheets / Excel e Google Slides / Power Point.
  • Proficiência e experiência prática em escrita de código SQL ou ferramentas equivalentes para extração de dados.
  • Curiosidade intelectual e vontade de aprender e alavancar o seu trabalho por meio do uso de ferramentas de Inteligência Artificial.
  • Experiência prévia em fintechs ou empresas de tecnologia de rápido crescimento (fast-paced).
  • Domínio de Python como ferramenta de análise de dados, incluindo manipulação, tratamento e automação de rotinas.

• Proficiência em inglês para facilitar a comunicação e aumentar a confiança em fóruns e reuniões com lideranças
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas de automação de marketing (como Braze, Salesforce ou Insider) e domínio de métricas de canais como Push, E-mail e SMS.

Queremos ser, cada vez mais,  um time excepcional - que constrói, apoia e reconhece equipes diversas que sobem a barra lá em cima!

Queremos ser, cada vez mais,  um time excepcional - que constrói, apoia e reconhece equipes diversas que sobem a barra lá em cima! 

Somos uma fintech fundada por um brasileiro que, insatisfeito com os bancos tradicionais, começou a construir um serviço que ajudasse a vida financeira das pessoas de forma simples e sem burocracia.

Quem pode se inscrever?
 
Todas as pessoas que se identificam como parte da comunidade negra, ou seja, pessoas pretas e pardas podem se inscrever nessa página e em outras vagas na nossa página de carreiras, seu perfil será revisado e direcionado para áreas onde estamos recrutando.
 
Por quê um banco de talentos para inclusão de talentos negros?
 
A Neon está comprometida com a promoção de Igualdade Racial e acreditamos que ao gerar oportunidades intencionais podemos influenciar, fortalecer e sobretudo enegrecer nosso ambiente, portanto, ações afirmativas são um importante passo para acelerar o nosso compromisso. Vale dizer, que o processo não sofreu alterações de etapas ou critérios de avaliação, então, se você se encaixa nos requisitos e é uma pessoa negra e quer transformar o mercado financeiro, vem com a gente!
 
Se eu me inscrever, eu vou automaticamente participar de um processo de recrutamento?
 
As pessoas inscritas nessa página terão seus perfis revisados e direcionados para um processo de recrutamento em áreas com posições abertas, caso hajam posições alinhadas ao perfil.

jobs.descriptionPlain:
Sobre a Neon

Queremos ser, cada vez mais,  um time excepcional - que constrói, apoia e reconhece equipes diversas que sobem a barra lá em cima! 

Somos uma fintech fundada por um brasileiro que, insatisfeito com os bancos tradicionais, começou a construir um serviço que ajudasse a vida financeira das pessoas de forma simples e sem burocracia.

Nosso objetivo é simplificar o sistema bancário e trabalhamos com um grande  propósito: criar caminhos por uma vida financeira melhor para todos os brasileiros.

Temos a tecnologia como aliada para inovar e desenvolver as melhores soluções para quem está no corre!


Por que um Banco de Talento afirmativo para LGBTQIA+?
 
A Neon está comprometida com a promoção de equidade acreditamos que ao gerar oportunidades intencionais podemos influenciar, fortalecer e sobretudo transformar nosso ambiente, portanto, ações afirmativas são um importante passo para acelerar o nosso compromisso. ✨
 
Com isso, nasce DiversaNeon, iniciativa criada para fomentar diversidade e inclusão e conta com pilares centrais, como: garantir um ambiente seguro, saudável e acolhedor; realizar ações de conscientização e educação, e suportar demandas.
 
Contamos com 7 grupos de afinidade: DiversaPCD, DiversaBlack, DiversaPride e DiversaWoman, DiversaGeneration, DiversaImmigration e DiversaParental representando os mais diversos grupos, para nos apoiar com ações que geram representatividade e protagonismo a todas as pessoas, além de vagas afirmativas com foco em inclusão e um Hub de conteúdos voltados a diversidade.
 
Pensando nisso criamos um “Banco de Talentos focado em inclusão de Pessoas LGBTQIA+”, uma oportunidade para profissionais que querem nos ajudar a construir a conta digital mais incrível do Brasil.
 
Buscamos pessoas incríveis e de alta performance, talentosas e colaborativas, divertidas e responsáveis. 🚀 💙
Os pré-requisitos e as responsabilidades variam de acordo com cada desafio e temos oportunidades em diversas áreas.

jobs.descriptionPlain:
Sobre a Neon

Queremos ser, cada vez mais,  um time excepcional - que constrói, apoia e reconhece equipes diversas que sobem a barra lá em cima! 

Somos uma fintech fundada por um brasileiro que, insatisfeito com os bancos tradicionais, começou a construir um serviço que ajudasse a vida financeira das pessoas de forma simples e sem burocracia.

Nosso objetivo é simplificar o sistema bancário e trabalhamos com um grande  propósito: criar caminhos por uma vida financeira melhor para todos os brasileiros.

Temos a tecnologia como aliada para inovar e desenvolver as melhores soluções para quem está no corre!


Por que um Banco de Talento afirmativo para MULHERES ?
 
A Neon está comprometida com a promoção de equidade acreditamos que ao gerar oportunidades intencionais podemos influenciar, fortalecer e sobretudo transformar nosso ambiente, portanto, ações afirmativas são um importante passo para acelerar o nosso compromisso. ✨
 
Com isso, nasce DiversaNeon, iniciativa criada para fomentar diversidade e inclusão e conta com pilares centrais, como: garantir um ambiente seguro, saudável e acolhedor; realizar ações de conscientização e educação, e suportar demandas.
 
Contamos com 7 grupos de afinidade: DiversaPCD, DiversaBlack, DiversaPride e DiversaWoman, DiversaGeneration, DiversaImmigration e DiversaParental representando os mais diversos grupos, para nos apoiar com ações que geram representatividade e protagonismo a todas as pessoas, além de vagas afirmativas com foco em inclusão e um Hub de conteúdos voltados a diversidade.
 
Pensando nisso criamos um “Banco de Talentos focado em inclusão de MULHERES”, uma oportunidade para profissionais que querem nos ajudar a construir a conta digital mais incrível do Brasil.
 
Buscamos pessoas incríveis e de alta performance, talentosas e colaborativas, divertidas e responsáveis. 🚀 💙
Os pré-requisitos e as responsabilidades variam de acordo com cada desafio e temos oportunidades em diversas áreas.

jobs.descriptionPlain:
Sobre a Neon

Queremos ser, cada vez mais,  um time excepcional - que constrói, apoia e reconhece equipes diversas que sobem a barra lá em cima! 

Somos uma fintech fundada por um brasileiro que, insatisfeito com os bancos tradicionais, começou a construir um serviço que ajudasse a vida financeira das pessoas de forma simples e sem burocracia.

Nosso objetivo é simplificar o sistema bancário e trabalhamos com um grande  propósito: criar caminhos por uma vida financeira melhor para todos os brasileiros.

Temos a tecnologia como aliada para inovar e desenvolver as melhores soluções para quem está no corre!


Por que um Banco de Talento afirmativo para PcD?
 
A Neon está comprometida com a promoção de diversidade, equidade e inclusão. E acreditamos que ao gerar oportunidades intencionais podemos transformar nosso ambiente e acelerar o nosso compromisso com a pauta. ✨
 
Com isso, nasce o DiversaNeon, iniciativa criada para fomentar diversidade e inclusão na Neon e conta com pilares centrais, como: garantir um ambiente seguro, saudável e acolhedor e realizar ações de conscientização e educação.
 
Hoje contamos com 7 grupos de afinidade: DiversaPCD, DiversaBlack, DiversaPride e DiversaWoman, DiversaGeneration, DiversaImmigration e DiversaParental representando a pluralidade das nossas pessoas. Os grupos foram criados para apoiar ações que geram representatividade e protagonismo a todas as pessoas, além de vagas afirmativas com foco em inclusão e um Hub de conteúdos voltados a diversidade.
 
Pensando nisso criamos um “Banco de Talentos focado em inclusão de Pessoas com Deficiência”, uma oportunidade para profissionais que querem nos ajudar a construir um futuro brilhante para o brasileiro trabalhador. E ai, vamos nessa?
 
Importante: os pré-requisitos e as responsabilidades variam de acordo com cada desafio e temos oportunidades em diversas áreas.

jobs.descriptionPlain:
Sobre a Neon

Na Neon, cada ideia conta e pode transformar a vida financeira de milhares de brasileiras e brasileiros que acreditam que o céu é o limite. Buscamos pessoas que querem contribuir com impacto real e crescer junto com a gente!

Nosso ritmo é intenso, assim como o aprendizado com gente muito talentosa e equipes colaborativas que geram impacto real desde o primeiro dia, com o bônus de trabalhar de qualquer lugar do Brasil.

Aqui a inovação e tecnologia andam juntos e diversidade é decisão estratégica do negócio e compromisso que molda nossas decisões e garante um ambiente acolhedor para todas as pessoas.

 Valorizamos a colaboração, o diálogo aberto e entregas que compreendam as necessidades das pessoas que usam nossas soluções.Se você é uma pessoa que gosta de construir, testar, aprender e se comprometer com a excelência, a Neon é pra você.

Vem fazer parte de um time que não tem medo de sonhar grande e trabalha junto para elevar a barra todos os dias, fazendo o dinheiro fluir e o mundo crescer. Vem #ViverNoAzul!


Requisitos
Experiência profissional com politicas de crédito de no mínimo 4 anos
Conhecimento técnico de métricas de risco de crédito
Experiência com manipulação de dados e programação SQL
Experiência anterior em fintechs, bancos ou instituições financeiras é altamente valorizada

Habilidades
Capacidade de desenvolver políticas de crédito eficazes do ponto de vista de controle de risco e rentabilidade
Visão analítica orientada para resultados, com foco em inovação e melhoria contínua
Senso critico e rigor técnico

Responsabilidades
Realização de estudos e desenvolvimento de políticas de concessão de cartão de crédito
Estudos e acompanhamentos das distintas estratégias aplicadas para a concessão do crédito
Acompanhamento, análise e projeções dos indicadores de safra
Análises e projeções de rentabilidade
Busca constante por oportunidades

lists.content:
• Atuar como a principal referência analítica da vertical de Consumer & AI, conectando os avanços de Inteligência Artificial aos múltiplos produtos do ecossistema Neon, como a Home do aplicativo e as Plataformas de Experimentação. 
  • Realizar análises horizontais focadas no comportamento do cliente na Home do app, auxiliando na priorização de componentes com base em lifetime value e no acompanhamento de métricas institucionais transversais (ex.: WTU e NPS). 
  • Estruturar e aprimorar o framework de testes A/B, definindo a metodologia de mensuração de impacto das iniciativas de produto e IA. 
  • Apoiar pontualmente os times técnicos no acompanhamento de métricas de plataforma, design system e dashboards de performance. 
  • Atuar de forma autônoma na extração, tratamento e modelagem de grandes volumes de dados complexos via SQL, aliando a capacidade analítica "na mão" ao uso inteligente de ferramentas de IA para acelerar diagnósticos e transformá-los em direcionamentos estratégicos. 
  • Implantar e disseminar o framework de testes A/B de ponta a ponta com rigor estatístico (cálculo de amostra, significância e margem de erro), garantindo solidez e confiabilidade nas recomendações levadas ao negócio. 
  • Desenvolver, validar e defender estudos de viabilidade financeira complexos perante a liderança, conectando diretamente as iniciativas de produto e IA a indicadores de saúde do negócio, como LTV, CAC, margem e controle de churn. 
  • Construir análises aprofundadas (deep dives) e estruturar a governança de painéis de performance (KPIs) para o comitê executivo, traduzindo métricas e dados complexos em narrativas estratégicas acionáveis. 
  • Arquitetar soluções de automação para coleta e tratamento de dados recorrentes, garantindo agilidade, precisão e autonomia para o fluxo analítico do time.

• Experiência acima de 7 anos e sólida trajetória em Business Analysis, Analytics ou Planejamento Estratégico em ambientes de tecnologia ou produtos digitais. 
  • Alta proficiência em extração, manipulação e modelagem de dados complexos diretamente das fontes brutas, sem dependência de automações. 
  • Aplicação prática de ferramentas e conceitos de IA no dia a dia para otimizar fluxos analíticos e potencializar entregas. 
  • Vivência com a cultura de experimentação e estatística focada em vivência prática no desenho, execução e análise estatística de Testes A/B e outras metodologias de experimentação
  • Compreensão aprofundada de P&L, LTV, CAC, churn e principais métricas de produto (ex.: WTU, NPS). 
  • Capacidade de estruturar cenários complexos, priorizar ações e traduzir dados em apresentações estratégicas para C-Level e diretoria. 
  • Perfil autônomo, proativo e flexível para articular alinhamentos entre times multidisciplinares e orientar/mentorar analistas mais juniores. 
  • Conhecimento em Python ou R para modelagem preditiva e análises estatísticas avançadas.
  • Visão de Negócio e Unit Economics trazendo forte entendimento de P&L (Lucros e Perdas) e das principais alavancas de resultado financeiro, conectando métricas de produto à sustentabilidade do negócio.
• Background no Mercado Financeiro com vivência consolidada em fintechs, bancos ou consultorias estratégicas.

jobs.descriptionPlain: Na Neon, nossa missão é simplificar a vida financeira de milhões de brasileiros de forma segura, ágil e escalável. Para que possamos continuar crescendo e inovando sem limites, a nossa blindagem perimetral e arquitetura de redes em nuvem precisam ser impecáveis. Como Cloud Security Engineer Specialist, você será a liderança técnica responsável por desenhar, automatizar e sustentar a segurança de nossas redes e perímetros na nuvem (com foco massivo em AWS). O seu desafio será garantir a integridade de um ecossistema financeiro complexo utilizando o que há de mais moderno em soluções de borda (Palo Alto e Zscaler), atuando de forma estratégica e hands-on para guiar o nosso time em direção a um ambiente cada vez mais resiliente e seguro por design.
jobs.description: Na Neon, nossa missão é simplificar a vida financeira de milhões de brasileiros de forma segura, ágil e escalável. Para que possamos continuar crescendo e inovando sem limites, a nossa blindagem perimetral e arquitetura de redes em nuvem precisam ser impecáveis. Como Cloud Security Engineer Specialist, você será a liderança técnica responsável por desenhar, automatizar e sustentar a segurança de nossas redes e perímetros na nuvem (com foco massivo em AWS). O seu desafio será garantir a integridade de um ecossistema financeiro complexo utilizando o que há de mais moderno em soluções de borda (Palo Alto e Zscaler), atuando de forma estratégica e hands-on para guiar o nosso time em direção a um ambiente cada vez mais resiliente e seguro por design.

lists.content:
• Arquitetura de Nuvem Segura: Desenhar, implementar e otimizar arquiteturas de rede seguras no ecossistema AWS, utilizando as melhores práticas de segmentação, isolamento e privilégio mínimo.
  • Gestão de Perímetro e SASE: Configurar, administrar e evoluir nossos firewalls de próxima geração (Palo Alto Networks / VM-Series) e nossas plataformas de acesso seguro e borda (Zscaler - ZIA/ZPA), liderando a estratégia de SASE/Zero Trust.
  • Infraestrutura como Código (IaC): Desenvolver e manter nossa infraestrutura de rede e segurança de forma totalmente automatizada (Security as Code) utilizando Terraform, mitigando riscos e promovendo padronização.
  • Monitoramento e Resposta Ativa: Atuar na linha de frente para detectar, analisar e mitigar ameaças ou incidentes de segurança de rede em tempo real, implementando melhorias contínuas para blindar novos vetores de ataque.
  • Conformidade de Alto Nível: Garantir que todos os ambientes de rede em nuvem estejam em conformidade com as diretrizes internas de segurança e com frameworks regulatórios de mercado (PCI-DSS, ISO 27001, CIS Benchmarks).
  • Disseminação de Cultura: Apoiar o desenvolvimento técnico do time, mentorando engenheiros e analistas, e sendo a referência em Security by Design para desenvolvedores, POs e outras áreas de tecnologia.

• Sólida experiência técnica atuando em Segurança de Redes e Cloud Security em ambientes complexos e escaláveis.
  • Domínio avançado do ecossistema de redes e segurança nativo da AWS (VPC, Security Groups, NACLs, Transit Gateway, Route 53, AWS WAF, Shield, GuardDuty e CloudTrail).
  • Prática consolidada na administração de firewalls de próxima geração Palo Alto Networks (VM-Series, Panorama).
  • Vivência técnica robusta com soluções de SASE/Zero Trust da Zscaler (Zscaler Internet Access - ZIA e Zscaler Private Access - ZPA).
  • Profundo conhecimento em fundamentos de redes: protocolos de roteamento dinâmico (BGP, OSPF), topologias de VPN (IPsec, SSL), modelo TCP/IP, OSI e análise avançada de pacotes.
  • Experiência prática na criação e manutenção de códigos de infraestrutura (IaC) utilizando Terraform.

• Conhecimento prático de segurança em múltiplos provedores de nuvem (Microsoft Azure ou Google Cloud Platform - GCP).
  • Experiência com plataformas modernas de CNAPP/CSPM (ex: Prisma Cloud, Wiz, Orca Security).
  • Certificações técnicas ativas, tais como:
  • AWS Certified Advanced Networking ou AWS Certified Security - Specialty.
  • Palo Alto Networks PCNSE.
  • Zscaler Certified Cloud Specialist (ZCCS).
  • Certificações de mercado agnósticas (CISSP, CCSP, CEH).

jobs.title: Lead Product Marketing Manager
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Neon

Neon is a global payments and e-commerce platform designed to help game publishers earn more money and independence from app stores. We believe commerce should be open and transparent: clear decisions, actionable insights, and aligned incentives. Founded by payments, fintech and gaming veterans, Neon focuses on product and partnership excellence: we share the playbook, co-pilot decisions, and abstract away risk and complexity for our customers. We’re replacing old-school, black-box relics with clear, modern, and developer-centric infrastructure.

As an early team member, you’ll have the opportunity to shape and scale Neon’s product and culture, making a direct impact on our growth and success. You’ll join a collaborative, diverse team from world-class companies like Apple, Affirm, Unity, and Visa, backed by renowned VC's including Thrive, a16z, Griffin Gaming, Ribbit, and Renegade. If you want to build disruptive technology, challenge the status quo, and help game creators thrive on their own terms, read on.

About the Role

We are looking for a Lead Product Marketing Manager (PMM) who can own product marketing end-to-end: positioning, messaging, sales enablement, competitive intelligence, and go-to-market execution. As our first Product Marketing hire, you will step into a high-leverage, solo function with the mandate to build Neon’s GTM foundation from scratch. You will serve as the foundational pillar of our marketing engine, shaping how the market perceives our core products.The core challenge is translating a genuinely complex product into messaging that lands with business-side stakeholders at game publishers & studios.

This role is right for someone who has done enterprise B2B product marketing at a fintech or SaaS company, has strong instincts for positioning in a category where most buyers do not fully understand what they are buying, and wants to build something from scratch rather than inherit a playbook.

What You'll Do

Positioning and Messaging

  • Own Neon's core narrative: why MoR is the right model for publishers, how we compare to app stores and self-managed payments, and what we do differently versus competitors

  • Develop audience-specific messaging for publisher BD, finance, and product stakeholders.

  • Translate complex product capabilities (MoR, loyalty, tax) into clear, credible value propositions that do not require a payments background to understand.

Sales Enablement

  • Build and maintain the core sales collateral: pitch decks, one-pagers, competitive battle cards, and objection-handling guides.

  • Create materials for publisher onboarding that explain what Neon owns (tax, chargebacks, compliance) and what the publisher owns.

  • Run enablement sessions with the sales and CS team when new products or market coverage launches.

Go-to-Market Execution

  • Own GTM for new product launches and major market expansions. Define the audience, message, channel, and success metric.

  • Lead co-marketing and launch announcements with publishing partners.

  • Develop thought leadership content that positions Neon as the authority on direct monetization for game publishers.

Competitive and Market Intelligence

  • Maintain a current view of the competitive landscape: competitors, app store fee structures, and emerging direct-to-consumer tooling.

  • Synthesize publisher feedback and market signals into positioning updates and product roadmap input.

  • Track regulatory and industry trends (app store legislation, tax rule changes) that affect Neon's positioning.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Partner closely with Product to understand roadmap priorities and translate them into external messaging.

  • Work with Sales and Customer Success to build feedback loops between market signals and product direction.

  • Influence roadmap prioritization based on competitive gaps and publisher feedback.

What You'll Bring

  • 7+ years in product marketing, with at least 3 years in enterprise B2B SaaS, fintech, or payments. Gaming industry experience is a strong plus.

  • Demonstrated ability to position a technically complex product to non-technical buyers.

  • Strong writing. You can write a one-pager, a LinkedIn post, and a pitch deck that all sound like they came from the same company.

  • Comfort with regulatory and compliance nuance. You do not need to be a lawyer, but you need to be able to explain concepts like MoR liability, chargeback ownership, and tax remittance without either oversimplifying or scaring buyers away.

  • Competitive analysis depth. You know how to run a rigorous teardown and turn it into actionable sales collateral.

  • Bias toward execution. You move quickly, produce work, and iterate rather than waiting for perfect information.

  • Prior experience in a founding or lead PMM role where you built the function rather than inherited it.

Bonus Points

  • Experience marketing to game publishers, studios, or developer platforms.

  • Background in MoR, payment processing, or e-commerce infrastructure.

  • Experience producing high-volume content (newsletters, LinkedIn series, blog) as part of a GTM motion.

  • Familiarity with the competitive dynamics between app stores and direct-to-consumer monetization.

About the Role

Neon is seeking a Senior Software Engineer who will help lead the development of one of our key work streams. As a design-minded engineer, you’ll bring ideas to life on a blank canvas, turning concepts into functional, beautiful products. You’ll be involved in the full stack of the technology, working hands-on to build and scale a core product that accelerates financial independence for game creators.

What You’ll Do

  • Develop and maintain both front‑end and back‑end components of the product

  • Collaborate closely with product leaders, designers, and fellow engineers to define, design, and ship new features

  • Ensure features are scalable, performant, secure, and user-friendly

  • Write clean, maintainable, and efficient code, participate in code reviews, maintain documentation

What We Look For

  • 5+ years software engineering experience.

  • Full-stack background, with strong focuses on React and TypeScript.

  • Excited about learning new things and flexing across the stack as the team evolves alongside you.

  • Highly productive, able to take ownership of key initiatives and deliver results.

  • Experience leading teams or projects and enjoy helping others level up their skills.

  • Able to work from our office in New York City

Join Neon. Shape the Future of Gaming.

jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Neon

Neon is a global payments and e-commerce platform designed to help game publishers earn more money and independence from app stores. We believe commerce should be open and transparent: clear decisions, actionable insights, and aligned incentives. Founded by payments, fintech and gaming veterans, Neon focuses on product and partnership excellence: we share the playbook, co-pilot decisions, and abstract away risk and complexity for our customers. We’re replacing old-school, black-box relics with clear, modern, and developer-centric infrastructure.

As an early team member, you’ll have the opportunity to shape and scale Neon’s product and culture, making a direct impact on our growth and success. You’ll join a collaborative, diverse team from world-class companies like Apple, Affirm, Unity, and Visa, backed by renowned VC's including Thrive, a16z, Griffin Gaming, Ribbit, and Renegade. If you want to build disruptive technology, challenge the status quo, and help game creators thrive on their own terms, read on.

Why Join Neon?

  • Game-Changing Mission: Be part of a company fundamentally changing how the gaming industry operates, helping creators build, run, and scale their businesses on their own terms.

  • Ownership & Impact: As an early member of the engineering team, you’ll have ownership of the development and scaling of our flagship webshop product, making a direct impact on the company’s success.

  • Disruptive Technology: Help create fintech tools that challenge the status quo, empowering independent game creators in the same way Neon challenges major platforms.

  • High-Profile Backing: Join a high-potential startup with renowned backers and investors supporting our mission to disrupt the gaming industry.

  • Collaborative Team: Work with a diverse team of low-ego, kind, and talented individuals from varied backgrounds including Stanford, Affirm, Palantir, Supercell, Apple, and Netflix.

 

About You

You’re passionate about doing your life’s best work, collaborating with highly talented individuals, and contributing to an ambitious mission. You are a high-impact engineer who learns by doing, enjoys taking ownership of projects, and wants to grow as an engineer and leader in your next role. You’re excited by the chance to shape Neon’s product, team, and culture, and you’ve already led successful projects that uplifted those around you.

 

About the Role

Neon is seeking a Forward Deployed Engineer who will scale the partner engineering function. You’ll work alongside our sales and customer success teams to build and manage developer onboarding, own our customer-facing documentation, and build out new features for our customers. You’ll also shape the direction of the team: manage how the team grows and set the standards for your teammates at Neon.

 

What We’re Looking For:

  • You have 5+ years of experience in partner engineering or a similar customer-facing engineering role.

  • You have experience writing and maintaining API documentation for complex technical products.

  • You have experience with, and are willing to flex into, full-stack product development to manage specific customer requests.

  • You are highly productive, able to take ownership of key initiatives and deliver results.

  • You have experience leading teams or projects and enjoy helping others level up their skills.

  • You’re located or willing to work from Seoul, South Korea.

  • Must be fluent in English and Korean

 

This is a unique opportunity to join an early-stage, high-growth company and work alongside some of the brightest minds in gaming, fintech, and tech. If you’re ready to contribute to a mission-driven team and help us accelerate change in the gaming industry, we’d love to hear from you.

 

Join Neon. Shape the Future of Gaming.

 

Our Process

We have designed our interviews to be as efficient and effective as possible, so once you pass our initial screen, please prepare for 4-6 hours of interviews across 3 rounds over 2 weeks.

 

Hiring Manager Screen: 30 min

Gain a better understanding of the Neon business and the engineering team.

 

Project Take-home Review: 1 hour

We’ll give you a take-home to work on; once you’re done, you’ll walk through it with our engineering team.

 

Virtual Onsite Interview: 4 hours

  • Two 1-hour technical sessions with our engineers to walk through a coding and/or systems design exercise.

  • One 1-hour session with our head of customer success.

  • CEO Meet & Greet: 30 minutes

  • Please come prepared to wow us with your skills; discuss and demonstrate how you collaborate with teammates; ask questions about how we work, and show how you’ll fit in.

 

Throughout the process, please come prepared with any open questions you have about the role, our team or opportunity; feedback on our process; your refined “Why Neon?” ;)

 - Ownership & Impact: As an early member of the engineering team, you’ll have ownership of the development and scaling of our flagship webshop product, making a direct impact on the company’s success.

 - Disruptive Technology: Help create fintech tools that challenge the status quo, empowering independent game creators in the same way Neon challenges major platforms.

 - High-Profile Backing: Join a high-potential startup with renowned backers and investors supporting our mission to disrupt the gaming industry.

 - Collaborative Team: Work with a diverse team of low-ego, kind, and talented individuals from varied backgrounds including Stanford, Affirm, Palantir, Supercell, Apple, and Netflix.

 

About You

You’re passionate about doing your life’s best work, collaborating with highly talented individuals, and contributing to an ambitious mission. You are a high-impact engineer who learns by doing, enjoys taking ownership of projects, and wants to grow as an engineer and leader in your next role. You’re excited by the chance to shape Neon’s product, team, and culture, and you’ve already led successful projects that uplifted those around you.

 

About the Role

Neon is seeking a Forward Deployed Engineer who will scale the partner engineering function. You’ll work alongside our sales and customer success teams to build and manage developer onboarding, own our customer-facing documentation, and build out new features for our customers. You’ll also shape the direction of the team: manage how the team grows and set the standards for your teammates at Neon.

 

What We’re Looking For:

 - You have 5+ years of experience in partner engineering or a similar customer-facing engineering role.

 - You have experience writing and maintaining API documentation for complex technical products.

 - You have experience with, and are willing to flex into, full-stack product development to manage specific customer requests.

 - You are highly productive, able to take ownership of key initiatives and deliver results.

 - You have experience leading teams or projects and enjoy helping others level up their skills.

 - You’re located or willing to work from Seoul, South Korea.

 - Must be fluent in English and Korean

 

This is a unique opportunity to join an early-stage, high-growth company and work alongside some of the brightest minds in gaming, fintech, and tech. If you’re ready to contribute to a mission-driven team and help us accelerate change in the gaming industry, we’d love to hear from you.

 

Join Neon. Shape the Future of Gaming.

 

Our Process

We have designed our interviews to be as efficient and effective as possible, so once you pass our initial screen, please prepare for 4-6 hours of interviews across 3 rounds over 2 weeks.

 

Hiring Manager Screen: 30 min

Gain a better understanding of the Neon business and the engineering team.

 

Project Take-home Review: 1 hour

We’ll give you a take-home to work on; once you’re done, you’ll walk through it with our engineering team.

 

Virtual Onsite Interview: 4 hours

 - Two 1-hour technical sessions with our engineers to walk through a coding and/or systems design exercise.

 - One 1-hour session with our head of customer success.

 - CEO Meet & Greet: 30 minutes

 - Please come prepared to wow us with your skills; discuss and demonstrate how you collaborate with teammates; ask questions about how we work, and show how you’ll fit in.

 

Throughout the process, please come prepared with any open questions you have about the role, our team or opportunity; feedback on our process; your refined “Why Neon?” ;)

jobs.title: Staff Product Designer
jobs.descriptionHtml:
OpenSea is building the gateway to the onchain economy - a rich world of communities, assets & creative expression uniquely possible with native digital ownership. Our products support millions of users and have helped shape onchain markets that exist today—and we're just getting started.

Our goal is to build the highest-leverage, most AI-native team in crypto (and ideally beyond.) We believe that a small team (broken into even smaller teams with extreme ownership) can accomplish enormous results with the right people, the right tools, and the right company-wide investments in AI. We are building that team.

We’re looking for a highly skilled, creative and self-driven Staff Product Designer to join OpenSea’s small but mighty design team. In this role, you’ll help define the future of how people discover, trade, and interact with digital assets—working closely with engineers and fellow designers to bring clarity and craft to complex problems. Design plays a central role in shaping product direction and strategy, so this position is ideal for someone who combines strong product thinking with exceptional visual craft. Beyond designing great products, you'll help evolve the systems, workflows, and AI-enabled practices that make the entire team more effective builders. If you’re energized by ownership, collaboration, and the chance to design for millions of users in a fast-evolving space, we’d love to meet you.

Responsibilities

  • Lead design initiatives from concept through launch, collaborating closely with engineers and other designers to define and deliver high-quality user experiences.

  • Channel design thinking into our product development process, ensuring we’re solving real user problems with consistency and simplicity

  • Hone open-ended product ideas into actionable design directions through research, prototyping, and iteration.

  • Create end-to-end experiences across mobile and web, balancing user needs, technical feasibility, and business goals while maintaining a high bar for visual quality, polish, and brand expression.

  • Contribute to and evolve our design system to raise quality, consistency, and efficiency across all OpenSea surfaces while helping designers and engineers build more effectively through emerging AI-powered tools and practices.

  • Explore and champion new design and AI-enabled workflows that improve team effectiveness and expand what's possible for product development.

  • Communicate design rationale clearly and effectively across disciplines, helping align teams around shared goals.

  • Help shape the design culture at OpenSea by modeling strong craft, collaboration, and curiosity.

Requirements

  • 7+ years of product design experience, across both consumer and platform-facing products

  • Demonstrated ability to own complex, ambiguous problem spaces and turn them into elegant, intuitive solutions

  • Strong product sense—comfortable thinking strategically and operating without the structure of a large product org

  • Strong experience designing mobile-first products, with a deep understanding of what makes for an intuitive, polished mobile experience.

  • Exceptional visual design and interaction design skills, with a portfolio that demonstrates strong aesthetic judgement, systems thinking, and meticulous attention to detail

  • Experience building, scaling, or maintaining design systems, component libraries, or other frameworks that improve product quality, consistency, and team velocity

  • Experience collaborating closely with engineers to ship high-quality, technically informed designs

  • Experience leveraging AI tools and workflows to improve design quality, efficiency, and team effectiveness

  • Breadth across UI, UX, motion & interaction, with particular strength in visual design, craft, and aesthetic execution

  • Exceptional communication and storytelling skills, with the ability to influence and align cross-functional partners

The base salary for this full-time position, spanning multiple internal levels depending on qualifications, ranges from $175,000 to $275,000 USD for candidates based in the United States and $148,750 to $233,750 USD for candidates based in the European Union, plus benefits & equity. Compensation for candidates based outside of the US and EU will vary to reflect local market conditions.

If you don't think you meet all of the criteria above but still are interested in the job, please apply. Nobody checks every box, and we're looking for someone who is excited to join the team.

#LI-Remote

Benefits & Perks

🏥 Health Benefits: We cover 100% Dental/Vision/Medical for employees and 90% for dependents

🌴 Flexible Time Off Policy: Our flexible time off policy is aimed at letting our employees take as much time off as they'd like to refresh so long as it doesn't interfere with their ability to meet their goals and contribute effectively to company velocity

👶 Parental Leave: 16 Weeks of Paid Parental Bonding & up to 8 additional weeks for the birthing parent

💛 Mental Health: We offer access to Spring Health, covering 8 therapy & 8 coaching sessions per year

📅 11 Company Holidays

🏦 Fidelity 401K Plan

📱 Internet/Mobile Reimbursement Plan

🧘 Reimbursement or Monthly Snack Delivery

✈ Company & Team retreats to get together for fun and collaboration

☕ Team Member Co-Working and Gathering Expense

🖥 MacBook Pro & WFH Stipend to make sure you are set up for success

🌯 Weekly $50 Uber Eats credit

By clicking submit an application below, you consent to our use and processing of your data as described in our Candidate Privacy Notice.

Please be aware that OpenSea participates in E-Verify to confirm employment eligibility.

We believe that a small team (broken into even smaller teams with extreme ownership) can accomplish enormous results with the right people, the right tools, and the right company-wide investments in AI. We are building that team.

We're looking for a highly skilled, curious, and self-driven Staff Platform Engineer to help build the technical foundations that power OpenSea. In this role, you'll design and evolve the platform, services, and infrastructure that enable our engineering teams to build, deploy, and operate products quickly, reliably, and at scale. You'll partner closely with product engineers to improve developer experience, system performance, and operational excellence while helping evolve the AI-enabled workflows, engineering systems, and technical foundations that make our entire team more effective builders.

Responsibilities

In the age of AI, Platform teams have two main roles - architect, build, and maintain critical systems, and enable the rest of the team to work safely and productively across your areas of ownership. Our goal is to make the systems protect themselves and enable everyone to build quickly.

  • Design, build, and evolve the platform services, infrastructure, and internal tooling that power OpenSea's products

  • Own complex technical systems from definition through implementation, balancing scalability, reliability, maintainability, and developer experience

  • Bring best-in-class observability, monitoring and alerting to all of the systems at OpenSea

  • Maintain and improve AI skills & tools to make our systems more accessible, introspectable and easy to contribute to

  • Accelerate and expand CI coverage to improve correctness and AI verifiability

  • Partner closely with product teams to accelerate build & deployment of critical products (where your agents can't yet!)

  • Build and ship high-quality, reliable software leveraging AI, modern development tools, and strong engineering judgment

Requirements

  • 7+ years of software engineering experience building large-scale backend or platform systems

  • Strong fluency in JVM languages such as Kotlin or Java

  • Experience designing and operating distributed systems, backend services, and modern cloud infrastructure

  • Strong understanding of platform engineering principles, developer tooling, CI/CD, observability, and operational best practices

  • Demonstrated ability to own complex, ambiguous technical problems and deliver thoughtful, scalable solutions

  • Excitement for making independent technical decisions balancing reliability, scalability, performance, and long-term maintainability

  • Experience leveraging AI tools and workflows to improve engineering quality, efficiency, and team effectiveness

  • Passion for Web3, digital ownership, AI, or other emerging technologies

jobs.title: Senior ML Ops Engineer (Machine Learning Infrastructure)
GTM, Enterprise
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About us

Parallel is a web infrastructure company. Our products are used by leading businesses in sales, marketing, insurance, and coding to build best-in-class AI agents with flexible and powerful programmatic access to the web.

We've raised $230 million from Kleiner Perkins, Sequoia, Index Ventures, Spark Capital, Khosla Ventures, First Round, and Terrain to build the web for AIs. We're currently valued at $2 billion and we're forming a world-class team of engineers, designers, marketers, sellers, researchers, and operational experts to achieve our mission.

Job: Customers, customers, customers. You’ll sell to enterprise customers, build trusted relationships with senior stakeholders, and turn real demand into revenue. You’ll operate with judgment, adapt to how each customer works, and consistently get deals done.

You: Curious, first principles thinker, relentless, competitive. Can't be put in a box. You are an experienced Enterprise seller who has previously held GTM roles for technical products. You don't like to lose.

Life at Parallel

Our team works fully in-person, between our Palo Alto HQ and San Francisco office. We’re a flat, talent-dense organization dedicated to solving technical and creative problems.

We seek like-minded individuals who share our passion for applying science, creativity, and consistency to big and complex problems with equally big outcomes. These are our values:

  • Own customer impact: It’s on us to ensure real-world outcomes for our customers.

  • Obsess over craft: Perfect every detail because quality compounds.

  • Accelerate change: Ship fast, adapt faster, and move frontier ideas into production.

  • Create win-wins: Creatively turn trade-offs into upside.

  • Make high-conviction bets: Try and fail. But succeed an unfair amount.

Compensation & benefits

  • Competitive salary

  • Generous equity

  • Visa sponsorships

  • 401K plans

  • Daily lunch & office snacks

  • Dinner at the office

  • Unlimited vacation

  • Caltrain pass reimbursement

jobs.title: Product Designer
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About us

Parallel is a web infrastructure company. Our products are used by leading businesses in sales, marketing, insurance, and coding to build best-in-class AI agents with flexible and powerful programmatic access to the web.

We've raised $230 million from Kleiner Perkins, Sequoia, Index Ventures, Spark Capital, Khosla Ventures, First Round, and Terrain to build the web for AIs. We're currently valued at $2 billion and we're forming a world-class team of engineers, designers, marketers, sellers, researchers, and operational experts to achieve our mission.

Job: As our product designer, you will own the end-to-end design of our developer-facing product, with an eye toward making powerful technology accessible far beyond a technical audience.. That means reimagining the playground, bringing coherence to our API architecture and navigation, and building the systems that scale across surfaces. You’ll shape what we build alongside engineering and product from the start, not after scoping is done.

You: You’ve shipped developer-facing product and you know what makes or breaks a developer’s first hour with a new tool. Your portfolio shows high visual craft without losing function, and end-to-end ownership from exploration to production. You think in systems, push back when the reasoning is sound, and move fast without being precious. You’ll be opening PRs here, so frontend comfort is a real advantage, but what matters more is that you don’t treat the line between design and engineering as someone else’s problem.

jobs.descriptionHtml:
About us

Parallel is a web infrastructure company. Our products are used by leading businesses in sales, marketing, insurance, and coding to build best-in-class AI agents with flexible and powerful programmatic access to the web.

We've raised $230 million from Kleiner Perkins, Sequoia, Index Ventures, Spark Capital, Khosla Ventures, First Round, and Terrain to build the web for AIs. We're currently valued at $2 billion and we're forming a world-class team of engineers, designers, marketers, sellers, researchers, and operational experts to achieve our mission.

The role:

You will build and maintain our backend that already handles millions of custom requests daily, and ensure that it’s reliable, performant and exceeds expectations for our customers as we scale. You will also be a steward of our API and ensure that it’s developer-friendly and easy to integrate with.

About you:

Have deep intuition on distributed systems, databases, maintainable code design, and API design. You like to reason about trade-offs between speed, scalability, and developer ergonomics. You care about your work powering products and systems that millions rely on, and about APIs that developers love to use.

You might be a good fit if you have:

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent combination of education, training, and professional experience

  • A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience

jobs.descriptionHtml:
About us

Parallel is a web infrastructure company. Our products are used by leading businesses in sales, marketing, insurance, and coding to build best-in-class AI agents with flexible and powerful programmatic access to the web.

We've raised $230 million from Kleiner Perkins, Sequoia, Index Ventures, Spark Capital, Khosla Ventures, First Round, and Terrain to build the web for AIs. We're currently valued at $2 billion and we're forming a world-class team of engineers, designers, marketers, sellers, researchers, and operational experts to achieve our mission.

Job: You will own growth at Parallel: the first dedicated growth hire, sitting adjacent to marketing but running a separate motion. You'll run experimentation across the funnel: A/B testing the marketing website, optimizing the signup-to-activation flow, and managing paid channels like Google Ads. You'll decide what gets tested, in what order, and why - instrumenting what isn't tracked, reading results honestly, and killing what doesn't move the numbers. You'll work closely with marketing on site tests, design on brand and UX guardrails, and product on activation and onboarding data.

You: Think in conversion rates, cohorts, and statistical significance, not gut feel. You've run A/B tests on a live marketing site, shipped changes to a PLG onboarding flow based on funnel data, and managed real paid spend - you know your CAC and payback period cold. You ship small and fast rather than waiting for the big redesign, and you're comfortable enough with tagging, events, and basic front-end changes to spec or build your own experiments without waiting on engineering. You call it like the data says, even when the team believed something else going in.
