jobs.title: Early Career Research Engineer
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About us

Parallel is a web infrastructure company. Our products are used by leading businesses in sales, marketing, insurance, and coding to build best-in-class AI agents with flexible and powerful programmatic access to the web.

We've raised $230 million from Kleiner Perkins, Sequoia, Index Ventures, Spark Capital, Khosla Ventures, First Round, and Terrain to build the web for AIs. We're currently valued at $2 billion and we're forming a world-class team of engineers, designers, marketers, sellers, researchers, and operational experts to achieve our mission.

About you

You're a researcher who thinks like an engineer, or an engineer who thinks like a researcher. You've worked on information retrieval systems, embedding models, or neural ranking at scale, or you're deeply curious about the fundamental problems that emerge when training models to understand and serve billions of web documents. You thrive in the space between theory and production, where elegant solutions must also run efficiently on real infrastructure. You're comfortable reading papers from SIGIR and RecSys one day and debugging distributed training pipelines the next.

The role

You'll design and train the models that power Parallel's APIs: the intelligence layer that helps AI agents find exactly what they need from the open web. This means tackling research problems that most labs encounter only at hyperscale: How do you train embedding models that capture semantic intent across diverse query types? How do you balance model expressiveness with sub-second retrieval latency? How do you maintain index freshness when the web updates constantly, without rebuilding from scratch?

Unlike traditional search engines built for human queries, you're building for AI agents that issue complex, multi-hop queries and expect structured, programmatic responses. This is information retrieval reimagined for the LLM era, work that combines classical IR techniques with modern deep learning, applied at a scale that demands new solutions.

You might be a good fit if you have:

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent combination of education, training, and professional experience

  • A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience

  • Years of experience required will correlated with the internal job level requirements for this position

jobs.descriptionHtml:
About us

Parallel is a web infrastructure company. Our products are used by leading businesses in sales, marketing, insurance, and coding to build best-in-class AI agents with flexible and powerful programmatic access to the web.

About us

Parallel is a web infrastructure company. Our products are used by leading businesses in sales, marketing, insurance, and coding to build best-in-class AI agents with flexible and powerful programmatic access to the web.

We've raised $230 million from Kleiner Perkins, Sequoia, Index Ventures, Spark Capital, Khosla Ventures, First Round, and Terrain to build the web for AIs. We're currently valued at $2 billion and we're forming a world-class team of engineers, designers, marketers, sellers, researchers, and operational experts to achieve our mission.

Job: You'll lead Parallel's enterprise sales team, working alongside the most talent-dense GTM leaders and ICs in the business. You'll carry a piece of the pipeline yourself, running discovery and closing cycles with enterprise buyers so your coaching comes from doing the work, not just watching it. These are six-to-twelve month cycles with a buying committee instead of a buyer — security review, procurement, legal redlines, a champion who has to sell internally for you when you're not in the room. You'll sharpen the playbook for navigating that process without losing momentum, build the ramp and coaching rhythm that gets new reps productive fast, and scale the team as pipeline grows. You'll partner with the head of Recruiting to build a dream team and with the head of GTM on segmentation. You're accountable for pipeline coverage, ramp time, and win rates across your team — not just your own number.

You: Have led an enterprise sales team for at least 4 years and know how to navigate a room with a CTO or VP without blinking. You've run deals through security reviews, procurement, and multi-stakeholder legal negotiations, and you know how to keep a champion engaged and a deal alive through a six-month lull. You've sold to technical buyers and can hold your own in a conversation about LLMs, agents, or RAG without a technical co-pilot in the room. jobs.descriptionHtml:
About us

Parallel is a web infrastructure company. Our products are used by leading businesses in sales, marketing, insurance, and coding to build best-in-class AI agents with flexible and powerful programmatic access to the web.

We've raised $230 million from Kleiner Perkins, Sequoia, Index Ventures, Spark Capital, Khosla Ventures, First Round, and Terrain to build the web for AIs. Job Help shape the legal foundation of a fast-growing AI company. You'll partner closely with Product and Engineering to provide pragmatic guidance across the product lifecycle—advising on data collection, retention, consent, and privacy-by-design. You'll own Parallel's privacy and data protection program, from policies and DPAs to data mapping and compliance across GDPR, CCPA, and emerging AI and state privacy laws. Along the way, you'll build the templates, playbooks, and self-service tools that scale the function.

You're technically fluent—comfortable with data pipelines, anonymization, and zero-retention architectures—and you can negotiate DPAs and data licensing deals with confidence. jobs.title: Member of Technical Staff, Retrieval & Indexing
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About us

Parallel is a web infrastructure company. Our products are used by leading businesses in sales, marketing, insurance, and coding to build best-in-class AI agents with flexible and powerful programmatic access to the web.

We've raised $230 million from Kleiner Perkins, Sequoia, Index Ventures, Spark Capital, Khosla Ventures, First Round, and Terrain to build the web for AIs. We're currently valued at $2 billion and we're forming a world-class team of engineers, designers, marketers, sellers, researchers, and operational experts to achieve our mission.

The role:

You will build and operate the systems that let Parallel run its own large-scale full-text index over the web. You will work across the full lifecycle: deciding what belongs in the corpus, building the searchable structures that hold it, building the signals and models that judge source quality and freshness, and serving queries against the index quickly and economically. You will anticipate bottlenecks before they appear and ensure the architecture evolves to meet increasing demand.

About you:

Have deep intuition on information retrieval, distributed systems, and performance tuning. You like to reason about the trade-offs between classical and neural retrieval, and between cost, reliability, and latency. You care about your work helping agents find the right information, and about infrastructure that can support products used by millions without breaking a sweat.

You might be a good fit if you have:

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent combination of education, training, and professional experience

  • A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience

  • Years of experience required will correlated with the internal job level requirements for this position

jobs.title: Member of Technical Staff, Search Ranking
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About us

Parallel is a web infrastructure company. Our products are used by leading businesses in sales, marketing, insurance, and coding to build best-in-class AI agents with flexible and powerful programmatic access to the web.

We've raised $230 million from Kleiner Perkins, Sequoia, Index Ventures, Spark Capital, Khosla Ventures, First Round, and Terrain to build the web for AIs. We're currently valued at $2 billion and we're forming a world-class team of engineers, designers, marketers, sellers, researchers, and operational experts to achieve our mission.

The role:

You will own the multi-stage ranking pipeline that narrows a web-scale set of candidates down to the handful of best passages for a query, spending the least compute necessary to do it well. You will push precision and recall across fast candidate retrieval, lightweight first-pass ranking, and heavier neural reranking, decide how much compute each query deserves, and grade everything on real usage outcomes rather than offline proxies.

About you:

Have deep intuition for relevance, feature engineering, and the trade-offs between quality, latency, and cost. Think rigorously about how ranking, retrieval, and agent behavior inform one another, and how to train models that serve all three. You care about your research being applied to product and systems that millions use.

You might be a good fit if you have:

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent combination of education, training, and professional experience

jobs.title: Member of Technical Staff, Model Training
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About us

Parallel is a web infrastructure company. Our products are used by leading businesses in sales, marketing, insurance, and coding to build best-in-class AI agents with flexible and powerful programmatic access to the web.

We've raised $230 million from Kleiner Perkins, Sequoia, Index Ventures, Spark Capital, Khosla Ventures, First Round, and Terrain to build the web for AIs. We're currently valued at $2 billion and we're forming a world-class team of engineers, designers, marketers, sellers, researchers, and operational experts to achieve our mission.

The role:

You will own the training pipeline behind the models that power both Parallel’s search stack and Parallel’s agents. On the search side, that means the rankers, classifiers, and query models that surface the right information. On the agent side, that means the models that help our agents plan, reason, and execute high-value tasks over web data. You will build the path from real product usage to high-quality training data, fine-tune and evaluate these models rigorously, and ship them safely to traffic used by millions.

About you:

Have deep intuition on modern models and training, including transformer fine-tuning, data curation, and the craft of label quality. Think rigorously about how ranking, retrieval, and agent behavior inform one another, and how to train models that serve all three. You care about your research being applied to product and systems that millions use.

jobs.title: Member of Technical Staff, Data Engineering
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About us

Parallel is a web infrastructure company. Our products are used by leading businesses in sales, marketing, insurance, and coding to build best-in-class AI agents with flexible and powerful programmatic access to the web.

We've raised $230 million from Kleiner Perkins, Sequoia, Index Ventures, Spark Capital, Khosla Ventures, First Round, and Terrain to build the web for AIs. We're currently valued at $2 billion and we're forming a world-class team of engineers, designers, marketers, sellers, researchers, and operational experts to achieve our mission.

The role:

You will build the data foundations that powers model training, product building and analytics across the company. You will work across the full lifecycle: designing pipelines that ingest and transform data at scale, building the storage and serving layers that make it fast and reliable to query, and establishing the quality, lineage, and observability systems that let others trust the data. You will anticipate scaling bottlenecks before they appear and make the architectural calls that keep the platform ahead of growing demand.

About you:

Have deep intuition on distributed data processing, data modeling, and system reliability. You like to reason about the trade-offs between batch and streaming, between storage cost and query performance, and between build-it-yourself and off-the-shelf infrastructure. You care about the data being right, not just available, and about building systems that teams across the company can depend on without a second thought.

jobs.title: Sr Manager, Accounting
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About us

Parallel is a web infrastructure company. Our products are used by leading businesses in sales, marketing, insurance, and coding to build best-in-class AI agents with flexible and powerful programmatic access to the web.

We've raised $230 million from Kleiner Perkins, Sequoia, Index Ventures, Spark Capital, Khosla Ventures, First Round, and Terrain to build the web for AIs. We're currently valued at $2 billion and we're forming a world-class team of engineers, designers, marketers, sellers, researchers, and operational experts to achieve our mission.

Job: You will own accounting at Parallel end to end, from month-end close and financial reporting to technical accounting, audits, tax, and statutory compliance. You'll manage multi-entity accounting as Parallel scales internationally, own our relationships with external accounting, tax, and audit partners, and drive the systems and future ERP decisions that support a fast-growing business. You'll partner closely with revenue leadership and the finance lead on quote-to-cash improvements and billing operations, and you'll build the processes and infrastructure that let the accounting function scale without breaking.

You: Have 8+ years of accounting experience at a high-growth technology company, with a track record of taking on increasing ownership of the function. You have deep expertise in US GAAP, technical accounting, and SaaS revenue recognition, and you're comfortable with multi-entity and international operations, transfer pricing, and inter-company accounting. You understand billing systems and revenue operations well enough to partner directly with commercial teams, not just report on them after the fact. You're a builder who wants to design the systems, not just operate them, and you stay close to the details even as you take on more scope. Bonus if you've led an ERP migration or can write SQL to answer your own questions instead of waiting on someone else's dashboard.

jobs.title: GTM Leader, AI Native
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About us

Parallel is a web infrastructure company. Our products are used by leading businesses in sales, marketing, insurance, and coding to build best-in-class AI agents with flexible and powerful programmatic access to the web.

We've raised $230 million from Kleiner Perkins, Sequoia, Index Ventures, Spark Capital, Khosla Ventures, First Round, and Terrain to build the web for AIs. We're currently valued at $2 billion and we're forming a world-class team of engineers, designers, marketers, sellers, researchers, and operational experts to achieve our mission.

Job: You'll lead Parallel's AI-native sales team, working alongside the most talent-dense GTM leaders and ICs in the business. You'll carry a piece of the pipeline yourself, running discovery and closing cycles against technical, AI-forward buyers so your coaching comes from doing the work, not just watching it. These are companies shipping on model updates and rearchitecting their stack every quarter — the buyer you talked to last month may have a different roadmap today, and the deal moves at the pace of their release cycle, not yours. You'll build the playbook for selling into teams that are already building with agents and LLMs, sharpen the ramp and coaching rhythm that gets new reps productive fast, and scale the team as pipeline grows. You'll partner with the head of Recruiting to build a dream team and with the head of GTM on segmentation. You're accountable for pipeline coverage, ramp time, and win rates across your team — not just your own number.

You: Have led a sales team for at least 3 years in an AI-native or fast-moving technical environment. You've sold to technical buyers — founders, engineers, ML leads — and can hold your own in a conversation about LLMs, agents, or RAG without a technical co-pilot in the room. You thrive when the product spec, the buyer's use case, and the competitive landscape all shift in the same week, and you know how to keep a deal moving when the ground underneath it won't sit still. You know the difference between coaching someone through a deal and doing it for them, and you'd rather build reps up than carry them. You create your own pipeline instead of waiting for it, and you're allergic to hand-holding, both giving and receiving it. You want to take an existing team further, not inherit a blank slate or a fully solved function.

jobs.title: GTM Enablement, Technical
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About us

Parallel is a web infrastructure company. Our products are used by leading businesses in sales, marketing, insurance, and coding to build best-in-class AI agents with flexible and powerful programmatic access to the web.

We've raised $230 million from Kleiner Perkins, Sequoia, Index Ventures, Spark Capital, Khosla Ventures, First Round, and Terrain to build the web for AIs. We're currently valued at $2 billion and we're forming a world-class team of engineers, designers, marketers, sellers, researchers, and operational experts to achieve our mission.

Job: You'll own product enablement for GTM, sitting at the intersection of engineering and go-to-market. You'll build and run product bootcamps, ongoing technical training, and enablement for every major capability we launch, then turn that knowledge into demos, eval templates, and technical collateral the GTM team can pick up and use on their own. You'll partner with engineering and marketing to build customer-facing technical content that helps buyers evaluate Parallel, and with Deployed Engineering to turn what they learn in individual deals into scalable resources for the broader team. You’ll spend roughly 80% of your time building and enabling and 20% staying close to live deals to keep everything you build grounded in real customer conversations and challenges.

You: You've been a Deployed Engineer, Sales Engineer, or Solutions Engineer for a highly technical product and/or have a strong engineering background. You have 2-3+ years in tech, ideally at a fast-moving startup, and you're fluent with modern AI tools because you use them constantly in your own work. You can write code, quickly understand a customer’s technical challenges, and make complex products clear enough that anyone can pick them up and run with them. Beyond technical fluency, you understand how great sales teams operate and have strong instincts for what helps them win. Product or technical enablement experience is a bonus, not a requirement.

Job: You will run Parallel's contracts management system end-to-end, owning Ironclad as its admin — building and maintaining workflows, routing approvals and signatures, fixing what breaks, and keeping the repository in a state where the reporting can be trusted. jobs.descriptionHtml:
About us

Parallel is a web infrastructure company. Our products are used by leading businesses in sales, marketing, insurance, and coding to build best-in-class AI agents with flexible and powerful programmatic access to the web.

We've raised $230 million from Kleiner Perkins, Sequoia, Index Ventures, Spark Capital, Khosla Ventures, First Round, and Terrain to build the web for AIs. We're currently valued at $2 billion and we're forming a world-class team of engineers, designers, marketers, sellers, researchers, and operational experts to achieve our mission.

The role:

You will build and operate the security systems that let Parallel ship quickly without creating avoidable risk. You will work across application security, secure defaults, AI-assisted security tooling, and the unique attack surface of agentic systems that consume untrusted web content. You will fix real vulnerabilities when they appear, then change the underlying systems so the same class of issue is harder to introduce again.

You will also help define how security fits into the development process: building reusable patterns for authentication, authorization, data handling, and outbound access, designing controls for enterprise customers, and ensuring security review happens as part of how software gets built rather than as a separate process at the end.

About you:

Have deep intuition on application security, software architecture, and how vulnerabilities emerge in real systems. You are comfortable finding issues yourself, but care more about eliminating vulnerability classes through better libraries, frameworks, and defaults.

You still like to write production code and have strong opinions on where current AI models are useful for security work and where they mostly create noise. You are comfortable operating independently, prioritizing the highest-leverage problems, and working directly with both engineers and customers.

You might be a good fit if you have:

  • Significant software engineering experience, including several years focused on product or application security

  • Strong experience with web and API security, including authentication, authorization, SSRF, IDOR, injection, and multi-tenant isolation

  • Built frameworks, libraries, or secure defaults that reduced entire classes of vulnerabilities across a codebase or engineering organization

  • Experience building security tooling using current AI models, such as automated code review, threat modeling, triage, agent harnesses, or evaluation systems

  • Experience securing systems that process untrusted inputs, especially LLM or agentic systems

  • Ability to work independently as the primary security owner and make clear prioritization decisions

  • Strong production coding skills in Python, Go, TypeScript, or similar languages

jobs.title: Member of Technical Staff, Infrastructure Security
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About us

Parallel is a web infrastructure company. Our products are used by leading businesses in sales, marketing, insurance, and coding to build best-in-class AI agents with flexible and powerful programmatic access to the web.

We've raised $230 million from Kleiner Perkins, Sequoia, Index Ventures, Spark Capital, Khosla Ventures, First Round, and Terrain to build the web for AIs. We're currently valued at $2 billion and we're forming a world-class team of engineers, designers, marketers, sellers, researchers, and operational experts to achieve our mission.

The role:

You will build and operate the security foundations that protect Parallel’s production infrastructure, internal systems, and access to both. You will own how people, services, and agents authenticate, what they can reach, how production is hardened, and how security controls are enforced from source code through running workloads.

You will work across identity and access, cloud and Kubernetes security, software supply chain integrity, logging and detection infrastructure, endpoint security, and recovery. You will design secure defaults engineers inherit rather than configure, and build the systems that make access, changes, and recovery measurable and auditable.

You will also help define how AI coding agents operate inside Parallel’s own infrastructure, including what they can access, what privileges they receive, and how their actions are constrained and logged.

About you:

Have deep intuition on cloud infrastructure, identity, network security, and production systems. You like to reason about which controls materially reduce risk and which ones mostly create process.

You write and ship code, prefer automation over manual controls, and are comfortable working at the boundary between security, platform engineering, and reliability. You can land changes across teams you do not manage, make practical tradeoffs, and build durable security foundations rather than controls that need constant tending.

You might be a good fit if you have:

  • Significant experience building or operating infrastructure or security systems in production cloud environments

  • Deep experience in at least one of identity and authorization, cloud and Kubernetes security, or logging and detection platforms

  • Strong cloud, network, secrets management, and workload isolation fundamentals

  • Experience building secure deployment pipelines, including artifact provenance, immutability, secret scanning, and software supply chain controls

  • Experience designing centralized logging, alerting, and detection infrastructure across cloud, SaaS, identity, and endpoints

  • Strong production coding and automation skills in Terraform, Python, Go, or similar tools

  • A track record of shipping security controls across an engineering organization, including making tradeoffs to get them adopted

  • Experience with endpoint security, device trust, recovery planning, SOC 2, customer audits, or contractual security requirements is a plus

jobs.title: Senior Security Engineer - Remote
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Us

Parity is one of the world’s most experienced companies building the core infrastructure behind blockchain — the system that allows information and value to be shared securely without needing an intermediary. We’re laying the foundation for a better web which respects the freedom and data of individuals, and empowers developers to build better, more trustworthy online services.


Our remote-first, global team develop open-source software that anyone can use or improve. This includes Polkadot, Polkadot SDK, and Kusama — key parts of the Web3 tech stack, the next generation of the internet. Our mission is to make Polkadot the most active and innovative community in blockchain, powering a new era of connected and decentralised applications.

About the Team

Parity’s Security Engineering team is at the forefront of protecting the Polkadot ecosystem by designing and implementing secure software, auditing code for vulnerabilities, and building cutting-edge ML tools to automate security analysis. We work closely with development teams to embed security best practices across our open-source stack, ensuring that our blockchain infrastructure is robust, resilient, and secure by design.

About the Role

As a security-focused software engineer, you will go beyond traditional application security - you’ll audit and ideally write secure Rust code where needed, conduct deep manual and automated code audits, and leverage machine learning to enhance security across our ecosystem. This is an opportunity to shape the security landscape of the next generation of decentralized applications and protocols.

  • Assist in developing Secure Software – Write and optimise Rust code to build security-critical components and tools.

  • Code Auditing & Vulnerability Analysis – Perform deep manual and automated code reviews to identify and mitigate security vulnerabilities.

  • ML-Powered Security – Design and implement machine learning models for automated security analysis, anomaly detection, and threat mitigation.

  • Bug Bounty & Vulnerability Management – Manage bug bounty submissions, triage security reports, and collaborate with ethical hackers to resolve issues.

  • Secure Development Best Practices – Work with engineering teams to integrate security best practices into the software development lifecycle.

  • Threat Modeling & Risk Assessment – Identify and assess security risks in our blockchain infrastructure, smart contracts, and core software.

  • Stay Cutting-Edge – Research and implement the latest advancements in secure coding, ML-driven security, and blockchain security.

What We're Looking For

  • Experience with secure coding practices and memory safety concepts.

  • Background in code auditing, vulnerability analysis, or exploit development.

  • Experience triaging and resolving bug bounty reports.

  • Knowledge of machine learning techniques applied to security (e.g., anomaly detection, fuzzing, automated threat detection).

  • Familiarity with cryptographic principles, blockchain security, or decentralized systems.

  • Strong problem-solving skills and an offensive security mindset.

If you're excited about writing secure software, auditing code, and pioneering ML-driven security solutions for Web3, we’d love to hear from you!

About Working With Us

Joining Parity means joining team mates who are genuinely excited about the impact their projects are having, and the opportunity to grow alongside some of the brightest minds in the Web3 space! You’ll work remotely and flexibly, while still getting to meet your team mates throughout the year at team and company-wide retreats.

Upon receiving an offer, all candidates undergo a background check through Zinc, our trusted third-party provider. Team members will be taken on as a contractor via our UK entity. View our Applicant Notice to see how we use your data.

Parity is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We welcome diversity in our global team and care about everyone in our collective feeling included and welcome.

Is this position not quite your match? Browse our other open roles.

  • Highly motivated to contribute to Parity’s mission and be part of something bigger

  • Excited to work on projects that are groundbreaking and complex

  • Autonomous, but also collaborate well with others

  • Take maximum accountability and have minimum ego at work

  • Comfortable with chaos and adapting to the ever-changing Web3 space

  • Continuously educating themselves about Parity and the wider Polkadot ecosystem

About the Team
We're looking for an IT Support Lead to level up how we deliver IT services across a remote-first, global organisation. You'll be a part of the Operations & Culture team and manage one End User Support Engineer. You'll act as the technical escalation point, and drive smarter, more automated ways of working, both within IT and for the tools we bring to the rest of the company.

This is a hands-on management role: you'll coach and grow your team while staying close enough to the work to support end users and spot where AI and automation can remove friction, and where our procurement processes need a sharper eye.

What you’ll do

Team management

  • Manage and mentor our End User Support Specialist, setting clear priorities and supporting their growth.

  • Own the day-to-day coordination of support tickets from creation to resolution, and act as the escalation point for complex or high-stakes issues, bringing enough technical depth to help identify root causes and permanent fixes.

  • Get hands-on with end user support yourself, troubleshooting issues directly and role-modelling a strong service and support orientation for the team. This will be a significant part of your day-to-day.

  • Build a high-performance, data-oriented culture within IT support.

AI & automation

  • Support the adoption of AI and automation across IT support workflows, from ticket triage to recurring processes, so the team works efficiently and spends less time on repetitive tasks.

  • Proactively identify new tools and approaches to deliver more efficient, cost-effective IT support as the business evolves.

  • Apply automation to your own processes and reporting where it makes sense.

IT procurement & vendor management

  • Own IT procurement from vendor selection to ongoing relationship management.

  • Handle individual laptop and hardware purchases for new hires in hard-to-reach or logistically complex countries, drawing on real expertise in sourcing and international delivery to make sure equipment arrives reliably and on time. This is a regular, recurring part of the role given how distributed our team is.

  • Set up regular monitoring and auditing of vendor and provider performance to ensure quality, reliability, and value for money.

  • Develop new procurement approaches suited to a remote-first company sourcing hardware and services across many countries, including markets where procurement is traditionally difficult.

Systems & operations

  • Manage and monitor the reliable delivery and performance of core IT systems against agreed BAU standards.

  • Ensure seamless IT onboarding and offboarding across our global team.

  • Communicate incidents and resolution plans clearly with third-party vendors and service providers.

  • Collaborate with SRE, Security, and Workplace teams to support IT security, compliance, and reliability.

Your skills

  • 5+ years of experience in IT support or IT operations, including experience managing or mentoring a team.

  • Comfortable using AI tools to automate workflows and improve support processes, and genuinely curious about applying this further.

  • Experience with user access management in a fast-moving, multi-SaaS environment.

  • Experience with MDM and EDR products.

  • Strong understanding of LAN and WLAN logical and physical infrastructures, from structured cabling to network device management, which includes access layer switches, firewalls, and access points. Experience with different network vendors is a plus.

  • You have knowledge of Linux (desktop and server) and Mac operating systems to be comfortable and sure when supporting end users.

  • Familiarity with on premise server hardware and operations, from minimal to moderate complexity.

  • Confident on the command line interface - both in Linux and Mac environments. Scripting skills or automation experiences is a plus.

  • Understanding of how software development teams work and the tools they typically rely on.

  • A solutions-oriented mindset, system-thinking abilities, comfortable working cross-functionally to get things done.

  • Financial discipline: you know exactly where every euro goes.

  • Passion and good knowledge of common Open Source Software products

  • English proficiency at C1 level or native speaker.

About working with us

  • Competitive remuneration packages based on iterative market research, including tokens (where legally possible)

  • “Future of work” environment that’s remote-first and self-initiating with flexible hours

  • Team mates that are genuinely excited about their impact and projects

  • Access to the brightest minds in this space to learn about Web3 and develop your skills and knowledge while on the job

  • Becoming part of the wider ecosystem (career and networking opportunities)

About Parity

Parity is one of the world’s most experienced companies building the core infrastructure behind blockchain — the system that allows information and value to be shared securely without needing an intermediary. We’re laying the foundation for a better web which respects the freedom and data of individuals, and empowers developers to build better, more trustworthy online services.

Our remote-first, global team develops open-source software that anyone can use or improve. This includes Polkadot https://polkadot.network/, Polkadot SDK https://substrate.io/, and Kusama https://kusama.network/ — key parts of the Web3 tech stack, the next generation of the internet. Our mission is to make Polkadot the most active and innovative community in blockchain, powering a new era of connected and decentralised applications.

People in our collective are:

 - Highly motivated to contribute to Parity’s mission and be part of something bigger

 - Excited to work on projects that are groundbreaking and complex

 - Autonomous, but also collaborate well with others

 - Take maximum accountability and have minimum ego at work

 - Comfortable with chaos and adapting to the ever-changing Web3 space

 - Continuously educating themselves about Parity and the wider Polkadot ecosystem

About the Team
We're looking for an IT Support Lead to level up how we deliver IT services across a remote-first, global organisation. You'll be a part of the Operations & Culture team and manage one End User Support Engineer. You'll act as the technical escalation point, and drive smarter, more automated ways of working, both within IT and for the tools we bring to the rest of the company.

This is a hands-on management role: you'll coach and grow your team while staying close enough to the work to support end users and spot where AI and automation can remove friction, and where our procurement processes need a sharper eye.




WHAT YOU’LL DO

Team management

 - Manage and mentor our End User Support Specialist, setting clear priorities and supporting their growth.

 - Own the day-to-day coordination of support tickets from creation to resolution, and act as the escalation point for complex or high-stakes issues, bringing enough technical depth to help identify root causes and permanent fixes.

 - Get hands-on with end user support yourself, troubleshooting issues directly and role-modelling a strong service and support orientation for the team. This will be a significant part of your day-to-day.

 - Build a high-performance, data-oriented culture within IT support.

AI & automation

 - Support the adoption of AI and automation across IT support workflows, from ticket triage to recurring processes, so the team works efficiently and spends less time on repetitive tasks.

 - Proactively identify new tools and approaches to deliver more efficient, cost-effective IT support as the business evolves.

 - Apply automation to your own processes and reporting where it makes sense.

IT procurement & vendor management

 - Own IT procurement from vendor selection to ongoing relationship management.

 - Handle individual laptop and hardware purchases for new hires in hard-to-reach or logistically complex countries, drawing on real expertise in sourcing and international delivery to make sure equipment arrives reliably and on time. This is a regular, recurring part of the role given how distributed our team is.

 - Set up regular monitoring and auditing of vendor and provider performance to ensure quality, reliability, and value for money.

 - Develop new procurement approaches suited to a remote-first company sourcing hardware and services across many countries, including markets where procurement is traditionally difficult.

Systems & operations

 - Manage and monitor the reliable delivery and performance of core IT systems against agreed BAU standards.

 - Ensure seamless IT onboarding and offboarding across our global team.

 - Communicate incidents and resolution plans clearly with third-party vendors and service providers.

 - Collaborate with SRE, Security, and Workplace teams to support IT security, compliance, and reliability.


YOUR SKILLS

 - 5+ years of experience in IT support or IT operations, including experience managing or mentoring a team.

 - Comfortable using AI tools to automate workflows and improve support processes, and genuinely curious about applying this further.

 - Experience with user access management in a fast-moving, multi-SaaS environment.

 - Experience with MDM and EDR products.

 - Strong understanding of LAN and WLAN logical and physical infrastructures, from structured cabling to network device management, which includes access layer switches, firewalls, and access points. Experience with different network vendors is a plus.

 - You have knowledge of Linux (desktop and server) and Mac operating systems to be comfortable and sure when supporting end users.

 - Familiarity with on premise server hardware and operations, from minimal to moderate complexity.

 - Confident on the command line interface - both in Linux and Mac environments. Scripting skills or automation experiences is a plus.

 - Understanding of how software development teams work and the tools they typically rely on.

 - A solutions-oriented mindset, system-thinking abilities, comfortable working cross-functionally to get things done.

 - Financial discipline: you know exactly where every euro goes.

 - Passion and good knowledge of common Open Source Software products

 - English proficiency at C1 level or native speaker.


ABOUT WORKING WITH US

 - Competitive remuneration packages based on iterative market research, including tokens (where legally possible)

 - “Future of work” environment that’s remote-first and self-initiating with flexible hours

 - Team mates that are genuinely excited about their impact and projects

 - Access to the brightest minds in this space to learn about Web3 and develop your skills and knowledge while on the job

 - Becoming part of the wider ecosystem (career and networking opportunities)

 - Team and company-wide retreats

 - Work laptop

Joining Parity means joining team mates who are genuinely excited about the impact their projects are having, and the opportunity to grow alongside some of the brightest minds in the Web3 space! You’ll work remotely and flexibly, while still getting to meet your team mates throughout the year at team and company-wide retreats.

Upon receiving an offer, all candidates undergo a background check through Zinc https://zincwork.com/candidates, our trusted third-party provider. Team members will be taken on as a contractor via our UK entity. View our Applicant Notice https://www.parity.io/applicant-notice/ to see how we use your data.

Parity is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We welcome diversity in our global team and care about everyone in our collective feeling included and welcome

Is this position not quite your match? Browse https://www.parity.io/jobs/ our other open roles.

jobs.title: Senior Product Designer
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Us

Playground is working to make excellent child care accessible to all. Playground has built best in class software to manage all aspects of running a child care business. Playground has raised millions of dollars in funding, has several Statewide contracts, and is working with thousands of schools across the country. Our founders were recently recognized by Forbes as 30 under 30, and our work has been recognized across the country.

Playground is at an inflection point, growing at a quick pace. Playground is compromised of a team of owners who are not afraid to dive into large, complex projects.

Job Description

As a Product Designer at Playground, you will be responsible for crafting seamless user interfaces and delivering exceptional user experiences. Your role will involve collaborating with cross-functional teams to design and iterate on products that meet the needs of our users and align with our company's vision.

Responsibilities

  • Design and prototype intuitive, user-friendly interfaces for our digital products.

  • Collaborate with product management and engineering to define and implement innovative solutions for product direction, visuals, and experience.

  • Conduct user research and evaluate user feedback to enhance the usability of our products.

  • Utilize Figma to create high-fidelity designs and prototypes.

  • Stay up-to-date with the latest UI/UX trends, techniques, and technologies.

Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in product design, with a focus on user interface and user experience.

  • Proficiency in Figma and other design tools.

  • Strong portfolio showcasing your design work.

  • Excellent visual design skills with sensitivity to user-system interaction.

  • Ability to solve problems creatively and effectively.

  • Up-to-date with the latest UI trends, techniques, and technologies.

Compensation:

  • The annual salary range for this position is $160,000 - $200,000, subject to standard withholding and applicable taxes

  • Job level and actual compensation will be decided on factors including, but not limited to, individual qualifications objectively assessed during the interview process (including skills and prior relevant experience, potential impact, and scope of role), market demands, and specific work location. The listed range is a guideline, and the range for this role may be modified.

Why Join Playground:

  • Competitive salary + equity

  • 3 weeks of PTO

  • Health, vision, and dental benefits

  • $1200/year education stipend

  • Free lunch daily

  • New Macbook

  • Collaborative and supportive work culture with a high level of autonomy and room for growth

  • Help accelerate our mission to make excellent childcare accessible to all!

How to Apply: If you're a hustler who's excited to join a mission-driven, early-stage company with ownership, craftsmanship, and empathy at the center of what we do, apply now. The Playground Team is fully in-office in Union Square, NYC. Please make sure you are open to a fully in-person role before applying.

Check out: https://www.tryplayground.com/about to learn more about our journey and co-founders Dan, Josh, and Sasha.

jobs.title: SaaS Account Executive
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Playground

Playground is working to make excellent child care accessible to all. Playground has built best in class software to manage all aspects of running a child care business. We believe that providers should focus on providing incredible child care — the kind of work that only people can do — and that software should manage the rest. We’re building the child care management platform that eliminates the administrative work of running a center.

Playground is at an inflection point — and poised to grow extremely fast. We recently raised millions of dollars, have several statewide contracts, and are working with thousands of schools across the country. Additionally, our founders were recently honored as Forbes 30 under 30.

We are a team of owners, who are not afraid to dive into large, complex projects. If you are excited by the prospect of helping build out Playground’s sales organization and joining a collaborative, high-growth startup — please apply!

About the Role

As an Account Executive at Playground, you will play a critical role in driving new business and expanding our customer base. You will be responsible for the entire sales cycle, working a pipeline that's roughly 75% qualified leads from our SDR and inbound teams and 25% self-sourced through your own outbound efforts. This role requires a self-starter with a proven track record in B2B sales, who is passionate about technology and thrives in a fast-paced environment. This role is fully in-office at our new Denver office.

What You'll Do

  • Closing Deals: Take ownership of qualified leads passed on by the SDR team, guiding them through the final stages of the sales process to successful close.

  • Sales Process Management: Own and manage the entire closing process, from deep discovery to contract negotiation and closing. Develop and execute strategic closing techniques to achieve revenue targets.

  • Customer Engagement: Build and maintain strong relationships with prospects and clients, understanding their business needs and providing tailored solutions.

  • Collaboration: Work closely with marketing, product, and customer success teams to refine messaging, improve the sales process, and deliver an outstanding customer experience.

  • Reporting & Analysis: Maintain accurate records in our CRM system, provide regular updates to management, and contribute to sales forecasting and planning.

  • Continuous Improvement: Stay up-to-date on industry trends, competitive landscape, and product knowledge to effectively position our offerings in the market.

  • Mentorship: Act as a player-coach by actively participating in sales activities while mentoring and supporting junior team members in their development.

What You Need

  • Proven Sales Experience: 1.5 years of experience in B2B sales, with a track record of meeting or exceeding sales quotas. Experience in early childcare is a plus.

  • Tech-Savvy: Strong understanding of SaaS products and the ability to communicate complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.

  • Customer-Centric: A deep understanding of customer needs and the ability to provide consultative sales advice that leads to successful outcomes.

  • Results-Driven: A self-motivated individual who thrives in a high-performance environment and is relentless in pursuing goals.

  • Excellent Communicator: Strong verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to effectively present and negotiate with senior-level decision-makers.

  • Collaborative Team Player: Ability to work cross-functionally and contribute to a positive team culture while maintaining a high level of personal accountability.

  • Adaptable: Comfortable working in a fast-paced, dynamic environment with the ability to quickly pivot when necessary.

Compensation

  • OTE for this position is $165,000 subject to standard withholding and applicable taxes

  • Job level and actual compensation will be decided on factors including, but not limited to, individual qualifications objectively assessed during the interview process (including skills and prior relevant experience, potential impact, and scope of role), market demands, and specific work location. The listed salary is a guideline, and the salary for this role may be modified.

Why Join Playground

  • Competitive salary + equity

  • 3 weeks of PTO

  • Health, vision, and dental benefits

  • $1200/year education stipend

  • Free lunch daily

  • New Macbook

  • Collaborative and supportive work culture with a high level of autonomy and room for growth

  • Help accelerate our mission to make excellent childcare accessible to all!

How to Apply

If you're a hustler who's excited to join a mission-driven, early-stage company with ownership, craftsmanship, and empathy at the center of what we do, apply now. This role is fully in-office out of our Denver office. Please make sure you are open to a fully in-person role before applying.

Check out: https://www.tryplayground.com/about to learn more about our journey and co-founders Dan, Josh, and Sasha.

jobs.title: Senior/Staff Full Stack Engineer
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Playground

Playground is working to make excellent child care accessible to all. Playground has built best in class software to manage all aspects of running a child care business. Playground has raised millions of dollars in funding, has several Statewide contracts, and is working with thousands of schools across the country. Our founders were recently recognized by Forbes as 30 under 30, and our work has been recognized across the country.

Playground is at an inflection point, growing at a quick pace, and we are looking to expand our engineering team as quickly as possible. Playground is a team of owners who are not afraid to dive into large, complex projects.

Job Description

As part of Playground's engineering team, you will be responsible for building new products from zero-to-one across the full stack, from the APIs and backend services that power our platform, to the frontend experiences that delight our users. You'll play a critical role in shaping the future of child care, working directly on products relied on by thousands of child care businesses, agencies, and government organizations.

This role spans the entire stack. You'll own projects end-to-end: designing and scaling core backend systems, building performant and maintainable frontend features, and everything in between. We're looking for self-starters who thrive on ownership, operate with urgency, and are excited to use modern AI coding tools to dramatically increase their leverage and output.

Responsibilities

  • Collaborate with a cross-functional team to design and build features end to end with a strong focus on customer needs and product impact

  • Write clean, maintainable, and efficient code across the stack — React and TypeScript on the frontend, Node.js and Express on the backend.

  • Lead the design and delivery of mission-critical backend APIs and services, with a focus on performance, security, and long-term maintainability.

  • Build and improve frontend features in our web app, contributing to a best-in-class user experience for thousands of child care businesses

  • Participate in code reviews to maintain code quality and share knowledge across the team.

  • Interact directly with customers to gather feedback and understand their needs.

  • Proactively identify technical debt and drive improvements across both frontend and backend architecture.

Requirements

  • 5+ years of experience in full stack or software development, with meaningful exposure to both frontend and backend technologies.

  • Proficiency in React and TypeScript (or JavaScript) on the frontend.

  • Strong proficiency in Node.js and Express (or similar backend frameworks).

  • Experience designing and maintaining RESTful APIs in production environments.

  • Strong experience operating systems in the cloud (GCP preferred but not essential), including infrastructure, performance tuning, and reliability best practices.

  • Ability to ship quickly and focus on work that has the highest impact

  • Strong problem-solving skills, attention to detail, and excellent communication abilities.

  • Demonstrated ownership of high-impact, complex projects from concept to reality.

Compensation

  • The annual salary range for this position is $170,000 – $270,000, subject to standard withholding and applicable taxes.

  • Job level and actual compensation will be decided on factors including, but not limited to, individual qualifications objectively assessed during the interview process (including skills and prior relevant experience, potential impact, and scope of role), market demands, and specific work location. The listed range is a guideline, and the range for this role may be modified.

Why Join Playground

  • Competitive salary + equity

  • 3 weeks of PTO

  • Health, vision, and dental benefits

  • $1200/year education stipend

  • Free lunch daily

  • New MacBook

  • Collaborative and supportive work culture with a high level of autonomy and room for growth

  • Help accelerate our mission to make excellent child care accessible to all!

How to Apply
If you're excited to join a mission-driven, early-stage company where ownership, craftsmanship, and empathy are at the center of what we do, apply now. The Playground Team is fully in-office in Union Square, NYC. Please ensure you are open to a fully in-person role before applying.

Check out our journey to learn more about our co-founders Dan, Josh, and Sasha.

About Playground

Playground is working to make excellent child care accessible to all. Playground has built best in class software to manage all aspects of running a child care business. Playground is at an inflection point, growing at a quick pace, and we are looking to expand our Product team as quickly as possible. Playground is a team of owners who are not afraid to dive into large, complex projects.

Job Description

We're looking for someone who came up through engineering, understands how systems are built, and has the scar tissue from owning a product end-to-end at a fast-moving company. You'll be the connective tissue between Engineering, Product, CS, Onboarding, and Sales cutting through the noise of competing priorities to identify what actually matters for our users and drive it to completion.

Responsibilities

  • Own core product areas end-to-end, from discovery through delivery and iteration

  • Deeply understand the childcare industry, our users (childcare providers and parents/guardians), and the problems they face

  • Communicate directly with users through calls, chats, research, and feedback loops

  • Synthesize feedback from customer-facing teams (CS, Onboarding, Sales) into a clear, prioritized roadmap that reflects what matters most across our customer base and business

  • Partner closely with Engineering to translate customer and business needs into well-scoped, technically grounded specs

  • Operate as the connective tissue across teams — you'll be the person who keeps everyone aligned and moving

  • Make hard prioritization calls and defend them with data and customer insight

  • Proactively identify gaps in product experience and drive improvements without waiting to be asked

  • Own the payments roadmap end-to-end: transaction flows, billing, payouts, reconciliation, and compliance

  • Partner with Engineering on payment infrastructure decisions (processors, rails, ledger design, fraud/risk tradeoffs)

Requirements

  • 6-10+ years of PM experience, with 3+ years specifically owning payments products in B2B SaaS or FinTech

  • Deep working knowledge of payment processing, transaction lifecycles, and reconciliation

  • Experience working with payment processors/PSPs (Stripe, Adyen, etc.) and understanding of interchange, chargebacks, and settlement

  • Technical background — prior software engineering experience or a degree in a technical discipline (CS, engineering, or similar)

  • Proven ability to deeply understand engineering systems, architecture decisions, and technical tradeoffs without needing to write the code

  • Experience owning a significant product or function at a startup, with real accountability for outcomes

  • Strong prioritization instincts — you've managed a flood of inbound requests and know how to say no clearly and credibly

  • Excellent communication skills across technical and non-technical audiences

Nice To Have

  • B2B SaaS or FinTech experience

  • Former founder or a long history of launched side projects

  • Background in childcare, education, or a related vertical

  • The annual salary range for this position is $170,000–$250,000 base, subject to standard withholding and applicable taxes.

Check out our journey to learn more about our co-founders Dan, Josh, and Sasha.

jobs.title: Product Quality Analyst
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Playground

Playground is working to make excellent child care accessible to all. Playground has built best in class software to manage all aspects of running a child care business. Playground has raised millions of dollars in funding, has several Statewide contracts, and is working with thousands of schools across the country. Our founders were recently recognized by Forbes as 30 under 30, and our work has been recognized across the country.

Playground is at an inflection point, growing at a quick pace, and we are looking to expand our Product team as quickly as possible. Playground is a team of owners who are not afraid to dive into large, complex projects.

Job Description

As part of Playground’s Product team, you will be responsible for helping ensure the quality, reliability, and usability of the products relied on by thousands of child care businesses, agencies, and government organizations. You’ll play a critical role in catching issues before they reach customers, validating that new features work as intended, and helping our engineering and product teams ship with confidence.

This role sits at the intersection of product, engineering, and customer experience. You’ll test new features, reproduce and document bugs, validate fixes, build and and use your product knowledge to identify edge cases that others may miss. We’re looking for a detail oriented self-starter who takes ownership, communicates clearly, and is excited to help raise the quality bar across the product as we continue to grow.

Responsibilities

  • Manually test new features built by engineers, with a focus on edge cases, unexpected user behavior, and regressions in adjacent areas of the product

  • Read and interpret product requirements to validate that what's built matches what was intended

  • Surface bugs clearly and concisely in our ticketing system (Linear) with enough context for engineers to act fast

  • Work cross-functionally with Engineering and Product throughout the development cycle

  • Develop a deep understanding of the Playground product to spot when something feels off, even when it's technically "working"

Requirements

  • 1-2 years of experience in a role touching the product development or software delivery lifecycle — QA, product ops, implementation, or similar

  • Familiarity with how software gets built and shipped — you understand what a ticket is, what a sprint is, and how a feature goes from idea to production

  • Experience with a ticketing or project management tool (Linear, Jira, or similar)

  • Strong attention to detail and a natural instinct to poke at things until they break

  • Clear written communication — you can describe a bug in a way that's actionable, not ambiguous

We'll also consider strong new grads who have internship or project experience in a product or engineering environment and can demonstrate genuine curiosity about how software works.

Nice to Have

  • Experience at a startup or fast-moving team

  • Exposure to B2B SaaS products

  • Familiarity with childcare, education, or government software

Compensation

  • The annual salary range for this position is $60,000 – $75,000, subject to standard withholding and applicable taxes.

  • Job level and actual compensation will be decided on factors including, but not limited to, individual qualifications objectively assessed during the interview process (including skills and prior relevant experience, potential impact, and scope of role), market demands, and specific work location.   • $1200/year education stipend

jobs.descriptionHtml:
Who We Are:

Sequoia is the strategic partner helping investor-backed companies of all sizes achieve their business goals through smarter people spend. For 24 years, we’ve guided the most innovative employers to navigate growth and get the most out of their global people investment. With our expert advisory team and integrated platform, we help clients drive business impact through their total comp and benefits, improving executive decision making, controlling costs, protecting the business, and elevating the employee experience. Visit Sequoia.com or follow us on LinkedIn to learn more.

This position is based in Mexico City, and only candidates within a commutable distance to our Mexico City office will be considered.

We are seeking a leader to join our marketing team supporting all things Web and Digital Experience for across three distinct and dynamic brands: Sequoia, Transform and SemperVirens. In this role you will define and drive the strategy of compelling digital experiences that attract, inspire, engage, and convert prospective targets for each business.

This role requires a high level of collaboration with teams across Marketing, Product, Web Engineering, and Creative to develop shared goals, translate business objectives into long-term roadmaps, and deliver cohesive customer experiences.

An ideal candidate has a track record of owning the strategy and execution of sophisticated, cross-functional web strategies in a results-driven environment. You have a data-driven mindset, lead with a customer-centric approach, take an analytic approach to problem-solving and have a strong understanding of what data drives impact.

In this role, you can expect to:

·   Own the overarching web strategy, including site updates, landing page experiences, testing and optimization that support acquisition, conversion, and retention.

·   Collaborate with Marketing, Web Engineering, Creative, and Product teams to build site experiences for campaigns, product initiatives, tests, and always-on programs, ensuring accurate messaging, timing, and capabilities needed to execute.

·   Drive continuous experience improvement through the development of an ongoing web experience roadmap and weekly sprint planning that is aligned to short-term and long-term opportunities.

·   Analyze and monitor page performance and user behavior across site landing pages, generate data-driven hypotheses that inform strategies and uncover areas of opportunity to improve the web experience.

·   Develop a deep understanding of our members and site visitors through data, insights, and cross-functional partnerships (Analytics, Engineering, and Consumer Insights). Leverage those insights to inform site strategy.

·   Partner with Analytics to establish a clear measurement framework, define KPIs, track and analyze website performance, and manage forecasts.

·   Define and execute on SEO initiatives and content opportunities that improve website visibility and performance.

·   Leverage personalization capabilities to create digital experiences aligned to audiences and channels.

·   Establish systems of governance, standards, technical requirements, and define resources needed to implement site strategies.

To thrive in this role, you have:

·   7+ years experience leading integrated web strategy and complex web programs at a tech, consumer finance or innovative, consumer brand.

·   Strong leadership presence with ability to lead, influence, and direct projects and processes across multiple teams.

·   Experience using data and insights to inform requirements, ideas, and strategies with hands-on experience with web tools including CMS (Wordpress), A/B testing tools, site analytics (Google Analytics) and business intelligence tools.

·   Well-versed in the technical aspects of running a website, UX, SEO, domain management, HTML/CSS/JavaScript.

·   Demonstrated understanding of SEO fundamentals and the interaction between site architecture and content to deliver organic traffic performance.

·   Effective communication skills with the ability to articulate strategies and plans to a wide variety of audiences.

·   Effective communication and presentation skills; ability to articulate strategies, story-tell with data, and present plans to leadership and stakeholders across the organization

·   Ability to adapt and thrive within the fast pace and ambiguity of a growth organization

Sequoia’s Culture – Our most important asset 

  • Integrity 

  • Passion for service 

  • Innovative 

  • Growth oriented 

  • Caring for others 

  • Promise-centric 

  • Focused on relationship building 

Sequoia provides equal opportunity to all applicants without regard to race, color, creed, religion, citizenship, national origin, age, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, pregnancy, marital status, military or veteran status, disability, or any other basis prohibited by applicable law.

Compensation & Benefits
Sequoia provides competitive compensation including base salary, performance-based bonus programs, and comprehensive benefits package.

jobs.title: Application Security Engineer
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Who We Are:

Sequoia is the strategic partner helping investor-backed companies of all sizes achieve their business goals through smarter people spend. For 24 years, we’ve guided the most innovative employers to navigate growth and get the most out of their global people investment. With our expert advisory team and integrated platform, we help clients drive business impact through their total comp and benefits, improving executive decision making, controlling costs, protecting the business, and elevating the employee experience. Visit Sequoia.com or follow us on LinkedIn to learn more.

As an Application Security Engineer, you will be providing application security expertise throughout the Software Development LifeCycle (SDLC) as well as being responsible for managing and driving forward the Application Security Analytics practices. A key part of your role will also involve validating and testing web applications in order to ensure applications meet the requirements of the SDLC Policy and industry best practices. In addition, undertaking threat modelling and conducting periodic penetration testing using best of breed tools, a good understanding of the OWASP Top 10 vulnerabilities and maintaining documentation.

You'll perform various day-to-day activities related to ensuring the security of Sequoias application environment. These tasks may include conducting application security reviews to identify vulnerabilities in software applications that could be exploited by attackers, performing penetration testing to assess the effectiveness of existing security controls and identify potential weaknesses, providing training and outreach to internal development teams to improve their understanding of security best practices, developing security guidance documentation to help others understand how to implement secure systems and applications, developing security tools to automate or streamline security processes, delivering security metrics to stakeholders and working on improving the overall security posture of your organization.

What You Get to Do:

  • Application security reviews

  • Mobile security reviews

  • Secure architecture design

  • Threat modeling

  • Projects and research work as needed

  • Security training and outreach to internal development teams

  • Security guidance documentation

  • Security tool development

  • Security metrics delivery and improvements

  • Assistance with recruiting activities and administrative work

What You Bring:

  •  5+ years' experience with emphasis on application development, application security or related fields.

  •  3+ years of programming in Python, Ruby, Go, Swift, Java, .Net, C++ or similar object-oriented language experience

  •  2+ years of any combination of the following: threat modeling experience, secure coding, identity management and authentication, software development, cryptography, system administration and network security experience

  •  3+ years' experience in application security technologies with knowledge of application security threats. Experience with threat modeling, attack surface analysis, penetration testing, software vulnerability assessments, and understanding of software security threat vectors.

  •  Knowledge of Component Analysis using tools such as OWASP Dependency-Check, Bytesafe Dependency Checker, Patton, PHP Security Checker, etc.

  •  Experience with static and dynamic application security testing.

  •  Experience with AWS products and services

  •  Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

 Preferences:

  •  Experience as an application security engineer using a suite of tools used for the following:

  •  Recon and Information Gathering (e.g. Nmap, NetCat, Spiders, OWASP Zed Attack Proxy).

  •  Mapping and Discovery (e.g. Burp Suite with plug-ins)

  •  Exploitation of top OWASP vulnerabilities such as SQL Injection, Cross-site Scripting (XSS), Cross-Site Request Forgery (CSRF) attacks, etc. Experience with tools such as MetaSploit, AppScan or WebInspect.

  •  Knowledge of Threat modeling using PASTA and STRIDE methodology.

  •  Knowledge of OWASP Best practices

  •  Knowledge of OWASP Testing Guide 4.0

  •  Knowledge of OWASP Code Review 2.0

  •  Knowledge of Software Component Verification

 

Sequoia’s Culture – Our most important asset 

  • Integrity 

  • Passion for service 

  • Innovative 

  • Growth oriented 

  • Caring for others 

  • Promise-centric 

  • Focused on relationship building

jobs.descriptionHtml:
Who We Are:

Sequoia is the strategic partner helping investor-backed companies of all sizes achieve their business goals through smarter people spend. With our expert advisory team and integrated platform, we help clients drive business impact through their total comp and benefits, improving executive decision making, controlling costs, protecting the business, and elevating the employee experience. Visit Sequoia.com or follow us on LinkedIn to learn more.

 

Location: Mexico City

 

What You Get to Do:

Sequoia's Information Technology (IT) department is seeking an IT Support Engineer who will be responsible for timely delivery of quality technical support to Sequoia team members. As an IT Support Engineer, you will help manage the ticket queue, perform IT operations, and systems administration for our growing company. You will have the opportunity to impact, learn, and develop through challenging projects and deployment of various technologies while also ensuring excellent service to our Sequoia team members.

  • Work the IT support queue and provide Tier 1 - 2 support to both onsite and remote users.

  • Own org-wide IT asset procurement, distribution, and logistics.

  • Assist managing company spend for endpoints, hardware, and other equipment.

  • Identify, troubleshoot and resolve issues with laptops, multifunction printers, smart phones, tablets, and IT related hardware/software.

  • Software duties include installing, upgrading, and maintaining a suite of software for Windows OS and MacOS systems.

  • Perform Active Directory and Microsoft 365 administration such as account creation, account removal, maintenance, and policies.

  • New hire deployments, laptop imaging and setup including network/email accounts and computer hardware.

  • Provide SaaS telephony and mobile device configuration and troubleshooting.

  • Maintain and update documentation (procedures, diagrams, inventory, and knowledge articles).

  • Lots of opportunities for challenging projects and deployment of new tech.

  • May require occasional work on weekends and/or holidays.

  • Occasional travel between Bay Area and New York office locations.

  • Most importantly, live our Sequoia Values day in and day out.

What You Bring:

  • Bachelor 's degree required, preferably in a technology field.

  • 5 years of experience in an IT support role.

  • Onsite presence, 5 days a week.

  • Experience with endpoint management and deployment solutions

  • Experience with Active Directory and/or Azure AD administration.

  • Experience with both Windows and MacOS platforms.

  • Some experience with SaaS platforms such as Okta, Microsoft 365, Zoom, and more.

  • Strong customer service and communication skills.

  • Ability to handle multiple tasks in a fast-paced environment.

Who We Are:

Visit Sequoia.com or follow us on LinkedIn to learn more.

Location: Mexico City

What You Get to Do:
The Client Analyst is a client-facing role working with our Sequoia Team Members, as well as Finance and HR professionals at some of the most exciting and disruptive technology companies in the world. You will partner with our consulting teams to provide actionable data and strategic insights to shape the future of these companies’ benefit programs. You need to be a well-organized, solutions-driven individual who thrives in keeping up with the demands of our largest and fastest growing clients.

jobs.descriptionHtml:
Who We Are:

Sequoia is the strategic partner helping investor-backed companies of all sizes achieve their business goals through smarter people spend.
