With our expert advisory team and integrated platform, we help clients drive business impact through their total comp and benefits, improving executive decision making, controlling costs, protecting the business, and elevating the employee experience. Visit Sequoia.com or follow us on LinkedIn to learn more.

 

Location: Mexico City

What You Get To Do

We are seeking a Senior Visual Designer to join our creative team, supporting visual storytelling, design systems, and brand consistency across Canopy’s portfolio of brands, including PeopleLoop, Sequoia, Transform, and Semper Virens. In this role, you will concept and execute compelling visual designs, campaign systems, illustrations, and motion graphics that strengthen each brand’s identity while ensuring cohesion across the broader Canopy ecosystem.

This role requires a high level of collaboration with teams across Marketing, UX Design, Product, Web, Communications, and brand stakeholders to translate strategic initiatives into visually cohesive and impactful creative.

An ideal candidate is a strategic thinker with a strong design-systems mindset, a refined visual aesthetic, and deep curiosity about how AI can enhance creative work. You are comfortable using AI tools to accelerate ideation, explore concepts, build workflows, and improve creative output. You know how to lead a project from brief to final delivery, balancing concept development, design quality, and operational rigor across multiple brands.

This role reports directly to the Director of Creative, based in the Mexico City office.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop visual design systems, campaign concepts, illustrations, and motion graphics for web experiences, digital campaigns, landing pages, social media assets, email communications, and other brand touchpoints across Canopy brands.

  • Lead campaign creative from start to finish, from early concepting and art direction through refinement, production, and final quality control.

  • Use AI tools intentionally to support creative exploration, workflow efficiency, content development, and concept iteration.

  • Identify opportunities to strengthen and organize brand systems across PeopleLoop, Sequoia, Transform, and Semper Virens, and turn those opportunities into scalable design solutions.

  • Maintain and elevate visual consistency across all digital channels and brand expressions while respecting each brand’s distinct identity.

  • Partner with cross-functional teams to ensure creative work is aligned to the brief, brand standards, business goals, and project timelines.

  • Participate in visual concepting sessions, contributing innovative ideas aligned with campaign strategies and brand guidelines.

  • Translate strategic and conceptual thinking into polished, high-quality design executions.

  • Help establish effective workflows, shared brand kits, templates, documentation, and operating processes that improve team efficiency and consistency across the Canopy ecosystem.

  • Provide quality control, fine-tuning, and design support across projects to help ensure the team is operating with clarity and excellence.

  • Collaborate with other designers and web partners to produce compelling branded digital experiences.

  • Stay current on design trends, AI tools, and best practices in branding, digital, and interactive media.

  • Support branded collateral and collateral systems, including one-pagers, whitepapers, presentations, storyboards, and other marketing assets.

  • Attend team meetings and calls and be an effective contributor to team initiatives.

  • Effectively plan and communicate regarding deadlines, bandwidth, project requirements, and handoffs to facilitate collaboration within the broader marketing team.

  • Commit to sustaining company values and key organizational goals.

What You Bring

  • 7+ years of experience in visual design, branding, and digital marketing design, preferably within B2B brands or companies. Experience on both the agency and business side is highly desirable.

  • A portfolio that demonstrates strong conceptual thinking, art direction, design systems thinking, and polished execution across multiple formats and channels.

  • Demonstrated experience using AI tools in the creative process, with examples of workflows, experimentation, or outputs that show real-world application and impact.

  • Strong ability to think strategically about brand systems and identify areas of opportunity across a multi-brand environment.

  • Proven ability to lead campaigns and creative projects from concept to completion, with strong judgment around quality, consistency, and refinement.

  • Excellent typographic and layout skills.

  • Examples of how you incorporate illustrations, patterns, iconography, vector art elements, and other visual devices into flexible systems.

  • Fluency in both print and digital design.

  • Ability to articulate the strategy behind your design approach and explain creative decisions clearly.

  • Ability to pair design styles appropriately to audience and context.

  • Nice to have: motion design experience, event/environmental design experience, illustration experience, and experience building AI-assisted creative workflows or design systems.

What We Want to See in Your Portfolio

  • Strong evidence of concept development and art direction, not just production execution.

  • Examples of design systems applied across a wide range of deliverables and channels.

  • Creative application of design to a corporate marketing campaign, launch, or event.

  • Examples of how you’ve used AI to support ideation, workflow efficiency, or creative problem-solving.

  • Work that shows you can manage quality, consistency, and final polish across a project lifecycle.

  • A mix of B2B and B2C examples across a variety of industries is ideal.

  • Personal side projects are welcome, but the majority of your portfolio should focus on relevant brand work delivered for corporate clients.

Tools You’ll Need to Work In Every Day

  • Adobe Creative Suite, particularly Illustrator, InDesign, and Photoshop

  • Canva for building out marketing and social media asset templates

  • Figma for precise digital layouts and systems

  • Microsoft suite of tools including Word and PowerPoint

  • Comfort using AI tools for concepting, workflow development, and creative production support

Who You’ll Report To

Director of Creative, Mexico City

Your Key Collaborators

Brand experience director, marketing leadership, demand gen team, and key organizational stakeholders and functional team leaders.

Location

Hybrid, Mexico City. 3 days onsite per week required.

Language

English Business-level fluency required.

Sequoia’s Culture – Our most important asset 

  • Integrity 

  • Passion for service 

  • Innovative 

  • Growth oriented 

  • Caring for others 

  • Promise-centric 

  • Focused on relationship building 

Sequoia provides equal opportunity to all applicants without regard to race, color, creed, religion, citizenship, national origin, age, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, pregnancy, marital status, military or veteran status, disability, or any other basis prohibited by applicable law.

Compensation & Benefits
Sequoia provides competitive compensation including base salary, performance-based bonus programs, and comprehensive benefits package.

Sequoia’s Candidate Privacy Policy 

https://www.sequoia.com/legal/candidate-privacy-policy/

jobs.descriptionHtml:
Who We Are:

Sequoia is the strategic partner helping investor-backed companies of all sizes achieve their business goals through smarter people spend. For 24 years, we’ve guided the most innovative employers to navigate growth and get the most out of their global people investment. With our expert advisory team and integrated platform, we help clients drive business impact through their total comp and benefits, improving executive decision making, controlling costs, protecting the business, and elevating the employee experience. Visit Sequoia.com or follow us on LinkedIn to learn more.

This job is located in Tempe, Arizona and you must be able to commute into the office.

What You Get to Do:

The Payroll Tax Coordinator is responsible for maintaining an efficient and accurate tax payment and filing operation. Sequoia One is our newest service offering, providing HR outsourcing to help tech startups grow quickly and safely.

  • Manage incoming tax correspondence received via email, US mail, DocuSign, RightSignature, etc. in a timely manner.

  • Support tax notice resolution by uploading documents to cases, routing documents to appropriate internal teams, and properly categorizing these requests.

  • Support Payroll Tax Specialists by submitting tax documents to agencies for processing. Interface with various tax agencies to follow up on requests, obtain new account information, and help with different problem resolution activities.

  • Support new client location processing and assist with maintaining client payroll tax account information in our systems. (PrismHR, MasterTax ADP SmartCompliance, Salesforce, etc.)

  • Assist with compliance related reporting tasks for quarter-end, year-end, and other required frequencies.

  • Additional projects and tasks assigned on an as needed basis.


What You Bring:

  • 3+ years of client service or administrative experience

  • Preferred experience in a multi-client payroll tax processing setting PEO, insurance, or start-up experience is highly desirable

  • Attention to detail, organized, and thorough with a desire for continuous improvement

  • Excellent analytical, organizational, and communication skills

  • Ability to prioritize workload and perform in a fast-paced environment

  • Strong spread sheeting and analytical skills

  • Hands-on, team player who possesses a can-do attitude

  • Experience with PrismHR, MasterTax, ADP SmartCompliance, Salesforce is a plus

Sol is an agentic HR system built for how work is changing. We're replacing the traditional HRIS with an AI-native foundation. We are built for change, designed to scale, and reimagined with AI from the ground up, so HR leaders get a clear view of their workforce instead of a system everyone works around.

At Sol, we're guided by three things: people: we hire driven, humble people and build to amplify their potential and our customers'; imagination: we challenge assumptions about our industry and how software gets built, then move fast once we've decided; and durability: we sweat the details to build a company that is meant to last. Day to day, that shows up as a bias toward writing things down over meetings, async communication by default, and flexible hours that respect how differently everyone works. We try new things, kill what isn't working, and hold a high bar without the politics or ego that slow good decisions down.

Sol was founded by leaders who spent decades building the modern HR category, and is backed by Sutter Hill Ventures and NEA. Our first customers go live in early 2027 and we need you to make them wildly successful.

The Role

Most HR systems treat payroll as an endpoint. At Sol, it's key to how the full picture of employment comes together. Compensation, time off, leave, equity, benefits -- today those live in disconnected systems without connective tissue. Sol is built to hold all of it. Getting payroll right means earning employee trust.

We're hiring a Product Architect, Payroll to own how Sol thinks about, models, and executes pay. The right person has been a product manager at a payroll company or a payroll administrator with deep product knowledge. They know the domain at depth: multi-state complexity, garnishment sequencing, equity treatment, off-cycle edge cases, the compliance landmines that have humbled better engineers than them. They're proud of that knowledge. And they're probably ready to do something with it that their current system won't let them.

One of Sol's core values is imagination -- the conviction that payroll doesn't have to work the way it always has. AI and new technologies are opening up design possibilities that weren't available before. We're looking for someone who can hold deep payroll expertise and still ask "why does it work this way?" and genuinely mean it.

At Sol, this role owns the payroll domain and shapes how it's built. That means defining the data model, the compliance architecture, and how payroll connects to every other employment event across a worker's lifecycle -- compensation changes, leave, time off, equity vesting, benefits deductions. You're not inheriting an engine. You're designing one, in close partnership with engineering and informed by real customer complexity from day one.

What You'll Do

  • Own the payroll domain at Sol -- be the person in the room who knows how pay actually works and what breaks when it doesn't

  • Write payroll product specs that translate real-world complexity -- multi-state, garnishments, equity treatment, off-cycle runs, benefits deductions -- into requirements engineering can build against

  • Partner with engineering on payroll architecture decisions -- you're not handing off requirements, you're co-designing

  • Work directly with design partners to pressure-test payroll assumptions against real customer complexity before anything ships

  • Stay ahead of the compliance landscape and translate regulatory requirements into product constraints, not afterthoughts

  • Roll up your sleeves on early customer work while the payroll engine matures -- and bring back what you learn

What We're Looking For

  • You've been a product manager with payroll as your primary domain at a company where payroll was core

  • You understand payroll complexity at the detail level: multi-state, garnishments, equity treatment, benefits deductions, off-cycle runs, multi-worker-type variation

  • You can hold the compliance dimension without outsourcing it -- you know when something is a product decision and when it's a regulatory constraint

  • You think in data models and systems, not just features -- you care about what belongs at the platform level vs. what belongs in configuration

  • You write structured product specs that engineering can build against, not just PRDs that document what already exists

  • You're comfortable in early-stage ambiguity -- there's no existing payroll codebase to maintain or inherit. You're here to define it.

  • You're genuinely excited about what AI and new technologies can enable in payroll -- faster compliance, smarter modeling, real-time visibility -- and you want to help build that future, not just observe it

Bonus if you have:

  • Exposure to payroll-adjacent domains: benefits administration, equity management, or time and attendance

  • Experience with non-US payroll (we're US-first, but thinking globally early matters)

  • A technical background that helps you reason about calculation engines, compliance rules, and configuration boundaries

Why Now

Payroll is the most compliance-critical, trust-sensitive domain in HR -- and it's been too long since someone reimagined the space. Most payroll systems today are calculation engines built decades ago, patched for compliance, and bolted awkwardly onto everything else.

Sol is building an AI-native HRIS from scratch. Payroll is a core domain, not a bolt-on, not a future integration, not something we'll get to eventually. This role exists to make sure we get the foundation right before we build on top of it.

You'd join early enough to define that foundation. The data model, the compliance architecture, the way payroll connects to every employment event across a worker's lifecycle -- that's yours to design. Few roles at a company this early offer domain work this deep.

Compensation and Benefits

  • Base Range: $200-250k and significant early-stage equity

  • Premium medical, dental, and vision coverage, with plan choices through Kaiser and Aetna

  • Mental health support (Talkspace), fertility and family-building care (Kindbody), and virtual or same-day primary care (Teladoc, One Medical)

  • Pre-tax FSA and dependent care accounts

  • Company-paid life and disability insurance

  • 401(k) through Empower

  • Untracked paid time off and company holidays

Sol is an equal opportunity employer. We don't discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, marital status, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law. We're committed to building an inclusive workplace and providing reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities.

The Role

You'll build Sol's product surface end to end — from backend services and APIs to the modern, AI-native interfaces our customers use. The product is early and the surface area is wide: you'll regularly ship features that span data model to UI, working closely with the founding team and our domain architects.

What You'll Do

  • Build product features across the stack: Kotlin/JVM backend services, APIs, and the frontend experiences they power

  • Build dynamic, data-driven interfaces that adapt to each customer rather than static layouts

  • Build conversational and agent-mediated experiences alongside traditional enterprise UI

  • Contribute to the component and API patterns the product scales on

  • Move fast with AI-assisted development as a first-class part of how we build

What We're Looking For

  • You have deep backend experience in Kotlin or Java — services, APIs, and data models that hold up in production — and you design for composition, not one-off use

  • You understand your tools below the surface: JVM behavior, concurrency, data access patterns, where performance actually goes to die

  • You're comfortable crossing into the frontend — working TypeScript familiarity and the willingness to ship UI, not just hand off an API

  • You want breadth — features that run from data model to pixels — and the ambiguity that comes with shaping an early product

  • You use AI coding tools daily and have developed real fluency with them — this is how we work, not an experiment

  • You're scrappy, curious, and want the ownership that comes with an early team

Why Now

The product is at the stage where one engineer's work is visible everywhere: the patterns you establish this year are the ones thousands of enterprise users will live in. You'd be building a new kind of enterprise interface with a team that has done the enterprise part before and is rethinking the rest.

 

Compensation and Benefits

  • Base Range: $200-300k and significant early-stage equity

  • Premium medical, dental, and vision coverage, with plan choices through Kaiser and Aetna

  • Mental health support (Talkspace), fertility and family-building care (Kindbody), and virtual or same-day primary care (Teladoc, One Medical)

  • Pre-tax FSA and dependent care accounts

  • Company-paid life and disability insurance

jobs.title: Chief of Staff & Business Operations
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Sound Ventures

At Sound, we believe inspiration beats convention, and that the best founders aren’t just solving problems; they’re rewriting the rules.

For the last 15 years, we’ve invested thematically in category-defining companies at the forefront of major technology platform shifts. We seek out founders with relentless ambition and bold ideas, backing them before the rest of the world sees what’s coming.

Our portfolio includes early investments in Affirm, Airbnb, Airtable, Anthropic, Duolingo, EquipmentShare, GitLab, OpenAI, SentinelOne, and Uber, among others.

Sound Ventures is led by General Partners Effie Epstein and Guy Oseary and manages $2B+ across a series of funds.

The Role

We're looking for a force-multiplier — someone who sits at the intersection of Chief of Staff and Business Operations and makes the entire team more effective. This role doesn't fit neatly into a job description because the work won't either. You'll own high-priority initiatives, drive operational rigor, and serve as a trusted thought partner to firm leadership and founders.

The defining requirement: you must be genuinely AI-native. Not AI-curious — AI-proficient. You deploy AI tools daily to do the work of multiple people, identify where AI can unlock leverage across the firm, and help us build a culture where that's the norm, not the exception.

What You'll Do

• Serve as a strategic partner across the firm — managing priorities, preparing for key meetings, and ensuring nothing falls through the cracks.

• Lead cross-functional projects that cut across investing, portfolio support, marketing, incubations, and finance

• Build internal AI-powered processes to own the operating cadence: team rhythms, firm-wide communications, and follow-through on key decisions.

• Identify and implement AI tools and workflows that meaningfully increase the team's leverage and output quality.

• Identify operational bottlenecks and design solutions before they become problems.

• Stay at the frontier of what's possible and bring those capabilities to the firm before we know we need them.

What We're Looking For

• 5–7 years of experience in venture capital, investment banking, management consulting, or a high-growth startup in a strategy or operations role

• Demonstrably AI-native: you use AI tools as a core part of your daily workflow and can show your work.

• Exceptional written and verbal communicator — you can distill complex ideas crisply and confidently

• A builder's mindset: you don't wait for systems to exist, you create them.

• High emotional intelligence and the judgment to navigate conversations across the organization, as well as with founders, LPs, and partners.

• Comfort operating in ambiguity — this role will evolve and you'll help define it.

• Low ego, high ownership. You're equally comfortable setting the strategy and executing the details as part of a small team

Nice to Have

• Prior experience in venture capital or working directly with a GP or founder.

• A Marketer’s mindset We are a Marketing-leaning firm that thinks and works creatively.

Location & Compensation

This job is based in Los Angeles, CA. Potential for LA/SF hybrid. Competitive salary, carry eligibility, and benefits commensurate with experience.

jobs.title: Marketing Manager
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Sound Ventures

At Sound, we believe inspiration beats convention, and that the best founders aren’t just solving problems; they’re rewriting the rules.

For the last 15 years, we've invested thematically in category-defining companies at the forefront of major technology platform shifts. We seek out founders with relentless ambition and bold ideas, backing them before the rest of the world sees what's coming.

Our portfolio includes early investments in Affirm, Airbnb, Airtable, Anthropic, Duolingo, EquipmentShare, GitLab, OpenAI, SentinelOne, and Uber, among others.

Sound Ventures is led by General Partners Effie Epstein and Guy Oseary and manages $2B+ across a series of funds.

The Role

We're looking for a Marketing Manager who thrives on variety. This is a role for someone who loves solving different marketing challenges every day rather than specializing in a single function.

This isn't a role where you'll own one channel or one vertical. Instead, you'll work across nearly every aspect of marketing – helping build the Sound brand, supporting our portfolio companies, and partnering on incubation projects as new companies come to life.

One day you might be planning a founder dinner, building a presentation, or preparing for a conference. The next, you could be conducting a brand audit on a prospective investment, helping shape messaging for a portfolio company, or developing positioning for an incubated startup.

We're a lean team, so everyone wears multiple hats. The right person is excited to flex different marketing muscles – from brand, product, and event marketing to communications, storytelling, operations, and creative strategy – and is equally comfortable thinking strategically and jumping in to execute.

What You'll Do

  • Support marketing initiatives across the Sound brand, including presentations, events, digital marketing, content, and marketing operations.

  • Help plan and execute founder dinners, LP events, conferences, and other community-building experiences.

  • Support our portfolio marketing efforts by preparing for founder engagements, conducting brand and messaging audits, researching competitive landscapes, and developing strategic recommendations.

  • Partner with our incubation team on positioning, go-to-market strategy, messaging, creative development, and early marketing initiatives.

  • Create high-quality presentations and other marketing assets.

  • Coordinate with external agencies, designers, PR partners, and other creative vendors.

  • Jump into high-priority marketing projects wherever they're needed and help move them from idea to execution.

  • Continuously identify ways to improve how marketing operates across the firm and our portfolio.

Who You Are

  • 5-7 years of marketing experience preferably at a startup, agency, venture firm, or high-growth company.

  • Curious, resourceful, and excited by technology, with AI as part of your daily workflow.

  • Great communicator and storyteller.

  • Comfortable wearing many hats across different marketing disciplines.

  • High ownership, low ego, and thrives in ambiguity.

  • Open to LA-based, with some travel

Why Sound

  • Work alongside founders building category-defining companies.

  • Gain exposure to every dimension of marketing – from brand and communications to product marketing, events, strategy, and company building.

  • Join a lean, collaborative team where you'll have meaningful ownership from day one.

  • Help shape both the Sound Ventures brand and the next generation of AI companies.
